title: Italian Garlic Bread

ingredients.rawText: 1 loaf French bread or sourdough, cut in half lengthwise in 6-inch sections

instructions: Melt butter and mix in equal amount of garlic juice with melted butter.
Lightly toast bread.
Spread melted butter-garlic juice mix on bread.
Again, lightly toast until butter & garlic juice combination are slightly bubbly. Serve warm.
P.S. Don't forget to add garlic juice to your pasta sauce, too!
notes: Alternate method: Spray bread with garlic juice, toast lightly, then spread butter and toast until melted into bread.

title: Bruschetta Classica

ingredients.rawText: 4 slices thick-crusted Italian country bread (about 1 cm thick)
Whole small dry red peppers, spicy (optional)

instructions: Preheat oven, broiler, toaster, or light up a charcoal fire.
Grill the bread on both sides until golden brown.
Lightly rub the garlic on the surface of the bread.
If you like, you may also lightly rub the red pepper over the bread.
Pour a thin stream of olive oil on the bread, and sprinkle with salt. Serve while still warm.
notes: A classic Italian antipasto staple. Always rub the garlic immediately after grilling while the bread is still hot.

title: Bruschetta al Pomodoro

ingredients.rawText: 4 slices thick-crusted Italian country bread (about 1 cm thick)

instructions: In a bowl mix tomato, basil, extra-virgin olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Preheat oven, broiler, toaster, or light up a charcoal fire.
Grill the bread on both sides until golden brown.
Lightly rub the garlic on the surface of the bread.
Distribute tomato uniformly on bread slices and serve warm.
notes: Ripe, sweet garden tomatoes yield the most flavourful topping.

title: Muffaletta Sandwiches

ingredients.rawText: 1 15-inch loaf French bread or Sicilian round crusty loaf

instructions: Cut bread in half horizontally.
Spread generous layers of olive salad on both halves.
Layer salami, mortadella, prosciutto cotto, and provolone cheese.
Press halves firmly together, wrap tightly and chill before slicing into hearty wedges.
notes: Muffaletta is a type of Sicilian bread with a hollow center. Olive salad can be prepared several days ahead.

title: Mini Muffalata

ingredients.rawText: 1 package soft goat cheese (4.5 oz / 140 g)
Freshly ground black pepper and salt to taste

instructions: Mix goat cheese, olive oil, and garlic together. Season and set aside.
Cut baguette in 1/2 lengthwise. Pull out centre, leaving a thin crust border.
Spread both halves with olive paste, top with pieces of red pepper.
Place basil on top half and spread goat cheese on bottom half.
Sandwich together, wrap tightly in plastic wrap. Chill before serving.
Cut off ends and slice into 1/2 inch rounds to serve.
notes: Perfect finger food for parties and family gatherings.

title: Hot Mushroom Turnovers

ingredients.rawText: 3 packages (3 oz each) cream cheese, softened

instructions: In medium bowl, mix cream cheese, 1 1/2 cups flour, and 1/2 cup butter. Wrap dough; chill for 1 hour.
In a 10-inch skillet over medium heat, combine 3 tbsp butter, mushrooms, and onion until tender.
Add salt, thyme, and 2 tbsp flour until blended. Stir in sour cream.
On floured surface, roll out 1/2 dough; with cookie cutter cut out 20 (2 3/4 inch) circles.
On half of each circle put a tsp of mushroom mixture. Brush edges with beaten egg.
Fold dough over filling; with fork press edges together. Prick tops. Place on ungreased cookie sheets. Brush with egg.
Cover and chill for 25 minutes.
Preheat oven to 450°F. Bake for 12 minutes until golden.
notes: Rich and savory pastry with a velvety mushroom filling.

title: Pumpernickel Bread Bowl Dip
instructions: Cut top off from large pumpernickel bread. Core out the inside and cut into 1" cubes. Place cubes in plastic bag.
Ingredients for dip: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Put mixture into bread bowl.
Cover with saran wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve.
Serve with bread cubes placed around the bread bowl.
notes: Margaret V.

title: Russian Sandwich
instructions: Slightly wet slices of rye bread and fry them in vegetable oil.
Mix coarsely grated boiled beet with crushed garlic and mayonnaise.
Put the mixture over the bread slices.

title: Tortilla Roll-Ups

ingredients.rawText: 2 tbsp red bell pepper, finely chopped 12 flour tortillas

instructions: In a medium bowl combine cream cheese, sour cream, chillies, onion, red bell pepper, and cheddar cheese and mix.
Spread onto tortillas and roll up.
Cover tightly and chill for 2 hours or overnight.
When ready to serve, cut each roll into 1/2 inch slices.
Serve with salsa or picante sauce.

title: Vegetable Sandwich Mosaic
instructions: Peel the vegetables, rinse and slice in thin rings.
Make a general dressing: place curds/cottage cheese in an enamel bowl gradually adding soured cream and mayonnaise and rubbing until the mixture is even.
Cover the vegetable slices with the general dressing.
Put greens and fresh or canned berries over the slices and serve.
Decorate the slices using a cooking syringe filled with the dressing.

title: Brie Cheese Dip
instructions: Unwrap brie and place in centre of round pan
Pour jelly over top
Bake for 25-35 minutes
Slice baguettes and enjoy!

title: Brie Cheese with Cranberries and Pecans

ingredients.rawText: ¼ cup whole berry cranberry sauce or preserves

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Spread cranberry sauce over Brie, combine pecans and maple syrup and spread on top.
Place on a parchment lined pan and bake 14-17 minutes or until cheese is starting to melt. Remove from oven and cool at least 10 minutes.
Serve with crackers.

title: Cheese Balls or Log
instructions: Mix and roll into 1 large or 2 small balls or logs.
Refrigerate or freeze.

title: Cheez Whiz Salsa Dip

ingredients.rawText: 2 cups Cheez Whiz Processed Cheese, 250 ml (1 cup)

instructions: Mix Cheez Whiz and salsa in medium microwaveable bowl.
Microwave on medium 5 minutes or until Cheez Whiz is melted, stirring after 3 minutes.
Serve hot with assorted cut-up vegetables or tortilla chips.

title: Delicious Cheese Ball

ingredients.rawText: Something different for an appetizer perhaps…
250 grams of Black Forest Ham (or oven-roasted turkey breast)

instructions: Mix first 5 ingredients together. Form a ball.
Put parsley on wax paper and roll cheese ball into it.
Roll cheese ball in nuts (or pat/sprinkle them on).
Serve chilled with crackers… yummy.

title: Fig and Goat Cheese Crostini

ingredients.rawText: 1/4 lb dried Black Mission figs, finely chopped (3/4 cup)
6 oz soft mild goat cheese (room temperature)
2 fresh ripe figs, cut into 1/2-inch pieces

instructions: Cook shallot, thyme sprigs, and bay leaf in butter in a saucepan over medium-low heat until softened, about 2 minutes.
Add dried figs, Port, salt, and pepper and bring to a boil. Simmer covered until figs are soft, about 10 minutes.
Remove lid and simmer until most liquid evaporates (3-4 mins). Discard bay leaf and thyme; stir in minced thyme.
Preheat oven to 350°F. Arrange baguette slices on baking sheet, brush lightly with olive oil, and bake 7 minutes.
Spread each toast with 1 tsp fig jam and top with 1 1/2 tsp goat cheese and 2 pieces of fresh fig.
notes: Fig jam can be made 1 day ahead and chilled covered.

title: Ham and Cheese Roll Ups

ingredients.rawText: ¼ lb cream cheese, room temperature

instructions: Take cream cheese and mix in green relish to spread easily.
Spread over 6 slices of cooked ham.
Roll up and refrigerate in plastic bags to keep fresh until serving.
Cut bite size slices and put on plate with coloured toothpicks in each piece. Makes 30 bite size pieces

title: Nacho Dip Recipe
instructions: One each red and green pepper, shredded cheese
(“Old El Paso” comes in Mild, Medium or Hot…Take your pick)
Prepare in a flat deep dish
Mix sour and cream cheese together and line bottom of the dish with it
Put a layer of “Old El Paso” salsa on top of the sour and cream cheese
Dice tomatoes and sprinkle on top of salsa
Dice one red and one green bell pepper and sprinkle on top of tomatoes
Top with shredded cheese
Serve with Nacho chips and ENJOY

title: Nordica Cottage Cheese Dip
instructions: Purée cottage cheese and yogurt
Add all the remaining ingredients and mix well until blended
Serve with sliced raw vegetables

title: Fried Spicy Parmesan Balls

ingredients.rawText: 4 tbsp fresh Parmigiano Reggiano, freshly grated

instructions: Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry.
Gradually add the Parmigiano Reggiano, pinch of salt, and half the paprika while continuing to beat.
In a heavy Dutch oven or deep fryer, heat oil to 360°F.
With a teaspoon, drop little mounds of the batter into the hot oil.
Fry until light golden brown.
Remove with a slotted spoon onto absorbent paper towels.
Sprinkle with remaining paprika and toss well before serving.
notes: Airy, crispy, cheesy bites with a gentle kick of paprika.

title: Fantastic Mexican Dip

ingredients.rawText: 1 (2 oz) can sliced black olives, drained

instructions: Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir ground beef in the hot skillet until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes; drain. Stir in taco sauce and set aside.
Mix together sour cream, cream cheese, and taco seasoning in a large bowl until well combined; spread onto the bottom of a medium serving dish.
Cover sour cream mixture with beef mixture, Cheddar cheese, and lettuce. Top with tomato, green onions, and black olives.
notes: Cream cheese at the base of the dip makes it extra thick and scoopable. Seasoned beef and vegetables make it extra filling and tasty. You may want to prepare two batches. Serve with tortilla chips.

title: Nacho Beef Dip

ingredients.rawText: 1 jar (15 to 16 oz) cheese dip with salsa (salsa con queso) or other cheese
ingredients.normalizedName: cheese dip with salsa other cheese

ingredients.rawText: ½ cup thick-and-chunky mild or medium salsa

instructions: Toppings: Blue, yellow and/or white corn tortilla chips (optional) Diced red bell pepper, thinly sliced green onions, sliced ripe olives (optional)
Heat nonstick skillet over medium heat until hot.
Add ground beef; cook 8 to 10 minutes, breaking into 3/4-inch crumbles and stirring occasionally.
Add cheese dip and salsa; cook and stir about 3 minutes or until mixture is heated through.
Ground beef should be cooked to an internal temperature of 160°F. Color is not a reliable indicator of ground beef doneness.
Pour beef mixture into shallow serving dish. Serve with tortilla chips for dipping. Garnish with toppings, if desired.
notes: Try this dip with tortilla chips or veggie strips.

title: Party Pork Balls Appetizer

ingredients.rawText: 1 tsp fresh or preserved ginger, minced 1 tbsp soy sauce

instructions: Combine pork, water chestnuts, onions, ginger, salt, soy sauce, egg and bread crumbs in a large bowl; mix well. Shape into 36 balls. Roll in cornstarch to coat lightly, shaking off excess
Brown in oil in a large skillet. Remove balls as they brown to a roasting pan; cover loosely with foil
Bake in a moderate oven (350ºF) for 20 minutes, or until thoroughly cooked. Combine with Sweet and Sour Sauce.

title: Sweet and Sour Sauce
instructions: Sauté peppers and carrots in oil in large saucepan until tender, 3 min.
Add pineapple juice & chunks, vinegar, soy sauce, sugar, broth & ginger
Combine cornstarch with 1/3 cup water in a cup; stir into saucepan
Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens.

title: Ground Chicken or Beef Croquettes

ingredients.rawText: 3 tbsp coriander leaves, finely chopped 1 lb lean ground beef

instructions: Cook ground meat (no water required) on moderate heat with fresh cut ingredients (except mint and coriander leaves) until well cooked and dry.
Grind salt and allspice powder and add to wet mixture.
Add chopped mint, coriander leaves and eggs; mix well.
Shape into croquettes; roll in breadcrumbs and deep fry until golden brown. Drain on paper towel; serve with lemon wedges.

title: Crab Dip

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 can cream of mushroom soup, heated

instructions: Mix all above ingredients until well blended and refrigerate.
Form into a ball.
May be rolled in chopped walnuts or other nuts. Serve with crackers.

title: Creamy Crab/Tuna Delights

ingredients.rawText: 6 oz crabmeat or tuna drained and flake

instructions: Use a medium size cup to cut circles out of the bread.
One circle per slice. Keep crust for stuffing and freeze.
Brush melted butter on all sides of the bread.
Press bread gently into individual muffin tins.
Make dainty cups with a petal effect.
Bake shells in hot oven (425 ° F) for 15 minutes.
Filling: Melt butter until bubbly. Add flour to form smooth paste.
Stir in milk and cook until thick.
Add cheese and stir until melted.
Add other ingredients one at a time stirring after each addition.
Spoon into shells and serve.
Freeze by putting shells on cookie tray and freeze individually. When frozen put in covered container. To reheat put in preheated 325 ° F oven on a shallow pan and cook 15 minutes.

title: Salmon Ball

ingredients.rawText: 2 - 7 1/2 oz canned pink or red salmon 1 tbsp lemon juice
ingredients.normalizedName: canned pink red salmon lemon juice

instructions: Drain salmon and mash in a small bowl.
Cream cheese in a large bowl.
Add lemon juice, grated onion, horseradish, salt, Worcestershire sauce and hot pepper sauce to cream cheese and mix well.
Add salmon to mixture.
Refrigerate for a few hours or overnight.
Mold into a flattened ball.
Mix walnuts and parsley on waxed paper and cover ball.
Serve with crackers.

title: Salmon Dip
instructions: Mix all above ingredients until well blended and refrigerate.
After a few hours form into a ball.
Roll ball in parsley.
Serve with crackers.

title: Tuna Dill Rounds
instructions: Using round cookie cutter cut out bread rounds; spread with mayonnaise.
Top with a slice of cucumber.
Chop leftover cucumber.
In a small bowl mix chopped cucumber, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, tuna and next 4 ingredients.
Spoon onto each round; top with pimento.

title: Artichoke Hearts Dip

ingredients.rawText: An excellent dip with crackers or corn chips.
ingredients.normalizedName: excellent dip with crackers corn chips

instructions: (1) 15-oz can artichoke hearts (in water), chopped 1 cup cheddar cheese, grated 1/2 tsp garlic 1/3 cup Parmesan cheese 1/2 to ¾ cup mayonnaise
Mix all ingredients together.
Place in ovenproof baking dish.
Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 350ºF. Serve warm.

title: Hot Artichoke Parmesan Dip Kraft
instructions: Preheat oven to 180ºC. (350ºF)
Mix all ingredients until blended well.
Spoon into 23 cm (9inch) pie plate.
Bake 15 minutes or until hot and bubbly.

title: Homemade Traditional Hummus

ingredients.rawText: 1 can (15 oz) garbanzo beans (chickpeas), drained and rinsed

instructions: Add garbanzo beans, 2 tbsp water, olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, and 1/4 tsp salt to a food processor.
Process until smooth and creamy.
If needed, add additional water to thin out hummus and salt to taste.
Store covered in the refrigerator and drizzle with olive oil before serving.
notes: Silky smooth chickpea spread that pairs wonderfully with crusty bread.

title: Onion Soup Dip
instructions: Combine above ingredients. Makes 2 cups (500 ml) dip
notes: a. Cheesy Onion Dip: Add 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese b. Skinny Dip: Replace 1 cup sour cream with 1 cup plain yogurt c. Zesty Dip: Add 4 tbsp pickle relish, 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce to dip

title: Spinach and Artichoke Dip
italianTitle: Salsa Calda di Spinaci e Carciofi

ingredients.rawText: 2 packages (10 oz each) chopped frozen spinach, thawed and drained
2 cans (8 oz each) quartered artichoke hearts, drained
1 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp white pepper

instructions: In large frying pan, sauté shallots and garlic in butter at medium heat.
Add well-drained spinach and artichokes and cook at low heat briefly.
Add cream, garlic herb cheese, salt, and pepper.
Simmer until cheese is melted and mixture is blended.
Remove from heat, and fold in the grated Parmesan cheese.
Place on serving platter. Serve warm with tortilla chips, pita chips, or crackers.
notes: Extremely popular for family celebrations and holiday buffets.

title: Frank's Wine Making

ingredients.rawText: 1 (4 gallon) pail of Moscato (must or mosto)
2 (4 gallon) pails of Ruby Cabernet (must or mosto)
Glass demijohns, airlocks, siphon tubing, and corks

instructions: Ensure temperature is between 68–75°F. Open pails of mosto at home and stir thoroughly. Keep for 3-5 days in pails.
Wash and sterilize demijohns thoroughly with sterilizer solution.
Using plastic tubing, siphon mosto from pails into sanitized demijohns without disturbing sediment.
Keep demijohns full to about 5-6 inches from top to allow expansion; fit with airlocks.
First Racking (4 weeks): Siphon wine into clean demijohn using tube with spacer stick so sludge is left behind. Add antioxidant. Fit airlocks.
Second Racking (8 weeks): Repeat siphoning process until wine is clear.
Siphon clear wine into clean glass bottles leaving headspace for corks. Store upright at 55°F.
Red wine should be aged for one year; white wine is ready to drink after six months.
notes: The cantina winemaking craft passed down from Antonio Ruffolo to his son Frank.
originalPhotoCaption: Frank pouring his home made wine into gallons in the cantina

title: Planters’ Punch
instructions: Mix and place in tall glass and serve with straws

title: Singapore Sling
instructions: Mix and place in tall glass and serve with straw

title: The Americano
instructions: Topped with club soda, ginger ale, and garnish with lemon peel.
notes: Ordered by James Bond in the first 007 film Casino Royale.

title: The Milano Torino
instructions: Pour over ice and garnish with orange and lemon peel.

title: Champagne Rose Punch

ingredients.rawText: 2 pkg (10 oz each) frozen, sweetened strawberries, thawed
2 bottles (4/5 qt. each) rose wine, chilled
6 oz can frozen concentrated lemonade, thawed
4/5 qt. bottle (3 ¼ cups) champagne, chilled

instructions: In large bowl, combine strawberries and one 4/5 qt rose wine
Cover, let stand at room temperature for 1 hour
Press strawberry mixture through strainer into punch bowl or 3 quart container, add lemonade, remaining rose wine, champagne and ice; mix well. Serve immediately.

title: Mimosa Champagne Orange Juice
notes: Mimosa is a kind of plant that has lovely yellow flowers. The colour of a mimosa drink, usually made with equal parts orange juice and champagne (or other sparkling wines), is said to resemble the plant's colour, hence the name. A mimosa is generally considered a brunch drink. However, since the mimosa cocktail is light on alcohol, it makes a great anytime drink!

title: Energizing Morning Shake!

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup of frozen fruit (blueberries work best)

instructions: Blend until smooth.
This high protein drink will keep you going all morning with plenty of energy.
Kids love it too because it tastes so good! You can substitute whey powder for peanut butter for extra protein.

title: Cranberry/Strawberry Christmas Punch
instructions: Blend all ingredients above until smooth. Pour into punch bowl
Then add ingredients below: 5 1/2 cups cranberry juice 1/3 cup orange juice Fizz (sprite, soda, etc.)
notes: Sandy V.

title: Icy Mocha Frappé
instructions: Place coffee in refrigerator for 1 hour to cool.
Chill 4 drinking glasses in freezer.
Using a blender combine all ingredients; pulse until mixture becomes a slush and well blended.
Pour frappe into glasses; serve at once with spoons and straws. Makes 4 servings.

title: Tropical Punch
instructions: Combine punch and frozen concentrate with water.
Pour over ice in a large punch bowl. Carefully pour in ginger ale. Serves 30 to 35 people. Note: Use an ice ring with orange slices and fresh mint leaves frozen in it.
notes: Margaret V.

title: Hot Cranberry Cocktail
instructions: Empty top three items into large pot and bring to rolling boil
Turn to simmer and add rum to taste
Let everything steep to acquire the flavour. Serves up to 50 people
notes: Sandy V.

title: Apple Tea Toddy

ingredients.rawText: 8 tbsp of apple puree (see Apple Butter recipe above or store bought)
1 pint of decanted, pre-brewed black tea of choice

instructions: In a large saucepan over medium heat, combine the apple puree and the decanted tea; bring to a boil.
Add sugar or honey and stir until dissolved. Remove from heat. Add liquor, if desired. Makes 4 servings

title: Meat Broth

ingredients.rawText: 2 lbs (1 kg) meat for broth, cut in large chunks (beef bones, turkey, chicken)

instructions: Place the meats in a large stockpot and fill the pot with cold water.
Stick the cloves on the surface of the onion.
Add into the pot the onion, carrot, celery, parsley, tomato, peppercorns, and bay leaf. Season with nutmeg and salt.
Bring water to a boil. When boiling, skim away the foam that forms on surface with a slotted spoon. Cook until meat is tender.
Remove meat and set aside for another dish.
Filter broth through a fine strainer to clarify it. Let cool at room temperature.
When cold, skim off the solidified surface fat. Use as base for soups, risotto, tortellini, or pasta.
notes: The golden foundation of traditional Italian holiday soups and risotto.

title: Serbian Goulash Broth
instructions: Add all ingredients to an eight quart stockpot.
Stir and bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for one hour, stirring occasionally.
notes: Goulash is a spicy broth that can be served with cornbread or over mashed potatoes. A dry red wine such as Chianti or merlot goes well with this dish.

title: Chicken Soup

ingredients.rawText: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs
ingredients.normalizedName: 1 pound boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs

ingredients.rawText: 1 tbsp turmeric, freshly grated (or 1 tsp ground turmeric)
1 tsp fresh thyme, chopped and stems removed

instructions: Place oil in a large pot over medium. Once oil is hot, add garlic, onion, carrots and celery. Sauté a few minutes until onion becomes translucent.
Add in grated ginger and grated turmeric. Sauté for 30 seconds to let the spices cook a bit, and then add in chicken broth, chicken breast, rosemary, thyme, salt and pepper.
Bring soup to a boil, then stir in couscous. Ensure the chicken is covered by the broth by stirring them down to the bottom.
Reduce heat to medium low and simmer uncovered for 20-25 minutes or until chicken is fully cooked.

Once chicken is cooked, remove with a slotted spoon and transfer to a cutting board to shred with two forks. Add chicken back to the pot then stir in frozen peas. If not enough broth, add in another cup.
Taste and adjust seasonings as desired. Enjoy.
notes: Everyone loves a good, soul soothing soup when they are sick. Soup can actually help to reduce the length of your cold. This will be one of your favourite soups of all time. Packed with anti-inflammatory ingredients like ginger, turmeric, and garlic .

title: Homemade Chicken Soup
instructions: Place chicken, carrots, celery, and onion in a large soup pot; add enough cold water to cover. Bring to a boil over medium heat; reduce heat to low and simmer, uncovered until meat falls off of the bone, about 90 minutes. Skim off foam every so often, as needed.
Remove chicken from the pot and let sit until cool enough to handle; chop meat into pieces, and discard skin and bones.
Strain out vegetables, reserving the stock; rinse the soup pot and return the stock to the pot.
Chop vegetables into smaller pieces; return chopped chicken and chopped vegetables to the pot.
Warm soup until heated through; season with salt, pepper, and chicken bouillon to taste.
notes: Prep Time: 15 mins Cook Time: 1 hr. 30 mins

title: Rita’s Chicken Soup
instructions: Bring pot of water to boil.
Clean chicken thighs. Peel onion and cut in half. Wash celery stalks and cut in half. Cut tomato in half.
When water boils add chicken thighs and bring to a boil. Turn heat down to medium high and allow scum to come to top of water.
When lots of scum has formed, remove from heat and pour chicken in steel colander and throw out the scummy water.
Clean the pot, add water and bring to a boil once again.
Clean the chicken thighs so there is no longer any scum.
When water boils, add salt, celery, onion, tomato and chicken.
Cook until chicken is tender about 1 ½ hours.
Remove and throw out celery, onion, and tomato.
Remove chicken from water, cool and remove bones and skin.
Add shredded chicken back to broth in pot. If desired put some of the chicken and broth in containers to freeze or boil pastina and add to soup with chopped parsley to enjoy immediately.

title: Chicken Meatballs for Soup
instructions: Crack and beat egg. Add all other ingredients to the mixing bowl.
Mix well and roll into small meatballs. Place meatballs on parchment in aluminum trays, either freeze or cook immediately.
If meatballs are cooked immediately place in boiling water or chicken broth for ½ hour or bake for ½ hour in oven at 400°F.
When meatballs are frozen, put in individual freezer bags and cook from frozen or defrosted.

title: Chicken Stracciatella Soup

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 package of any kind of small pasta (pastina, ditalini)

instructions: Bring chicken broth to a boil in a pot, put in pasta, and cook until tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together beaten eggs, grated Parmesan cheese, and fresh lemon juice.
Slowly pour egg mixture into boiling pasta broth, stirring gently. Cook another 2 minutes until soft egg ribbons form.
Ladle into soup bowls and serve warm with extra grated Parmesan.
notes: Ready in 10 minutes. A classic Roman comforting starter that soothes colds.

title: Egg Drop Stracciatella Soup

ingredients.rawText: A classic of Roman cuisine, Stracciatella (egg drop soup) was a must at the beginning of
formal dinners. It is a dish of simplicity, made out only of broth and eggs, ready in less
ingredients.normalizedName: formal dinners it is dish simplicity

instructions: then 10 minutes.
4 tbsp parmigiano reggiano cheese, freshly grated 4 eggs grated rind of one lemon Salt to taste 1 quart (approximately 1 litre) homemade meat broth
In a small bowl beat eggs, parmigiano cheese, lemon rind, and salt.
Bring broth to a fast boil. Pour egg mixture slowly into the boiling broth and mix quickly with a fork to break the egg in small lumps.
Serve hot in soup bowls, with a pinch of grated nutmeg (optional).
Pass around the table a small bowl of grated parmigiano cheese, for the guests to add on top of the soup

title: Chicken Tortellini Soup
instructions: Boil chicken in water (1/2 hour) with whole onion, celery, salt, pepper and chicken bouillon granules.
Remove chicken, onion and celery and set aside.
Pour a small amount of olive oil in a pan and sauté chopped onion, garlic and sliced carrots until they are crisp and tender.
Add chicken broth and cook until carrots are tender.
De-bone chicken and add to the above mixture.
Bring to a boil and add tortellini; cook until tender.
Add seasonings to taste. Add spinach before serving and heat through.
Sprinkle helpings with Parmesan cheese.

title: Italian Wedding Soup

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb pork meat or 3-4 pork ribs
1 head green cabbage, cut in large shreds
1 head escarole, chopped in large pieces
1 small bunch of herbs (basil and thyme)
Carrot, onion, parsley, celery, bay leaves, salt

instructions: Place all the meats in a large empty pot with carrot, onion, parsley, celery, bay leaves, and halved tomatoes.
Fill pot with water, cover, and bring to boil. Skim off foam, add salt, and simmer until meat is tender.
Remove meat, filter broth through fine strainer and cool to remove surface fat. Dice meat into small pieces.
Bring a second pot half full of water to boil. Drop cabbage, escarole, Swiss chard, and herbs in to blanch. Drain and chop.
Bring clarified broth to a boil, add blanched vegetables and red pepper. Cook 20 minutes until tender.
Add meat back into the soup and serve piping hot, topped with grated Parmigiano cheese.
notes: The marriage ('maritata') of rich meats and leafy greens makes this a treasured feast day classic.

title: Fish Soup
instructions: Heat olive oil and add pepper, celery & garlic. Sauté 10 mins.
Add: 48 oz. Clamato juice Salt & pepper to taste 1 cup white wine 1 bay leaf 1 cube chicken bouillon 1 tsp oregano 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce 2 tomatoes, chopped 8 drops hot sauce (Tabasco)
When this boils, reduce to a simmer for 20 mins.

Cut fish into chunks and add all fish to the sauce. Stir gently, cover and cook for 8 - 10 mins. or until shellfish open. Serves 10 people Remember - Don’t eat shellfish that haven’t opened. They’re dead .
notes: Mary F. Seafood: 2lbs. of any: Haddock, Halibut, Cod or Snapper

title: Seafood Bouillabaisse Soup

ingredients.rawText: 1 envelope mushroom soup powder or cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.normalizedName: envelope mushroom soup powder cream mushroom soup

ingredients.rawText: 2 pieces red and green bell peppers

instructions: Heat pan, pour oil, fry garlic then sauté onions.
Add butter and crabmeat, clams and shrimps.
If it sticks, add a little broth to the pan.
Add some more broth, seasonings and the rest of the ingredients.
Pour the rest of the broth into pan and bring to a boil.
Add mushroom soup powder and mashed potatoes.
Bring to a boil again stirring constantly and serve hot.

title: Fish Tomato Sauce Soup

ingredients.rawText: 1 pound cut up assorted fish (e.g. shrimp, prawns, cod, haddock, calamari,

instructions: In a large pot add olive oil, garlic and hot pepper flakes, heat on medium for one minute.
Add cut up assorted fish, cook one minute.
Add white wine and cook on medium-high for approximately 3 minutes.
Add tomato puree and water, oregano, basil, salt to taste and fresh parsley, stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to a low simmer for approximately 30 minutes and until thickened. 4. Serve over grilled crusty Italian bread or with crusty Italian bread. Enjoy

title: Barley Soup (Zuppa D’Orzo)

ingredients.rawText: 2 cans, approximately 1 lb (450 gr) borlotti beans, drained
ingredients.normalizedName: 2 cans, approximately 1 lb (450 gr) borlotti beans, drained

instructions: Soak the pearl barley in a small bowl filled with water for about 1 hour. Place half of the beans in a food processor and reduce to purée. In a saucepan, bring the broth to a boil.
Prepare “soffritto” chopping celery, carrot, onion, and half of the parsley finely together.
In a large saucepan, put the extra-virgin olive oil and butter, and turn heat to medium. When the butter starts foaming, add the chopped vegetables. Sauté for a few seconds.
Add bacon and sauté until the onion is soft and translucent and the bacon is lightly brown.
Add the puréed beans, whole beans, hot broth, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.

Drain the pearl barley, and stir into the soup. Cook for about 25 minutes, stirring occasionally to prevent the soup from sticking to the pan. Adjust salt if necessary. When the barley is soft, turn heat off, spread the rest of the chopped parsley over the soup and let it rest covered in the saucepan for about 5 minutes before serving.

If the soup is prepared in advance the barley will absorb most of the water and the soup will become very dense. In this case, reserve some of the broth, heat it and stir it into the soup just before serving.
notes: This dish is popular in the Friuli and Trentino regions. Barley soup is prepared in many different ways and sometimes includes potatoes.

title: Barley Soup with Sausages

ingredients.rawText: 6 oz smoked kielbasa or bratwurst or Italian sausage
1-2 tbsp fresh parsley leaves, chopped 1 tsp dried rosemary

instructions: Brown sliced sausage in 1 tbsp hot oil in skillet
Add to soup pot with stock, barley and bay leaf
Bring to boil and simmer, partly covered for 30 minutes
Heat 2 tbsp oil in same skillet
Add cabbage and cook until it begins to color (5 minutes)
Add onion, carrot, celery, parsley, and rosemary
Cook until onion is browned about 10 minutes
Stir in marjoram and garlic
Add 1 cup liquid from soup pot and stir to loosen any browned bits on bottom of skillet
Mix contents of skillet into soup pot and add potatoes
Cover and simmer until barley is tender not mushy and potatoes are cooked firm, about 15-20 minutes
Season with salt and pepper. Remove bay leaf. Serve with cheese.
notes: Sandy V.

title: Hearty Barley Soup

ingredients.rawText: 2 lb beef stew meat, diced into 1 inch pieces
4 small red potatoes, cut into chunks

instructions: Season beef stew chunks with salt and pepper to taste.
Place seasoned beef in a large soup pot.
Add 2 tbsp of oil and sauté for 5 minutes on high heat. Remove meat.
Add 2 more tbsp of oil to pot and add onions, carrots and mushrooms.
Sauté for 5 minutes, stirring often.
Add garlic and thyme to pot and sauté for 3 more minutes.
Add the chicken broth and 3 cups of water to pot.
Add the frozen mixed vegetables, potatoes and barley.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Stir all together and bring to a boil.
Cover pot, reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
notes: The frozen vegetables, fresh onion, carrots, potatoes, and mushrooms make this soup both filling and nutritious. Requires 60 - 90 minutes of low simmer

title: Bean & Kielbasa Soup (Pasulj)

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb dried white beans (navy or cannellini)

instructions: Clean the beans by picking the bits of grit and chaff and rinse them twice in cold water. Put the beans in a large saucepan and cover them with water to a depth of 1 to 2 inches.
Bring the water to a boil and then turn down the heat. Leave to simmer gently for half an hour.

Remove pan from heat and pour in enough cold water to cover beans to a depth of 3 inches. The beans will settle on the bottom. Leave them for a minute or two; then pour off water and replace with fresh water.
Bring the water to a boil and then turn down the heat to simmer.
Add the onions, garlic, bay leaves, parsley, tomato paste, carrot, and peppercorns to the beans. Cook gently over very low heat for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until the beans are soft.
After 45 minutes cooking, add the kielbasa.
Fifteen minutes before you are ready to serve, add the salt .

In a small saucepan heat the oil until it is smoking lightly; then quickly stir in the paprika, followed by the flour. Mix to a thin paste. Add to soup, stirring well. Simmer for 5 minutes, until soup is thick and rich.
Serve with plenty of bread and good red wine.

title: Bean Soup

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb dried white beans (navy or cannellini)

instructions: Pick over the beans for bits of grit and chaff, and rinse them twice in cold water. Put the beans in a large saucepan and cover them with water to a depth of 1 to 2 inches.
Bring the water to a boil and then turn down the heat.
Leave to simmer gently for half an hour.

Remove the pan from the heat and pour in enough cold water to cover the beans to a depth of 3 inches. The beans will settle on the bottom. Leave them for a minute or two; then pour off the water and replace with fresh water.
Bring the water to a boil and then turn down the heat to simmer.
Add the onions, garlic, bay leaves, parsley, tomato paste, carrot, and peppercorns to the beans. Cook gently over very low heat for 1 1/2 to 2 hours until the beans are soft.
After 45 minutes of the cooking, add the kielbasa.
Fifteen minutes before you are ready to serve, add the salt.
Heat oil until sizzling; then quickly stir in the paprika, followed by the flour. Mix to a thin paste. Add this to the soup, stirring well.
Simmer for 5 minutes until the soup is thick and rich.

title: Pasta e Fagioli (Pasta Fasul)

ingredients.rawText: 11 oz (315 g) dry borlotti beans (or 2 cans romano beans)
2 oz (60 g) pancetta or un-smoked bacon, finely chopped
5 oz (140 g) short ditali or broken spaghetti
2 tbsp fresh ripe tomato, finely diced
2 cups broth plus bean cooking water

instructions: Soak dry borlotti beans overnight. Boil in fresh water for 20 minutes until tender (or use drained canned beans).
In a stockpot, heat 3 tbsp olive oil over medium heat. Sauté pancetta, onion, celery, and carrot for 2-3 minutes until soft. Stir in diced tomato.
Transfer 1/3 of the cooked beans to a plate and mash to a paste with a potato masher.
Add whole beans, bean purée, broth, and cooking water to the pot. Bring to a boil, season with salt and pepper, and simmer 15 minutes.
Add ditali pasta and cook until al dente.
Ladle into bowls, drizzle generously with extra-virgin olive oil and cracked black pepper.
notes: The quintessence of Italian home cooking. The mashed beans create the signature rich, creamy texture.

title: Simple Pasta and Fagioli Soup

ingredients.rawText: 2 cans (19 oz each) romano beans, drained and rinsed
1 1/2 cups tubetti or other small pasta
1 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper

instructions: In a Dutch oven, fry bacon over medium heat until golden and crisp (about 8 mins); remove with slotted spoon.
Drain fat. Heat 1 tbsp oil in same pan; fry onion, celery, carrot, potato, and garlic for 10 minutes until softened.
Stir in white wine, tomatoes, salt, and pepper; simmer 10 minutes until tomatoes break down.
Stir in chicken stock, water, beans, and cooked bacon.
Bring to a boil, add small pasta, and simmer until pasta is al dente (about 8 minutes).
Serve sprinkled with grated Parmesan and chopped parsley.
notes: Tip: Toss 1 cup chopped spinach or Swiss chard into pot during the final 2 minutes of pasta cooking.

title: Pasta e Ceci (Chickpea) Roman Soup

ingredients.rawText: 11 oz (300 g) dry chickpeas soaked overnight (or 2 cans chickpeas)
6 oz (180 g) short ditali or broken spaghetti
2 oz (60 g) fresh tomato, peeled and diced

instructions: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Place 1/3 of chickpeas in food processor and blend to a fine paste.
In a saucepan, heat 3 tbsp olive oil, garlic, and the rosemary sprig over medium heat. Add anchovies and stir until melted into oil (do not burn garlic).
Immediately add diced tomato, whole chickpeas, chickpea paste, and 4 cups water/broth. Bring to a boil.
Simmer for 20 minutes until flavors combine. Discard rosemary sprig.
Add pasta and cook until al dente.
Transfer to serving bowls and finish with a drizzle of extra-virgin olive oil and freshly ground black pepper.
notes: One of the oldest recipes in Roman cooking. Rosemary and anchovy give an incredible savory depth.

title: Cauliflower Soup

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb (450 gr) green cauliflower, cut in about 2 inch (5 cm) pieces
1 cup homemade broth, or 1 bouillon dissolved in 1 cup of warm water
3 oz (100 gr) short "ditali" pasta, or spaghetti, broken in 1/2 inch

instructions: Cleaning the cauliflower: Remove the bottom leaves and the stem base.
Carve out the inside stem and separate florets in about 2 inch pieces.
Place the cauliflower in fresh water and rinse. Some of the tender leaves can also be used.
Preparing the soup: Put olive oil in a large saucepan, and turn the heat to medium.
Add the onion, celery, and carrots. Sauté the vegetables until the onion is soft. Stir frequently.
Drain the cauliflower and add it to the saucepan.
Add tomatoes, salt, pepper, and stir for few seconds.
Add water and broth and bring to a boil. Cook until the cauliflower is tender but still firm.
Add the pasta and cook for the time indicated by the manufacturer.
Taste for readiness and cook until pasta is firm but not overcooked ( al dente ). Correct salt if necessary.

title: Creamy Cauliflour Soup
instructions: Combine cauliflower, broth, onion, celery and water in a large saucepan.
Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and cover.
Simmer until vegetables are tender, 13-15 minutes.
Let mixture cool 5 minutes.
Pour soup into blender, in batches and puree.
Return soup to pan and stir in cream.
Cook, stirring occasionally over medium heat until hot. (3 minutes)
Sprinkle with paprika and chives
notes: Georgina V. Florets from 1 head cauliflower (5 cups) 1 small onion, chopped

title: Whipping Cream Cauliflower Soup

ingredients.rawText: 1 large stalk celery, chopped (3/4 cup) 1 tbsp lemon juice

instructions: Remove outer leaves and stalk of cauliflower and wash well
Separate cauliflower into florets
Bring 2 cups water to boil in 3 quart saucepan
Add cauliflower, celery, onion and lemon juice
Cover and heat to boiling
Cook until tender, about 10 minutes; do not drain
Press cauliflower mixture in blender and blend until uniform consistency
Heat margarine in 3 quart saucepan over low heat until melted.
Stir in flour
Cook, stirring constantly, until mixture is smooth and bubbly
Remove from heat and stir in 2 1/2 cups water.
Heat to boiling, stirring constantly
Boil and stir 1 minute
Stir in cauliflower mixture, instant bouillon, salt, pepper and nutmeg
Heat just to boiling
Stir in cream and heat but do not boil
Serve with grated cheese if desired

title: Cuccia (St. Lucia Heritage Soup)

ingredients.rawText: 1 bag Farro wheat grains from Italy

instructions: Day before: Rinse and soak chickpeas and wheat berries in cold water overnight. Soak kidney beans for 6 hours, navy and black beans for 3 hours.
Cook chickpeas and white kidney beans in a large pot with 4x water, simmering for 1.5 hours.
Cook navy and black turtle beans in a second pot with 4x water. Drain and rinse black water completely.
Boil wheat berries and farro until tender.
In fourth pot, heat olive oil and sauté chopped onions and celery. Add pearl barley, water, and cook 30 minutes.
Combine all cooked beans, farro, wheat berries, and barley together in largest family stockpot.
Add hot water to achieve hearty consistency, stir in vegetable broth cubes and salt.
Simmer all together, stirring well. Serve warm.
notes: Rosina Ruffolo, our matriarch, soaked beans each December 12 and ladled cuccia into containers for all her children on Santa Lucia Day. The tradition continues with Lena Orrico.

title: Leek Potato Soup

ingredients.rawText: Save prep time by peeling and dicing the potatoes while the leeks are
ingredients.normalizedName: save prep time by peeling dicing potatoes while leeks are

ingredients.rawText: cooking in the second step. Use either Yukon gold or Russet potatoes for
ingredients.normalizedName: cooking in second step use either yukon gold russet potatoes

instructions: this soup. The Yukon golds will result in a creamier soup.

2 lbs potatoes (Yukon gold or Russet), peeled, diced into 1/2-inch pieces 1 or 2 sprigs fresh thyme, or 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme Sprinkle of Tabasco or other red chili sauce 4 cups chicken (or vegetable) broth 2 tablespoons butter 3 large leeks (about 3 cups, chopped) 1 bay leaf White or black pepper to taste 1/4 cup chopped parsley 1 tsp. sea salt, less or more to taste Pinch dried marjoram

To Clean and cut the leeks: Cut roots off the leeks. Cut the leeks lengthwise, fan them open under running water to dislodge any dirt or mud hiding inside. Cut off the tough dark green tops and discard (either compost or freeze for making stock).

Slice the white and light green parts of the leeks crosswise into 1/4- inch thick slices. Place the slices in a bowl of cold water and agitate them with your hands to dislodge any remaining dirt. Then scoop out the leeks with a sieve or slotted spoon. To cook leeks in butter to soften :
Melt butter on medium heat in a 3 to 4 quart thick-bottomed pot. Add the chopped leeks, stir to coat with the butter.
Cover the pot and reduce the heat to low, cook for 10 minutes until the leeks are softened. Check to make sure the leeks are not browning.
Simmer the soup:
Add the broth, diced potatoes, bay leaf, marjoram, thyme, and a teaspoon of salt to the pot.
Increase heat to high. Bring to a boil, then lower the heat to maintain a low simmer, and cook 20 minutes, until potatoes are cooked through. To purée the soup :

Remove and discard the bay leaf and thyme sprig. Use an immersion blender or standing blender to blend about half of the soup if you want a chunky soup, or all of it if you would like your soup to be smoother. Note: if using a standing blender, purée the soup in batches, don't fill the blender more than a third full at a time and remember to hold down lid while the blender is going. To season the soup :
Add the parsley and cook a few minutes more. Add a few dashes of Tabasco to taste.
Add freshly ground pepper and more salt to taste. (Potatoes soak up salt, so you may need to add more salt than you expect.)

title: Lentil Soup

ingredients.rawText: A common saying in Italy is: Lentils bring you luck and happiness. This is a
ingredients.normalizedName: common saying in italy is lentils bring you luck happiness this is

instructions: very easy soup. It is a nice side dish for chicken, pork or veal.

1/2 lb Italian lentils 3 cups broth (chicken, beef, veg) 1/2 onion, finely sliced 1 scallion, finely sliced 1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil 2 tbsp half and half cream Salt to taste Red hot chili pepper flakes to taste
Soak the lentils overnight and discard all the floating ones. Rinse, drain and put the lentils in the broth and simmer for one hour.
Meanwhile, in a frying pan sauté the onion and the scallion until translucent.
Add salt and pepper flakes according to your taste, remove from heat and add the half and half cream.
Stir gently, add the mixture to the lentils and serve.

title: Lentil Soup with Rice and Spinach

ingredients.rawText: 1 bunch spinach, washed and cut into strips
1 cup (200 g) lentils, soaked for 4 hrs

instructions: Rinse the lentils and cook them for 45 minutes in 2 quarts of water with the onion, celery, salt and pepper. Remove the lentils with a slotted spoon, and strain the broth, discarding the celery.
Slice the onion and sauté it in a pot with the oil and the garlic for 3 minutes, then add the tomato sauce and cook 2 minutes more.
Add the lentils and the spinach and then the lentil broth.
When the soup comes to a boil add the rice and cook, stirring occasionally until it is done, about 15 minutes. Serves 4
notes: MINESTRA DI RISO CON LENTICCHIE E SPINACI Rice is one of the best ingredients for a soup, better than noodles as it provides body and works especially well with lentils.

title: Lentil Ham Soup
instructions: Wash lentils well.
Put lentils, ham, chicken broth, water and celery into soup pot and bring to a boil.
Cook for 45 minutes on moderate heat.
Add remainder of ingredients and cook for 30 more minutes on low heat. Add salt and pepper.

title: Minestra di Lenticchie

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 lb (250 gr) approximately small dry lentils
1/4 lb (100 gr) pasta (short ditali or broken spaghetti)

instructions: Clean the lentils to remove impurities, wash in fresh water, and drain.

In a stockpot put approximately 6 cups of water and the dry lentils. Bring to a boil and cook for about 20-30 minutes. When the lentils are tender but still firm, turn the heat off and reserve them in their water.
In a saucepan put 3 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil and turn heat to medium. Add the garlic and sauté for a few moments.
Add the celery, carrots, tomatoes and sauté for 1 min stirring frequently.
Add the lentils with the water used to cook them and 2 or 3 cups of broth depending how thick you desire the soup.
Bring to a boil, add salt and cook for about 10 minutes. Add the pasta and cook for the time indicated by the manufacturer, or taste, it must be firm but not overcooked (al dente) .
Correct salts if necessary, add freshly grated pepper, 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil, parsley, and serve warm in soup dishes.

title: Lentil Tomato Soup
instructions: Chop onion, carrot and celery.
Sauté in oil until onion is lightly toasted.
Add lentils, undrained tomatoes (crush with fork if whole), water, stock cubes and Liquid Smoke.
Cover; bring to a boil. Simmer 1 ½ hours, or until lentils are tender. Season with pepper and parsley.

title: Dimitra’s Lentil Soup for a Crowd

ingredients.rawText: Salt, pepper, and oregano to taste
1 sweet pepper, whatever colour you like, shredded or chopped

instructions: Clean and rinse lentils in cold water.
Cover lentils with water in large soup pot and let boil for 5 to 10 minutes, then throw out the water.

Pour fresh water into soup pot to cover the lentils with at least 2 inches of water above the lentils. Set the stove on medium. Let the lentils cook for 15 minutes on medium. Then add all the chopped vegetables. Cook for approximately another hour.
In the last 15 minutes, add the 3 tbsp of olive oil; salt, pepper, oregano to taste. If the soup is too thick, just add water to the consistency you desire. Remove bay leaves before serving.

title: Serbian Meat Bean Soup
instructions: Soak beans in 1 quart cold water the night before you plan to make soup.
Next day, drain beans and put aside.
Put 2 quarts water, beef bones, salt and vegetables in a large soup pot and cook over low heat for 2 hours.
Strain and reserve liquid. Put drained Beans into the reserved liquid; add enough water to bring the amount back to 2 quarts.
Cook covered over low heat until beans are done.
Make little dumplings and put aside.
Melt the lard in a frying pan. Sauté onion in it, then mix in the flour and cook over very low heat until the mixture is light brown.
Remove from heat and mix in mashed garlic and paprika.
Whip in 1/2 cup cold water.
Add to the almost ready bean soup and cook the soup over very low heat for at least 10 minutes longer.

title: Minestrone alla Milanese
instructions: Heat oil in a large stockpot; add garlic, celery, onion, and parsley. Sauté 5 minutes.
Add potatoes, carrots, zucchini, green beans, and tomatoes.
Cover generously with water and season with salt.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then lower heat and simmer covered for 2 hours, adding water as needed.
After the first hour, add grated savoy cabbage.
Fifteen minutes before serving, add rice and simmer, keeping rice al dente.
Serve warm with a generous sprinkling of grated Parmesan cheese.
notes: A hearty vegetable feast where slow simmering develops rich sweet vegetal depth.

title: French Onion Soup

ingredients.rawText: Salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Melt butter in a heavy-based pan; add thinly sliced onion and cook slowly, stirring continuously until soft and deep golden.
Stir in flour for 1 minute, then slowly stir in the beef stock.
Add sugar, season with salt and pepper. Cover and simmer gently for 20 minutes.
Toast slices of French bread and top generously with grated cheese.
Ladle soup into oven-safe bowls, top each with cheese toast, and grill/broil until cheese melts and bubbles brown.
notes: Caramelizing the onions slowly with butter without rushing produces rich sweetness.

title: Peas and Rice Soup
instructions: In a saucepan, put the butter, olive oil, bacon, and onion. Turn heat to medium.
When the onion becomes soft and the bacon is cooked, add peas, 4–5 tablespoons broth, stir, and cover.
Cook for about 5-10 minutes.
Add the rest of the broth, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Add rice and cook for about 20 minutes.
When the rice is al dente (firm but not too soft or overcooked), and the soup has a dense consistency, Taste, add salt and pepper if needed. Add parmigiano cheese and parsley.
Stir briefly and serve warm.

title: Split Pea Soup

ingredients.rawText: 7 - 8 whole allspice in a tea strainer or tied in cheesecloth.
ingredients.normalizedName: allspice in tea strainer tied in cheesecloth

instructions: Combine peas, water, allspice, salt and pepper and bring to boil.
Simmer for about 1 hour.
Stir in potatoes, onions, carrots, ham and cabbage.
Return to a boil, reduce heat and simmer for about 30 min. Feeds a lot!

title: Baked Potato Soup

ingredients.rawText: 10 ounces shredded Cheddar cheese 1 (8 ounce) container sour cream

instructions: Prick potatoes with a fork and cook in the microwave, 3 or 4 at a time, and scoop out the flesh (while the others are cooking).

In a large saucepan over medium heat, melt butter. Stir in flour and cook about a minute. Whisk in milk, a little at a time, stirring constantly until thickened. Stir in potatoes, salt, pepper, 1/3 cup bacon bits, 2 tablespoons green onions and most of the cheese. Cook until thoroughly heated. Stir in sour cream and heat through. Serve topped with remaining bacon, onions and cheese.

title: Ukrainian Potato & Beets Borsch

ingredients.rawText: 4 quart water or beef or pork stock

instructions: Boil all vegetables in the water and/or stock about ¾ hour.
Add 1 ½ cups canned tomato, or tomato juice.
Add Bay Leaf, 1 tbsp salt, ¼ tsp pepper.
Add 1 tsp lemon juice or vinegar.
Simmer 15 minutes or more. Serve as is or with 1 tsp of sour cream on top.

title: Spinach and Rice Soup
instructions: Boil rice in broth, approx. 20 to 25 minutes.
Melt butter in skillet; add spinach for 1 to 2 minutes.
Remove from heat.
Beat eggs; add cheese and spinach. Add mixture to broth and rice.

title: Phoy Chay Buddhist Vegetarian Soup

ingredients.rawText: 1 pkg of fresh or dried banh pho (flat rice noodles) prepared according to pkg
10 oz can of mock meat (fried wheat gluten duck, chicken, abalone, etc.)

instructions: Noodles: and rinsed well under cold running water after boiling.
Meat: Heat vegetable broth and 10 ½ cups of water in a saucepan, leaving enough room for the ginger, onion and leek leaves.
Remove the outer layer of the onion and add it whole to the broth.
With the ginger skin intact, chop off the numbs and bruise using a mortar and pestle and add to broth.
Let soup boil for 45-60 minutes or until onion and ginger are softened.
Once onion and ginger are softened, discard the leek leaves.
Add ¾ tbsp Chinese five spices to broth and season with soy sauce and sugar to taste.
Continue to cook on medium heat for 15 minutes.
Meat Mixture: Thinly slice leek stems and chop mushrooms and mock meat into bite- sized pieces. Deep fried tofu can be used in place of mock meat if desired.
Sauté the leeks with vegetable oil in a medium pan until golden.
Add mushrooms and “meat”.
Assemble, garnish and serve.

title: Butternut Squash & Roasted Garlic Soup
italianTitle: Vellutata di Zucca e Aglio Arrosto

ingredients.rawText: 1 large butternut squash, halved and seeded
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. Line baking sheet with parchment paper.
Season squash halves with salt and pepper, tuck 2 sprigs thyme in each cavity. Roast cut side down for 40 minutes until fork-tender.
Squeeze roasted garlic paste from roasted bulbs.
Discard thyme; scoop out squash pulp into a food processor with roasted garlic and 1/2 cup chicken stock. Puree until smooth.
Add remaining stock gradually until loose, velvety puree forms. Season with salt and pepper.
notes: Roasting brings out caramelized sweetness in both the squash and garlic.

title: Roasted Garlic
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (205° C):
Peel and discard the papery outer layers of the whole garlic bulb.
Leave intact the skins of the individual cloves of garlic
Using a sharp knife, cut 1/4 to a 1/2 inch from the top of cloves.
This exposes the individual cloves of garlic.
Put garlic in baking pan or muffin tin. Place the garlic heads in a baking pan, cut side up. (A muffin pan works great for this, as it keeps the garlic bulbs from rolling around.)
Drizzle with olive oil over each exposed head, using your fingers to rub the olive oil over all the cut, exposed garlic cloves.
Cover the bulb with aluminum foil.
Bake at 400°F (205°C) for 30-40 minutes, or until the cloves are lightly browned and feel soft when pressed.

Cool and remove roasted garlic cloves from their skins. Allow the garlic to cool enough so you can touch it without burning yourself. Use a small knife to cut the skin slightly around each clove. Use a cocktail fork or fingers to pull or squeeze roasted garlic cloves out of their skins.
Eat as is or mash with a fork and use for cooking. Can be spread over warm French bread, mixed with sour cream for a topping for baked potatoes, or mixed in with Parmesan and pasta.

title: Italian Salad Dressing
instructions: Variations : Basic Italian Dressing - Replace the balsamic vinegar with red or white wine vinegar. Herb - Add 1 teaspoon dried oregano or 2 tablespoons fresh chopped basil or parsley to the basic recipe or try all 3 herbs and toss in some minced capers ....delicious! Mustard & Garlic - Add 1 tablespoon Dijon mustard and 1 finely minced garlic clove to the basic recipe. Cheese - Add 2 tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese to the basic recipe. Raspberry - Use raspberry vinegar in place of the other vinegars. This is great on salad greens that are topped with toasted walnuts and fresh raspberries or strawberries.
In these variations combine all ingredients in a jar, close tightly, and shake vigorously.
Mix all the ingredients together and beat lightly with a fork or a whip for 1 minute.
Drizzle on your salad of choice and serve.

title: Orange and Fennel
instructions: Slice the oranges and arrange them in a serving plate.
Clean fennels, removing base, outer tough leaves, and green stems.
Slice the fennel very thin. Transfer to a bowl.
Dress the fennel with extra-virgin olive oil, salt, pepper.
Transfer fennel to the serving dish. Drizzle with extra-virgin olive oil.
Add olives and onion if desired.

title: Raspberry-Spinach Salad

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb Fresh spinach (could use mix of Boston and Romaine lettuce)

instructions: Salad: Combine topping ingredients in a large frying pan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until sugar melts to a golden brown and coats almonds, about 5 minutes. Turn out on to square of greased foil. Cool, then break up into small pieces.
Combine all dressing ingredients in a container with a tight-fitting lid. Shake well to blend, then shake again before using.
Wash and dry spinach and place in a large bowl with raspberries. Add dressing and toss. Add almonds; toss lightly and serve immediately. on hand.
notes: Mary F. & Vera F. Crunchy caramelized almonds add the crowning touch to this simple, beautiful-looking and delicious summer salad. Serves 4 Tip: prepare a few batches of almonds and dressing ahead of time and keep

title: Waldorf Salad
instructions: Pour orange juice into bowl
Mix diced apples in juice
Chill, drain apples, add celery, walnuts and mayonnaise and maraschino cherries

title: Three Bean Pasta Salad

ingredients.rawText: 15 oz can three bean salad, chilled

instructions: Cook pasta in boiling salted water until desired doneness as directed on package.
Drain.
Combine with undrained three bean salad and tomatoes in medium bowl.
Mix gently, cover, and chill. Serves 6

title: Garden Pasta Salad

ingredients.rawText: 1 (16 ounce) package uncooked tri-color spiral pasta
1/2 cup cucumbers, peeled and thinly sliced

instructions: Cook pasta in large pot of boiling water until al dente. Rinse under cold water and drain.
Mix chopped carrots, celery, cucumber, green pepper, tomatoes, and onion together in large bowl.
Combine cooled pasta and vegetables together in large bowl. Pour Italian dressing over mixture, add Parmesan cheese and mix well.
Chill for one hour before serving.

title: Greek Pasta Power Salad

ingredients.rawText: 7 oz. fat-free red wine vinaigrette, or fat-free Greek dressing
7 oz. cooked garbanzo (chickpeas) beans, drained and rinsed
6 medium or jumbo black olives, pitted, chopped

instructions: Boil pasta according to package instructions. Drain and rinse in cold water to prevent further cooking.
Put pasta into a large bowl. Add onion, cucumber, chickpeas, tomatoes, and olives and mix well. Pour in dressing and toss.
Sprinkle feta cheese over salad & toss again. Refrigerate before serving.
notes: Margaret V.

title: Shrimp Pasta Salad

ingredients.rawText: 16 oz pkg frozen carrot & snap peas, cooked, drained
9 oz pkg frozen cooked shrimp, thawed, drained

instructions: Cook rotini as directed on package and drain.
Mix with remaining ingredients and chill at least 1 hour to blend flavors.

title: Southwestern Pasta Salad

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup canned black beans, well rinsed
1/2 cup chopped black olives or 3/4 cup sliced
Optional: grilled red or yellow peppers, diced

instructions: Cook pasta al-dente in salted boiling water.
Rinse pasta with cold water and drain well.
Add remainder of ingredients and toss. Chill before serving. *Cilantro is a type of parsley, sometimes called "Chinese parsley".

title: Summer Pasta Toss
instructions: In a large pot with boiling, salted water cook pasta until al dente. Drain.

In a large saucepan heat the Italian dressing and olive oil together over medium heat. Add drained spaghetti; toss well to coat. Add chopped tomatoes, chicken or turkey, and grated Parmesan. Toss lightly. best.
notes: Fresh cucumbers from the yard are

title: Tuna Penne Pasta Salad

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb canned tuna fish in olive oil.
ingredients.normalizedName: canned tuna fish in olive oil

instructions: In a serving bowl, put the drained cannellini beans, tuna, celery, red onion, and part of the oil. Toss well and set aside.

Bring 6 quarts (5 1/2 L) water and 1 1/2 tablespoons coarse salt to a boil. Boil the pasta until al dente according to the package. Drain and cool with plenty of cold water to stop the cooking process. Drain again, and put into a serving bowl.
Add the rest of the extra virgin olive oil and black pepper, toss well.
Garnish with Parmesan flakes before serving.

title: Tuna Pasta Salad

ingredients.rawText: 1 4 oz can water packed solid white tuna, drained and flaked

instructions: Prepare the pasta according to package directions. Drain, and let the pasta cool in a large bowl.
In a small bowl, add the chicken broth, lemon juice, oregano, oil, garlic, sugar, and black pepper.
Whisk ingredients together until combined. Pour over the pasta.
Add the tuna, olives, celery, red pepper, and cheese.
Toss to coat and garnish with basil or mint leaves. Serves 4

title: Rice and Chick Pea Salad

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup uncooked wild and white rice
1½ tsp sesame oil or olive oil
½ cup lightly packed fresh parsley

instructions: Cook rice according to package instructions; drain well.
Finely grate peel from ½ lemon. Squeeze out 2 tbsp juice from lemon.
Stir tahini with lemon juice, lemon peel, garlic, oil, salt and cayenne pepper. Stir in water to make a thick but pourable dressing.
Stir rice, chickpeas and tahini dressing together. Add carrots & onions.
Finely chop parsley; add to rice mixture.

title: Rice and Shrimp Salad
instructions: Cook rice.
Cook peas.
Combine peas and rice with onions, celery, and shrimp.
Dressing: Mix together all dressing ingredients
Pour mixed dressing over rice mixture and toss
Store in refrigerator 8 hours or more before serving
Stir occasionally

title: Shrimp, Tomato and Rice Salad
instructions: Toss together all ingredients in medium bowl to combine.
Cover and chill for 30 minutes to blend flavors. Makes 4 servings

title: Crab Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Refrigerate.
notes: Chrissy Z.

title: Easy Crab and Shrimp Salad

ingredients.rawText: 1 bag crab sticks, cut/flakes ready to use

instructions: Combine all ingredients and serve

title: Margaret’s Own Seafood Salad

ingredients.rawText: Large shrimp cut into small pieces
A bag of assorted fish mix for variety

instructions: Marinade: Boil cleaned fish in water only. (Vinegar makes them tough)
Boil shrimp, scallops & calamari rings for 2 minutes
Boil each variety separately.
Cool right away under running cold water.
Make marinade and pour over fish, stir and put in refrigerator at least a day before serving.
A day or 2 before serving add lemon juice, salt and vinegar.
notes: Margaret V. (Can be prepared a few days ahead of time to marinate) It is made with fish that have no tentacles, mussels, or octopus.

title: Marinated Seafood Salad

ingredients.rawText: 1/3 cup olive oil or cooking oil
16 oz large, fresh or frozen, peeled and deveined shrimp
ingredients.normalizedName: 16 oz large, fresh or frozen, peeled and deveined shrimp

instructions: Thaw shrimp and scallops, if frozen. Cut scallops in half. Cook shrimp and scallops in boiling water in large uncovered saucepan for 2 to 3 minutes or until shrimp turn pink and scallops are opaque. Drain and rinse under cool water to stop cooking. Put seafood into plastic bag and in bowl.

For marinade, stir together lime juice or lemon juice and ½ cup water. Pour marinade over seafood in bag. Close bag tightly, then turn to evenly distribute marinade. Chill for 8 hours or overnight, turning bag occasionally. Drain seafood, discarding the marinade.

In medium mixing bowl stir together green onion, chili peppers, oil, cilantro or parsley, capers, and dash of salt and pepper. Gently stir in seafood until combined. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours.

To serve, line a serving platter with lettuce leaves. Arrange onion slices on top of lettuce leaves around the edge of the serving platter, if desired. Spoon seafood mixture into center of platter. Makes approx. 24 servings.

title: Seafood Salad
instructions: Dressing: Mix equal amounts of water and vinegar and let it come to a boil
Boil each fish separately in its own water and vinegar and then drain
Shrimps boil for one minute
Squid or cuttlefish boil for 12 minutes.
Octopus boil for 15 - 20 minutes.
After all fish have been boiled and drained combine in a salad bowl
Combine dressing ingredients and mix well.
Pour dressing over fish and mix well

title: Panici Seafood Salad

ingredients.rawText: You need boiled and sliced octopus, cuttlefish, squid, and shrimps
Lemon juice 1/2 bottle (Real lemon concentrate or fresh squeezed lemon)

instructions: Octopus cleaned from store: Wash and drop into boiling water and vinegar uncovered about 60 minutes until fork goes in. Remove eyes
Peel should easily come off under and remove pink peel from octopus
Chop up octopus into bite size pieces
Cuttlefish cleaned from store: Wash and drop into boiling water and vinegar for 60 minutes
Chop up in fine pieces after cooking
Squid cleaned from store: Cut above eyes and remove eyes from head
Turn body inside out, clean insides and remove the cartilage
Place body in boiling water and vinegar for 5 to 10 minutes
Add head into boiling water and vinegar for 3 minutes
Cut into small pieces
Shrimp: Remove shells. Slit back in half and remove vein
Drop into boiling water and vinegar for 5 to 10 minutes
Salad Combination: Combine all dressing ingredients and stir until well mixed
Pour dressing over cooked seafood and stir well.
Let stand in refrigerator 24 hours, stirring occasionally

title: Bean Salad
instructions: Pre-boil green and yellow beans, adding salt
Dressing: Mix together dressing ingredients and pour over vegetables
notes: Sandy V.

title: Beet, Citrus & Spinach Salad

ingredients.rawText: 1 can (14 oz) rosebud beets, drained, quartered
2 large navel oranges, peeled and sectioned
1/2 cup Raspberry Vinaigrette Dressing and Marinade

instructions: Toss all ingredients except dressing in large bowl.
Add dressing. Mix lightly. Serve immediately. Serves 8

title: Caesar Salad Olive Oil

ingredients.rawText: ½ cup Parmesan cheese, freshly grated 1 clove garlic, crushed

instructions: Steep garlic in oil overnight; remove and discard.
Cut bread into small cubes and sauté in 1/4 cup of the garlic oil in a large skillet until golden brown. Drain on paper towels.
Combine remaining oil, lemon juice, anchovies, salt, mustard, pepper and Worcestershire in a large salad bowl.
Heat egg in hot water in a small bowl 10 minutes.
Tear Romaine in bite-size pieces into salad bowl. (3 quarts leaves)
Top with half the Parmesan. Break egg over salad. Toss salad, spooning from bottom of bowl, until greens are coated with dressing.
Sprinkle with remaining Parmesan and the sautéed bread. Serve at immediately.

title: Caesar Salad Mayonnaise
instructions: Mix mayonnaise, milk, mustard and garlic powder together.
Pour over lettuce, add bacon, croutons and cheese. Mix well, enjoy.

title: Caprese Salad Mozzarella and Tomato Salad

ingredients.rawText: 4 tomatoes - about 1 lb (450 gr), not too ripe
1/2 lb (220 gr) Italian fresh mozzarella cheese
Black pepper, freshly crushed from the mill

instructions: Slice tomatoes and mozzarella 1/4” (5 mm) thick.
Eliminate water and seeds from tomatoes if necessary.
Alternate tomato and cheese slices in a plate.
By hand break basil leaves in 2 - 3 pieces & place on top of tomatoes.
Season with salt and pepper and top with the olive oil.

title: Neapolitan Cauliflower Salad

ingredients.rawText: 1 curly escarole, chopped in large pieces
3 oz (100 gr) roasted bell peppers in jar, drained
3 oz (100 gr) stale crusty bread, diced and lightly toasted

instructions: Clean and boil the cauliflower. Transfer boiled cauliflower to a bowl.
Add the escarole, olives, giardiniera, bell peppers, anchovy fillets, capers, toasted bread, olive oil, vinegar, salt and pepper.
Toss salad to combine the ingredients and decorate with egg slices.
Prepare the salad ahead and keep it refrigerated.

title: Chicken Salad with Radicchio
instructions: Cut the boiled chicken breasts into cubes.
Place chicken cubes into a clay pot to soak with olive oil, lemon juice, a few grated slices of lemon peel, & chopped parsley. Salt lightly.
Let the mixture marinade for a minimum of 2 hours in the refrigerator.

Just before serving, prepare a serving plate with a bed of red radicchio, cut into thin strips. Place chicken breast cubes and marinade on top of radicchio. (May also be served in small plates to each guest)
notes: Margaret V.

title: Coleslaw Dressing

ingredients.rawText: 2 pkg sliced almonds, browned in oil

instructions: Mix together dressing ingredients (sugar, vinegar, oil, salt & pepper)
In large bowl mix together green onions, sliced almonds, ramen noodles and shredded cabbage.
Pour dressing over coleslaw ingredients and toss well. Enjoy.

title: Coleslaw Vinaigrette Salad

ingredients.rawText: ¼ cup pimiento-stuffed green olives, sliced

instructions: Trim outer leaves from cabbage; quarter, core & chop coarsely. (need about 6 cups). In a large bowl combine cabbage with olives and carrots.
Combine oil, vinegar, capers, salt, pepper and red pepper flakes in a large screw-top jar. Cover; shake well. Pour dressing over cabbage and toss to coat. Cover and refrigerate for several hours
To serve: Top cabbage with cherry tomatoes; sprinkle with parsley. Toss again before serving. Tip: *If you wish, gently remove inner core of cabbage to chop, reserving outer shell to fill.

title: Napa Cabbage Salad
instructions: Finely shred the cabbage; do not chop. Combine green onions and cabbage in a large bowl, cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.
Preheat oven to 350°F. (175ºC)

Make the crunchies. Melt butter in a pot. Mix ramen noodles, sesame seeds and almonds into pot with melted butter. Spoon mixture onto a baking sheet and bake crunchies, turning often to make sure they do not burn. When browned remove from the oven.

Make the dressing: In a small saucepan, heat vinegar, oil, sugar, and soy sauce. Bring the mixture to a boil for one minute. Remove the pan from the heat and let cool. Combine dressing, crunchies, and cabbage just before serving.

title: Olive Salad

ingredients.rawText: 2/3 cup green olives, pitted and coarsely chopped
2/3 cup black olives, pitted and coarsely chopped (or gaeta olives)
1/4 cup pimento, chopped (or 2 small jars diced pimentos)
1/3 cup flat leaf, finely chopped (Italian) parsley

instructions: Mix all the ingredients together. Cover and allow to marinate over night or a minimum of 12 hours.
Olive Sandwich: Slice French bread in half lengthwise.
Lay open halves on a baking sheet and spread tops with olive salad, using 1 cup and reserving remainder in refrigerator.
Divide the salami over the sandwiches, followed by half the cheese, prosciutto and mortadella. Top with remaining provolone. Drizzle with a bit of olive oil from the Olive Salad.

Top with remaining half of bread and cut into 4 pieces. Note: The sandwiches may be served as open-faced hot sandwiches also. Prepare both halves of the bread with fillings and place sandwiches under the broiler until the cheese is melted. Cut each half into 4-8 pieces

title: Potatoes and Greenbeans Salad

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb (450 gr) very tender small green beans
1 lb (450 gr) small red potatoes, boiled

instructions: Clean the green beans removing the two extremities.
Boil the green beans in lightly salted water until tender but still firm and not too soft or overcooked. Let the beans cool to room temperature. Transfer to a bowl.
Cut the potatoes in large chunks and add them to the bowl.
Add salt, extra-virgin olive oil, and vinegar. Mix thoroughly and serve.

title: Peacemakers' Potato Salad

ingredients.rawText: 3/4 cup chopped onion (more if you like)

instructions: Wash, dry and oil potatoes. Bake at 350°F. for an hour, or until done. The potatoes may be baked on the rack in the oven or in a roaster.
When potatoes are baked, cool, peel and cut into small pieces.
Add onions and chopped parsley, then Hidden Valley Ranch Dressing, and mix well. P.S. This recipe is on the back of the Hidden Valley Mix.
notes: Nothing is better than fresh green beans and tomatoes from the garden.

title: Tomato Salad

ingredients.rawText: dried or fresh oregano salt as desired

instructions: Cut tomatoes into wedges.
Slice onions.
Crush garlic and chop.
Wash and cut fresh basil leaves.
Place above into a bowl.
Add salt, oregano and olive oil as desired. Samantha chops tomatoes.
Mix well and serve.

title: Serbian Romaine Salad

ingredients.rawText: fresh ground black pepper to taste
2 green peppers, seeds removed and diced
2-3 green onions, trimmed, chopped and divided
1 cucumber, peeled, seeds removed and sliced thin
1 romaine lettuce or baby lettuce leaves, if you can find them

instructions: Combine oil, vinegar, garlic, basil, thyme, oregano & marjoram in a canning jar and shake to combine. Refrigerate overnight.
An hour before serving, remove garlic from dressing and discard.
Combine tomatoes, peppers, about 2/3s onion and cucumber with dressing. Let the flavours meld for about an hour, more if you like.
Line platter with Romaine and top with vegetables. Sprinkle feta and remaining onions on top. now their son, Frank, continues the tradition.
notes: Drying seeds and making seedlings was passed on by Antonio Ruffolo, to his wife Rosina and

title: Tuna and Bean Salad

ingredients.rawText: 3/4 lb (300 gr) dry cannellini beans or 2 cans white beans
1 can tuna fish in oil (approximately 1/2 lb, 200 g), drained
1 - 2 tbsp white wine vinegar (optional) Salt and pepper to taste

instructions: Tip: *** If using canned beans, drain the beans and rinse them with fresh water before preparing the salad.
Clean and wash the beans the night before. Place them in a container and cover with fresh water. Let the beans soak in the water overnight.

The next day, when ready to cook, drain the beans. In a stockpot, pour 1 quart (1 litre) water and add the beans. Boil for about 20 minutes or until the beans are tender. Let the beans cool to room temperature.
Transfer the beans to a bowl.
Add celery and drained tuna fish.
Add vinegar. Season with salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly. Add extra- virgin olive oil. Mix to combine the ingredients and serve.
notes: Select fresh firm ripe tomatoes from the plants.

title: Artichokes Roman Style
instructions: The artichoke season in Italy begins in December and ends in spring. Some artichokes are large and tender and one variety in particular, called “cimaroli” (literally “those that grow on the top”) are the best ones. Large, globe-like, full of pulp, and with tender leaves, they are picked early to avoid the unpleasant tough chokes inside. This dish is good when served warm or lukewarm. If cold, let the artichokes come to room temperature. Avoid warming them for a second time, otherwise their taste will have an unpleasant tang. Artichokes Roman Style are dressed with Mentuccia (Calamintha Officinalis), a type of mint with very small leaves that spontaneously grows in the Rome area. Difficult to find in Canada, the mint can be substituted with parsley instead.
1 large juicy lemon, cut in half 4 artichokes 1 bunch of Italian parsley 2 cloves of garlic Salt and pepper to taste 6 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil 1/2 glass of water

To clean artichokes fill a large bowl with fresh water. Squeeze half lemon in the water. Reserve the other half. After cleaning each artichoke, rub the outside of the artichoke with the half-lemon and then place the artichoke in the bowl. Placing the artichoke in lemon water will prevent it from discolouring. Repeat until all artichokes are clean.
Chop the parsley and the garlic very fine and mix them together.

Rinse the artichokes in fresh water to remove the lemon flavour, drain well, shake away the excess water, and pat them with a cloth. Rub the outsides and the insides with salt and pepper. Insert the mix of parsley and garlic uniformly among the leaves.

Place the artichokes in a large saucepan with stems up and leaves down. Add the extra-virgin olive oil and the water. Cover the pan, place paper towels between the pan and the lid, closing it as tightly as possible. Steam will form in the pan while the artichokes are cooking. The paper will prevent the steam from escaping and the artichokes will cook uniformly.

Turn heat to medium and cook for about 20 – 30 minutes. Cooking time may vary, depending on the quality and size of the artichokes. After about 20 minutes test for readiness. When the artichokes are ready, a fork can be easily inserted into the thick part of the stem.
Uncover the pan and turn the heat to high. Fry artichokes for a few minutes, turning them carefully on all sides until the outer and bottom leaves of the artichokes are brown.
Serve warm with the cooking oil.

title: Bread Stuffed Artichokes

ingredients.rawText: 1-2 tbsp extra olive oil for drizzling
2-3 tbsp Parmesan or Romano cheese, grated

instructions: Rinse artichokes well, tugging leaves outward to loosen slightly for stuffing. Trim off stems so artichokes sit on a flat surface.
Trim off the pointed tips of each leaf. Set aside.

In large bowl combine bread crumbs, cheese, parsley, garlic salt, and pepper. Mix well; slowly add the oil until the crumb mixture is moistened enough to stick together. Adjust the amount of oil depending on the type and amount of bread crumbs used.
Stuff each leaf of the artichoke, starting from the bottom and working your way around, with crumb mixture.
Stuff desired amount of leaves and shake off excess mixture.
Continue this step with remaining artichokes.
Place artichokes in a large baking pan and fill bottom of pan with 1/2 to 1 inch of water. Drizzle olive oil over top of stuffed artichokes and cover tightly with heavy duty foil.
Cook on 375ºF. for approximately 60-80 minutes (depending on size of artichoke) or until leaves come out easily.
Cool for 10 minutes; serve and enjoy!

title: Meat Stuffed Artichokes

ingredients.rawText: Ground pork, beef or sausage meat

instructions: Rinse artichokes well and tug leaves to loosen slightly for stuffing. Trim off stems so artichokes sit upright. Trim pointed tips of leaves with knife or scissors. Place prepared artichokes in a baking dish.
Sauté meat, drain fat, add tomato sauce and cook a few minutes.
In a large bowl combine bread crumbs, cooked meat and sauce, cheese, parsley, minced garlic, salt, and pepper. Add oil until the crumb mixture is moistened enough to stick together.
Stuff each leaf of the artichoke, starting from the bottom and working your way around, with crumb mixture. Fill each artichoke with stuffing.
Fill the bottom of the baking pan with 1/2 to 1 inch of water. Put artichokes in pan and drizzle with olive oil. Cover tightly with foil.
