Cook at 375°F. for about 60-80 minutes (depending on size of artichoke) or until leaves come off easily when pulled. Serve while hot!

title: Oven-Roasted Asparagus
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425ºF. (220ºC).
Wash and trim asparagus. To remove woody ends, grab stalk of asparagus at either end and bend until it snaps. It will naturally snap where it starts to get tough.
Place asparagus into a mixing bowl; drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, garlic, salt, and pepper. Arrange asparagus in a single layer in a baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven until just tender, 12 to 15 minutes depending on thickness. Sprinkle with lemon juice just before serving.
notes: Roasted asparagus seasoned with garlic, lemon, and Parmesan cheese. This recipe is super quick to prep and roasting removes any bitterness. Try it next to lamb or grilled fish. Recipe by swedishmilk

title: Sautéed Beans with Sage

ingredients.rawText: 4 oz (115 gr) fresh ripe tomatoes, peeled and diced

instructions: Clean and wash the beans the night before, place them in a container, and cover with fresh water. Leave the beans to soak in the water overnight.
Drain the beans the next day when you are ready to cook them
Put the beans in a stockpot full of water and boil for about 20 minutes, or until the beans are tender.
In a skillet, pour the extra-virgin olive oil and turn the heat to medium. Add garlic and sage, and sauté until the garlic starts colouring to a very pale brown.
Add the beans, salt, and pepper. Sauté over low heat for about 2–3 minutes.
Add the tomatoes. Cook uncovered over low heat for about 20 minutes or until the beans are tender and the sauce thickens
Stir occasionally, adding a small quantity of water if the beans become too dry.

title: Serbian Beans & Carrots
instructions: Put beans in a pot with cold water. Heat and boil for about 10 minutes.
Discard water and replace it with new, hot water. Add salt and sliced carrot.
Cook until beans get cooked but each bean must remain solid.
With a slotted spoon remove beans from water and dry them but keep the water.
Chop onion in large pot and put in hot oil until it becomes golden brown. Add 1 tablespoon of paprika powder, mix it well for 30 sec and remove from the heat.
Take onion from oil and mix with beans and bay leaves. Put it in a large, deep bowl pour some water that is left after cooking.
Put beans in oven and bake until the top becomes dark brown. of water used, it may be almost completely dry or like a very thick sauce.
notes: Note: Prebranac can be served both hot or cold and depending on amount

title: Green Beans with Onion
instructions: Wash the green beans and then clean them eliminating the extremities.
Fill a stockpot with water and bring to a boil. Add a pinch of salt, the green beans, and boil for about 5 to 10 minutes, or until the green beans become tender. Drain in a colander
Pour the olive oil in a skillet, and turn the heat to medium. Add the onion and sauté until tender and translucent.
Add the green beans, salt, pepper, and sauté for about 5 minutes.

title: Bok Choy

ingredients.rawText: 2 lb baby Bok Choy, halved or quartered

instructions: To keep bok Choy intact, halve or quarter each stalk and wash under cold running water
Add the oil to a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat. Swirl to coat the entire surface of the pan.
Add garlic and shallots, stirring constantly for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the bok Choy, soy sauce, and sesame oil. Toss to coat and cover.
Cook for 1-2 minutes, uncover, toss, then cover and continue to cook until bok Choy is cooked to desired doneness (approximately 3-5 minutes more).
Sprinkle with crushed red pepper and serve immediately. Enjoy!

title: Easy Broccoli Cottage Bake

ingredients.rawText: 10 oz frozen chopped broccoli, thawed and well drained
3/4 cup old or medium cheddar cheese, diced
1/4 cup roasted red peppers, well drained and chopped

instructions: Mix all ingredients until well blended.
Pour into 9 inch pie plate sprayed with no stick cooking spray.
Bake at 350°F. for 45 minutes or until centre is set.
Let stand 10 minutes before cutting into 6 slices to serve.

title: Broccoli and Cheese Stew
instructions: Quickly thaw frozen broccoli by placing in a colander or holding under hot running water. Separate the pieces with fork; drain well.
Combine Broccoli with all remaining ingredients in a large bowl and beat until well blended.
Pour into greased crockpot
Cover and cook on high for 1 hour, then on low for 2 to 3 hours.

title: Roasted Parmesan Brussel Sprouts

ingredients.rawText: 1 pound brussel sprouts, cleaned and trimmed
3 cloves garlic, peeled & sliced *See the notes section before starting*
¼ cup Parmesan Cheese, freshly grated
Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
3 tablespoons good quality olive oil or for Keto, butter flavor coconut oil

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F/200°C.
Clean by running brussel sprouts under faucet. Trim brussel sprouts, cut in halves, dry and place them in an oven safe dish. Dry well before cooking.
Add garlic, Parmesan, salt, pepper and last olive oil. Toss to coat.
Roast in the oven uncovered for 20-25 minutes until crisp, brown and caramelized on the outside and tender on the inside. Serve with more grated cheese.
notes: *This recipe makes very crispy garlic . In some ovens, it could burn or become bitter. If you are worried about the garlic getting too dark for your liking, slice it thin and add at the last 5-7 minutes of cooking time, coated in a little oil, and scattered around the pan. *For less crispy cheese , add it for the last 10 minutes. *To keep sprouts from sticking , line pan with nonstick foil or paper. *Dry brussel sprouts well . The drier the sprouts, the crispier they’ll be. Use paper towels to pat dry or use a salad spinner to spin off liquid. *For crisper sprouts , spread them on the pan without too much touching. Overcrowding causes Brussel sprouts to be steamed instead of roasted. *Cut sprouts into even-sized pieces to have a similar texture. *Start with a hot oven so sprouts are crisp on outside and soft on inside. *Brown is good . If you’ve never cooked brussel sprouts this way, at first glance, you may think it looks burnt out of the oven, but once you taste it, you’ll know those little “burnt” areas are the best-tasting parts! *When using untrimmed brussel sprouts , trim off the dry part of the stem at the base of the sprout and any loose outer leaves. *For an extra caramelized area , place the sliced brussel sprouts cut-side down on the pan. This will give a larger browned surface area. *Leave smaller sprouts whole to avoid overcooking. *On smaller sprouts that don’t need to be halved, slice a cross in the stem. The stem is the toughest part of the brussel sprout and the cross allows them to cook at the same rate as the tender area. *For an extra kick of flavor , try adding lemon zest before roasting and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice before serving. *Be sure to taste and season well before serving.

title: Roasted Soy Sauce Brussel Sprouts
instructions: Wash and trim sprouts and cut in half.
Combine remaining ingredients in a glass bowl and whisk well to mix
Place sprouts and marinade in a gallon sized zip lock baggie and turn to coat. Place in the fridge for at least 1 hour.
Pour the sprouts into a colander (place a bowl under to catch the marinade if desired).
Spread sprouts out on an oiled baking sheet.
Place in a 425°F preheated oven and cook, stirring once for 25 minutes or until crispy tender.
When the sprouts are done, move to a warm bowl and drizzle with a few drops of balsamic vinegar.

title: Roasted Brussel Sprouts with Chestnuts
instructions: Cut an X into the flat side of chestnuts. Place in baking dish in single layer. Add water and oil. Roast in preheated 350’F oven for 35 minutes or until tender when pierced with a knife. Remove from oven. Cover with damp towel or moist paper towel. Let stand 10 minutes. Peel chestnuts by hand and reserve. Try to keep chestnuts whole but not necessary. Chestnuts should be in large pieces so as not to burn during roasting.

In a bowl, toss brussel sprouts with shallots, oil, salt and paper. Place on parchment-lined baking sheet and roast in a preheated 400ºF oven for 25 minutes or until tender. Turn half way through cooking. Last few minutes reduce temperature and add chestnuts to heat.
Remove from oven and toss with syrup and chestnuts. Serve hot.
notes: Note: If canned chestnuts are available, they may be substituted for fresh.

title: Cabbage Rolls

ingredients.rawText: Cabbage leaves boiled in salt for 5 minutes
ingredients.normalizedName: cabbage leaves boiled in salt minutes

instructions: Mix everything together except cabbage leaves.
Place mixture in each cabbage leaf, roll up and secure with toothpick.
Put sauce in bottom of pan. Add cabbage rolls. Pour sauce on top sprinkle with cheese. Bake 350ºF 45 minutes
notes: Anne V.

title: Fried Cabbage
instructions: Place water in pot, cover and bring to a boil.
Add cabbage to pot and bring to a boil at high heat for a few minutes.
Decrease heat to medium, remove lid to allow water to evaporate.
Fry garlic and onions in oil in small frying pan and mix with cabbage
Salt the cabbage and allow to cook until water is evaporated
If desired fry sausages, add to cabbage mixture and cook for a few minutes stirring constantly

title: Sautéed Cabbage (Cavolo Affogato)
instructions: In a large sauté pan, put olive oil, chopped peppers and garlic.
Slice the cabbage in about 2 inch pieces. Separate the pieces so that all the leaves are loose.
Turn the heat to medium. When the oil is hot transfer the cabbage to the pan. Don’t let the garlic burn or color.
Place the lid on the pan and cook covered for 10 to 15 minutes, until the cabbage is tender.
The cabbage should release enough liquid to cook with its own juices. Check occasionally and add a little warm water if the pan appears too dry. Don’t let the cabbage stick to the pan.
When the cabbage is ready, optionally sprinkle the red vinegar in the pan, turn heat to high and mix vigorously to evaporate. Quantity of vinegar may vary depending on strength and personal taste.

title: Ukrainian Holubts (Cabbage Rolls)

ingredients.rawText: ½ lb ground beef and pork
4 or 5 tbsp butter or other fat

instructions: Fill an 8-10 pint saucepan with boiling water and put over high heat to keep at a rolling boil. Add salt
Remove core of cabbage and place cored side down in the boiling water. Let rest for 1 minute then turn the cabbage cored side up.

The leaves will almost immediately start to fall away from the head. As the leaves fall apart, take them out of the pan and stack on a platter. If they stick to the head, there may be some core left and the leaves should be cut away with a paring knife. Do this quickly so that the cabbage leaves are only wilted and not cooked.
Separate tougher outside wilted leaves from the tender inside leaves.
Using a paring knife cut away the bulky part of the vein from the tender leaves, leaving just a thin strip to hold the leaf together. Set aside.
Tear the outer leaves in half by pulling from the thin top edge of the leaf down to the thicker, large veined end. Set aside.
Meat and Rice Filling: Put raw rice in 1 ½ cup of cold water with 1 tsp of salt in a saucepan, bring to a boil, stir and then cover the saucepan.
Turn off the element. Set kitchen timer for 10 minutes. After 10 minutes, remove from the element, take off the cover and allow the rice to cool.
Stir in 1 cup of tomato juice and 1 tbsp of tomato paste until well blended and then set aside.
In frying pan brown ½ lb of ground beef or pork or both using half and half. Add onions and sauté.
Add 1 clove of garlic, 1 tsp of Worcestershire sauce, tsp of basil, cup of tomato juice or V8 and tsp of tomato paste.
Add cooked rice.
In a roasting pan, pour 1 cup of tomato juice.
Take a cabbage leaf and fill with meat and rice mixture. Roll the leaf folding as you roll. Continue until all leaves or mixture are finished.
Place rolled cabbage leaf in roasting pan. Cover with tomato juice.
Cover with foil. Bake at 325°F. for 1 ½ to 2 hours. Tip: * For variations add ½ cup or more of well browned bacon to rice and meat filling for added flavour
notes: Georgina V.

title: Russian Cabbage Rolls
instructions: Remove core from cabbage and separate the leaves.
Place leaves in large, shallow pan or pot and pour boiling water over them. Let stand in hot water for 3-minutes. Remove with slotted spoon and drain.
Sauté beef and onion in butter until meat is browned. Add rice, parsley and dill and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Place 2 to 3 tablespoons beef mixture in center of each cabbage leaf and roll, jelly roll fashion, tucking in ends.
Place in baking pan.
Blend tomato sauce, lemon juice and enough water to make 2 cups. Pour over cabbage rolls.
Cover and bake at 350ºF. 45-60 minutes or until rolls are tender.
Serve with sour cream. Makes 6 servings .

title: Vegetarian Cabbage Rolls

ingredients.rawText: Serbian sarma is similar to Greek dolmas, though it's made with cabbage
ingredients.normalizedName: serbian sarma is similar greek dolmas

ingredients.rawText: instead of grape leaves. Sarma is made with ground pork and beef. During
ingredients.normalizedName: instead grape leaves sarma is made with pork beef during

ingredients.rawText: Lent it is made with vegetables. Hence: lenten (posna) sarma. This recipe
ingredients.normalizedName: lent it is made with vegetables hence lenten sarma this recipe

instructions: sounds odd, so one could use grape leaves instead to Greek it up.
1 cabbage 4 or 5 onions, diced 2 or 3 stalks celery 1/3 cup oil 1 green pepper, diced 1/2 cup rice, cooked 1 cup ground walnuts 1-16 oz can whole tomatoes Salt to taste
Cut out the hard core of the cabbage; or, if using sweet cabbage boil it and then separate each leaf.
Heat oil in a skillet, then add onions, celery and pepper. Fry until soft.
Add cooked rice, stir and fry the whole deal.
Remove from heat, add salt and walnuts, mix well.
Scoop approximately a tablespoon onto cabbage leaf and roll it up.
Place rolls in a large pot, adding tomatoes and enough water to cover.
Cook over a slow boil (medium heat) for about an hour. Keep covered until it's time to eat.

title: Butter Sautéed Baby Carrots
instructions: In a saucepan bring water to a boil. Add carrots and cook for about 5 minutes or until tender. Drain in a colander.
In a skillet put butter and turn heat to medium. When the butter starts foaming add carrots, salt, and pepper.
Sauté for about 1 to 2 minutes. Top with the parsley. Serve warm.

title: Marinated Carrots
instructions: Combine cooled, cooked carrots with onions and green pepper in large bowl.
Combine the rest of ingredients in saucepan. Bring to a boil, stirring to dissolve sugar and salt.
Pour over vegetables and chill overnight or for 2 or 3 days.

title: Cauliflower Frittelli

ingredients.rawText: 2.5 glasses of water (2.5 dl, 8 fl oz);
Abundant extra virgin olive oil to fry;

instructions: Traditionally, the batter is prepared in the morning for the dinner.
In a bowl mix the flour with the yeast and a pinch of salt.
Create a well in the flour mound and pour water and egg whites in the center, mixing constantly to prevent lumps, until you get a homogeneous mix. Let it sit until evening.
Clean the cauliflower, breaking apart all the flowers, wash it and blanch it in slightly in salty water.
Mix the batter again before dipping the cauliflower pieces in it.
Fry the cauliflower pieces in plenty of hot olive oil.
Drain them on a layer of paper towels, add salt and enjoy immediately.
notes: F rittelli can be served as appetizers or as a side dish with meat or as a snack. “Frittelli” are pieces of cauliflower or sprouts of wild herbs or pieces of cod dipped in batter and fried in abundant olive oil.

title: Cauliflower Gratin

ingredients.rawText: One white cauliflower, about 2 lbs (900 gr)
3 oz (90 gr) parmigiano reggiano cheese, freshly grated and salt

instructions: Cleaning the cauliflower: Cut out the bottom of the cauliflower. Eliminate the tough green leaves. Carve out the centre. Cut the cauliflower in half.
Separate the florettes and cut in 2” (5 cm) pieces. Green tender leaves can be used. Place in a bowl full of fresh water. Wash and drain.

Cooking: In a large saucepan, bring to a boil lightly salted water. Place the cauliflower into the boiling water. Boil until the cauliflower is tender but still firm, then drain in a colander. Don’t overcook.
Preheat oven to 350°F. (180°C). Butter a medium size oven pan. Distribute the boiled cauliflower in the pan. Cover evenly with the balsamella white sauce. Top with the grated parmigiano cheese.
Place in the oven for about 10-15 minutes or until the surface starts turning gold. Serve warm.
Glorified cheese cauliflower: Prepare and cook 1 medium head cauliflower (about 2 lbs) as directed above for whole cauliflower.
Pour Cheese Sauce (below) over hot cauliflower
Sprinkle with paprika if desired.

title: Cheese Sauce
instructions: To Pan Fry: Heat margarine over low heat until melted. Blend in flour, mustard, salt and pepper. Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until smooth and bubbly. Remove from heat and stir in milk
Heat to boiling, stirring constantly. Boil and stir 1 minute
Stir in cheese and pepper sauce, stir over low heat until cheese melts.
To Microwave: Microwave margarine uncovered in 1 pint glass measuring cup until melted about 30 seconds. Stir in flour, mustard, salt and pepper with fork
Gradually stir in milk. Microwave uncovered 1 minute; stir.
Add cheese and pepper sauce. Microwave uncovered to thicken, 1 1/2 minutes

title: Sweet and Sour Cipollini Onions
instructions: Peel, wash and pat dry the onions.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet.
Add the onions and cook, swirling the skillet to move the onions around without breaking them, until a light golden brown.
Add salt to taste, cover with a lid and cook over low heat, swirling the pan every few minutes until the onions are soft, about 10 minutes.
Dissolve the sugar in the vinegar and just before removing the onions from the heat, pour it over the onions.
Increase heat to medium and cook a few minutes more until the sauce is reduced and the sugar starts to caramelize.
Serve warm as a side dish or chilled as an appetizer
notes: This is a nice side dish to serve with roasted or grilled meats. Served cold it is a wonderful appetizer for a summer night’s dinner.

title: Corn on the Cob
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and add the corn.
Cook, stirring occasionally to make sure the corn is submerged for 3 to 5 minutes or until the corn is tender and bright yellow.
Alternatively, place the corn in a large pot filled with cold water. Bring it to a boil and cook 1 to 2 minutes until the corn is just tender.

title: Eggplant Caponata

ingredients.rawText: 2 lbs (900 g) eggplant, cut into 3/4-inch dice
1 lb (450 g) celery, boiled and diced
6 oz (180 g) Sicilian green olives, pitted
4 tbsp capers in salt, rinsed and drained
Olive oil for frying and sautéing

instructions: Boil celery sticks for 6-7 minutes until tender; dice finely.
In a saucepan, heat 4 tbsp olive oil, sauté garlic, onion, and red pepper flakes until soft.
Add pureed tomatoes, basil, olives, and capers. Simmer for 10 minutes and set aside.
In a separate large frying pan, fry diced eggplant in hot oil until golden brown (8-10 mins). Add a pinch of salt.
Transfer fried eggplant and cooked celery into the tomato mixture.
Whisk sugar and vinegar in a small bowl until dissolved, then stir into the pan.
Cover and cook 5 minutes until thick and glossy.
Transfer to a dish and let cool. Caponata tastes best the next day served lukewarm as an antipasto or side.
notes: The sweet and sour (agrodolce) glaze creates an extraordinary balance with the creamy fried eggplant.

title: Eggplant Rollatini
italianTitle: Involtini di Melanzane con Ricotta e Prosciutto

ingredients.rawText: 1 large eggplant, sliced lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices

instructions: Dip eggplant slices in beaten egg, then coat thoroughly with breadcrumbs.
Fry eggplant slices in olive oil over medium-high heat until golden brown on both sides. Drain on paper towels.
Preheat oven to 350°F.
Spread a thin layer of ricotta cheese onto each fried eggplant slice, then top with a slice of prosciutto.
Roll up tightly and arrange seam side down in a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Pour tomato sauce over rolls and cover generously with shredded mozzarella.
Bake for 15 minutes until cheese is melted, bubbling, and golden brown.
Serve rolls hot as a main course or side dish.
notes: Can be served alongside tender angel hair pasta for a complete Sunday meal.

title: Eggplant Lasagna
instructions: Peel the eggplant and trim the ends. Slice lengthwise into 1/4 inch thick slices to resemble lasagna noodles. Set on a tray and sprinkle with salt. Let stand for 15 minutes to sweat out some of the liquid. Turn slices over and repeat salting and sweating. Brush off excess salt.
Preheat the oven to 350ºF. (175ºC). Place bacon in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook until evenly browned on both sides. Remove to drain on paper towels.

Spread a thin layer of sauce in the bottom of a 9x7 inch casserole dish. Cover with a layer of eggplant slices. Sprinkle with a little of the shredded mozzarella, then top with another thin layer of sauce, and another layer of eggplant slices. Spread the ricotta cheese only on top of this layer of eggplant, and cover with more eggplant. Spoon on more sauce, then crumble feta cheese and bacon over the sauce, followed by half of the remaining mozzarella cheese. Top with a final layer of eggplant, remaining sauce, and the rest of the shredded cheese.
Bake for 25 minutes in the preheated oven, if cheese does not brown, turn on the broiler for about 5 minutes at the end.

title: Eggplant Rollatini

ingredients.rawText: 1 eggplant, peeled and cut lengthwise into 1/4 inch slices

instructions: Dip the eggplant slices in egg, then coat with breadcrumbs. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Fry the eggplant on each side until golden brown. Remove to a paper towel lined plate to soak up excess oil
Preheat the oven to 350ºF. (175 ºC.)

Spread a thin layer of ricotta cheese onto each slice of eggplant. Place a slice of prosciutto onto each one. Roll up tightly and place seam side down in a 9x13 inch baking dish. Pour spaghetti sauce over the rolls, and top with shredded mozzarella cheese.
Bake for 15 minutes in the preheated oven until the cheese is melted and lightly browned.

While the eggplant rolls are baking, bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add the angel hair pasta, and cook for 2 to 3 minutes, until tender. Drain. Serve eggplant rolls and sauce over pasta.

title: Eggplant with Tomato and Garlic Sauce

ingredients.rawText: 1 ½ cups tomato pulp, cut into thin strips

instructions: Cut end off eggplant, wash and without peeling, cut into 1/2 inch cubes
Heat garlic briefly in oil, add eggplant and season with salt and pepper t
Cover and simmer 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add strips of tomato pulp and simmer another 10 minutes. Serve hot.

title: Eggplant Rolls

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 lb tomatoes, puréed in a blender

instructions: Slice the eggplant lengthwise approximately 1/4” (5 mm) thick
In a skillet, bring 2 tablespoons of the oil to frying temperature. Lightly fry the eggplant until golden on both sides.
Transfer the fried eggplant to a plate lined with kitchen paper to drain the excess oil.
In a small skillet, fry half of the bread crumbs with 1 tablespoon of the extra-virgin olive oil, until golden. Set aside.

In a skillet over medium heat, pour 3 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil. Add the onion. Sauté until the onion is soft and translucent. Stir in the fried bread crumbs. Transfer to a bowl and cool to lukewarm.
When onion is cold, combine the grated cheese, oregano, and pepper.
Preheat oven to 370ºF. (190ºC.)
Spread 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil and a small quantity of the bread crumbs on the bottom of an oven pan. This will prevent the eggplant rolls from sticking to the pan.
Place the eggplant slices on a work board. On each slice, put 1 tablespoon of the onion mixture, one egg wedge and 1 tablespoon of tomato purée.
Roll the eggplant slices and place the eggplant rolls in the oven pan, side by side in rows.
Spread the remaining tomatoes, bread crumbs and 3 -4 tablespoons olive oil on the rolls.
Bake for about 20 minutes. Serve warm.

title: Stuffed Eggplants
instructions: Slice eggplants in half and boil for 5 minutes. Remove and cool.
Remove pulp and mash together with remaining ingredients.
Salt eggplant bottoms and stuff with mixture.

Place tomato sauce in pan and place stuffed eggplant in pan. (if desired cover with sauce) STUFFED EGGPLANT WITH GROUND BEEF Mary V. 1 large eggplant 1/2 pound ground beef 1/4 cup breadcrumbs 1 egg 2 tomatoes, chopped 1 small onion, diced 1 small red pepper, diced 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 1/4 cup grated Pecorino Romano, Salt to taste 1/2 cup freshly chopped parsley leaves freshly ground black pepper 1/2 cup freshly chopped basil leaves, chopped 3 tbsp. extra-virgin olive oil,
Preheat oven to 350ºF.

Cut the eggplant in half and scoop out the centre, leaving enough meat inside the skin so that it holds its shape when baked. Boil the scooped- out center part until very soft, about 10 to 12 minutes.
Meanwhile, in a sauté pan, heat 1 tbsp. olive oil over medium heat.

Season the beef with salt and pepper. Add the seasoned ground beef to the pan and sauté until all of its liquid is evaporated and the beef begins to brown slightly. Drain the beef, removing the extra, unnecessary fat. Let cool briefly and chop the cooked beef so that there are no large chunks of meat. In another medium sauté pan over medium heat add the remaining 2 tbsp. olive oil and sauté the onions, peppers and garlic together.
In a bowl mix together the cooked eggplant, vegetables, cooked beef, herbs, 1 cup of the cheese, breadcrumbs, and the egg.
Fill the scooped-out eggplant halves with this mixture, dividing it evenly between the 2 halves.

Top with chopped tomatoes and the remaining 1/4 cup of grated cheese, season with salt and pepper, place on an oiled oven tray or baking dish, and bake for 50 minutes in preheated oven. Let cool briefly, slice widthwise and serve.

title: Eggplant Tomato Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºF. (200ºC.).
Spray a pan with non-stick oil spray and arrange eggplant rounds on pan and sprinkle Parmesan over the eggplant.
Layer one slice of tomato on top of each eggplant round.
Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake for 10 to 15 minutes.

title: Stuffed Ground Beef and Pork Eggplants

ingredients.rawText: Hard slices or chunks of bread
1/2 cup parsley leaves, freshly chopped 2 cups Parmesan cheese

instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºF.
Heat the tomato sauce to boiling. Pour sauce over the hard slices or chunks of bread. With a fork or knife ensure that all the bread is softened with the sauce and in small pieces.
Cut the eggplant in half and score the flesh 2 or 3 times with a sharp knife. Boil eggplant in salted water until soft about 10-12, minutes.
Strain in a colander and run cold water over eggplants.
Scoop out the centre, place on a cutting board and chop the meat.
Place eggplant shells on a platter and sprinkle cheese over the shells.

Season the beef with salt and pepper. Add the seasoned ground beef to the pan and sauté until all of its liquid is evaporated and the beef begins to brown slightly. Drain the beef, removing the extra, unnecessary fat. Let cool briefly and chop the cooked beef so that there are no large chunks of meat.
In the large sauté pan over medium heat add the 3 tbsps, olive oil and sauté the onions, and garlic together.
In a bowl mix together the chopped cooked meat of the eggplant, vegetables, cooked beef, herbs, 1 cup of the cheese, bread slices or chunks, and the eggs.
Fill the scooped-out eggplant halves or shells with this mixture, dividing it evenly among the 20 halves.
Top with grated cheese, season with salt and pepper, and place on an oiled oven tray or baking dish.
Bake for 50 minutes in preheated oven.

Let cool briefly, and serve warm. oven pan and cook for only 30 minutes. Let it cool. Wrap with foil and freezer bag and place in freezer. Defrost and cook in oven for another delicious meal during the week.
notes: Sandy V. Note: This is enough for 10 people. If desired put into ten halves in a glass

title: Sautéed Mushrooms
instructions: Clean the mushrooms and cut them in large slices.
In a frying pan, put olive oil and add the garlic and red pepper.
Turn the heat to medium. Sauté briefly.
Add the mushrooms before the garlic starts coloring. Add salt.
Cook over medium heat until the mushrooms are tender.
Top with the fresh parsley and serve warm.

title: Fried Onions, Tomatoes, and Beans
instructions: Chop the onion in small pieces and fry it in the oil.
Add the peeled tomato and fry.
Add the beans and warm it up.
Add garlic just before serving.
Put on the table, finish with yogurt.

title: Onion Rings

ingredients.rawText: 1 large sweet onion, cut into 1 ½ in. thick rounds separated into rings

instructions: Stir together flour, smoked paprika, and 1/4 teaspoon of the salt in a shallow dish.
In another shallow dish lightly beat egg and water.
Stir together panko and remaining 1/4 teaspoon salt in a third shallow dish.

Dredge onion rings in flour mixture, shaking off excess. Then dip in egg mixture, allowing any excess to drip off. Finally dredge the onion rings in the panko mixture, pressing the sides so that it sticks.
Coat both sides of the onion rings with cooking spray.

Place each onion ring in the air fryer basket in a single layer. Cook at 375°F for approximately 10 minutes or until golden brown and crispy on both sides, flipping onion rings at the 6-minute mark. Cover to keep warm while cooking remaining onion rings.

title: Roasted Peppers & Eggplants (Ajvar)

ingredients.rawText: 8 to 12 fresh red New Mexican chillies, or substitute green chilies
1 to 2 tbsp lemon juice (or 1 tbsp red wine vinegar)
1/2 to 3/4 cup olive or corn oil
Parsley, fresh and chopped for garnish Salt and pepper to taste

instructions: Roast the chiles and eggplants over charcoal or a gas flame--or bake them in a preheated 475°F. oven until the skins are blistered and black.
Place the roasted vegetables in a paper bag and let them steam in their own heat for 10 minutes. Peel off and discard the burnt skins along with the stems and seeds of the chilies.
Mash the peppers and eggplant pulp together to form a homogenous mass - completely smooth or slightly chunky, as desired. You can do this in a food processor.
Heat 3 tablespoons oil in a large skillet, and sauté the onion until very soft.
Add the garlic and cook 2 minutes longer. Remove from the heat and stir in the pepper-eggplant pulp, mixing well.
Slowly drizzle the remaining oil into the mixture, stirring constantly to incorporate all the oil.
Add lemon juice or vinegar, salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer to a serving bowl and garnish with the parsley.
notes: Pronounced Eye-var, this dish is made from roasted Peppers and Eggplant. Ripe red mild or medium-hot peppers are most often used, although green peppers, unripe tomatoes, and even string beans can be combined into ajvar. Fresh ajvar is always made during the late summer and early autumn, just after the pepper harvest when many households also can or bottle their own ajvar for use throughout the year. Serve it as an appetizer to spread on thick slices of country-style white bread or flat pita bread or use it as a side dish.

title: Rosina’s Stuffed Peppers

ingredients.rawText: 2 tbsp chopped parsley and 2 tbsp fresh basil

instructions: Wash peppers and set one aside. Cut around stems of 8 peppers and remove seeds and membranes.
Cut out 8 little circles from the reserved pepper to plug the stem holes so filling won't spill.
Parboil rice in salted water for 10 minutes, drain and cool.
In a bowl, combine cooked ground beef, rice, olive oil, Parmesan, parsley, basil, chopped anchovy, nutmeg, and half the tomatoes.
Stuff peppers upside down with rice mixture and cover holes with pepper circles.
Arrange stuffed peppers side by side in a baking dish. Spoon remaining diced tomatoes over top.
Drizzle with olive oil, season with salt, and bake at 350°F for 45 minutes.
Delicious hot or cold the next day.
notes: Nonna Rosina's signature technique of cutting small pepper plugs keeps the savory filling sealed inside.

title: Quinoa Stuffed Peppers

ingredients.rawText: 1 10 oz frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
2 15 oz cans diced tomatoes, drained, liquid reserved
1 15 oz can black beans, rinsed and drained
4 large red bell peppers halved lengthwise, ribs removed
1 ½ cups grated reduced fat pepper jack cheese divided
½ cup (2) ribs celery finely chopped

instructions: Heat oil in saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion and celery and cook 5 minutes or until soft.
Add cumin and garlic and sauté 1 minute.
Stir in spinach and drained tomatoes. Cook 5 minutes or until most of the liquid has evaporated.
Stir in black beans, quinoa, carrots and 2 cups water. Cover, bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium low and simmer 20 min. so quinoa is tender.
Stir in 1 cup cheese. Season with salt and pepper as desired.
Preheat oven to 350°F. Pour tomato liquid in bottom of baking dish.
Fill each bell pepper half with heaping ¾ cup quinoa mixture and place in baking dish. Cover with foil and bake 1 hour.
Uncover and sprinkle each pepper with 1 tbsp remaining cheese.
Bake 15 minutes.
Put stuffed peppers on plates and drizzle with pan juices before serving.

title: Serbian Stuffed Peppers (Punjene Paprika)

ingredients.rawText: l lb ground pork or beef

instructions: Cut tops off peppers, remove seeds and wash peppers to prep for filling
Fry chopped onions and grated carrots in olive oil at medium to high temperature. Stir constantly. After 2-3 minutes add minced meat and salt and continue to fry it for another 4-5 minutes.
Remove from heat and add rice, plain flour, sweet paprika and dehydrated vegetable or green herb stock.
Stir the mixture. Spoon filling into the peppers. Cover the top of each pepper with a slice of Potato. Place peppers in a dish. Place remaining potatoes between peppers.
Pour water until peppers are covered. Boil at low temperature for 40-45 minutes. Sprinkle chopped parsley on the top. Serve hot.

title: Vegetarian Stuffed Peppers
instructions: Cut off tops of peppers and remove and discard seeds.
Dice tops, discard stems and mix all ingredients, reserving ½ cup of cheese.
Stuff peppers and place in a round microwavable casserole.
Put extra filling around peppers. Peppers should fit tightly in pan.
Cover with plastic wrap, piercing 4-5 times for vents.
Microwave on high 15 minutes. Sprinkle with reserved cheese.
Cover let stand 2-3 minutes and serve. Tip: *This dish can be made ahead and frozen for later use. Do not cook until fully thawed.

title: Twice Baked Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºF. (175ºC.).
Bake potatoes in preheated oven for 1 hour.
Meanwhile, place bacon in a large, deep skillet. Cook over medium, high heat until evenly browned. Drain, crumble and set aside.

When potatoes are done allow them to cool for 10 minutes. Slice potatoes in half lengthwise and scoop the flesh into a large bowl; save skins. To the potato flesh add sour cream, milk, butter, salt, pepper, 1/2 cup cheese and 1/2 of the green onions. Mix with a hand mixer until well blended and creamy. Spoon the mixture into the potato skins. Top each with remaining cheese, green onions and bacon.
Bake for another 15 minutes.

title: Boiled Potatoes
instructions: Boil and mash potatoes
Mix in cheddar cheese, milk, salt, pepper & oregano well into potatoes
Place in pan and bake at 350ºF for ½ hour until golden.
notes: Iolanda V.

title: Mashed Potatoes

ingredients.rawText: salt and garlic powder to taste

instructions: Cut potatoes lengthwise in half and into slices.
Place in cold water to remove starch and keep from browning.
Bring pot of water to a boil.
Heat milk in microwave for a minute.
Place drained potatoes in boiling water for 8 minutes or until soft.
Drain potatoes in colander, return to pot.
Add warm milk, cold butter, salt and garlic powder and mash with a potatoe masher, stirring to combine all ingredients evenly. Serve warm

title: Potato Mold (Gatto’ di Patate)

ingredients.rawText: 2 oz (60 gr) parmigiano reggiano cheese grated

instructions: Boil potatoes with their skin on until tender. Peel, and mash them in a food mill or with a potato masher while still hot.
Preheat oven to 350°F. (175°C).
Transfer to a bowl the mashed potatoes, egg, 1 tablespoon of the butter, parmigiano, mozzarella, ham, parsley, lemon rind, nutmeg, milk, salt, and pepper.

Mix with a spatula to thoroughly combine all the ingredients. Brush an 8 inch (20 cm) diameter round oven pan with butter, Spread with some of the breadcrumbs. Transfer the potato mixture to the pan. Level it with a spatula. Top with the breadcrumbs. Make a design on the surface of the potatoes with the prongs of a fork. Top with the remaining diced butter.
Bake for about 30 minutes until the surface is golden. Serve hot.

title: Potatoes and Mushrooms Gratin

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 oz (15 gr) dried porcini mushrooms 2 lb (900 gr) golden potatoes
1 lb (50 gr) cremini mushrooms, sliced 1 1/2 tablespoons butter
2 oz (60 gr) parmigiano reggiano cheese freshly grated

instructions: Place the mushrooms in a small bowl filled with warm water. Soak the mushrooms for about 30 minutes until softened. Drain, chop coarsely and set aside.
Slice the potatoes very thin and place in a container. Fill with water until the potatoes are covered.
Preheat oven 400°F. (200°C)

Place the butter in skillet and turn heat to medium. When the butter starts foaming, add mushrooms, soaked wild mushrooms, and thyme. Sauté until the mushrooms are tender and the liquid is evaporated. Add salt and pepper.
In a bowl mash the blue cheese until smooth. Add the cream and mix to dissolve the cheese.
Spread butter on the bottom of a baking dish. Place one third of the potatoes in the bottom of the baking dish. Spread half of the mushrooms evenly on the potatoes.
Add a layer with half of the remaining potatoes then the remaining mushrooms. Finally top with the remaining potatoes.
Pour the cream mixture on top of the potatoes.
Top evenly with the grated parmigiano cheese.
Bake for about 45 minutes until the potatoes are tender, the cream is absorbed and the surface is golden.
Serve hot spooning from the dish.

title: Nordica Cheese Tater
instructions: In a small bowl combine all ingredients
Mix well Makes 1 cup for a quick and easy, low calorie addition to potatoes

title: Aunt Lena’s Special Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 425ºF
Spray casserole dish with cooking spray
Chop onion and clove of garlic. Sauté chopped onion and garlic in ¼ cup of oil in the oven for 5 minutes
Peel and cut potatoes into quarters and put them in a casserole dish.
Add a dash of salt, oregano, black pepper and oil and stir to mix evenly.
Put casserole dish in oven with the lid on.
A quarter hour later, take lid off casserole dish and turn potatoes over.
Let bake for half hour
9. Ready to serve ENJOY

title: Oven Roasted Potatoes
instructions: Wash, peel and cut potatoes into chunks or wedges.
Place peeled, cut and washed potatoes in bowl and cover with cold water. Water will turn white from the starch. Drain and wash potatoes. Let potatoes drain in colander and dry on paper towels.
Preheat oven to 450ºF
Spray a black heavy oven pan with cooking spray.
Place dried cut potatoes in pan and add oil, garlic salt, pepper, salt and oregano. Mix well.
Put pan in oven for 15 minutes. Stir potatoes.
Return pan to oven for 15 more minutes. Cool, serve and enjoy.

title: Olive Oil and Rosemary Roasted Potatoes

ingredients.rawText: 1 pound Yukon gold or white potatoes . 1 tsp sea salt
ingredients.normalizedName: yukon gold white potatoes sea salt

instructions: In a small bowl, combine olive oil, minced garlic, minced rosemary sea salt and freshly ground black pepper.
Peel and quarter potatoes. Place potatoes in a greased baking dish, large enough that the potatoes are in one layer.
Pour the oil mixture over the potatoes and toss to coat well.
Roast potatoes in a 350ºF oven for 45 minutes or until golden brown and tender.

title: Sauerkraut, Potatoes

ingredients.rawText: 2 lb sauerkraut, I prefer the kind that is refrigerated, not canned

instructions: Brown sauerkraut in butter, slowly. If desired add a sliced onion
Set aside. Can be done the day before and reheat before serving.
Boil 3 of the potatoes, cool, peel and cube. Set aside.
Can also be done day before, and then reheated.
Grate 3 remaining uncooked potatoes, add 2 eggs, salt and pepper and add enough flour to make mixture very thick.
Bring large pot of water to boil.
Put potato/flour mixture on large dinner plate with a small teaspoon, dip in boiling water, scoop a teaspoon of dough and put into the water.
Stir occasionally. Stir water frequently with wooden spoon to keep dough drops from sticking. Boil until dumplings rise to top. (This should take only a few minutes.) Drain.
Fry bacon and crumble. Reserve bacon drippings.
Mix cubed potatoes, sauerkraut, dumplings, bacon and drippings in a large bowl.
Add freshly ground pepper to the final product. personal taste.
notes: Tip: * Amounts of sauerkraut, bacon, and drippings can be adjusted to

title: Scalloped Potatoes
instructions: In a greased 13 X 9 inch pan, arrange alternating layers of 5 lbs of thinly sliced potatoes with 1 lb thinly sliced onions.
Dot each layer with 1 tbsp butter, a pinch of salt and pepper and finish with a layer of potatoes.
Mix together 1 1/2 cups milk, 1 cup whipping cream and 2 tbsp freshly chopped parsley. Pour over potato mixture in dish.
Bake at 425ºF for 29 minutes; reduce heat to 350ºF and continue to cook for a further 60 to 75 minutes or until potatoes are cooked and golden brown on top.

title: Scalloped Potatoes and Goat Cheese

ingredients.rawText: 4 lb russet potatoes, peeled, thinly sliced
4 tsp herbs de Provence***”A dried herb mixture available at specialty foods
ingredients.normalizedName: herbs de provence herb mixture available at specialty foods

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Butter a 13 x 9 x 2-inch glass baking dish.
Mix all ingredients except goat cheese and potatoes in large pot.
Simmer over medium/high heat.
Add half of goat cheese; whisk until smooth. Chill remaining cheese.
Add potatoes to pot; bring to a simmer.
Transfer potato mixture to prepared dish, spreading evenly.
Cover with foil; bake 15 minutes.
Uncover and bake until potatoes are very tender and liquid bubbles thickly, about 50 minutes.
Dot potatoes with remaining cheese.
Bake until cheese softens, about 5 minutes.
Let cool 15 minutes before serving. Serves 8

title: Sweet Potato (Yam) Supreme

ingredients.rawText: 2 cups cooked sweet potatoes, mashed 2 tbsp cream or milk
1 cup pecan halves or crushed walnuts 1/3 cup butter (or less)

instructions: Mix potatoes, cream, melted butter, salt and pepper.
Spread into a greased casserole dish.
To make Topping: Heat brown sugar and butter over low heat, stirring constantly until butter is barely melted.
Do not cook after butter is melted or topping will harden when casserole is heated.
Spread topping over potatoes and cover with pecan halves.
Refrigerate until ready to heat.
May be warmed in microwave or oven until bubbling hot to serve.

title: Sautéed Rapini (Broccoletti Ripassati)

ingredients.rawText: Crushed red pepper flakes to taste

instructions: Pull and discard tough outer leaves. Cut hard stem base; slice remaining stems in half into 4-inch lengths.
Wash rapini thoroughly in fresh water and drain.
To eliminate part of the natural bitterness, drop briefly in boiling salted water for 2 minutes, then drain.
In a large sauté pan, heat olive oil, garlic, and crushed red pepper over medium heat (do not let garlic brown).
Add rapini to the pan, cover with lid, and sauté for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Season with salt to taste and serve hot or lukewarm.
notes: The quintessential Calabrese green side dish. A staple for sausage dinners and holiday menus.

title: Rapini and Sausages

ingredients.rawText: Freshly ground black pepper to taste

instructions: Preheat oven to 500°F.
Clip off large stems of the rapini, remove the tough outer leaves and split the stem in two or four. Wash in cold water, drain. Set aside.
Prick the sausage with a fork, set it on a metal pan or skillet, and bake 15 minutes, turning occasionally. Remove to a plate and cool.
In a 4 to 5 quart pot, sauté the garlic gently in the oil until golden but not brown.
Add the rapini, salt, pepper flakes, black pepper and water.
Mix well, cover and cook 5 to 7 minutes.
Meanwhile, slice the sausage. Mix with the rapini. Remove and discard the garlic. Serve immediately. Makes 4 servings.
notes: If you cannot find broccoli rabe, use broccoli florets. The broccoli rabe is perfect for sausages as the bitter-almond flavor of the rapini sets off the sweetness of the meat. The choice parts of the broccoli rapini are the slender green florets. Blanching reduces the bitterness.

title: Spinach Cheese Casserole

ingredients.rawText: 10 oz frozen chopped spinach, thawed 12 oz medium seashell pasta

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. (175°C).
Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook pasta in boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes, or until al dente; drain.
Bring 1/2 cup water to a boil in a saucepan, and cook the spinach 4 to 6 minutes until tender.
Place the cooked pasta in a medium bowl. In a small bowl, whisk together the eggs and oil. Toss the pasta with the cooked spinach, egg mixture, and breadcrumbs.

Cover the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish with 1/3 of the pasta sauce. Pour half of the pasta mixture into the baking dish, and cover with another 1/3 of the pasta sauce. Sprinkle with half of the cheddar cheese and half of the mozzarella. Layer with remaining pasta mixture, and top with remaining sauce. Sprinkle with the rest of the cheddar and mozzarella cheeses.
Bake 45 minutes or until bubbly and lightly browned.

title: Rapini and Italian Sausages

ingredients.rawText: 1 tablespoon water, salt and black pepper

instructions: Preheat oven to 500°F. Prick sausages with a fork and bake in skillet for 15 minutes, turning occasionally. Cool and slice.
Clean rapini, removing tough outer stems. Split stems in half.
In a 4-5 quart pot, sauté smashed garlic gently in olive oil until golden.
Add trimmed rapini, salt, pepper flakes, black pepper, and 1 tbsp water.
Cover tightly and cook 5 to 7 minutes until tender.
Add sliced cooked sausages to the rapini, toss together over heat for 2 minutes, and serve immediately.
notes: The bitter-almond notes of rapini perfectly offset the sweet fennel and pork in the sausage.

title: Squash
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºF.
Wash and cut squash lengthwise in half and remove seeds.
Pour water in baking pan and place squash cut side down in pan.
Place pan in preheated oven for about half an hour
Squash is cooked when fork can easily pierce pulp
Remove squash from oven and scoop out and mash pulp
Add salt, pepper, honey and brown sugar to taste
Return pulp to squash shell and serve.

title: Spaghetti Sauce Squash
instructions: Wash, cut squash in half lengthwise and remove seeds
Pour 1 cup of water in baking pan.
Place squash cut side down in water in baking pan.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°F.
Turn and bake until skin turns tender.
With fork release spaghetti like strands of cooked squash.
Add salt, pepper, bacon bits, and Parmesan. Enjoy or serve with spaghetti sauce.

title: Spaghetti Tofu Squash
instructions: Cut a small spaghetti squash in half, remove seeds, and steam for 1/2 hour.
Sauté in the olive oil: 5 cloves of garlic, cubed tofu, diced carrots.
Sauté until carrots are just beginning to soften and the tofu is beginning to brown.
Add pine nuts, chopped tomatoes, edamame beans, spices, salt & pepper.
Use a fork to remove the cooked spaghetti squash meat so that it comes out in strands.
Add it to the sauté. Serve hot. Yum!

title: Swiss Chard
instructions: Wash Swiss Chard and cut off stalks.
Cut off bottom of stalk and peel off strands
Slice stalk in half and chop up.
Add chopped stalk to covered pan with boiling water
Boil at least 5 minutes
Chop up green leaves and add to boiling water
Let cook for a few minutes
Drain and set boiled Swiss Chard aside
Heat oil and sauté garlic and onion. Add chopped red pepper
Add boiled chopped Swiss Chard and fry

title: Rice Stuffed Tomatoes

ingredients.rawText: 4 tomatoes ripe but firm, about 2 1/2 inch (6 cm) in size

instructions: Fill a medium size saucepan with water and bring to a boil. Add rice and cook for 5 minutes. Drain the rice and place in a bowl to cool.
Cut the top of the tomato horizontally, removing a little cap.

Keep this cap and empty the inside of the tomatoes removing the pulp, the seeds and the watery part. Transfer the seeds and the watery part to a fine colander, strain and remove the seeds. Chop the pulp finely.
Add the tomato juice to the rice mixture.
Keep the caps and the tomatoes on a board upside down ready to fill.
Add to the boiled rice the chopped tomato pulp, garlic, basil, extra-virgin olive oil, salt and pepper. Combine thoroughly together.
Sprinkle the inside of the tomatoes with salt.
Peel the potatoes, wash and cut in approximately 3/4 inch cubes. Season with salt and pepper.
Grease the bottom of a baking pan with a little extra-virgin olive oil.
Preheat oven to 350°F. (180°C).
Fill the tomatoes with the rice mixture, place the cap on top and align the tomatoes in the center of the baking pan.
Spread the diced potatoes around the tomatoes in the pan. Top the potatoes with the extra-virgin olive oil and place in the oven.
Bake for approximately 90 minutes or until the rice is cooked. Serve at room temperature. Garnish with fresh basil leaves.

title: Turnip Casserole
instructions: Mix together 3 cups hot mashed turnip, 2 tbsp butter and 2 eggs.
Add flour, brown sugar, baking powder and salt and pepper to taste
Top with buttered breadcrumbs
Sprinkle with paprika
Bake 30 minutes at 350 F

title: Grilled Marinated Vegetables
instructions: Slice the vegetables lengthwise approximately ¼ inch thick.
Place all the sliced vegetables on a grill or barbeque. Turn the vegetables a couple of times until cooked on both sides.
In a small bowl put the garlic, about 2 tablespoons of the parsley, olive oil, vinegar, salt and red pepper. Whisk lightly to emulsify.

Place about 1 tablespoon of the oil mixture on the bottom of a serving dish. Place in the dish one layer of vegetables, top with some of the oil mixture and a little of the parsley. Continue the layers topping them with the oil mixture and the chopped parsley, until all the vegetables are used. Finish topping with the oil mixture and parsley.
Place vegetables in the refrigerator to marinate for at least 24 hours.
Serve at room temperature.

title: Summer Vegetable Medley Ratatouille
instructions: Wash, peel and slice all the vegetables
Heat oil in a large skillet. Fry chopped onion and garlic
Add potatoes to oil and fry until golden
Add sliced eggplants and beans and mix well with potatoes
Cook and stir for about 10 minutes
Add sliced peppers, zucchini, salt and pepper and mix well
Add tomato sauce and cook over medium low heat for another 10 minutes, stirring frequently to avoid scorching the vegetables

title: Vegetable Medley
instructions: Empty tomatoes into a large pan
Add basil, salt, pepper and Worcestershire sauce
Simmer
Peel and cut all vegetables into equal size pieces
Wash and chop parsley
Place all vegetables in pan
Cover and simmer until vegetables are tender
Serve over rice or noodles, or in a bowl with brown bread
notes: Sandy V.

title: Fried Zucchini with Eggs
instructions: This dish can be served as a starter or as an accompaniment to roast meat . 4 courgettes (zucchini), medium size 2 eggs Salt and pepper to taste 4 tbsp flour Sunflower oil, for shallow frying Parsley, chopped Grated cheese and salad, to serve
Peel and grate the courgettes, put them in a colander, sprinkle with salt and leave for 30 minutes to 1 hour.
Drain and remove excess moisture by squeezing them with your hands.
Put the courgettes, eggs, flour, parsley, salt and ground black pepper in a medium bowl. Mix well.
Place spoonfuls of mixture into hot shallow oil and flatten each one with a spoon.
Cook for 4-5 minutes until golden brown on both sides. Put each cooked slice on kitchen paper to absorb the excess oil.
Place on a serving dish with salad and sprinkle with grated cheese.

title: Fried Zucchini
instructions: In a heavy pan or deep fryer, heat oil.
Wash zucchini and cut into half inch strips, removing some of the centre from each strip.
Lightly salt zucchini and let them sit for an hour or two, then drain off liquid and flour them.
Shake off the excess flour and drop a few pieces at a time into the hot oil (test oil with a bread cube to see if it's hot enough).
Wait until they have firmed up before flipping them over if needed, or they will break.
When golden brown, remove them with a slotted spoon place on an absorbent towel or a rack to drain. Serve immediately.

title: Pitolini (Fried Zucchini Flowers)
instructions: Combine all above ingredients
Heat oil in frying pan; when very hot. drop batter by tbsp into hot oil.
Turn pitolini over once
Remove from oil when golden
Put pitolini on paper towels to drain some of the oil

title: Zucchini Flowers Fried

ingredients.rawText: ¾ cup beer or club soda

instructions: 1.Wash zucchini flowers. Take out stamen. Can be fried whole or torn into strips. When torn into strips, the middle can be cleaned properly.
Use fork to mix flour, baking powder, egg and salt.
Dip blossoms in batter and let drip.
Heat oil in frying pan and slide battered blossoms into hot oil.
With tongs turn once until golden and crispy.
Remove from oil and put on rack or paper towel on tray to cool.
Fry remaining battered blossoms. Sprinkle with salt and serve.

title: Zucchini Milanese Style
instructions: Cut end off zucchini and cut them to same length, wash and drain.
Boil zucchini in lightly salted water for 10 minutes.
Drain and slice in half lengthwise.
Remove pulp, drain, chop and reserve it in a bowl. Reserve shells
Brown ground beef in skillet and drain
Mix ground beef, parsley and basil with chopped zucchini pulp
Add breadcrumbs, all of the grated Parmesan except for 2 tbsps, eggs, freshly grated nutmeg and salt and pepper.
Mix these ingredients thoroughly and set aside
In pan melt 1/4 cup of the butter and stir in flour. Gradually stir in milk. Stir over low heat until sauce bubbles and thickens
Stir sauce into zucchini mixture. Add more breadcrumbs if mixture is not thick enough to spoon
Using a spoon fill zucchini shells with mixture
Arrange stuffed zucchinis side by side in a buttered (use remaining butter) shallow baking dish.
Sprinkle with remaining grated Parmesan and bake in a preheated oven for about 1/2 hour. Serve hot in baking dish.
notes: Sandy V.

title: Stuffed Vegetables

ingredients.rawText: 1/3 cup packaged Italian breadcrumbs 1/2 lb hot Italian sausage
ingredients.normalizedName: packaged italian breadcrumbs hot italian sausage

instructions: Cook zucchini in boiling, salted water in a large skillet 10 minutes. Drain; scoop out insides, leaving a 1/4 inch shell. Mash insides; drain well. Put shells in a shallow baking dish.

Remove casings from sausage; break up meat. Cook sausage in same skillet 5 minutes. Add onion and garlic; sauté until tender, 3 minutes. Stir in mashed zucchini and breadcrumbs. Spoon mixture into shells; sprinkle with cheese
Bake in a moderate oven (350ºF) 30 minutes or until piping hot.
notes:  Use medium ripe tomatoes, eggplants, artichokes  Lean ground beef or veal can be substituted for sausage meat

title: Zucchini Ricotta Lasagna
instructions: Cut zucchini lengthwise in ¼ inch thick slices.
Place in basket over one inch boiling water. Steam 5-6 minutes until tender.
Drain and pat dry.
In large bowl combine ricotta, eggs, 3 tbsps breadcrumbs, 3 tbsps Parmesan, parsley, oregano, basil & pepper.
Spray baking dish with Pam and cover bottom with 1/3 spaghetti sauce.
Sprinkle 2 tsps. breadcrumbs and cover bottom of pan with half of the zucchini slices, ricotta mixture and mozzarella.
Cover with 1/3 of spaghetti sauce. Layer zucchini slices, ricotta mixture and mozzarella and cover with remaining sauce.
Combine 2 tbsps breadcrumbs & Parmesan cheese & sprinkle over top.
Cover and bake at 350°F. for 45 minutes.
Uncover and bake for 15 minutes.
Remove from oven and let stand 15 minutes before serving.

title: Ida’s Marinated Eggplants

ingredients.rawText: Hot pepper cut in round slices (optional)

instructions: Red shepherd peppers, sliced thinly into 2 inch strips.
Wash and peel eggplants
Slice eggplants into strips and place in pail, add salt and stir as more strips of eggplants are added. Dark water will be created.
Cover with a lid or plate and place 2 gallons of vinegar on lid overnight. Let stay for 24 hours.
Next day drain eggplants and rinse in cold water a few times removing all seeds.
Drain eggplants in colander and return to pail.
Boil vinegar and water.
Carefully pour the boiled vinegar and water over eggplants in pail and stir. Let rest for 24 hours or until cool to handle.
Slice red peppers into 2 inch strips, put into a small pail or bowl, salt and stir. Place plate over peppers and place weight on top of plate. Let rest for 24 hours.
Next day wash out salt from peppers and drain.
Squeeze out water and vinegar from eggplants using a colander with weight over it to drain or use a torchetto.
Add shepherd peppers, black pepper, salt, garlic, oregano and oil to drained eggplants and stir well.
Fill 6 mason jars tightly with eggplant mixture. Pack tightly just under the rim of the jar and cover with oil. Close mason jars.
Add hot red pepper slices to remaining eggplant mixture and toss wearing gloves so as not to touch hot peppers. Pack into jars tightly, topping with oil and closing the lids tightly.
After a few days check to ensure eggplants are covered with oil.

title: Rosina’s Marinated Eggplants
instructions: Wash eggplants, peel and place in pail with cold water to keep peeled eggplants from discolouring.
Cut into thin strips and drop them into another pail, salt and stir as strips of eggplants are added. Keep in pail with salt overnight.
The next day, wash under cold water, remove seeds and drain.

Boil 2 parts water and 1 part vinegar. Return eggplant strips to pail and cover with water and vinegar and stir. Ensure that eggplant strips are covered with water and vinegar mixture. We put a plate the same diameter as the pail upside down on top of the eggplants and then put two gallons of vinegar or oil on top of the plate for weight.
Keep eggplant strips another day in the vinegar and water mixture.

The next day squeeze water out of eggplants by placing in a clean cloth in a bushel and putting weight on it for 5-6 hours or overnight. (Optional: We squeeze out the water by placing the eggplant strips in a torchetto or vegetable press and fix the eggplants right away.)
The next day put oil, mint leaves, chopped garlic and salt in a bowl and add and stir in eggplant strips.
Pack eggplant strips firmly tamping in jar, cover with oil and seal. Variation: Green tomatoes or sliced zucchini

title: Gina’s Marinated Eggplants
instructions: Wash and peel eggplants. Put in pail with water to avoid peeled eggplants going black.
Slice eggplants into strips. As strips are cut, put in pail, add salt and stir. Cover, put weight on top and let stand 24 hours.
Next day boil 1 ½ gallons of water and add ½ gallon vinegar.
Pour vinegar water onto eggplants in pail.
Top with a plate and put weight on top to keep eggplants submerged for 24 hours.
Next day drain water. Wash eggplants and remove seeds.
Add salt, mint, chopped pepper, (optional boiled cauliflower)
Place in jars. Pack firmly with a tamper (8 inch long, 1 inch in diameter dowel). Top with oil and seal with lid.

title: Eggplants 20 Lb Marinated
instructions: Wash, peel and place eggplants in pail with water.

Slice eggplants lengthwise in half. Put side of half cut eggplant on cutting board. Hold eggplant up with one hand and slice eggplant down into 7 or 8 slices. Place slices stacked one on top of each other with widest cut slice down flat on cutting board and cut into 8-10 strips.
Put strips into pail, add salt stirring constantly while cutting and adding to pail.
Put large plate on pail and put two gallons or vinegar or oil on top of plate for weight.
Let stand 30 hours.
Drain black water.
Wash eggplants under faucet (put in large steel colander so seeds will be removed) and place in next sink then with steel scooper pick up eggplants and place in plastic colander in white bin.
Transfer eggplants into pail from white colander.
Boil 1 ½ gallons water and ½ gallon vinegar.
Put eggplants half in steel colander and half in white colander, place in sink and cover with plate and top with weight (gallons of vinegar or oil).
Place eggplants from steel colander in a pail and add half of the boiling vinegar water and stir carefully.
Place eggplants from white colander in pot with remaining boiled vinegar water, stir and let stand 24 hours until cool.
Next day, drain eggplants, fix with oil and spices and pack into jars.
notes: Nonna Rosina enjoyed organizing the cantina or cold room.

title: Hot or Mild Giardiniere

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 head cauliflower, chopped into small florets
2 large red bell peppers, seeded and chopped
4 Serrano peppers (or more according to heat preference), sliced
1/4 teaspoon red chili flakes (optional, for hot giardiniera)
1 cup green olives, pitted and sliced

instructions: Place the chopped veggies a large non-reactive pot or bowl. Pour 1/4 cup kosher salt over the vegetables and enough water to cover them. Let the vegetables soak in the salt water for at least 6 hours or overnight.

To prepare the jars, place the spices into each of the jars, reserving the garlic and olive oil until after the brine is added. (I like to make some jars hot and some mild by adding/omitting the red chili flakes).
Thoroughly rinse and drain the vegetables before dividing them up between the jars. Pack the vegetables as tightly as you can. Place a clove of garlic (cut in half) in each jar.

To make the brine bring the water, vinegar and salt to a boil. Pour the boiling brine over the vegetables leaving a little more than 1/2 inch headspace from the top. Pour a tablespoon of olive oil over the top in each jar. Thoroughly wipe the rims with a wet paper towel, ensuring no oil or other residue is on them and seal the jars.

If you plan on using the giardiniera within two weeks let the jars sit at room temperature for a day or two and then transfer them to the fridge. The flavour only gets better with time so wait at least 2-3 days before eating it. Will keep refrigerated for 2 weeks.

If you are canning the giardiniera for long-term storage, seal the jars with the lids and rims and prepare a boiling water bath. Boil the jars for 10 minutes. Carefully remove the jars and let them sit undisturbed for 24 hours before moving them. months but will keep for at least a year.
notes: If processed in the water bath, the giardiniera is best consumed within 6

title: Italian Giardiniere

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb assorted vegetables (cauliflower, carrots, green beans, peppers, onions
and fennel), washed, dried thoroughly and cut into small pieces

instructions: The above makes 1 quart giardiniera jar.

½ bushel shepherds peppers, 1 celery, destringed and chopped 8 large onions, cut into 8 parts 2 large cauliflowers 5 lb carrots, thick sliced in food processor 16 cups water 8 cups white vinegar 2 ¼ cups sugar 1 ½ cups kosher salt 5 tbsp oregano 3 tbsp whole peppercorns 5 bay leaves
Prepare sterilized jars. Place jars in boiling water for 10 minutes.

Prepare brine (pickling liquid). In a large pot, combine, water, vinegar, sugar and kosher salt. Bring to a boil over medium/high heat and stir for 1-2 minutes to dissolve sugar and salt. Turn off heat. Add dry oregano, bay leaf and whole peppercorns. Cover and allow to steep for 10 minutes. Bring brining solution back to a boil.
Pack the chopped veggies into hot jars. Keep going until all vegetables are packed as tightly as possible.
Top off vegetables with the hot pickling liquid until all vegetables are covered. With a wooden spoon push down on vegetables to create space on top to add more vegetables.
Ensure all veggies are covered with liquid. Leave a half-inch space between top of brine and the lid.
Seal the jars and put in bushel covered with a cloth. When finished, cover cloth over jars and allow to seal. Keep hot jars in covered bushel for a few days.

title: How to Cure Fresh Olives
instructions: Sort olives and remove any bruised or ones with insect holes in them.
Put them in a large container with a lid and cover them with water until they start to float.
Put the lid on the container and put it in a shady place.
Change the water every day for 10 days.
To Brine the olives: Boil the 1.5 L of water and the 150 g of salt for 10 minutes then leave to cool. You can add herbs such as thyme or bay leaves to the salt water if you like.
Sterilize the jars you have collected by heating them with their lids off in a 200 oven for 15 minutes. Leave to cool.
Boil the lids in water for 10 minutes and leave to drain and dry.
Drain water off olives and pour them onto tea towels to dry them
Check through the olives again for any rotten or blemished ones.
Fill the jars with olives to within about 2 cm from the top of the jar.
Pour in the cooled salt solution until it gets to the top of the jar.
Screw the lids on, label the jars, then place them in a dark place.
Wait for two months before eating. Rinse olives before being eaten.
notes: Cure your olives at home with a simple method. Preserved green olives and fresh tomato salad.

title: Green Olives

ingredients.rawText: 2 16 lb cases of jumbo green olives

instructions: Crack olives in centre with stone on top of cutting board and drop into pail half filled with water. Put one box of cracked olives in one pail and the other box of olives in the second pail.
When finished cracking all the olives, dump the dirty water and rinse the olives.
Remove all the loose cracked olives and put into a separate little pail for deboned olives and throw away the pits. Keep the whole cracked olives in the large pail.
Fill the pail with clear water so that olives are covered and add a handful or two of salt. Cover the water with a clean dishcloth so olives remain submerged.
After four days drain the olives of the dirty black water.

Making the brine: Fill a jar with olives, add water so the olives are covered. Measure the water used to fill the jar and use it as a guide for the water needed to fill the jars. For example, a half jar of water was used as our guide. We know that approximately 25 500 ml mason jars are required for one case of olives. So we put 3 jars of warm water with 25 handfuls of salt in a pail of water so the salt could melt, then added 22 more jars of cold water and stirred it to make sure the water absorbed the salt evenly. A raw egg was placed in the salted water to ensure that it floated on top of the water and it did. If the egg floats the ratio of salt to water is good.

Fill all the jars with the olives. We put the deboned olives in separate jars and the whole cracked olives in the other jars. Apply pressure on the olives so that they remain under the rim of the jar.
When all jars are filled, use a measuring cup to fill the jars with the salted water so that the olives are totally covered with salted water.
Put the screw caps or lids on the jars loosely tightened.

After three days unscrew the caps a little so that the fizz is removed from the olives then loosely tighten tops again. Do this twice a week for a month until no more fizz is heard when caps are unscrewed.
After a month screw the caps on tight. They should be good for a year.

title: Olives Rosina
instructions: Crack olives with half a brick.
Place cracked olives in a pail and fill with cold water.
On a daily basis drain and wash the olives for a week.
After a week, drain the olives and put into jars. Add salted water and put weight on the top of the jars so that the olives are always covered with water.
notes: Follow steps 1-3. Change the water for 3 days. Remove the olives. Place water in a bucket and stir in salt until dissolved. Place olives in jars and pour salted water over olives. Close jars with lids.

title: Baked Dried Black (Moroccan) Olives
instructions: Separate and rinse olives twice in cold water.
Throw out separated olives and pits.
Let soak overnight in cold water.
Next day drain olives in colander.
Let dry on paper towels.
Line large pizza pan with parchment paper.
Bake at 275°F. for 2 hours.

title: Elvira‘s Hot Marinated Chili Peppers
instructions: Wash and dry peppers on tea towel.
Put on gloves and cut off stems with scissors.
Place peppers in food processor to chop.
Stir in salt as peppers are being chopped.
Wrap salted chopped peppers in a tea towel or cheesecloth.
Place in a colander in the sink (or bowl), cover with a plate and place a weight on top such as a gallon of vinegar or a box of salt
Let rest and drain 24 hours.
Next day squeeze out moisture in torchetto.
Fix with vegetable oil. Place in jars. Ensure head room on top, cover with oil. Put on lid and store in cantina.
notes: Elvira’s hot marinated chili peppers from Frank’s Garden.

title: Rosina’s Roasted Red Peppers

ingredients.rawText: Washed and dried peppers (green and red)

instructions: Roast peppers on barbeque turning to barbeque all sides.
Drop roasted peppers in large pot with ice at bottom. Cover with lid to create steam to loosen pepper skins.
Peel the onion and remove skin layers off the peppers
Cut around stems with a sharp, pointed knife and remove stems.
Cut peppers in half and remove the seeds and fibrous membrane.
Cut peppers into strips.
Put cooled peppers into freezer bags for later use or into jars (dressed as per recipe below)
Combine oil, salt and garlic to taste in a large bowl
Add pepper strips and stir well
Put pepper strips in jars and ensure that they are covered with oil.
Put the lid on jars and store in cantina (wine cellar).

title: Roasted Canned Red Peppers

ingredients.rawText: 4 lb firm, fresh, clean red bell peppers
Additional olive oil for roasting peppers
*Bottled lemon juice has a consistent level of acidity, which you need for this
ingredients.normalizedName: bottled lemon juice has consistent acidity

instructions: Wash red peppers and place in tablecloth covered bushel or box to dry.
Roast red peppers until all charred.
Place ice in deep pot.
Add hot barbecued peppers in pot with ice and cover
Let peppers sit for a while.
Peel peppers, remove cores and seeds. Tear peppers into strips.
Make the Marinating Brine: While the peppers cool, prepare marinating brine.
Heat about 1 tablespoon of the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add the onions and garlic and sauté briefly until fragrant.
Add the remaining olive oil, vinegar, lemon juice, dried oregano, and sugar if using. Bring to a boil then reduce the heat to low and keep warm until ready to use it.
Packing Instructions: Pack into quarter-litre (½ US pint) or half-litre (1 US pint) jars.
Leave 3 cm (1 inch) headspace.
Optional: a pinch of salt per jar.
Top up each jar with clean boiling water (such as from a kettle, for instance), maintaining headspace.
Debubble; adjust headspace.
Wipe jar rims.
Put lids on firmly.
Put jars into canner. Ensure tops of jars are covered with water.
Processing time: either size jar 35 minutes after water boils.
notes: Use water bath method instructions if canning for shelf storage, otherwise just use clean jars and lids and store in the refrigerator for up to 3 weeks.

title: Crisp Green Bean Canning 2021
instructions: Sterilize 6 (1/2 pint) jars with rings and lids and keep hot.
Trim green beans 1/4 inch shorter than your jars.
In a large saucepan, stir together the vinegar, water and salt. Add garlic and bring to a rolling boil over high heat.
In each jar, place 1 sprig of dill and 1/8 teaspoon of red pepper flakes.
Pack green beans into the jars so they are standing on their ends.

Ladle the boiling brine into the jars, filling to within 1/4 inch of the tops and discard garlic. Seal jars with lids and rings. Place in a hot water bath so they are covered by 1 inch of water. Simmer but do not boil for 10 minutes to process. Cool to room temperature.
Test jars for a good seal by pressing on the centre of the lid. It should not move. Refrigerate any jars that do not seal properly. Let pickles ferment for 2 to 3 weeks before eating.

title: Green Bean Canning

ingredients.rawText: 16 cups green beans or 16 cups wax beans, cut in 1 inch lengths

instructions: Pack beans loosely in sterilized jars, leaving an inch of headroom.
Bring remaining ingredients to a boil in a large pot.
Pour over beans, to within 1/2 inch of the top. Wipe edges of jars with a clean cloth and seal with sterilized lids.
Process in hot water bath for 30 minutes. Can be served heated in the liquid from the jar or drained and rinsed, then heated.

title: Tomato Canning Tradition
contributor: Nonna Rosina, Frank, Sandy, Ethan, Hunter, Justin, Sam & Daniel

ingredients.rawText: 5 bushels of fresh, ripe plum tomatoes
Vegetable spray for stainless steel pot
Tomato squeezer machine, propane burner, and 100-quart pot
Sterilized Mason jars, lids, and warm cloths

instructions: Wash tomatoes thoroughly in three water bins.
Cut tomatoes into quarters and discard any bruised spots.
Pass quartered tomatoes through the tomato squeezer machine to separate seeds and peels from fresh juice.
Pour juice into a 100-quart stainless steel pot over the outdoor propane burner.
Add salt and bring to a rolling boil for 1.5 to 2 hours, stirring constantly with a tall wooden spoon so it doesn't burn.
Pour boiling sauce into hot, clean jars leaving 1/2-inch headspace. Seal immediately with lids.
Place sealed jars into bushels lined with blankets to let heat slowly seal the jars overnight.
Store cooled sealed jars in the cantina (cold room) for the entire year's pasta feasts.
notes: An all-hands late-summer family ritual spanning generations from Antonio and Nonna Rosina to the great-grandchildren.
originalPhotoCaption: Grandsons (Ethan, Hunter, Justin, Sam, Daniel) washing and grinding tomatoes; Nonna Rosina stirring sauce

title: Tomato Canning
instructions: Set up and test propane burner.
Line bushels with blankets or cloths.
Spray Pam vegetable spray on bottom of stainless steel pot. Set aside.
Half fill three large bins with water and wash tomatoes from one bin to another. Throw out water when water looks dirty.
Rinse bushels and place clean tomatoes in rinsed bushels.
Cut tomatoes into quarters. Remove bad spots. Throw out rotten tomato.

Set up tomato grinder machine and place two tall pails under the front and back of the spout of the grinder. instructions: Line a baking sheet or cookie pan with waxed paper.

Wash the strawberries and pat dry thoroughly with paper towels; set aside. NOTE: Make sure the strawberries are completely dry. Even a drop of water in the melted chocolate can cause it to “seize” and turn the entire mixture into a grainy mess.

If using refrigerated strawberries, bring them to room temperature a few hours before dipping them in the melted chocolate. If you use cold fruit, condensation will form that will prevent the chocolate from sticking.
Using one of the following methods, melt the chocolate chips:

Melting chocolate methods: Double Boiler: In the top of a double boiler over hot water, (not boiling) melt chocolate; add cream, stirring until smooth. Be careful, boiling water may cause steam droplets to get into chocolate, which can result in “seizing” when the chocolate becomes stiff and grainy. If you don’t have a double boiler you can improvise one by placing a glass or stainless steel bowl over but not touching simmering water in a pot.
Remove from heat and blend in brandy, liqueur, or coffee.
Let the chocolate cool slightly, but it should not set.
Microwave Melting Chocolate: In a microwave-safe bowl, melt chocolate chips using either the defrost setting or 10 per cent power in the microwave.
Microwave for 1 minute, check and stir. If more time is needed, do it in 10 to 20 sec. intervals. Check and stir after each additional heating time

Remove the container from the microwave and stir the chocolate until completely melted. Baking chips and baking chocolate may appear formed and un-melted after heating but will become fluid after stirring. Blend in cream, brandy, liqueur, or coffee.

How to dip strawberries: Grasp stem or green leaves of the strawberry and dip into chocolate and swirl in chocolate to partially cover. Give the strawberry a little shake as you withdraw it from the chocolate (this will fill in all the cracks and leave a nice even line of chocolate at the base.)

When the strawberry is completely withdrawn from the chocolate, swirl it in a quick, clockwise motion to let the excess chocolate drip off. Place on prepared cookie sheet. Repeat with the rest of the strawberries.

Either place strawberries in refrigerator or set aside so chocolate hardens, about 30 min. Transfer fruit onto serving platter to serve. refrigerate for longer storage, but serve at room temperature for greatest flavour .

notes: Arborio rice is a short, fat and slightly oval shaped rice with a pearly white exterior, prized for its creamy texture. It has a high starch content and absorbs the flavours it is cooked in. Arborio rice is used primarily in making risotto but it can also be used to make other dishes that require plump, creamy rice, including rice pudding, and even paella. It can also be part of a soup like minestrone. There are various size designations such as; superfino but the largest grain size is the most common. Arborio rice is high in amylopectin, a starch present in rice. It undergoes less milling than ordinary long-grain rice, so Arborio retains more of its natural starch content. Cooking the rice releases this starch, resulting in a firm, chewy, and creamy rice. Arborio rice costs almost double the regular rice. Do not rinse Arborio rice. Rinsing will remove the starchy coating that creates the creamy texture when cooked. Arborio should only be rinsed if it is being used in a recipe that calls for fluffy, looser rice.
