SECOND RISOTTO COOKING TECHNIQUE: Begin by browning the onion (or leek or whatever) in olive oil, never butter, and once it has browned remove the onion so it does not burn and become bitter as the rice is fried, a process that takes about 10 minutes over a moderate flame, while stirring constantly.

Return the onion to the rice and add previously heated wine. Let the wine evaporate completely before adding the remaining ingredients and the broth, which is added all at once, rather than a ladle at a time.

Cover the rice and let it cook gently for about 15 minutes, stirring in a little more broth at the end that combines with the starch the rice gives off, giving it a creamy texture. Then do whatever last-minute things need to be done and serve it. because the rice absorbs 1.5 times its volume in liquid, so that is what is added. The bottom line is, you may not be able to adopt this cooking method if you are using a rice you have never tried before, but once you have a feel for the volume of water the rice will absorb to reach the degree of doneness you like, this method will give you consistent good results. well to being fried with the rice, for example squash, fresh mushrooms, or various kinds of meat, use the two-pan technique. Prepare the intingolo, or the sauce part with the moist ingredients, in one pot, and once it is cooking start sautéing the onions and rice (remove the onions once they have browned if you want) in a second pot; once the rice is translucent add the warmed wine (return the onions to the pot at this point if you removed them), followed by the first ladle of broth once the wine has evaporated. When the rice is half-cooked add the intingolo, which should be at about the same stage of doneness, and finish cooking the risotto as you would normally. Note 2: Rice was introduced to Italy by the Arabs who dominated Sicily and parts of the Southern mainland in the late Middle Ages but proved best suited to the marshy regions of the Po Valley, where it was adopted by the residents of the Veneto region, Lombardia and Piemonte.
REGULAR RICE: especially good for croquettes, puddings and rice rings.

Rice is best when cooked in the amount of water that will be absorbed during cooking. This gives better flavour, texture and vitamin retention than cooking in a larger amount of water that must be drained off at the end of the cooking period. If too little water is used cooked rice will be hard, brittle and small in volume. To cook: Add 1 teaspoon salt and 2 cups water to 1 cup rice. Heat to boiling, stirring occasionally. Simmer tightly covered for 14 minutes. (Do not remove cover.) Remove from heat and fluff with fork; cover and let steam about 5 minutes.
PARBOILED (CONVERTED) RICE: can be substituted for regular rice. To Cook: Follow package directions.

BROWN RICE: Only the outer husk has been removed, leaving the “brown” bran layer surrounding the rice. This layer of bran contains many vitamins and minerals. The nutty flavour and chewy texture go well with most dishes and can be substituted for white rice. Because of the outer coating, the cooking time may be almost double. To cook: Add 1 teaspoon salt and 2 ½ cups water to 1 cup rice. Heat to boiling, stirring occasionally. Simmer tightly covered, 40 to 50 minutes or until tender. If necessary, add ¼ cup water.

WILD RICE: Although referred to as rice, this is actually the seed for a water grass. However, it is cooked and served in a manner similar to rice. Because it is relatively expensive and has a rather strong nutty flavour, it is often combined with white or brown rice. To cook: Add 1 teaspoon salt and 2 ½ cups water to 1 cup rice. Heat to boiling, stirring occasionally. Simmer tightly covered, 40 to 50 minutes or until tender. If necessary, add ¼ cup water.

PRECOOKED OR QUICK-COOKING RICE: This is a long-grain white rice that has been cooked, dehydrated and dried commercially. It is fast to cook and is a good main dish recipe. To cook : Follow package directions.

RICE TIPS: Cooked rice can be stored covered, in refrigerator for up to 1 week or in freezer 2 to 3 months. To reheat, thaw and place in saucepan with 2 to 3 tablespoons water. Simmer covered, until hot, 5 to 10 minutes. To reheat in over, place rice in covered casserole with water in 350ºF oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until hot. When cooking add: chicken or beef bouillon to water, chopped apple and raisins or orange peel and raisins (add with rice), chopped green pepper, onion or celery (add with rice), ½ teaspoon curry powder, celery or dill seed, marjoram or basil leaves (add with salt). After cooking add: 2 tablespoons margarine or butter, 2 tablespoons poppy seed, ½ cup crushed pineapple, 2 cups cooked peas, ¼ to ½ cup toasted slivered almonds, chopped salted peanuts or cashews, 1 to 2 tablespoons minced parsley, 1 to 2 diced fresh tomatoes and ¼ tablespoons soy sauce (omit salt), ½ cup sliced water chestnuts or 1 cup sautéed mushrooms. Note: Do not rinse rice before or after cooking because of the possibility of losing some nutrients in the water.

RICE SERVING: Allow ½ cup cooked rice per serving. Rice yields: Regular – 1 cup uncooked yields 3 cups cooked rice Parboiled – 1 cup uncooked yields 3 cups cooked rice. Precooked or quick cooking – 1 cup uncooked yields 2 cups cooked rice. Wild rice – 1 cup uncooked yields 3 cups cooked rice.

RICE STORAGE: o Rice keeps well, but is better fresh than old, so don't buy so much that it will sit around for months or even years. In all cases, keep it dry. o Unrefined rice is more perishable, and shouldn't be exposed to sunlight, because the oils in the husk can become rancid. o Once you have opened a package of rice, transfer it into a clean glass jar and keep it in a cool dark place. o To shorten the cooking time, soak the rice in the water you'll be cooking it in for 2 hours (measure out the water precisely). o Cooked rice, especially whole grain or parboiled, will keep for several days in the refrigerator, and is good reheated in a pan with other ingredients, or as a stuffing, or in fritters

Add vegetable broth, together with the juice of the two oranges. When the rice reaches the al dente stage carefully stir in the julienned zest strips, the cleaned sections, and the remaining butter. Cover and let the rice rest for a minute, and then serve. Serves 4 Note: The recipe calls for fresh or thawed shrimp -- If canned shrimp is used, add shrimp at the end lest they become very tough.
notes: RISOTTO CON GAMBERI AL PROFUMO DI ARANCIA

title: Microwaved Sun-Dried Tomato Risotto

ingredients.rawText: 1 oz sun-dried tomatoes, not oil packed, about 10 halves

instructions: In a small saucepan, simmer tomatoes in 1 cup of water for 2 minutes.
Drain, reserving 2/3 cup liquid and chopping softened tomatoes.
Heat butter and oil, uncovered at high in 9 X 13 “ or other shallow microwave-safe dish for 2 minutes.
Stir in onions, garlic and rice and microwave 2 minutes
Stir in tomatoes, reserved 2/3 cup liquid from tomatoes and chicken stock (4 cups liquid total)
Microwave on high 20 to 25 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is almost all absorbed, stirring once or twice
Stir in cheese, then taste and season with salt and pepper
Cover loosely with waxed paper or paper towel and let stand 8 to 10 minutes
Sprinkle with parsley just before serving Makes 6 main courses or 8 side dishes

Monkfish yellow risotto: Risotto Giallo all Pescatrice: Monkfish is known as a poor man's lobster, which gives an idea of how tasty it is. Combined with saffron it makes a perfect first course for a festive meal, like Christmas Eve. 2/3 lb monkfish, skinned, boned, and diced 1 1/2 cups Arborio rice 1 small onion, minced 1 quart simmering vegetable broth A packet of saffron pistils 1/2 cup dry sparkling wine, warmed 1/4 cup parsley, minced 1/4 cup unsalted butter Salt to taste

Heat the butter in a saucepan and sauté the onion and parsley until the onion is translucent and begins to color. Add the monkfish, give the contents of the pot a stir, and then add the rice. Cook, stirring, for a minute, and then add the wine.
As soon as the wine has evaporated, add two ladles of broth and when the broth comes back to a boil reduce the flame somewhat. Continue to cook, adding liquid as the rice absorbs it.
After 7-8 minutes add the saffron, check seasoning, and continue to cook until the rice is al dente and the risotto is creamy. Serve at once; cheese will not be necessary. Serves: 8

title: Risotto with Squid and Tomato

ingredients.rawText: 1 1/2 cups + 2 tbsps (320 g) short grained rice such as Arborio or Carnaroli
ingredients.normalizedName: short grained rice such as arborio carnaroli

ingredients.rawText: 1 1/8 pounds (500 g) cleaned small squid, chopped into small pieces
1 oz (25 g) dried porcini mushrooms, finely chopped (optional)
1 quart (1 litre) vegetable broth or unsalted vegetable bouillon, simmering
1/4 cup (50 g) unsalted butter (or 2 tablespoons olive oil and 2 of butter)
2 tablespoons olive oil (optional, if cooking squid separately)

instructions: Begin by washing squid well, patting dry, and chopping them; should you find any beaks, remove them. If you're using the two pot method, sauté half the onion in 2 tbsps oil, and when golden add the squid.
When it is heated thoroughly stir in the tomato sauce, check seasoning, and reduce the heat to a simmer.

If including mushrooms, which add a nice surf-and-turf touch, set them to steep in warm water for 15 minutes. When they have softened, drain them well, reserve liquid (strain it to remove sand), and chop mushrooms. Add them to the squid.
Heat 2 tablespoons of oil or butter in a second saucepan and sauté the remaining onion and celery until the onion is translucent and is shifting towards gold.
Stir in the rice and continue to cook, stirring, until the grains are translucent, 3-5 minutes.
Add the warmed wine, and when it has evaporated add the first ladle of vegetable broth, together with some (or all) of the mushroom liquid.

Continue to cook the rice, stirring, until it is about half done and at this point add the squid mixture to the pot. Continue stirring and adding liquid as necessary until the rice reaches the al dente stage.
Stir in the remaining butter, fresh ground pepper, and the chopped thyme, turn off the heat, cover, and let the risotto sit two minutes.

Serve at once. Serves 4 tablespoons oil or butter; when they are translucent add the rice and sauté 3- 5 minutes more. Add the tomato and begin adding broth (and mushroom juice if desired), and continue cooking until the rice is about 3/4 done. Stir in the fish and mushrooms and finish cooking the risotto as above.
notes: RISOTTO AI CALAMARI CON POMODORI Although this risotto may be cooked in one pot, the squid should cook in a separate pot as it may come out chewy when doing it all at once. Tip: To use the 1-pot method, sauté the onion and celery together in 2

title: Shrimp and Bean Risotto

ingredients.rawText: 1 1/2 cups (300 g) short-grained rice, e.g. Arborio or Vialone Nano
2 pounds (900 g) fresh whole scampi (use prawns if you must)
1 carrot, half diced and half minced
1 leek, half diced and half minced
1 rib of celery, half diced and half minced Salt and pepper to taste
3 oz (100 gr) freshly grated Parmigiano cheese

instructions: Soak the beans overnight in cold water. Drain them, and put them in a pot with water to cover by a couple of inches, bring the pot to a boil, and simmer them for an hour or until just shy of being done.
Wash the scampi, shell them, and set them aside.

Use a meat pounder to crush the claws and heads, and put the shells in a pot with the diced vegetables and 2 tablespoons of butter. Simmer the mixture briefly and then add 3 pints (1.5 L) hot water. Salt the broth to taste, reduce the heat to a simmer, and cook the broth for a half hour. Filter it through a strainer, squashing down on the scampi to extract as much flavor as possible.

Blend a third of the beans and put them in a pot with all but 2 tablespoons of the remaining butter together with the minced vegetables and a third of the scampi broth. Bring the mixture to a boil, add the rice, cook, stirring gently lest the rice stick to the bottom of the pot adding more liquid as necessary.
A few minutes before the rice is done, add the reserved beans and the bodies of the shrimp; check seasoning.

When the rice reaches the proper al dente texture, stir in the grated cheese and the last of the butter. Mix well, turn off the burner, let the rice rest for a couple of minutes, and the risotto is done. Serves 4.
TOMATO SAUCE RISOTTO RISOTTO CON IL SUGO: In a saucepan bring the broth to a simmer. Place the tomato sauce in a larger saucepan on medium heat and bring to a boil.
Stir the rice into the tomato sauce and turn the heat to medium.

When the rice starts absorbing the sauce and appears thicker, add a ladle of broth. Stir frequently to prevent the rice from sticking to the pan. When broth is absorbed and rice is thicker, add more broth. Continue stirring and adding broth a ladle at a time, keeping rice to consistency of a dense paste. Add salt and pepper. The rice is ready in about 22 minutes, when “al dente” (firm, but not too soft)
Beat the egg with a pinch of salt. When the rice is ready add the egg and mix vigorously.
Stir in the parmigiano cheese and butter. Transfer to warm serving dishes and serve at once.
notes: This is an elegant and comforting dish for Christmas Eve, Good Friday.

title: Dumplings
instructions: Stir together flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt in a bowl.
Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly. Stir in milk and mix until a batter forms that is thick enough to be scooped with a spoon. Allow batter to rest for 3 to 5 minutes.
Drop batter by spoonfuls into boiling stew or soup. Cover and simmer without lifting the lid for 15 minutes. Serve hot and enjoy ingredients. For a finer consistency, sift the flour mixture
notes: Tip: * To make parsley dumplings, add 1 tablespoon parsley flakes to the dry

title: Pelmeni, Vareniki, Perogi Dough

ingredients.rawText: 4 ¼ cups all-purpose flour, measured and sifted

instructions: Put dough hook in mixer. Mix the milk, salt, egg and water
Add the flour, continue mixing until the dough is smooth and flour is well incorporated. Dough should not stick to your hands.
Allow dough to rest 15-30 minutes before using it. Be sure to keep dough tightly covered so it doesn’t dry out.

title: Potato Russian Dumplings (Vareniki)
instructions: Sauté onion in butter until lightly browned. Add to mashed potato. Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Roll out Pelmeni/Vareniki Dough on floured surface, 3 or 4 at a time, and cut into 2.5-inch squares or 3-inch circles.
Place 1 tbsp potato mixture in center of each dough circle.
Brush edges with water.
Fold to form half moons and pinch edges to seal just like the pelmeni. Dust with flour. Repeat with remaining balls of dough.
Bring large pot of salted water to a boil.
Drop vareniki into water and cook until dumplings surface, about 4- minutes. Remove with slotted spoon.
Drizzle with melted butter and sprinkle with dill.

title: Serbian Dumplings (Pelmeni)

ingredients.rawText: 1 tbsp chopped fresh dill or 1 tsp dried dill

instructions: Salt and pepper to taste Makes 100 pelmeni.
Mix ground beef, onion, dill, salt, pepper and enough water, about 1 cup to make a soft mixture.
Roll Pelmeni/Vareniki Dough, 3 or 4 at a time, to 3-inch circles.
Place 1 tablespoon filling on each dough round. Brush edges with water. Fold to form half moons, pinch opposite ends to one another to seal. Repeat with remaining balls of dough.
Brush pelmeni with beaten egg white. Bring large pot full of salted water to boil.
Without crowding, drop pelmeni into boiling water, stirring to prevent sticking, until the pelmeni come to the surface, about 4 minutes.
Remove with slotted spoon.

Melt butter over medium heat and drizzle over pelmeni or serve pelmeni with sour cream. VARIATION: For sour cherry vareniki, substitute 2-cups sour cherry preserves for potato filling and continue to fill, seal and cook in lightly salted water as directed for Potato Vareniki. Serve sweet vareniki topped with additional cherry preserves and sour cream.

title: Homemade Fresh Pasta

ingredients.rawText: 3 cups (15 oz / 400 g) unbleached all-purpose flour

instructions: Sift flour onto wooden board. Shape into a mound and hollow the center to form a deep well.
Break eggs into hollow, add olive oil and pinch of salt.
Using a fork, beat eggs together and gently draw flour in from the inner rim a little at a time until absorbed.
Knead the dough pushing with palms, folding and turning for 8 to 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Shape into a round ball, cover with a moistened cloth or plastic wrap, and rest for 30 to 60 minutes.
Flatten by hand or pass through pasta machine from widest notch down to desired thinness.
Fold and cut into Fettuccine (1/4 inch), Pappardelle (1 inch), Farfalle (pinched squares), or Lasagna sheets.
Boil in abundant salted water for 3 to 5 minutes until perfectly al dente.
notes: The soul of Italian family Sundays. Golden egg yolks give authentic vibrancy and silky bite.

title: Optional Ingredients

Flavouring ingredients. Additional taste can be given by adding to the

For different colouring use only natural ingredients, such as the saffron for intense yellow, red beet for violet, tomato paste for red, spinach for green, bitter chocolate for dark brown, and squid ink for black. Quantity of egg should be reduced proportionally when adding colouring ingredients.

Equipment: Cutting board. Use a wooden board that should be approximately 2 feet wide x 3 feet long (60 x 90 cm), made out of compact hardwood that doesn’t chip when hit by the knife. The long edge should have on the additional wooden trim at the bottom to prevent the board from sliding while you knead dough. Rolling pin. This should be one solid perfect wooden cylinder with rounded edges, about 3 ft long (90 cm) x 2 in (5 cm) in diametre. Knife. Use a sharp cook’s knife. Spatula. You need a large square spatula to clean the board of pasta residue.
Sift the flour. Pour it onto the wooden board. Shape it into a mound, and hollow the center.
Break the eggs and pour them in the hollow.
Add 1 tablespoon of extra-virgin olive oil, and a pinch of salt (optional).
Using a fork, beat the eggs together. Gently bring some of the flour into the egg mix.
Continue drawing flour into the eggs a little at a the time until all the flour is absorbed.
Use your hands to obtain a uniform mixture.
After cleaning the pasta residues off the work surface, pour a thin layer of flour to prevent the fresh pasta from sticking to it.
Return the dough to the work surface and knead the pasta, pushing with the palm of your hands.
Alternatively push and fold the dough.
Repeat this step of pushing and folding for 8 to 10 minutes, or until the dough feels smooth and firm.
Make a round, smooth ball and place it on a plate.
Cover it with a moistened cloth or a plastic wrap and let the dough rest for 30 minutes to 1 hour.

Serve cold over hot pasta. Serves 4

title: Salsa Marinara

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb (450 gr) tomatoes, puréed in blender

instructions: In a skillet over medium heat, pour in olive oil and add garlic.
Before the garlic begins colouring, add the tomatoes, salt, and pepper.
Cook over medium heat for about 20–25 minutes, until the tomato sauce thickens. Stir frequently.

Leave the pan uncovered to allow the sauce to thicken. To prevent the sauce from splattering, cover with a mesh or place a wooden spoon across the edge of the pan, so that the lid is partially open and the steam is allowed to escape.
When the sauce is ready, stir in the parsley and oregano and turn heat off.
Cook the pasta in abundant salt water following manufacturer’s instructions, checking for readiness from time to time until al dente (firm but not too soft or overcooked).

Drain the pasta and transfer it to a bowl. Top with the tomato sauce, toss, and serve at once. * Do not burn the garlic. * Use fresh herbs. * Use fresh very ripe tomatoes, or high quality Italian canned tomatoes.

instructions: In a medium pot with boiling salted water cook macaroni pasta until al dente. Drain.

In a large skillet, cook hamburger and onion until brown. Drain grease. Add mayonnaise and spaghetti sauce; mix well. Add drained and cooked macaroni, cook on medium heat stirring occasionally until heated through. Mix thoroughly.
To serve, pour mixture into a large serving bowl and top with shredded Cheddar cheese. Serve warm

title: Spaghetti Bolognese
instructions: In large saucepan, heat oil over medium-high heat. Add onion, garlic, carrot, and celery and cook for 5 minutes. Add ground beef and stir until beef is no longer pink, but not browned. Drain fat.
Add wine and cook over medium-high heat until evaporated. Add milk, salt, pepper and cook until milk has evaporated. Add the tomatoes, tomato paste, and bay leaf and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and let cook for 2 hours or until thickened, stirring occasionally. Discard bay leaf.
Meanwhile, cook spaghetti al dente. Add half the sauce to the spaghetti, toss, and use the rest to top. Sprinkle with Parmesan cheese and parsley to taste. Serves 6.

9 oz pkg frozen, cooked chicken breast strips, thawed

In the same pot you used to cook the pasta, combine undrained tomatoes and chicken and cook over medium heat until mixture begins to bubble, about 4 minutes.
Add fettuccine and toss to combine. Serve with cheese and avocado. Makes 4 servings

title: Chicken Noodle Casserole

ingredients.rawText: 1 (3 pound) chicken, cooked, deboned and shredded
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup

instructions: Cook spaghetti in a large pot of salted boiling water until it is al dente (about 8 to 10 minutes). Drain and set aside.
Preheat oven to 350°F. (175ºC.).

In a 9x13 inch baking dish combine the shredded chicken, cooked spaghetti, soups, water, salt and pepper. Mix all together. Sprinkle cheese on top of mixture and bake in preheated oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until cheese is melted and turning slightly brown. Let cool 10 minutes and serve.

title: Chicken Vegetable Pasta

ingredients.rawText: ¼ cup packed fresh basil, chopped
½ tsp each salt and pepper

instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook fettuccine until tender but firm; drain.
In another large saucepan, heat oil over medium heat.
Add mushrooms, onion, celery and garlic, stirring often, cooking for about 8 minutes or until tender.
Whisk flour into cold milk until well mixed; stir into mushroom mixture and cook, stirring, until hot.
Add cooked chicken strips, Parmesan cheese, parsley, basil, and hot pasta; simmer, stirring gently, for 3 to 5 minutes or until sauce is thickened.
Season with salt and pepper.

title: Spaghetti all'Amatriciana

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb tomatoes, seeded and diced (or canned plum tomatoes)
1 fresh chili pepper, chopped (or crushed red pepper)
1/4 cup Pecorino Romano cheese, freshly grated

instructions: Add olive oil and diced pancetta to pan and cook over low heat until golden.
Add sliced onion and cook 10 minutes until lightly browned.
Add diced tomatoes and chili pepper; season with salt and pepper.
Cover and simmer gently for 20 minutes until sauce thickens.
Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente. Drain and toss in sauce.
Top generously with grated Pecorino Romano and serve at once.
notes: Originated in the mountain town of Amatrice near Rome. Famous for combining cured pork with rich tomato tang.

title: Spaghetti All’Amatriciana
instructions: Brush casserole with olive oil.
Add pancetta to casserole and cook over low heat.
Add onion, cook for 10 minutes until browned.
Add tomatoes, chili and add salt and pepper.
Cover and cook for 20 minutes.
Cook spaghetti in large pot in boiling, salted water until al dente.
Drain spaghetti, toss with sauce. Serve.

title: Salsa Amatriciana
instructions: Peel onion, chop finely.
Remove rind from bacon; cut bacon into thin strips across.
Peel and seed tomatoes, chop roughly.
Seed chilli, chop finely.
Heat oil in pan and add onion and bacon. Stir over medium heat for 5 minutes until onion is transparent, drain off surplus fat.
Add tomato and chilli, mix well. Simmer sauce gently, uncovered for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve with grated pecorino or Parmesan cheese. Serves 4

title: Spaghetti alla Carbonara

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb dry fettuccine noodles or spaghetti
Freshly ground black pepper in abundance

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook 8 to 10 minutes until al dente; reserve 1/2 cup pasta water, then drain.
Fry pancetta/bacon in skillet over medium heat until crispy. Remove and drain on paper towel.
Beat eggs, grated Parmesan, Pecorino, and black pepper in a warm bowl.
Immediately toss hot drained pasta into the egg-cheese bowl. The heat of the pasta cooks the eggs into a luxurious cream.
Add crisp pancetta with a spoonful of hot fat, and toss vigorously with tongs.
Finish with abundant freshly cracked black pepper. Serve immediately.
notes: Carbonara means 'in the coal miner way' because Italians grind black pepper on top until it looks like coal.

title: Pasta alla Gricia

4 oz (115 g) guanciale or pancetta, diced
1/4 cup (50 g) Pecorino Romano cheese, freshly grated

instructions: Put olive oil in a skillet, add diced guanciale/pancetta and red pepper flakes.
Fry over medium heat until bacon is golden brown and crispy.
Cook pasta in abundant boiling salted water until al dente.
Drain pasta, reserving 1/4 cup starchy pasta cooking water.
Transfer pasta to skillet with bacon and fat, add cooking water and grated Pecorino Romano.
Toss vigorously over low heat to form a glossy emulsified cheese coating. Serve hot.
notes: The historic Roman ancestor of Amatriciana and Carbonara. Simple, pure pork cheek and pecorino perfection.

Cook penne in boiling salted water for 8 minutes until al dente.
Drain pasta, add to sauce, and toss over heat for 1 minute. Top with grated Parmesan.
notes: Silky and luscious with a delicate pink blush from the tomato and cream reduction.

title: Spaghetti with Eggs and Bacon - Spaghetti alla Carbonara

ingredients.rawText: 4 oz (115 gr) pancetta, diced (or substitute with bacon)
2 oz (60 gr) pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated
Abundant black pepper, freshly grated from the mill

instructions: In a large stockpot, bring the water for the pasta to a boil.
While waiting for the water to boil, pour the olive oil in a frying pan, and add the pancetta or bacon.
Fry until the bacon is light brown, but still soft.
In a pasta bowl, beat the eggs with a pinch of salt.
When the water comes to a boil, add salt and cook the pasta following manufacturer’s instructions, testing for readiness from time to time, until al dente (firm but not too soft or overcooked).
Drain pasta and drop it immediately into bowl over the beaten eggs.
Mix vigorously. The heat of the boiling pasta will cook the eggs, making them resemble a light cream.
Add the bacon with its frying fat, the grated cheese, and abundant black pepper.
Toss thoroughly. Serve at once. substitute with a mix of half pecorino romano and half parmigiano reggiano cheese, freshly grated.
notes: The pasta must be very hot when dropped into bowl. Eggs are raw and will cook instantaneously with the heat of the pasta, forming a tasty cream. name of this dish means “in the style of the charcoal men,” referring to the shops in past times that sold charcoal used for cooking. Tip: * If the pecorino romano cheese is too strong or salty for your taste,

title: Pancetta or Turkey White Sauce
instructions: Fry pancetta or turkey in separate frying pans
Add whipping cream and lower heat
Cook for approximately 4 minutes
Blend all ingredients into sauce pan

title: Pesto Cubes for Sauce

ingredients.rawText: ¾ cup olive oil or as needed

instructions: In summer, pick wash and dry basil and oregano leaves. Wet basil and oregano may be put in salad spinner to dry and then on a paper towel to dry.
Separate cloves from head of garlic, peel and cut off bottom.
Pulse and mix basil, oregano, garlic and olive oil in food processor. Add more oil if required.
Freeze in ice cube trays. Once frozen, pop them out and put in freezer bag. When making sauce add a pesto cube and dried bay leaf in addition of salt and other spices.
notes: Notes : *Parsley can also be added or substituted for oregano.

title: Pasta with Cauliflower Sauce

ingredients.rawText: few hours or even the day after it is prepared.
ingredients.normalizedName: few hours even day after it is prepared

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 teaspoon saffron powder, dissolved in 1 - 2 tablespoons of warm water

instructions: To clean the cauliflower, cut out the bottom of the cauliflower. Eliminate the tough green leaves. Carve out the center. Cut the cauliflower in half. Separate the florettes and cut in 2” (5 cm) pieces. Green tender leaves can be used. Place in a bowl full of fresh water. Wash and drain.
Fill a large stockpot with water and bring to a boil; add cauliflower and salt. Cook for about 5 minutes until cauliflower is half-cooked and not yet fully tender.
Drain the cauliflower with the help of a large slotted spoon. Reserve the cooking water.

In a medium-size saucepan, pour the olive oil and turn heat to medium. Add the onion, generous red pepper, and sauté gently until the onion becomes soft and translucent. Turn heat off. Add anchovie fillets to the pan.
Quickly stir and break the anchovies with a fork to dissolve them. When adding the anchovies, don’t let them cook otherwise they will burn, giving the dish a very strong tang.

Turn heat to medium, add pine nuts, raisins, saffron and cauliflower. Mix to combine and sauté briefly. Anchovies can be very salty, therefore, adjust salt at this point if necessary. If sauce is too thick, add about 1 cup of the cauliflower cooking water.
Bring the stockpot with the reserved cauliflower cooking water to a boil.

Cook the fusilli in the cauliflower cooking water following manufacturer’s instructions. Taste for readiness from time to time, until al dente (firm but not too soft or overcooked). Drain and transfer to a bowl. Top with the sauce, toss and set aside. Serve lukewarm.
notes: FUSILLI COI BROCCOLI ARRIMINATI - This pasta dish can be served warm but it is tastier if eaten lukewarm after a

title: Broccoli, Mushrooms & Cauliflower Penne

ingredients.rawText: 1 sweet red pepper cut in strips

instructions: In a large pot of boiling water, cook pasta according to package directions until almost tender. Add broccoli and cauliflower; cook until pasta is tender but firm. Drain well.
Meanwhile, in large nonstick wok or skillet, heat oil over medium-high heat; cook onions, stirring often, until tender.
Add garlic, mushrooms, and dried basil (if using); cook, stirring, for 3 to 5 minutes or until mushrooms are browned and tender.
Sprinkle evenly with flour, cook, stirring, for 1 min.
Stir in milk, salt, pepper and red pepper; bring to a boil, stirring constantly.
Stir in pasta mixture and Parmesan; cook, stirring for 2 minutes or until heated through and coated in sauce. Stir in fresh basil (if using). Serve
notes: Sandy V.

title: Beans, Ham Bone & Pasta

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 lb dried kidney beans soaked overnight
1/4 lb lasagna broken in 1" / 2" pieces ("malatagliati" or any pasta)

instructions: Drain and rinse beans, cover with cold water in saucepan and bring to a boil. Stir and continue boiling for 15 minutes.

Drain beans, transfer to large pot with ham bone, onion, carrot, celery, pinch of pepper, olive oil and stock. Add cold water to cover. Cover pot well and simmer until beans are cooked and begin to thicken stock.
Remove bone and cut off any meat from it and flake.
Remove half of the beans starting from the broken ones and puree
Return flaked meat and pureed beans to the pot and discard the bone.
Taste for seasoning; salt if needed, depending on the bone used.
Bring the soup back to a boil, add pasta and cook until it is al dente.
Let rest off heat for 1 to 2 minutes before serving.
Plate it and garnish with a tablespoon of extra virgin olive oil and more freshly ground pepper. Note: This is one of the few Italian soups that don’t call for Parmesan cheese .

title: Canned Peas or Bean Sauce

ingredients.rawText: 1 – 14 oz tin of peas or 1 – 19 oz tin beans (White, Red Kidney, chickpeas,

instructions: In a pan, heat oil and sauté chopped onions & garlic
Rinse peas or beans under cold water in a colander.
Add peas or beans and salt to hot oil
Stir frequently and let cook 5 minutes
Cook your favourite pasta (tubetti or ditali), drain and pour peas or beans over it and toss to evenly coat.
notes: Sandy V.

title: Green Bean Sauce
instructions: Wash and remove stem and tip of green beans. Break beans in two with hands. If extra long cut into three parts so beans are bite size.
In a pan heat oil and sauté chopped onions & garlic
Add sauce and salt to taste and bring to a boil.
When sauce is boiling add cut and cleaned green beans.
Cook 10-15 minutes.

title: Eggplant Pasta
instructions: Cut the eggplant in about half inch cubes, sprinkle with salt and place in a colander to drain away the bitterness.
In a large skillet, sauté eggplant in olive oil for 15 minutes.
Remove eggplant to absorbent paper towel to drain the excess oil.
Add a little more oil to the skillet and sauté onion until golden.
Add eggplant, tomatoes, salt and red chili pepper flakes to taste.
Add water and simmer for 15 minutes.
Boil water in large pot and cook penne according to package directions.
Drain well and add to sauce, stir to coat well.

title: Garlic & Oil Pasta (Pasta Aio e Oio)
instructions: Cook the spaghetti in abundant salt water following manufacturer’s instructions, tasting for readiness from time to time.
While the pasta is cooking, pour olive oil in a skillet and add the garlic and red pepper.
Turn the heat to medium. Sauté the garlic briefly but turn heat off before the garlic could begin colouring.
When pasta is al dente (firm but not too soft or overcooked), drain and transfer to a bowl.
Top with the oil, garlic mixture.
Spread the chopped parsley on top (if desired).

Toss thoroughly and serve at once. big mistake in Italian cooking. Use fresh hot peppers when available and slice them before adding them to the skillet. If fresh red peppers are unavailable, use whole hot dry red peppers, chopped coarsely or a generous quantity of hot crushed red pepper.
notes: Aio e Oio is the Roman dialectal way of saying garlic and oil. It is generally prepared very spicy, therefore, don’t be shy with the quantity of red pepper **NOTE ** Do not overcook or burn the garlic! Browned garlic is considered a

title: Garlic and Pepper Spaghetti

ingredients.rawText: 1/4 cup top quality extra virgin olive oil 1 tsp chili pepper flakes
ingredients.normalizedName: top quality olive oil chili pepper flakes

instructions: Bring 5 quarts of salted water to a boil.
Meanwhile mince garlic and sauté it in a large pan with the extra virgin olive oil and the chili pepper flakes until golden.
Set pan aside.
Mince parsley.
Cook spaghetti al dente, according to package directions.
Drain pasta when done (don't rinse) and pour pasta back in the pan.
Sauté for 2 more minutes, sprinkle with the minced parsley.
notes: SPAGHETTI AIO OLIO E PEPERONCINO

title: Fusilli Mediteranean
instructions: Cook fusilli al dente for 10 minutes in boiling water
In a saucepan sauté olive oil, butter and garlic
Add all ingredients into saucepan and sauté for 5 minutes
Add a pinch of black pepper, salt and basil
When fusilli is cooked and drained add to sauce pan with the rest of fresh vegetables and toss together
Put mixture in pasta plate and top with fresh feta cheese and parsley
notes: Mary & Julia Vitale.

title: Spaghetti alla Boscaiola
instructions: Soak dried porcini mushrooms in 1cup of warm water for 15 min.
Drain mushrooms and pat dry with a paper towel.
Chop mushrooms coarsely.
Sauté together in olive oil and butter the garlic, onion, rosemary and parsley in a deep frying pan.
Add salt and pepper to taste
Add tomatoes and the revived mushrooms.
Let simmer for 30 minutes
Cook the spaghetti al dente. Drain and mix with sauce.
Cover and leave on heat for 1 minute.
10. Add Parmesan cheese and serve hot. Serves four
notes: Chrissy Zonca.

title: Spaghetti Sauce with Mushrooms

ingredients.rawText: 1 jar or can (28 oz) of tomatoes

instructions: In a sauce pan heat oil and sauté chopped onions and garlic
Brown the mushrooms, add tomatoes and tomato paste and the tomato paste, salt and pepper (extra herbs if desired)
Cook on low heat for 1 hour, stirring frequently Tip: *If pressed for time substitute with cooked jar of tomato sauce
notes: Sandy V.

title: Pesto Sauce

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup fresh basil leaves, washed & dried
1/4 cup pine nuts, lightly toasted * see below*

instructions: Combine garlic, basil, parsley and pine nuts in bowl of food processor.
Continue processing and add oil in a slow, steady stream.
Stop the machine and add cheese, salt and pepper.
Turn on machine and process a few seconds to combine.
Taste for seasoning, then toss with hot pasta. Serve promptly Recommended Pasta: 3/4 lb capellini, spaghetti, or linguine
To toast pine nuts: Spread pine nuts in a single layer in an unoiled heavy skillet.
Place on moderate heat and stir occasionally until lightly browned.

title: Potatoes & Pasta (Pasta e Patate)
instructions: Peel and dice potatoes in small cubes (about 1" size).
Mince onion, carrot and celery and sauté until onion is translucent.
Add potatoes, chopped tomato, stock cubes and hot water.
Stir until cubes dissolve. Let simmer for 45 minutes on very low heat.
Bring back to a rolling boil, add pasta and cook al dente according to package. (6 - 8 minutes). Let sit for few minutes before serving.
Sprinkle pecorino cheese and freshly ground pepper directly on the dish. Garnish with minced parsley if desired.

title: Pasta Primavera

ingredients.rawText: 1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped or 1 tsp leaf basil, crumbled

instructions: Wash and trim broccoli, zucchini and asparagus.
Cut broccoli into bite-sized pieces; cut zucchini into thin slices; cut asparagus into1 inch pieces.
Cook in boiling, salted water until crispy-tender; drain; put in a large bowl
Cook and drain linguini
Sauté garlic and tomatoes in oil in a large skillet for 2 minutes
Stir in basil and mushrooms; cook for 3 minutes
Stir in peas, parsley, salt, black and red pepper; cook 1 minute more. Add mixture to vegetables in bowl
Melt butter in same skillet; stir in cream and cheese. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until smooth
Add linguini; toss to coat. Stir in vegetables; heat gently just until hot

title: Spring Penne Pasta

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 of a small hot chili pepper
Salt and white pepper to taste

instructions: Clean artichokes, removing the stem and the hardest outer leaves. Cut in half, removing all remaining spikes, and the inner beard. Put them in a bowl of cold water with the juice of the lemon for at least 10 minutes. (This will preserve their colour).
Meanwhile bring a pot of salted water to a boil, slice the artichokes lengthwise in 1/2 inch wide strips and cook them for 5 minutes.
In a big frying pan heat the oil, and sauté the onion until translucent.
Add artichokes and the cherry tomatoes and let cook over medium heat for 10 minutes.
Add the basil, the red hot chili pepper, season with salt and pepper toss well for one minute. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the salted boiling water, cook pasta "al dente" according to package directions.
Drain and pour pasta into the frying pan.
Sauté for 3 minutes over medium heat, and serve immediately.

title: Penne, Tomato & Red Pepper All’Arrabbiata
instructions: Cut the tomatoes in large cubes.
In a frying pan, pour the olive oil and add garlic and red peppers. Stir and sauté for a few seconds.
Add the tomatoes and half of the basil leaves. Cook for about 10 minutes.
Use a fork to mash the tomatoes and reduce roughly to a paste.
Add rest of the basil leaves, breaking them by hand and turn heat off.

Cook the pasta in an abundance of salt water following manufacturer’s instructions. Taste for readiness from time to time, until al dente (firm but not too soft or overcooked). Drain and transfer to a bowl.
Top with the sauce. Toss thoroughly.
Serve at once. Garnish with more basil leaves if you like.
notes: The shape of pasta traditionally used for this dish is penne rigate, small-ridged tubes cut diagonally at the ends. The name of this dish literally means “angry pasta,” because it is served very hot, dressed with abundance of hot red peppers

title: Penne with Sun-Dried Tomatoes
instructions: Chop up sun-dried tomatoes, onion, garlic and parsley.
Using 1 tbsp of the oil from the sun-dried tomatoes, sauté sun dried tomatoes, parsley, onion, and garlic until onion is translucent.
Pour in pureed tomatoes; bring to a boil.
Add oregano, salt and pepper. Decrease heat to low. Simmer for ½ hour with the lid on and another ½ hour with lid off. Stir occasionally.

In separate pot cook pasta (al dente is nice). Drain pasta; stir into sun- dried tomato mixture. Add cheese and serve! penne, use spaghetti. In addition to sun-dried tomatoes, onion, garlic and parsley you can use some chopped anchovies. Serving suggestion : Place foil paper (enough to cover) on plate, spoon pasta & cheese into foil. Wrap; wait 5 minutes, then unwrap, ready to eat.
notes: Recipe variations: In place of Parmesan use grated Crotonese. In place of

title: Alfredo Fettuccine, Butter & Parmigiano

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 lb (225 gr) butter, at room temperature
1/2 lb (225 gr) parmigiano reggiano cheese, freshly grated

instructions: Prepare fresh fettuccine according to the package. Set aside.
Place half of the butter in a serving bowl. Keep the bowl warm.
Cook the fettuccine in an abundance of salted water. When the pasta is perfectly al dente, (firm but not too soft or overcooked), reserve a few tablespoons of the cooking water.
Drain without shaking the colander too much, so that the pasta doesn’t become too dry. Drop the hot pasta in the bowl over the butter.

Add the rest of the butter and toss quickly to melt it. reserved cooking water if the pasta appears too dry. Toss vigorously and serve immediately, accompanied by a small bowl with more grated parmigiano reggiano cheese, for the guests to add if they would like
notes: Tip: Add the parmigiano reggiano cheese and a small quantity of the

title: Alfredo Pasta Sauce

ingredients.rawText: ½ cup butter or margarine softened

instructions: Cream butter or margarine.
Beat in whipping cream a little at a time until mixture is well combined.
Beat in Parmesan and set aside at room temperature.
Cook fettuccine in boiling salted water stirring occasionally (10-12 minutes) or follow the instructions on the package. Drain
Transfer pasta to warm chafing dish or serving bowl
Add the creamed mixture and toss until fettuccine is coated
Season with a little salt and ground pepper
Serve at once with extra Parmesan
notes: Sandy V.

title: Balsamella Italian White Sauce)

ingredients.rawText: 1 oz (30 gr) parmigiano reggiano, freshly grated

instructions: Place butter in a saucepan and turn the heat to low. When the butter is melted, remove the saucepan from the stove.
Sift flour into butter a little at a time stirring continuously to combine.
Add the milk a little at a time.
Put the saucepan back on the stove and slowly stir with a wooden spoon, until the sauce starts boiling and becomes thicker.
Turn heat off. Add salt, and stir in grated cheese and pinch of nutmeg.

title: Bocconcini, Cherry Tomatoes Pasta
instructions: Cook spaghetti in salted water until it is al dente.
Meanwhile, place a frying pan over medium heat and drizzle 1 tbsp of olive oil. Add in cherry tomatoes and cook for 4-5 minutes.
Add in the chili and the fresh garlic. Season to taste.
If tomato mix is looking dry, add in a spoonful of the pasta water.
When the pasta is ready, transfer it to the saucepan.
Coat the pasta in the tomato sauce and add a little extra pasta water if it needs to be loosened.
Remove from heat, add basil and bocconcini. Serve and enjoy!

title: Cream & Lemon Sauce Farfalle

ingredients.rawText: 3/4 lb farfalle pasta (or any short pasta you like)
Salt and black pepper to taste

instructions: In a bowl large enough for the pasta also, work the butter with cream and lemon juice until you get a soft cream.
Season with salt and pepper and add the minced herbs.
Meanwhile, bring plenty of salted water to a boil: cook pasta al dente according to the package. Drain and pour pasta into the bowl with the lemon sauce.
Toss carefully to coat all the pasta and serve.

title: Cream and Tomato Pasta Sauce
instructions: In a saucepan, sauté onion and garlic in olive oil over medium heat. Make sure it doesn't burn.
Add tomatoes, basil, sugar, oregano, salt and pepper. Bring to boil and for 5 minutes or until most of the liquid evaporates.
Remove from heat; stir in whipping cream and butter. Reduce heat and simmer 5 more minutes.

title: Macaroni and Cheese

ingredients.rawText: 1 (28 ounce) can tomatoes with juice, diced

instructions: In a large pot with boiling, salted water cook macaroni pasta until al dente. Drain.
In a large skillet cook ground beef until no pink remains. Drain excess grease.

In a large bowl add the tomato juice, diced tomatoes, cooked ground beef, cooked and drained pasta, one package of the grated cheese, and mix well. Pour into a 2 quart casserole baking dish. Spread remaining package of grated cheese over the top.
In a 425°F. (220°C.) oven bake until the cheese on top is melted, then broil until the cheese is golden brown. Serve.

title: Mozzarella Summer Pasta
instructions: In a large pot with boiling, salted water cook linguini pasta until al dente.
Drain.

Meanwhile, in a large bowl combine the chopped tomatoes, grated mozzarella cheese, fresh basil, garlic, olive oil, garlic salt, and ground black pepper. Allow to stand at room temperature until pasta has finished cooking.
Toss drained and slightly warm pasta with tomato mixture. Serve cool.

title: Romano Cheese & Black Pepper Pasta

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 cup Pecorino Romano cheese, freshly grated
Generous freshly ground black pepper from the mill

instructions: In a serving bowl, mix grated Pecorino Romano cheese and very generous freshly cracked black pepper.
Cook spaghetti in abundant salted water until al dente.
Before draining, reserve 1/2 cup of starchy boiling water.
Drain pasta without shaking too much so it stays moist. Dump immediately over the cheese and pepper in bowl.
Add 2 to 3 tablespoons of hot cooking water and toss vigorously. The heat creates a velvety sauce.
Serve immediately while piping hot.
notes: Essential Roman classic. The pasta must be very hot to melt the pecorino into a smooth fondue.

title: Philly Pesto Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta as directed on package.

Meanwhile cook and stir mushrooms in hot oil in large skillet for 5 to 7 minutes or until mushrooms are tender. Add cream cheese spread and pesto; cook 5 minutes or until cream cheese is melted and mixture is well blended, stirring frequently.
Drain pasta and add it to the skillet along with tomatoes and basil; mix lightly.

title: Ricotta & Zucchini Pasta

ingredients.rawText: 2 pounds zucchini, sliced into 1/4-inch-thick pieces (for larger zucchini, cut in
1 pound ziti or other dry pasta
1 cup pecorino or a mixture, set some aside for serving

instructions: Put a pot of water on to boil.
In a large skillet over medium-high heat, cook the onions in 3 tbsps olive oil until softened, 5 to 8 minutes.
Reduce heat as necessary to keep onions from browning.
Add zucchini, season generously with salt and pepper, and continue cooking, stirring occasionally until soft, about 10 minutes. Turn off heat.
Meanwhile, use a mortar and pestle to pound garlic, basil and a little salt into a rough paste (or use a mini food processor). Stir in 3 tbsps olive oil.
When boiling, salt the pasta water well and put in the pasta, stirring. Boil per package instructions but make sure to keep pasta al dente. Drain pasta, reserving 1 cup of cooking water.
Add cooked pasta to zucchini in skillet and turn heat to medium-high.
Add 1/2 cup cooking water, then the ricotta, crushed red pepper and lemon zest, stirring to distribute. Check seasoning and adjust.
Cook for 1 minute more. Mixture should look creamy. Add a little more pasta water if necessary.
Add basil paste and half grated cheese and quickly stir to incorporate.
Spoon pasta into warm soup plates and sprinkle with additional cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Rigatoni au Gratin
instructions: Cook rigatoni in boiling, salted water to desired texture. Drain.
Place in a buttered baking dish.
Mix ricotta, tomato sauce, and half of the grated mozzarella. Pour over pasta and toss gently.
Top with remaining mozzarella and grated Parmesan. Add a few knobs of butter.
Bake in oven at 375ºF for 15 minutes. Makes 6 servings
notes: Margaret V.

title: Spinach & Ricotta Stuffed Pasta Shells

ingredients.rawText: 2 jars pasta sauce or make your own
1 lb ground beef, chicken or turkey

instructions: Sauce: Mix pasta sauce and diced tomatoes or use your own sauce.
In a Pyrex dish, line bottom with a layer of sauce. Set aside.
Boil pasta shells. When done, rinse in cold water to blanch. Set aside.
Meat: Heat oil in pan and sauté diced garlic and onion.
Add meat, sauté. Set aside.
Add half a container of cream cheese or ricotta and mix well. Add grated Parmesan cheese if desired.
Spinach and Ricotta Stuffing: Drain and pat dry the thawed out, chopped spinach and put in a bowl with ricotta and ½ the Parmesan cheese.
Add cream cheese and jerk seasoning to taste. Mix well.
Assembly: Stuff shells with desired filling. Once tray is full, cover with the rest of the sauce
Bake 20-30 minutes for cheese filling
Bake 30-45 minutes for meat filling
notes: Georgina V.

title: Pasta Putanesca (Anchovy, Olives & Tomato)

ingredients.rawText: 1 tbsp capers in salt, rinsed & drained Sea salt to taste
2 oz (60 gr) Gaeta or black olives

instructions: Bring six quarts of salted water to a rolling boil.
Meanwhile in a saucepan, over medium heat, quickly sauté olive oil, pepper flakes, and garlic.

Add the anchovy fillets and stir until they dissolve. Do not burn garlic and anchovies. Remove from the heat if you feel the oil temperature is too high. Burned anchovies have a very heavy fishy taste.
Add tomatoes, capers, olives, and 3/4 of the parsley. Cook on low heat for 15 - 20 minutes.
Meanwhile cook pasta "al dente" according to package instructions, drain, and put into a large bowl or platter.
Dress with the sauce and garnish with the rest of the parsley. Serve hot. Sprinkle with the rest of the chopped parsley.

title: Pasta alla Puttanesca

ingredients.rawText: 1 1/2 cups red ripe tomatoes, diced (or plum tomatoes)
2 oz (60 g) Gaeta or black olives, pitted
1 tbsp capers in salt, rinsed & drained
Red pepper flakes and sea salt to taste

instructions: In a saucepan over medium heat, heat olive oil with garlic and red pepper flakes.
Add anchovy fillets and stir until dissolved (do not burn garlic or anchovies).
Add diced tomatoes, capers, olives, and 3/4 of the chopped parsley.
Simmer on low heat for 15 to 20 minutes until thick and aromatic.
Cook pasta al dente in salted boiling water; drain.
Dress pasta with the sauce, toss well, and garnish with remaining parsley. Serve hot.
notes: Bold Neapolitan sauce brimming with briny olives, salty capers, and sweet tomatoes.

title: Baccala (Dried Cod) Sauce

ingredients.rawText: Frozen pesto cube or chopped basil & garlic

instructions: Three days before making sauce cut dried cod into 1 by 3 inch pieces and wash off the salt. Fill a large bowl with cold water and add washed cod pieces. Cover bowl and place in fridge. Rinse and change the water twice a day for the next three days.
On the fourth day drain, rinse and dry the cod pieces with paper towels. Coat dried cod pieces with flour.
Put 3 tbsps olive oil in large pot, add chopped onion and garlic and sauté.
Add 2 litres of tomato puree, salt, basil leaf and pesto cube or basil and bring to a boil. Let simmer 20 minutes.
Heat 1 cup of frying oil in a pan and fry floured cod pieces until golden brown. Put fried cod pieces into the sauce and simmer 10 min.

title: Clam Tomato Sauce
instructions: Heat oil, brown garlic and then remove
Add tomato sauce, parsley, clam juice, salt and pepper
Cook for approximately 30 minutes on low heat
Add washed clams, cook for another 5 minutes and serve over 1 lb. Cooked macaroni (Linguine)
notes: Sandy V.

title: Fresh Clams Linguine alle Vongole
instructions: Fry oil and garlic. Add clams and put lid over pot for 2 minutes
Add white wine and chopped parsley
Cook the linguini and add clam sauce.

title: Linguini with White Clam Sauce

ingredients.rawText: 2 (6.5 oz) cans minced clams, with juice

instructions: In large pot with boiling, salted water cook linguini pasta until al dente.
Meanwhile, in a medium sized saucepan using medium heat, cook olive oil and minced garlic until garlic is translucent.
Add chopped clams, clam juice or water, and chopped parsley. Add salt and ground black pepper to taste.
Bring to a boil. Lower heat and simmer 3 mins.
Toss pasta with clam sauce. Serve warm.

title: Misto Sugo

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup tomato sauce or to taste
Salt and pepper (or hot pepper) to taste
1/2 tsp fresh oregano or dried, chopped
Fresh basil leaves if in season
Salmon, prawns, squid, mussels and white fish

instructions: Set pasta water to boil.
Heat the oil and butter in large skillet. When butter has melted add the chopped herbs. Sauté, stirring until onion has become translucent gold.
Add the fish, first the squid and larger chunks and then the prawns and such, and finally the mussels and such.
Sauté briefly, add the tomato sauce, check seasoning, and simmer the sauce over a gentle flame.
When water boils put in the pasta.

When the pasta is just shy of being done drain it, give it one shake and upend the colander into the sauce. Turn the heat to high and cook, stirring, for about a minute. Garnish with the basil and serve at once. Grated cheese will not be necessary. Serves 4
notes: The Beginnings Of Fish Sauce For Pasta Or Rice Misto sugo is a mixture of chopped and whole fish including salmon, prawns, squid, mussels, white fish, and whatever fish that is not bony.

title: Salmon Pasta
instructions: Fry olive oil and onion in sauce pan
Chop smoked salmon into small pieces
Add smoked salmon to olive oil and onion frying it for 3 or 4 minutes
Add tomatoes, parsley and black pepper. Let simmer for 30 minutes
Add above to pasta cooked al dente, stir, enjoy.

title: Penne with Salmon & Shrimp Arrabiatta

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup grated Parmesan cheese ½ cup parsley, chopped

instructions: In a frying pan sauté salmon in 1 tbsp olive oil.
Add 4 fresh or dried chilies and garlic.
Add shrimp and butter. When shrimp are pink remove salmon and shrimp from heat and set aside.
Boil water for penne in a separate pot and add 1 tbsp of salt.
Remove pasta al dente drain and toss in sauce in frying pan.
Add 1 cup pasta water, shrimp and salmon.
Grate fresh Parmesan cheese and chopped parsley and serve with extra chilies for added zest.

title: Seafood Sauce for Pasta
instructions: Peel and devein shrimps and chop into large pieces.
Wash scallops and cut into half
Melt butter in pan, add garlic cook 1 minute
Add wine and cream and bring to boil for about 3 minutes
Add water and corn flour and stir until comes to a boil again
Add lemon, salt and pepper cook 2 minutes. Stir in parsley and shallots.
Cook pasta, drain and add sauce. Garnish with oysters in their shells.

title: Pasta and Shrimp alla Vodka
instructions: While bringing water to a boil, heat oil in a pan and add chopped garlic, (better if roasted) chili pepper and oregano on medium heat.
Throw in shrimp and salt and cook on both sides until shrimp are opaque and browned. Add vodka and flambé or simply let vodka evaporate. Then add tomatoes and let simmer for 10 minutes. Set aside.
Add salt to boiling water, then pasta and cook until al dente (8 minutes).

Drain pasta and add to tomato/shrimp mixture. Toss well then add cheese and chopped parsley. Variations: Instead of shrimp try scallops and/or lobster. Also before serving wrap final pasta mixture tightly in foil for 5 minutes. Serve directly from foil wrap. Nice with garlic bread and wine.

title: Tagliolini alle Erbe

ingredients.rawText: ¼ each dried thyme and oregano
Basil, salt and pepper to taste
½ lb shrimp cleaned and deveined

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add 1 tbsp parsley, herbs, tomato, salt and pepper (chopped vegetables and shrimp); sauté until shrimp are done, about 3 minutes.
Cook pasta; drain. Add pasta, butter and cheese to skillet and toss.
Garnish with remaining parsley.

title: Squid Tomato Sauce

ingredients.rawText: Squid, cleaned and cut into rings

instructions: Heat oil. Add and sauté onion. Add squid rings and blend with onions
Add jar of tomatoes, salt and pepper. Bring to a boil
Lower heat and simmer for 1/2 to one hour.
Cook pasta and pour sauce over pasta.

title: Tuna Fish Tomato Sauce

first course of pasta. using a large chunk of tuna, approximately 3–4 inches

instructions: alternative use diced tuna fish for a more practical recipe.

3 - 4 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil 1 medium onion, diced Pinch of crushed red pepper 2 lb (1 kg) fresh tuna fish, diced 1/2 cup (120 cc) dry white wine Salt to taste 2 1/2 cups (600 gr) tomato, puréed 2 bay leaves 1 clove garlic Pinch of cinnamon powder
Heat oil in saucepan on medium heat. When oil is hot, add onion and pinch of red pepper. Sauté until the onion becomes translucent.
Add the tuna. Stir thoroughly to brown the tuna uniformly on all sides.
Add the wine and let it evaporate, now add the tomato purée.
Add bay leaves, clove, and cinnamon. Stir, cover the pan, and cook on medium low until the tuna fish is tender.
Cook the spaghetti or bucatini following the instructions.
Drain pasta, transfer it to a serving bowl and dress with tuna fish sauce

title: Vito’s Pasta con Tonno (Tuna)

ingredients.rawText: ¼ - ½ tsp hot red pepper flakes to taste 1 lb spaghetti

instructions: Heat the oil in a 10-inch skillet and add the garlic. Fry on medium-low heat until golden then remove the skillet from the heat.
Add the hot red pepper flakes and stir quickly to keep them from burning. (If burned, they become very bitter.)
With the pan still off the fire, add the anchovy paste and stir to dissolve with a wooden spoon.
Return the skillet to the heat and add the tomatoes and 1 teaspoon salt. Mix and simmer on medium heat for 15 to 20 minutes.

Add the tuna, breaking it up with a spoon. Add 3 tablespoons of the parsley and cook for 10 minutes more. If the sauce becomes too thick add a couple tablespoons of water and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.
Bring 6 quarts (5 1/2 L) water with 1 1/2 tablespoons coarse salt to a boil. Cook pasta until al dente.
Add 1 cup of cold water to stop the cooking process then drain the pasta. Add pasta to tuna sauce and mix well to coat.
Serve on a warm platter, garnished with remaining parsley

title: Cannelloni with Balsamella White Sauce

ingredients.rawText: 2 1/2 lb ground beef (or mix of beef and pork)
3 oz (90 g) plus 2 1/2 oz Parmigiano Reggiano, grated
2 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper

instructions: Prepare Balsamella: Melt butter in saucepan, whisk in flour, gradually stream in milk stirring constantly until boiling and thickened. Stir in nutmeg, salt, and Parmesan.
In skillet, brown ground meat with olive oil, salt, and pepper. Process meat finely in food processor.
Blend 4 tbsp white sauce, nutmeg, and Parmigiano into meat until soft compound forms.
Preheat oven to 350°F. Spread 1/2 cup white sauce in bottom of baking pan (11x14 inch).
Stuff cannelloni tubes with meat filling and arrange in pan side by side.
Pour remaining white sauce evenly over cannelloni and sprinkle with grated Parmigiano.
Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes. Uncover and bake 5-10 minutes until golden.
notes: A holiday and Sunday classic. Creamy white balsamella pairs gloriously with tender seasoned meat.

title: Crepes Crespelle
instructions: To make sweet crepes for a dessert add: In a bowl combine flour, salt, eggs, and half of the milk.
Whisk lightly until the batter is smooth.
**NOTE: Add sugar and vanilla at this point if you are making sweet crepes for a dessert.
Add the remaining milk and water a little at the time whisking to avoid lumps.
Use a non-stick skillet or crepe pan about 6 inch in diameter. Heat the pan on medium-high.

Lightly grease the pan with the butter. *** NOTE Many chefs do not grease the pan. The crepes shouldn’t stick to the pan but greasing the pan makes the process much easier. Do not let the butter brown.
Pour 1/4 cup of the batter in the pan.
Tilt the pan in all directions to coat the whole bottom.
Cook for less then a minute, shaking the pan in order to keep the crepe loose. Avoid browning the crepes.

To cook the other side, flip over the crepe or use a small dish. Place the dish upside down on the pan, turn the pan over, so that the crepe is now on the dish and slide the crepe back into the pan, or turn it over with a spatula.
Cook the other side for approximately half a minute.
Remove and stack the crepes one on top of the other.
notes: Crepes are used in entrees or sweetened and used as a dessert. Crepes can be refrigerated for few days, stacked and covered with saran wrap.

title: Rita’s Canneloni Crepes
instructions: Crepes: Mix all above ingredients in blender
Drop on hot buttered griddle to desired diameter
Turn quickly (does not need to get brown)
Stuffing: Mix all above ingredients in a large bowl
Place 1 tbsp of stuffing on each crepe and roll up

Place each rolled crepe with seam side down side by side on a greased baking dish 3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour 3/4 tsp salt 1/4 tsp nutmeg 1/2 tsp white pepper 2 1/4 cups milk 3 tbsp dry white vermouth 3 tbsp Parmesan cheese
Melt butter over low heat
Add combined flour, salt, nutmeg and pepper
Cook for 3 minutes stirring constantly
Add milk and vermouth
Cook and stir constantly until thick for 10 minutes.
Remove from heat; stir in cheese until melted

title: Gnocchi alla Rosina
instructions: Cook unpeeled potatoes in boiling salted water until tender. Drain, peel, and mash hot through a food mill or potato masher.
Place mashed potatoes in a bowl, let cool slightly, then stir in flour, salt, and egg.
Knead dough on a floured surface until smooth, elastic, and non-sticky. (Add flour sparingly as needed).
Shape dough into long ropes (3/8-inch diameter). Cut ropes into 1 1/4-inch lengths.
Press each gnocchi against fork tines or a 'crivo' with two fingers to form ridged ruffles with a hollow back.
Drop gnocchi into rapidly boiling salted water in batches. When they float to the surface (1-2 mins), lift out with a slotted spoon.
Serve hot with homemade tomato meat sauce or browned butter and sage.
notes: Nonna Rosina's tip: Drop one test gnocchi into boiling water first. If it holds shape and floats, dough is ready; if it falls apart, knead in a tiny bit more flour.
originalPhotoCaption: Work dough until smooth and elastic. Shape dough into long ropes and roll on gnocchi board

title: Potato Gnocchi

ingredients.rawText: 2 lbs (approximately 1 kg) whole old russet potatoes, unpeeled
3 oz (90 gr) parmigiano reggiano cheese, freshly grated

instructions: for the dressing: Wash the potatoes, place them in a large stock pot filled with water and bring to a boil. Cook until the potatoes are soft without overcooking to prevent them from breaking. Cooking time may vary depending on the size of the potatoes
Peel immediately while potatoes are still hot and mash them using a potato masher or a food mill.
When the potatoes are still warm but cool enough to be handled, shape them in a mound with a well in the middle.
Add 1 cup (150 gr) of the flour, the egg, and salt.
Draw the ingredients together with a fork and mix to form a dough.
At this point the dough will be sticky on your hands.
Sprinkle a little of the remaining flour on the dough and work it with your hands until the potato dough incorporates the flour.
Continue adding flour a little at a time and kneading the dough until the potato dough is no longer too sticky.
The dough must be soft and fluffy, avoid incorporating too much flour. and work dough with hands until potato dough incorporates the flour.
Cut the dough into four pieces. Sprinkle the work surface with a little flour and place the first piece on it.
Roll the dough into one or two long ropes approximately 3/4 inch (2 cm) in diameter. Then cut the ropes into pieces 3/4 inch (2 cm) long.

Roll the pieces in your hands to give them a rounded oval shape then roll the pieces along the prongs of a common fork, surface of cheese grater, back of a basket, or special ridged tool using two fingers, in a way that the side of the piece running along the tool will be ruffled and the side you are pressing with your finger will be a little concave.
Work constantly on a lightly floured surface. Transfer the gnocchi to a dry and clean cloth. Repeat these steps with the rest of the dough.

Fill a stockpot three quarters full with water, bring to a boil, and add salt. When the water boils, drop the gnocchi in a few at a time to avoid damaging them. The gnocchi will fall to the bottom of the pot. After about 1 – 2 minutes the gnocchi will come up to the surface and this will be the sign that they are cooked. Don't drain gnocchi in a colander as you would do with pasta. Gnocchi are very soft and may be damaged. Instead remove them as soon as they float to the surface, with the help of a large slotted spoon or strainer. Drain thoroughly.
In a skillet large enough to contain the gnocchi, place the butter and sage leave. Turn heat to medium to melt the butter.
Transfer the gnocchi to the skillet and sauté briefly, stirring gently with a large spoon until the gnocchi are fully covered by the butter.
Transfer to a serving dish, top with the grated parmigiano cheese.
Serve hot at once
notes: Roll ropes, cut lengths and roll lengths on board. Gnocchi drying on cloth covered pan.

title: Clams & Porcini Mushrooms Gnocchi

ingredients.rawText: *1 lb (500 gr) fresh porcini mushrooms, diced

instructions: Note: *If fresh porcini mushrooms are not available, substitute with: 1 oz (30gr) dry porcini soaked in warm water, drained, and chopped or 1 lb (500 gr) fresh, dark cremini mushrooms, diced
Put 3 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil in a skillet.
Add mashed garlic and turn heat to medium.
When oil is hot, before it starts colouring, add mushrooms, salt and pepper.
Sauté until mushrooms are tender. Transfer mushrooms with their juices to a food processor fitted with a blade and reduce to a coarse paste.
Start cooking the gnocchi in boiling lightly salted water. In a skillet put 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil and garlic clove. Turn heat to medium.
When the oil is hot, add the clams.
As soon as the clams start opening up, add the mushroom paste.

If the gnocchi are not ready yet, turn the heat off under the skillet. Avoid overcooking the clams. Drain the gnocchi, drop them into the skillet, add the optional cream, sauté briefly to combine flavors. Serve at once topped with chopped parsley.

title: Traditional Meat Lasagna
italianTitle: Lasagne al Forno con Sugo di Carne

ingredients.rawText: 1 box lasagna noodles, cooked al dente
1 medium onion and 2 cloves garlic, minced
Basil, oregano, thyme, parsley, nutmeg, salt, pepper

instructions: Brown ground beef in skillet and drain. Sauté onion and garlic in oil, add tomato paste and crushed tomatoes with herbs. Simmer meat sauce 1.5 to 2 hours.
Preheat oven to 350°F. Boil lasagna noodles until al dente.
Spread a thin layer of sauce in bottom of 10x14 inch lasagna pan.
Cover with flat layer of noodles, then layer ricotta, sliced sausage, sliced hard-boiled eggs, mozzarella, and meat sauce.
Repeat layers ending with noodles, sauce, and generous Parmesan cheese on top.
Bake for 45 minutes until bubbly and golden. Cool 10 minutes before slicing.
notes: The quintessential Ruffolo-Vitale holiday centerpiece. Prepare a day ahead for maximum flavor development.

title: Pasta, Pork, Sausage al Forno

ingredients.rawText: ½ tsp freshly ground black pepper
2 oz Pecorino Romano (60 gr) 12 oz mozzarella cheese (350 gr)
1 tsp salt, to taste. Use extra for salting pasta and boiling water

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add finely chopped onion and a pinch of salt. Fry for 5 mins or until just taking on some colour.
Add ground pork and skinned, crumbled sausage.
Increase the heat and cook until browned.
When the meat has browned and is well cooked, add the tomato puree (passata), ½ cup water, salt and pepper.
Stir well and when the sauce starts bubbling, turn the heat down to low, partly cover with the lid and simmer for 30 minutes.
In the meantime, bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Salt well (2 or 3 tablespoons of salt) and add the rigatoni pasta.
Check the package instructions and drain the pasta 3 or 4 minutes before being completely cooked. Reserve 2 cups of the cooking water.
To assemble, taste the meat sauce and adjust the salt if necessary.
Add the pasta into the meat sauce along with ¾ of the mozzarella cheese, ¾ of pecorino Romano cheese and some cooking water.

Mix together really well adding more cooking water if it looks dry. There should be sauce at the bottom of the dish. Most likely you’ll need about 1 cup of water but it could be up to 1 ½ cups. This will keep pasta moist and make it creamy.
Tip into a baking dish 8 x 12 inches (20x30cm/12 cup capacity) and cover with remaining cheeses.
Bake 350ºF/180ºC for 20-25 minutes.
notes: * Be sure to salt the pasta cooking water very well. * Undercook the pasta because it will keep cooking in the oven. Boil for 3 minutes less than the package instructions. * Reserve some of the cooking water to use when combining the pasta, meat sauce and cheeses .

title: Cheese Lasagna

ingredients.rawText: 1 pound mozzarella cheese, shredded 2 cups grated Parmesan cheese

instructions: In a large heavy bottomed pot, heat the olive oil over medium high heat. Sauté the onions and garlic until soft and slightly clear. Pour in the crushed tomatoes and bring to a boil. Stir in the tomato paste, salt and pepper. Lower heat to medium, just hot enough to keep lightly bubbling. Add basil leaves and cook, stirring occasionally for an hour. Add salt and pepper and red wine and allow to simmer another hour or until desired consistency. Remove from heat and let it cool. If you have time, let it sit in the refrigerator over night.
Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 10 to 15 minutes or until al dente; drain and allow to cool.
Preheat oven to 350°F. (175ºC.).

You'll need two 9x13 inch baking trays. Put a layer of sauce in the bottom of the tray then a layer of slightly overlapping lasagna noodles. Spread a layer of ricotta over the noodles and a light sprinkling of mozzarella. Repeat until you fill the tray, making sure that you end up with lasagna noodles on top. Spread a layer of sauce over the noodles and sprinkle with mozzarella and Parmesan. Cover with foil.
Bake in a preheated oven for an hour. Remove the foil and bake another half hour.

title: Four Cheese Lasagna

ingredients.rawText: 16 ounces uncooked lasagna noodles 1 (26 ounce) can spaghetti sauce

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. (190ºC).
Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add pasta and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente then drain.

In a blender or with an electric mixer, blend tomato sauce and cottage cheese together until smooth. Spoon a little of the sauce mixture in the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish. Place a layer of cooked noodles over the sauce and sprinkle a portion of the mozzarella, the cheddar and the Parmesan over the noodles. Repeat layering of sauce, noodles and cheese; finish with a cheese layer.
Bake in preheated oven 30 to 45 minutes, until cheese is bubbly and golden.

title: Spinach, Ricotta & Sausage Lasagna
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. (175ºC).
Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add lasagna and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente; drain.

In skillet over medium heat, brown the sausage with the onions, garlic and 1/2 the parsley, drain. Add tomato sauce, water, Italian seasoning, oregano, and basil, mix well. Simmer, covered for 5 minutes stirring occasionally.
In a bowl, combine remaining parsley and ricotta, spinach, Parmesan, eggs, garlic salt, and pepper, mix well.

In lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish, spread 2 cups sauce mix. Begin layering with 4 noodles, 1/2 cheese mix, 1/3 remaining sauce, and 1 cup mozzarella. Repeat this layer again and the last layer will be noodles, sauce and mozzarella cheese.
Bake covered in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Bake uncovered an additional 10 minutes. Let cool 10 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken Lasagna Roll Ups

ingredients.rawText: 1 pkg no cook, oven ready lasagna noodles
1/2 lb fresh spinach, lightly steamed & chopped
1 can tomato sauce, flavoured or plain

instructions: In a large non-stick pan cook chicken in 1 tbsp vegetable oil for 5 to 7 minutes. Add spinach and seasonings.
In a saucepan, melt butter, stir in flour to form a paste. Gradually add hot milk, stirring all the time until mixture comes to a boil and thickens.
Stir in chicken mixture.
Spread a little of the chicken mixture onto each of the lasagna noodles.
Roll up tightly and secure with a toothpick. Place in a single layer in pan.
Spoon in tomato sauce. Cover and bake at 350ºF for 30 to 40 minutes or until lasagna noodles are tender.
Serve with a mixed green salad and fresh crusty rolls.

title: Lasagna with Cauliflower Cream

ingredients.rawText: 2 oz (60 gr) parmigiano reggiano, freshly grated
5 oz (150 gr) fresh mozzarella cheese, drained and diced
4 oz (120 gr) parmigiano reggiano cheese, freshly grated

instructions: For the lasagna: Prepare “balsamella” (white sauce) using the quantities indicated above
Prepare and cut fresh pasta

Preparing the cauliflower filling Clean the cauliflower * Place the cauliflower in a pot full of boiling, lightly salted water. Boil the cauliflower until tender but still firm. Drain thoroughly, transfer to a bowl, and coarsely mash it with a fork. * Put 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil and 2 oz butter in a skillet. When the butter starts foaming, add mashed cauliflower and broccoli abd sauté until the broccoli is tender. * Combine the balsamella sauce, adjust salt and pepper if necessary, and turn heat off.

Assembling the lasagna Check on the recipe for the Lasagna Bolognese on how to boil the pasta strips: * Bring the water to a boil in a stockpot. Add salt and 1 teaspoon of olive oil. Prepare a separate container of cold water.

Cook the pasta until al dente (firm but not too soft or overcooked). Check the manufacturer’s instructions for cooking time but test a little piece for readiness from time to time. * Remove the pasta with a slotted spoon, drop briefly in the cold water to stop the cooking process and place in a colander to drain.
After the strips are drained, place them flat on a clean kitchen cloth and tap them gently with the cloth to dry.
Preheat oven 350°F. Butter a flat oven pan approximately 9 x 12 inch (22 x 30 cm) and spread it with 2 – 3 tablespoons of cauliflower cream.
Place one layer of pasta strips, spread some of the broccoli cream, diced mozzarella and parmigiano reggiano cheese.
Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used.

Finish topping the last layer of pasta with diced mozzarella and grated parmigiano cheese. Place in the oven and cook for about 20 minutes or until golden. Serve it hot but let it set for 5 minutes before serving.

To taste for readiness, pierce the lasagna with a fork. When ready the lasagna will be soft. to cook at a later time. ***The quantity of fresh pasta indicated in the recipe could be excessive for this dish. Leftovers of the flattened dough can be cut into a different shape (such as fettuccine) and used for a different pasta.
notes: ***Lasagna can be conveniently prepared in advance, refrigerated or frozen

title: Crabmeat Lasagna
instructions: Melt butter, sauté onion add cream cheese and stir.
Remove from heat. Add ricotta, egg, seasonings and Parmesan cheese.
In a separate bowl, combine soup and wine. Stir in shrimp and crabmeat.
In a 9x13x3 rectangular casserole, place one layer of noodles, ½ cheese mixture, and 1/3 shrimp/crab mixture. Finish with layer of noodles covered with sauce.
Bake covered in 350ºF oven for 30 minutes.
Arrange sliced tomato and sprinkle with grated cheese.
Continue to bake uncovered for 15-20 minutes.
Allow to stand for 10 minutes before eating.
notes: Anna B.

title: Bolognese Lasagna al Forno

ingredients.rawText: 6 oz (approximately 180 gr) parmigiano reggiano, freshly grated

instructions: Bring water to a boil in a stockpot. Add salt and 1 teaspoon of olive oil. Prepare a separate container of cold water.
Cook the fresh pasta strips until al dente (firm but not too soft or overcooked). Cooking time will be less than 5 minutes.

Remove the pasta strips, drop them briefly in the cold water to stop the cooking process, and place in a colander to drain. * After the strips are drained, place them flat on a kitchen cloth and tap them gently with the cloth to dry.
Preheat oven to 350°F. (175°C).
Butter a flat oven pan approximately 9 x 12 inch (22 x 30 cm) and spread over it 2 – 3 tablespoons of tomato sauce.
Place one layer of pasta strips spread with the tomato sauce, the balsamella sauce and the grated parmigiano reggiano cheese.
Repeat the layers until all ingredients are used.
Bake for about 25 – 30 minutes. Serve hot.
notes: Prepare “sugo di carne” (meat/tomato sauce) Prepare the “balsamella”(white sauce) Ingredients to finish the lasagna: To taste for readiness pierce the lasagna with a fork. When ready the lasagna will be soft. Lasagna can be conveniently prepared in advance, refrigerated or frozen, to cook at a later time.
