title: Seafood Lasagna

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb mixed lobster, scallops, and salmon fillets

instructions: Cook noodles. Set aside
Sauté onion in oil.
Add flour, salt, pepper & cook over medium heat.
Stir in sherry and cream, cook until thick.
Add Swiss cheese and seafood.
Place noodles in the bottom of a greased (13” pan)
Spread half the spinach and half the fish/cheese mixture.
Repeat
Top with Parmesan cheese and bake
Bake at 350ºF for 40 minutes.

title: Vegetarian Zucchini Lasagna

ingredients.rawText: 2 large handfuls of spinach, coarsely chopped

instructions: Cut zucchini into ¼ inch thick slices, parboil for 3 minutes and drain on paper towels.
Preheat oven to 350°F.
In saucepan cook onion and garlic in olive oil about 4 minutes.
Add mushrooms and cook 4-5 minutes until tender.
Add spaghetti sauce and tomato paste, heat thoroughly.
In a small bowl mix eggs, cottage cheese, ½ cup mozzarella, Parmesan cheese and flour.
In lasagna pan place about ½ cup sauce on bottom.
Next, place spinach in pan, then a layer of zucchini slices.
Spoon cheese mixture over this and top with ½ cup of sauce.
Add remaining zucchini and the rest of the sauce.
Bake uncovered, 30-40 minutes.
Top with the other cup of shredded mozzarella cheese and bake 20 minutes longer.
Let stand for 10-15 minutes before serving.

title: Vegetable Lasagna

ingredients.rawText: 1 (16 ounce) package lasagna noodles 2 tablespoons olive oil
1 (10 ounce) package frozen spinach, chopped and thawed

instructions: Cook lasagna noodles in a large pot of lightly salted, boiling water for 10 minutes, or until al dente. Rinse with cool water, drain, and set aside.

Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chopped onions, mushrooms, garlic, and zucchini in the oil until soft. Stir in both cans of crushed tomatoes, tomato paste, oregano, brown sugar, and salt to taste. Reduce heat to low, and simmer for 15 minutes.

Meanwhile, microwave frozen spinach until cooked. Cool, and then squeeze out excess water. Drain cottage cheese. Using a mixer, blend spinach, cottage cheese, eggs, and 2 tablespoons basil until smooth. In a separate bowl, combine shredded mozzarella cheese and grated Parmesan cheese.

Preheat oven to 350°F. (175ºC.) Spread 1 cup sauce in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish. Layer 1/3 of the noodles, 1/3 cottage cheese/spinach mixture, 1/3 of remaining sauce, and 1/3 cheese mixture. Repeat layers with remaining ingredients. Sprinkle top with remaining 1 tablespoon of dried basil.
Bake in preheated oven for 60 minutes. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Zucchini Lasagna

ingredients.rawText: 10 oz. pkg frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
1 ½ cups reduced fat pepper jack cheese, grated and divided
4 large red bell peppers, halved lengthwise, ribs removed
16 oz reduced fat mozzarella cheese, shredded

instructions: Meat Alternate Ingredients: Slice zucchini into 1/4 inch thick slices, add salt and set aside on rack in a pan for 10 minutes. Zucchini has a lot of water so salting it takes out a lot of moisture. After 10 minutes, blot excess moisture with a paper towel. Alternative to salting -- Grill or bake zucchini on each side until cooked about 1 to 2 minutes per side. Drain and set aside.
In a saucepan, brown meat and season with salt and nutmeg. When cooked drain in colander to remove fat.
Add olive oil to pan and sauté garlic and onions about 2 minutes.
Return meat to pan, add tomatoes, basil, salt and pepper.
Simmer on low for 30-40 minutes, covered. Do not add extra water, as the sauce should be thick.
In a medium bowl mix ricotta, Parmesan and egg. Stir well.
Preheat oven to 350°F.
Spray bottom of 9 x 13 inch pan. Add a scoop of sauce, zucchini, cheese, then meat layer and continue until all ingredients are gone. Top with sauce and cover with foil
Bake in 350°F.oven for 45 minutes covered, top with mozzarella cheese and bake for 10 minutes longer uncovered.
Let stand 5-10 minutes before serving.

title: Manicotti
instructions: Beat eggs with salt, then add milk and beat well
Add flour until the consistency is of heavy butter milk
Fry batter in hot pan lightly coated with oil
Batter is done when bubbly
Mash ricotta and add one beaten egg with salt, chopped fresh parsley and grated Romano cheese
Fill and roll manicotti. Cooked side goes inside.
Place seam side down, cover with sauce (tomato or white)
Bake at 350ºF for 30 minutes

title: Spinach Manicotti

ingredients.rawText: 8 fresh basil leaves, minced or 1/2 tsp dried leaf basil, crumbled
1/2 teaspoon dried leaf oregano, crumbled (use fresh if available)
2 pkg of 10 oz spinach, frozen, chopped, thawed and squeezed dry, or 5
2 cups fresh mozzarella, diced (or 1 1/2 cups dry mozzarella, shredded)
I /2 the recipe of Ragu alla Bolognese or 3 cups thin béchamel sauce

instructions: In a large bowl, combine cheeses, herbs and spices. Mix well and taste, adjusting seasoning as desired.
Beat eggs well and add to the cheese mixture along with the spinach. Refrigerate until needed.
Prepare desired sauce.
Cook manicotti shells in a large pot of water with a handful of coarse sea salt, until just barely al dente. Drain but do not rinse.

In a baking pan large enough to hold the manicotti in a single layer with about 1/4 inch between each tube (13x9x2), place a thin layer of sauce. Stuff manicotti shells gently with the cheese mixture using a spoon or a large cake decorating bag fitted with a large round tip.
Lay the shells in the pan and cover with the remaining sauce.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes.

title: Balkan Corn Meal Mush
instructions: Add lemon juice and black pepper to tomato sauce.
Add salt to boiling water.
Add cornmeal and cook several minutes,
Stir in dill and feta.
Serve cornmeal topped with tomato sauce,

title: Polenta with Tomato Sauce and Cheese

title: Leftover polenta
instructions: NOTES : *Substitute ground beef for unflavored Italian sausage. *Balsamella white sauce is often used in place of cheese.
Preheat oven 350°F. (175°C). Spread 2 - 3 tablespoons of tomato sauce on the bottom of an oven pan.
Place the polenta slices in the pan.
Cover uniformly with tomato sauce.
Top with the fontina cheese. Finish with grated parmigiano reggiano. Repeat with an additional layer if you like.
Place in oven for about 15 - 20 min. until the cheese melts. Serve hot.

title: Pre Cooked (Or Instant) Polenta Flour
instructions: In a saucepan bring to a boil 5 cups water.
Place 2 cups cold water in a bowl. Drop polenta flour into cold water all at the same time. Stir to combine until a uniform mixture is obtained.
Pour polenta mix into the boiling water, stirring constantly to combine.
Reduce the heat to low and cook stirring constantly for about 5 minutes until the polenta is thickened.

title: Regular Basic Polenta
instructions: Prepare a saucepan full of water, and bring it to a simmer for later use.
In a stockpot, put 7 cups water, salt, olive oil, and turn heat to medium.
Just before the water starts boiling, add the corn flour a little at a time, stirring continuously with a whisk to prevent the polenta from clotting.

Continue to stir with a wooden spoon and boil the polenta for about 45 minutes. The absorption of water depends on the quality of the flour. If the polenta becomes too hard, add some warm water to adjust the consistency until it is like a dense paste.
While polenta is hot, pour it on a wooden board or to serving dishes.

Leftover polenta, sliced Plain breadcrumbs Salt to taste Frying oil
Cut the polenta slices in about 2 inch (5 cm) squares. Place the breadcrumbs in a shallow dish and add a pinch of salt. Dredge the polenta slices in the breadcrumbs and set aside.
Put the oil in the pan and turn the heat to medium. When the oil is hot shake away the excess breadcrumbs from the polenta pieces and place them in the pan. Fry on both sides until light brown.
Transfer the fried polenta to a dish covered with a paper towel to drain the excess oil. Serve hot at once.

title: Serbian Corn Bread Proja
instructions: Mix all ingredients together and bake in greased 5 cm or 2 inch high pan until golden. Serve with sour milk.

title: Using Pre Cooked Polenta

ingredients.rawText: one recipe basic polenta or precooked polenta.
ingredients.normalizedName: one recipe basic polenta precooked polenta

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb pork shoulder meat, largely diced

instructions: With a sharp knife separate the individual ribs.
Prepare the soffritto , finely chopping together the bacon, onion, carrot, and celery. This step can be done in a food processor.
In a large pan on medium heat put the extra-virgin olive oil. When the oil is hot add the soffritto mixture of finely diced bacon and vegetables.
When onion is soft and translucent and bacon is browned, add pork meat and ribs. Stir meat for a few minutes until pork is evenly browned.
Set the temperature to high, add the wine and let it evaporate.
Lower the temperature to medium and stir in the tomato and bay leaf.
When the tomato starts boiling, reduce temperature to a simmer, cover the saucepan and cook for about 45 minutes or until the meat is tender.
Prepare the polenta as indicated in the basic recipe or in the precooked polenta recipe.
Pour the polenta on a large wooden board. Spread polenta on the board in a uniform layer about 1/2 inch thick.
Create a small channel on the edge of the polenta to prevent the sauce from spilling on the board. Spread the sauce and the ribs on the polenta. Top with the pecorino romano cheese.
The polenta can be eaten picking it up directly from the board or can be transferred in slices to individual serving dishes.

title: Ravioli Stuffed with Spinach & Ricotta
italianTitle: Ravioli di Magro con Burro e Salvia

ingredients.rawText: 1 recipe fresh pasta dough (3 cups flour, 4 eggs, 1 tbsp olive oil)
1 lb (450 g) fresh spinach, boiled and squeezed dry
1 lb (450 g) ricotta cheese, thoroughly drained
Pinch of grated nutmeg, salt and pepper
4 oz unsalted butter and 10 fresh sage leaves

instructions: Boil spinach in salted water. Squeeze in cheesecloth until completely dry, then chop finely.
Combine chopped spinach, drained ricotta, egg, Parmigiano, salt, pepper, and generous pinch of nutmeg.
Roll out fresh pasta dough into two thin matching sheets.
Place 1 teaspoon portions of filling spaced 2 inches apart on first dough sheet.
Cover with second sheet, press air out around fillings, and cut with pastry wheel into squares.
Drop ravioli into boiling salted water; cook 3-4 minutes until al dente. Lift with slotted spoon.
Toss in skillet with melted foaming butter and fresh sage leaves. Top with grated cheese.
notes: Draining spinach and ricotta thoroughly is essential to prevent ravioli from opening during boiling.

title: Chicken Cacciatore and Ravioli

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts 1 tbsp olive oil
ingredients.normalizedName: 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts 1 tbsp olive oil

ingredients.rawText: 9 oz pkg refrigerated ravioli or tortellini 8 oz can tomato sauce
14 oz can diced tomatoes with garlic, undrained

instructions: Heat oil in heavy skillet and add chicken, onion and bell pepper. Cook and stir until chicken begins to brown. Add mushrooms, water, tomatoes, tomato sauce and bring to a boil. Add ravioli and cover the pasta with the tomato sauce. Carefully separate ravioli with large spoon.
Cover skillet and cook for 12-15 minutes until sauce is thickened, ravioli is tender and chicken is cooked through, stirring frequently to prevent sticking. 6 servings
notes: Cacciatore is an Italian dish that cooks meats in a tomato base along with herbs and sometimes wine.

title: Serbian Ravioli (Pelmeni).

ingredients.rawText: White of one small egg, beaten Water, chicken or beef broth

instructions: Combine flour and salt and mound on a clean surface.
Make a well in the centre and add eggs and water.
Incorporate flour mixture with egg mixture by working around the walls of the well until the dough is mixed.
Knead on a floured surface until soft and pliable.
Form into 100 balls, cover with a moist towel and let rest at room temperature for one hour.
Ingredients for the filling: Mix ground beef, onion, dill, salt and pepper to taste and enough water to make a soft mixture.
When the dough is ready flatten the dough balls into circles with a diameter of 7.5 cm.

Place one tablespoon filling on each dough round. Brush the edges with water and fold the dough to form half moons. Pinch opposite ends to one another to seal. Repeat this with the rest of the dough balls. Brush the pelmeni with beaten egg white.
Bring a large pot full of salted water to a boil, you also can use chicken or beef broth.
Without crowding, drop the pelmeni into the boiling water (or broth), stirring to prevent sticking until the pelmeni comes to surface (about 4 minutes).
Remove the pelmeni and put them on a large plate.
Melt butter over medium heat and drizzle it over the pelmeni.
Serve pelmeni with sour cream or a white sauce. Children like them with ketchup.
notes: This recipe will make about 100 pelmeni. Serves 10 people Ingredients for the dough:

title: Ukrainian Perogies (Pyrohy)

ingredients.rawText: 2 cups flour, 1 tsp salt, 1 egg, 1 tbsp oil, 1/2 cup water
1 cup cottage cheese or cream cheese
1 large onion, chopped & sautéed in 1/2 cup butter

instructions: Mix flour, salt, egg, oil, and water into a medium soft dough. Knead lightly; rest covered 10 minutes.
Mix mashed potatoes with sautéed buttered onions, cheese, salt, and pepper until thick.
Roll dough out thin, cut 2.5-inch rounds with a glass. Spoon filling in center, fold into half moon, and pinch edges firmly.
Drop perogies into rapidly boiling water; cook 3-4 minutes until they float to the surface.
Remove gently, drain, and coat in melted butter, sautéed onions, and fried bacon. Serve with sour cream.
notes: A beloved heritage recipe passed on through Georgina V. Cherished for holiday and family dinners.

title: Cooking Perogies

ingredients.rawText: 1 large onion, chopped & sautéed in ½ cup butter
1 large onion, chopped & sautéed in ½ cup butter
1 cup cottage cheese or ½ cup grated cheese or 1 cup cream cheese

instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil.
Melt butter, sauté chopped onion and fry with pork rinds or bacon.
Drop a few perogies at a time in boiling water.
Let boil rapidly 3-4 minutes and stir very gently while cooking to prevent them from sticking. Remove gently to colander and drain thoroughly.
Coat perogies well in sautéed onions and bacon.
Keep warm until all are cooked.
Serve with sour cream. 2 cups dry curd cottage cheese Salt and pepper to taste
Cheese and Potato Filling Preparation: Mix ingredients below well. Mixture should be quite thick.
Sauerkraut Filling Preparation: Rinse sauerkraut well and squeeze dry.
Chop dry sauerkraut very fine.
Sauté onion in fat until tender.
Add sauerkraut and season to taste with salt and pepper.
Cook over low heat for 15 minutes.
Cool completely before using.
notes: Cheese Filling: 1 egg, slightly beaten * 1 cup of chopped mushrooms may be sautéed with the onion *2. ½ lb ground beef may be sautéed with the onion and added to the sauerkraut

title: Liver and Bacon

ingredients.rawText: A delicious way to eat beef or pork liver along with bacon and onions. Cook
ingredients.normalizedName: delicious way eat beef pork liver along with bacon onions cook

ingredients.rawText: more bacon, liver, and onions if serving to more people. Be sure to simmer

instructions: everything (covered) for exactly 15 minutes.
6 slices bacon (use thin sliced bacon) Salt & pepper to season the onions and liver 1Ú2 lb beef or 1Ú2 lb pork liver, sliced thin 3 large onions, sliced thin 1Ú2 cup flour Butter flavoured Crisco
In a 12-inch skillet, cook the bacon slices. This should take about 20 minutes.
Remove bacon slices from skillet and set aside, but DO NOT drain off the bacon grease.
To the bacon grease in skillet add the sliced onions and season with salt and pepper.
Cook onion slices over medium to medium-high heat, for about 15 minutes; stirring often.
Remove onions from the skillet, set aside, but DO NOT drain off any of the bacon grease.
To the skillet, add a couple tablespoons of the Buttered Flavored Crisco.

title: Liver & Onion Venetian (Fegato Veneziana)

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb (500 gr) calf liver, thinly sliced and cut in 2 inch (5 cm) pieces

instructions: Cut the onions in very thin slices.
In a skillet place the olive oil and butter. When the butter starts foaming, add the onion. Sauté on medium low heat until the onion is tender and translucent.
Add the liver.
Mix with a wooden spoon and cook on medium heat for about 20 - 25 minutes or until the liver is tender and fully cooked.

title: Pork Liver

ingredients.rawText: 1 onion, sliced into rings to garnish

instructions: In a medium size bowl marinate the PORK LIVER with the 4 tbsps soy sauce, half the chopped garlic, ½ tsp black pepper and 2 tbsps lemon juice. Do not marinate more than 10 minutes.
Heat non-stick frying pan, add olive oil and when hot add sliced onions, and chopped garlic.
Add the marinated PORK LIVER and cook for at least 8-10 minutes. Do not overcook or else the pork liver will get hard,
Add salt if needed.
After 8-10 minutes it is ready to serve.

title: Pork Liver and Onions
instructions: Rinse liver and remove thin outer membrane (if there is one).
Slice the liver into 1/4 to 1/2 inch thick slices.
Soak the liver slices in milk for 1/2 - 1 hr.
Cut the onion into rings and then cut the rings into quarters.
In a large skillet over medium heat, heat 3 tablespoons oil.
Dredge the liver slices in flour and brown (for about 3 minutes per side).
Season to taste with salt and pepper.
Add onion and cook until onion is soft (about 5 minutes). Be careful not to overcook or liver will be tough.
Serve with mashed potatoes or other favourite side dish, salt to taste.

title: Tripe with Beans

ingredients.rawText: 3 oz borlotti or navy beans, pre-soaked 1 onion

instructions: Cut onion in half and stick the garlic clove in one half of the onion.
Wash the tripe under running water very carefully. Cut tripe in strips, about 1/2 inch wide and 2 inches long.
Boil tripe, half the onion with the clove stuck into it in lightly salted water for 10 minutes, drain and set aside
Prepare "battuto", finely dicing carrots, celery and the other half of the onion.
Strain tomatoes and remove all seeds, saving the juice.
In a large casserole, heat butter and oil, add battuto and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in tripe, season with salt and pepper then add tomatoes with their juice, sage, and the bay leaf.
Cover and cook on medium heat for about an hour.
While cooking, you may need to add some water, or broth.
When half cooked, pour in the beans and stir from time to time until done.
In the last 10 minutes remove lid and cook uncovered.
Arrange on dish, sprinkle with Parmigiano Reggiano and serve hot.

title: Roman Tripe with Tomato & Fresh Mint

ingredients.rawText: 2 oz (60 gr) pecorino romano cheese, freshly grated

instructions: Rinse the tripe well in fresh water. Fill a stockpot with water, 2 tablespoons of salt and the tripe. Bring to a boil and cook for about 30 minutes to tenderize. Drain and cut the tripe in slices about 3/4 inch (2 cm) wide.
Finely chop the bacon, onion, celery and carrot together. In a saucepan, put the olive oil and turn the heat to medium. Add the chopped vegetables and red pepper. Sauté until the onion is soft.
Stir in the tripe.
Add the wine, turn the heat to high and let the wine evaporate.

Add the tomatoes, 5–6 mint leaves, salt and bring to a simmer. Turn the heat to low, cover and cook for about 1 hour or longer until the tripe is tender. During cooking time, stir occasionally and add warm water if necessary to prevent the tripe from sticking to the pan.
When the tripe is almost ready, remove the lid and let the liquid evaporate to thicken the sauce. Add about 10 fresh mint leaves, serve warm and top with grated pecorino romano cheese.
notes: The taste of tripe cooked with tomato blends perfectly with the pecorino romano cheese and the fresh mint, giving this dish a unique flavour.

title: Serbian Tripe

ingredients.rawText: 2 tabs of butter or oil for frying

instructions: Place the whole piece of tripe into a pot with the peppercorns, 2 bay leaves, garlic and season with Vegeta or salt.
Cover with water and boil until tripe is tender. Remove tripe when cool and slice into fingers.
Chop the onions finely and fry until golden.
Place the tripe, the fried onions, ground pepper and 2 bay leaves into a saucepan. Add paprika to taste and cook slowly to reduce liquid.
Add crushed garlic, some of the water in which the tripe was boiled in and some dry white wine. (not too much liquid)
Cook another 10 mins. Before serving add tomato puree and vinegar

title: Osso Buco with Gremolata

ingredients.rawText: 3-4 whole veal shanks (or beef shanks, about 1 lb each)
1 bouquet garni (rosemary, thyme, bay leaf, cloves)
3 tbsp fresh parsley, 1 garlic clove minced, zest of 1 lemon (Gremolata)
Olive oil, butter, salt, black pepper

instructions: Pat veal shanks dry, tie with twine, season with salt and pepper, and dredge lightly in flour.
Heat oil in large Dutch oven until hot; brown shanks on all sides (3 mins per side). Transfer to plate.
In same pot, sauté onion, carrot, and celery until soft (about 8 minutes). Stir in tomato paste.
Return shanks to pan, pour in white wine and reduce liquid to half (5 mins).
Add bouquet garni and chicken stock. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer 1.5 to 2 hours until fork tender.
Prepare Gremolata: finely chop parsley, lemon zest, and minced garlic together.
During last 15 minutes of simmering, stir in 1-2 tsp gremolata.
Serve shanks topped with rich braising pan sauce and remaining fresh gremolata.
notes: 'Buco' means hole, referring to the marrow in the center bone. Make sure to offer small spoons for scooping out the marrow.

title: Osso Buco White Wine
instructions: In deep frying pan, with oil, brown osso buco dredged in flour mixture.
Remove and put it in baking dish.
In same frying pan, sauté onions, add carrots, wine, and chopped tomatoes. Cook for ten minutes.
Add onion mixture to osso buco.
Cover and put in a 350ºF oven for 2 hours. Serve over rice or pasta
notes: Rita V.

title: Ossobuco alla Milanese
instructions: for the gremolada: NOTE: The meat around the bone is surrounded by skin. To prevent the meat from curling up while it is cooking, cut the skin with vertical incisions. The shanks should not be thicker than approximately 3/4 inch (2 cm)— otherwise they may be too tough and would take very long to cook.
Pour flour onto a plate and add salt, mixing them together. Dredge the shanks in the flour until covered uniformly on all sides.
In a saucepan put the butter, and turn heat to medium. When the butter starts foaming, add the shanks.
Season with salt and pepper and brown the shanks well on both sides.
Add the wine and turn the heat to medium/high to evaporate it.
Add 1 1/2 cups of the broth; turn heat to medium/low; cover and cook very slowly for about 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
To make the “gremolada” mix together garlic, parsley and lemon rind.
When the meat is tender and tends to come off the bones, add 1 teaspoon of the “gremolada” mix on each of the meat slices, and finish cooking.
Add a little broth if necessary during cooking time to prevent the food from sticking to the pan. Serve warm.

title: Osso Buco Italian Braised Veal Shanks

ingredients.rawText: 6 (1- to 1 1/2-inch-thick) pieces osso buco (veal shanks) (about 4 pounds)
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, divided
1 (28 oz, 800g) hole tomatoes, canned, peeled, seeded and drained,

instructions: For the Gremolata : 2 tbsp (about 20g) finely minced flat-leaf parsley leaves and tender stems 6 medium cloves garlic, finely minced Zest of 1 lemon

Preheat oven to 325°F (163°C). Season veal shanks with salt and pepper. If available, tie a length of butcher’s twine tightly around the circumference of each shank so they hold their shape during cooking,

Put flour in shallow bowl. In a large Dutch oven, heat olive oil over medium/high heat until shimmering. Working in lightly dredge shanks in flour, shaking off excess. Fry shanks in Dutch oven being careful not to over- crowd. Turn shanks occasionally, until lightly browned on both sides, about 4 minutes per side; lower heat to prevent scorching. Transfer browned shanks to a platter and repeat with remaining shanks. Add more oil to Dutch oven at any point if it becomes too dry.

When all shanks are in platter, add butter to Dutch oven, along with onion, carrot, celery, and garlic. Cook, stirring, over medium/high heat until vegetables are softened and just starting to turn a light golden colour, about 6 minutes.

Add tomatoes, wine, and stock to Dutch oven, along with veal shanks and any accumulated juices. Try to arrange the shanks in as even a layer as possible (a little overlap is okay to make them fit). The liquid should nearly but not totally cover the shanks, if it doesn't, add more stock or water until it does. Add thyme and bay leaf. Bring to a simmer.
Cover shanks with parchment paper lid and transfer to oven. Cook for 2 hours.
Meanwhile make the Gremolata by stirring together parsley, lemon zest, and garlic in a small bowl. Set aside.

Remove parchment paper lid from shanks and continue cooking until they are fork-tender, about 1 hour longer. If the pot becomes too dry, add more stock or water as needed to keep it moist. Evaporation and reduction are good, but the pot shouldn't go dry. Feel free to move the shanks around so that any that are submerged can be exposed to the oven air. During the last 20 minutes of cooking, stir in 1 to 2 tsps (5 to 10 ml) Gremolata, depending on how strong you want the lemon and garlic flavour.

Use a spatula and tongs to transfer shanks to a platter so shanks do not fall apart. Using a spoon, carefully scrape off any excess fat on surface of braising juices. The liquid should be saucy and thick; you can adjust the consistency by adding either water or stock to thin out the sauce or simmering it on the stovetop until reduced more fully. Discard thyme and bay leaf and season with salt and pepper if necessary.

Remove twine from shanks, if used. Serve shanks on plates, spooning braising sauce on top and passing remaining Gremolata at the table for diners to sprinkle as a garnish to their own taste; make sure to offer small spoons for scooping out marrow from bones.

title: Ossobuco Milanese
instructions: for the gremolada: NOTE: The meat around the bone is surrounded by skin. To prevent the meat from curling up while it is cooking, cut the skin with vertical incisions. The shanks should not be thicker than approximately 3/4 inch (2 cm)— otherwise they may be too tough and would take very long to cook.
Pour flour onto a plate and add salt, mixing them together. Dredge the shanks in the flour, until covered uniformly on all sides.
In a saucepan put the butter, and turn heat to medium. When the butter starts foaming, add the shanks.
Season with salt and pepper and brown the shanks well on both sides.
Add the wine and turn the heat to medium-high to evaporate it.
Add 1 1/2 cups of the broth; turn heat to medium-low; cover and cook very slowly for about 1 1/2 to 2 hours.
To make the “gremolada” mix together the garlic, parsley and lemon rind.
When the meat is tender and comes off the bones, add 1 teaspoon of the “gremolada” mix on each of the meat slices and finish cooking.
Add a little broth if necessary during cooking time to prevent the food from sticking to the pan.
Serve warm.

title: Italian Simple Meatballs

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb ground veal (or beef, pork, or a combination)
1/4 cup grated Parmesan or Romano cheese

instructions: In a bowl, mix ground meat, cheese, beaten egg, breadcrumbs, minced garlic, parsley, salt, and pepper.
Blend thoroughly with hands. If too moist, add more breadcrumbs; if too dry, add another egg.
Form into uniform-sized meatballs, then coat with a light layer of breadcrumbs.
Heat olive oil with the whole garlic clove in a skillet over medium heat.
Lightly brown meatballs on all sides (they don't need to cook through inside).
Transfer browned meatballs directly into a pot of simmering tomato sauce and cook for 20-30 minutes until tender.
notes: Teresa R.'s recipe: Finishing the browned meatballs inside homemade sugo infuses the sauce with meat richness and keeps meatballs incredibly juicy.

title: Swedish Meatballs

ingredients.rawText: 2 tsp onion, chopped (or dried onion flakes)

instructions: Roll above ingredients into small balls.
Place in a greased casserole dish. 1 can jelly cranberry sauce 12 oz of chili sauce 2 tbsps brown sugar 1 tsp lemon juice
Bring cranberry sauce, chili sauce, brown sugar and lemon juice to a simmer, mixing well.
Pour sauce over meatballs
Cook in 200ºC oven for 2 1/2 hours.
notes: Sauce Ingredients :

title: Breaded Hamburgers

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper, or to taste
1/2 teaspoon garlic powder, or to taste

instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. (175ºC.)

Whisk eggs together in a small bowl. Place breadcrumbs on a plate. In a medium bowl, mix together the ground beef, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and Worcestershire sauce. Form into 4 patties. Dip burger patties into egg then press into breadcrumbs to coat.
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium/high heat. Brown the breaded hamburgers about 2 minutes per side.

Place onion rings in the bottom of a baking dish or casserole dish. Pour in just enough water to cover the bottom, but not cover the onion. Carefully place burgers on top of the onions in the baking dish without touching the water.
Bake for 25 to 30 min in preheated oven until burgers are well done.

title: Serbian Hamburgers (Pljeskavica)

ingredients.rawText: 1 tbsp hot paprika, or any hot red chili, crushed

instructions: Salt and pepper meat and let sit at least for 4 hours in the fridge. Mix in the onions and form into large, round, flat patties (hamburger-like form)
Grill over hot coals.

title: Natasa Serbian Hamburgers (Pljeskavica)

ingredients.rawText: 1 tsp baking soda and baking powder
*To make 4 pljeskavicas, 800 g of meat is required

instructions: Grind the meat three times on meat grinder.
Add all spices to ground meat and knead (work) the meat three times.
Between every knead, let the meat rest for 30 minutes.
Divide meat into 4 portions (about 200 g each) and make balls.
Flatten each ball and bake on the barbecue. Bon appetite!

title: Lipton Onion Meat Loaf
instructions: Combine soup mix with beef.
Add remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly.
Shape into a 9 X 5 inch loaf pan and bake at 350ºF for 1 hour.
Serve with onion gravy, if desired

Place half of meat mixture in loaf pan. Make a valley with hands and place spinach and cheese in valley, add whole boiled eggs and cover with spinach and cheeses. Cover with the second half of the meat mixture making sure to join upper and lower meat mixtures. Place hard cooked eggs, chopped parsley, cooked spinach or grated mozzarella in centre
notes: 3 lightly boiled eggs Spinach salted and sautéed grated mozzarella Parmesan cheese chopped parsley

title: Italian Meatloaf

ingredients.rawText: 2 tbsps leaf oregano (dry) or 3 tbsps fresh
1/2 pound frozen spinach, cooked, squeezed dry, finely chopped
1 tbsp leaf basil (dry) or 10 large fresh leaves, minced
1 cup cooked ham, diced in small pieces (preferably prosciutto cotto or

instructions: Preheat the oven to 375ºFs
Sauté the mushrooms in the oil until golden. Roughly chop.
Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl and gently blend with your hands.
Place in two 9 X 5 inch loaf pans.
Bake for 1 hour covering with foil if needed the last 20 minutes.
Cool for 10 minutes then serve.
notes: This recipe is good hot or cold and freezes well. You may want to make one meat loaf and shape the remaining mixture into meatballs. Bake the meatballs in a separate pan along side the meatloaf, cool and freeze for another meal.

title: Serbian Meatloaf

ingredients.rawText: Salt and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Grease a 1.75 litre/3 pint/71/2 cup loaf tin with the slices of streaky bacon.
Stretch the slices with the back of a knife, if necessary, to completely fill the tin.
Fry the diced bacon in a large frying pan until almost crisp.
Stir in the onion and garlic and fry for a further 2-3 minutes until they are soft and a pale golden brown.
In a large bowl soak the breadcrumbs in the milk for 5 mins or untill all the milk is absorbed.
Add the minced meats, bacon, onion, garlic, herbs and eggs to the breadcrumbs.
Season and mix well.
Spoon the mixture into the loaf tin.
Level the top and cover the tin with foil.
Bake for about 1 1/2 hours
Turn out and serve in slices with Serbian Garlic Sauce (below), herbed mashed potatoes and carrots.

title: Serbian Garlic Sauce

ingredients.rawText: A few drops of lemon juice

instructions: Sauté the garlic in the olive oil until golden brown; remove garlic and cool.
Add garlic to Mayonnaise and purée in a blender.
Season with pepper and lemon juice

title: Kielbasa Pork Sausages
instructions: In a large bowl, combine pork, beef and garlic. In a separate bowl, stir together black pepper, salt, brown sugar, ground allspice, marjoram and liquid smoke. Combine mixtures and knead with hands to combine.
Fill casings with meat mixture and refrigerate overnight. Boil or grill before serving.
notes: It's not that hard to make your own kielbasa! The best part is that you get to see exactly what goes inside. Boil or grill them before serving.

title: Serbian Beef/Pork Trieste Sausage Cevapcici
instructions: Place beef, pork, parsley, and garlic in a large mixing bowl. Season with seasoned salt, pepper, paprika, and nutmeg. Add egg white and red wine; mix thoroughly until well blended. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes to allow flavours to blend.
Preheat an outdoor grill on medium/high heat and lightly oil grate.
Roll the meat mixture into sticks about 1 inch thick by 3 inches long, using less than 1/4 cup of the mixture per stick. Brush the Cevapcici lightly with olive oil.
Cook on preheated grill until browned on the outside and no longer pink on the inside, about 12 minutes.
notes: Cevapcici are small sticks of seasoned, ground meat brushed with olive oil and cooked on an outdoor grill. This one incorporates a few non-traditional spices to add a new, Italian-style twist.

title: Serbian Sausage Rolls
instructions: Mix together the ground beef and pork.
Add plenty of salt and some pepper and work the mixture together well with your hands.
Mold the mixture into small sausage-shaped rolls, 2 inches long and the width of a finger
Place the rolls on a hinged grill basket and cook them quickly, turning them frequently so that they brown evenly, for about 6 minutes.
Serve the rolls with chopped onion.

title: Serbian Lamb/Pork/Veal Sausage Cevapcici

ingredients.rawText: 1 large yellow onion, peeled and grated
1/2 cucumber, peeled, grated and drained 1 hour
Salt and ground white pepper to taste

instructions: Yogurt Sauce: Mix all the ingredients, except the oil, thoroughly and roll the mixture into little "cigars" about 1 inch by 3 inches.
Rub lightly with olive oil and grill or broil until done. These are great on the barbecue. Serve with yoghurt sauce.

title: Serbian Cevapcici
instructions: Place beef, pork, parsley, and minced garlic in a large mixing bowl.
Season with salt, pepper, paprika, and nutmeg. Add egg white and red wine.
Knead mixture thoroughly by hand until well blended. Chill for 30-60 minutes.
Roll meat mixture into finger-length sticks (about 1 inch thick by 3 inches long).
Preheat outdoor grill or grill pan to medium-high; brush grates and cevapcici with olive oil.
Grill until browned on the outside and cooked through, turning frequently, about 10-12 minutes.
Serve in warm flatbread or pita with diced raw onions and creamy yogurt-cucumber sauce.
notes: A celebrated dish from the family's heritage, incorporating subtle Italian spices for a unique family signature.

title: Serbian Cevapcici Recipe
instructions: Preheat grill at a medium low heat.
Mix together the pork, lamb, beef and egg white in a large bowl.
Add the baking soda, cayenne pepper, garlic, paprika, salt and pepper. Mix thoroughly with your hands and shape into finger length sausages about 3/4 of an inch thick
Lightly oil the grilling surface and grill the sausages until completely cooked, turning as necessary, about 30 minutes.
notes: This is a tasty sausage that is very similar to meat. Excellent when served as a sandwich.

title: Yugoslavian Sausages (Cevapcici)

ingredients.rawText: 1 large yellow onion, peeled and grated
3 tbsp hot Hungarian paprika, or sweet paprika and a little cayenne
1/2 cucumber, peeled, grated and drained for 1 hour
Salt and ground white pepper to taste

instructions: Mix all the ingredients except the oil, thoroughly and roll the mixture into little "cigars" about 1 inch by 3 inches. Rub lightly with olive oil and grill or broil until done. These are great on the barbecue.
Serve with yogurt sauce (recipe follows).
Yogurt sauce: Mix all the ingredients together and serve with Cevapcici as a dip.

title: Asian Sloppy Joes, Cabbage Cilantro Slaw

ingredients.rawText: 2 tbsp Asian chili sauce (sambai oelek, chili-garlic, sriracha)

instructions: In medium bowl, combine cabbage and cilantro.
In small bowl whisk together vinegar, soya sauce, lime and oil.
Just before serving, pour vinaigrette over cabbage mixture. Toss lightly.
Asian Chili Mayo: In a bowl stir together mayo and Asian chili sauce.

title: Asian Sloppy Joes

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb lean ground beef, pork, chicken or turkey
½ cup chopped fresh or 1 can plum Roma tomatoes, drained and diced
1 ½ tsp each garlic or ginger minced

instructions: Heat a large skillet on medium high. Add oil, swirling pan to coat.
Add onion, garlic, ginger, celery and Asian Chili Sauce.
Cook, stirring often until meat is no longer pink 6-8 minutes.
Drain and discard fat. Add hoisin, tomatoes, cilantro and lime. Season with salt and pepper. Reduce heat to medium low. Simmer, uncovered 20-25 minutes stirring occasionally.
To serve arrange bottom halves of buns on plate. Slather each with about 1 tsp mayonnaise or to taste.
Spoon about ½ cup sloppy Joe mixture on top of bun. Cover with 2-3 tbsps slaw. Finish with top halves of buns.
Serve immediately.
Refrigerate any leftover meat, slaw and mayonnaise separately in airtight container for up to 2 days. Serves 4

title: Nordica Stroganoff Supreme
instructions: Melt half the butter in large skillet
Add ground beef and cook 3 to 5 minutes or until lightly browned
Add mushrooms, onions and garlic and cook 3 to 4 minutes or until softened
Remove meat mixture; keep warm
Add remaining butter to pan, blend in cornstarch
Add tomato paste
Gradually add beef stock; cook stirring until thickened
Return meat mixture to pan
Stir in cottage cheese and sherry
Serve immediately over cooked noodles
Garnish with parsley

title: Simple Beef Stroganoff

ingredients.rawText: 1 (10.75 ounce) can fat free condensed cream of mushroom soup
ingredients.normalizedName: fat free condensed cream mushroom soup

instructions: Prepare the egg noodles according to package directions and set aside.

In a separate large skillet over medium heat, sauté the ground beef over medium heat for 5 to 10 minutes, or until browned. Drain the fat and add the soup and garlic powder. Simmer for 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove from heat and combine the meat mixture with the egg noodles. Add the sour cream, stirring well and season with salt and pepper to taste.

title: Rice Florentine

ingredients.rawText: 1 pkg (300 g) frozen spinach. chopped 1 tsp salt

instructions: Leave ground beef in one piece and flatten into a rectangle
Heat oil in frying pan and place whole piece of ground beef in pan
Brown well on one side; turn and brown well on other side then cut into 12 pieces
Add onion and sauté 1 to 2 minutes
Push meat to outer sides of pan and add frozen spinach, water, tomato, salt, oregano and nutmeg. Break up spinach and bring to a boil
Stir in rice, cover
Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes. Makes 4 servings

title: Serbian Ground Beef, Veggie Potato Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. (200ºC.) Lightly grease a casserole dish.

In a skillet over medium heat, cook the beef until evenly brown. Remove beef from skillet, reserving juices and set aside. Mix in the olive oil and sauté the green pepper, onion, carrot, and celery until tender.

Return beef to the skillet, season with paprika, salt, black pepper, red pepper, cinnamon, and cloves. Stir in the water and red wine until heated through. Dissolve the beef bouillon cube into the mixture. Remove skillet from heat, mix in the half-and-half.
Layer the bottom of the prepared casserole dish with enough potato slices to cover. Place the beef and vegetable mixture over the potatoes, and top with remaining potatoes.
Cook, covered, 45 minutes in the preheated oven, or until the potatoes are tender.

title: Serbian Port and Beef
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. (190ºC.)

Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Brown ground beef, bacon, pork meat from hocks, and onions. Season with salt and pepper. Stir in sauerkraut and rice. Transfer contents to a casserole, and stir in chicken broth.
Bake, uncovered, in a preheated oven until rice is cooked, about 30 to 45 minutes. Check liquid level periodically; add water if the casserole is drying out.

title: Serbian Rice with Meat
instructions: Chop the veal meat and ham into cubes.
Peel and chop the onions and garlic (very fine)
Slice paprika, carrots and tomatoes.
Sauté meat and chopped ham with oil in a pan and season with salt.
Stir fry the onions, garlic and paprika with the meat and ham in the same pan.

Put bouillon in a pan, bring to a boil and add carrots. Allow carrots to cook for 10 minutes then add tomatoes, meat, ham, rice and the other vegetables, season with salt, red pepper and black pepper.
Put the food in a heat-resistant pan and bake in the preheated oven at 200 C for 50 minutes.
Before serving, decorate with finely chopped parsley. Serves 4:

title: Yugoslavian Burek

ingredients.rawText: Salt and freshly ground black pepper
1 box phyllo pastry sheet (12 inches x 17 inches)
1 medium yellow onion, peeled and chopped

instructions: Heat a large frying pan and add the oil.
Sauté the onion until soft and add the beef, spices, and salt and pepper to taste. Cook until the meat is crumbly but not dry.
Cool completely before you continue.

Lay 1 sheet of phyllo dough on the counter. Brush with some of the butter. Place a heaping 1/3 cup of meat mixture across the sheet along the long side, 2 inches from edge. Fold the bottom over the meat mixture and roll into a snake shape. Cut the roll in half and coil each roll into a snail shape. Place on a nonstick baking sheet and butter the end up against the edge of the pan to prevent uncoiling. Brush with additional butter.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375 º for 15 to 20 minutes or until just golden.

Keep the remaining sheets of phyllo dough covered with plastic, and work quickly to prevent it from drying out. before you open the box. Place the sheets of dough on a large cookie sheet and cover them with plastic wrap and then a heavy towel. Thus, they will not dry out while working with them. Work fast for best results and do not have the butter too hot when brushing the dough.
notes: Hint on handling phyllo dough: Be sure the dough is at room temperature

title: Beef Strips with Aruguala

ingredients.rawText: Pinch of crushed red pepper, optional
1 bunch of arugula salad (about 1/2 lb (400 gr)

instructions: (Straccetti con Arugula): Trim away the fat from the meat as much as possible. Slice the meat diagonally very thinly to obtain small meat tatters.
Put olive oil, garlic and red pepper in a skillet. Turn heat to medium.
When the oil is hot, but before the garlic starts colouring add the meat.
Mix thoroughly turning the meat pieces over several times until uniformly browned. Don’t overcook the meat, otherwise it will toughen.
Add the arugula and mix it with the meat. The vegetable will look like a large quantity but it will reduce very fast as soon as it will feel the heat of the pan. Add salt.
The vegetable will lose some liquid in the pan. Cook briefly on medium heat to evaporate the liquid. Serve hot.

title: Beef Stroganoff with Green Beans

ingredients.rawText: ¼ cup dry egg noodles (1/2 cup cooked) 1 egg
¼ cup cream of chicken soup
¼ whole onion or ¼ cup chopped onion

instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add egg noodles and cook for 8-10 minutes or until al dente. Drain egg noodles.
Dissolve flour in water. Stir in sour cream and cream of chicken soup.
Warm a nonstick skillet over medium heat and add onions, mushrooms, garlic powder and pepper. When onions soften, add sirloin and cook until just browned.
Pour the soup mixture over the steak and vegetables and cook until hot and bubbly.

Place a steamer insert in a saucepan and fill with water to just below the bottom of the steamer. Cover and bring water to a boil. Place green beans in steamer insert and cover. Steam for 5 minutes or until tender.
Serve mixture over egg noodles with steamed green beans on side.

title: Beef Stew

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb lean beef chuck, trimmed and cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Coat meat with flour.
Sauté with onions (6 minutes). Place on a plate
Add onions and mushrooms. Sauté 5 minutes, add garlic and pour off fat.
Return beef to pot and stir in tomato paste. Add enough water to just cover and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1¼ hours.
Add carrots, potatoes, and green beans.
Cover partially. Cook 15 minutes
In a small bowl, mix cornstarch and cold water and then stir into stew.
Increase heat and boil uncovered 1 minute.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve.

title: Beef Bourguignonne (Beef Stew)

ingredients.rawText: 2 lb steak (stewing beef or round cubed)

instructions: Shake meat in seasoned flour and brown in oil
Sauté carrots, onions, celery, garlic and rashers in oil
In a large pot, add all the above
Add bay leaves and season to taste
Bring to boil and simmer for 3 hours. As liquid evaporates add more wine

title: Quick Veggie and Beef Noodle Bowl

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb boneless beef sirloin steak cut into thin strips

instructions: Pour Parmesan cheese on top of breadcrumbs in a bowl and stir well.
Heat dressing in large frying pan.
Add steak strips and carrots and stir-fry 5-7 minutes or until cooked through.
Add broth, bok Choy, peppers and seasonings. Bring to boil, stirring occasionally.
Serve over pasta in bowls.

title: Stir Fried Beef and Snow Peas

ingredients.rawText: 1 tablespoon fresh ginger root, minced 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
1 lb beef round steak, cut into thin strips

instructions: In a small bowl, combine the soy sauce, rice wine, brown sugar and cornstarch. Set aside.
Heat oil in wok or frying pan. Add minced garlic and ginger root and stir fry.
Add beef round steak strips and stir fry until cooked.
Add soy sauce, rice wine, brown sugar and cornstarch and stir fry everything together. Serve warm.

title: Brined Roast Beef
instructions: 1 cup water Additional 3 cups cold water. Serving Ingredients : Red onions, Kaiser buns, horseradish, and stone ground mustard
Add above ingredients and the one cup of water to a saucepan and bring to a boil stirring until sugar is dissolved.
Remove from heat and add the additional 3 cups cold water
Place in a zip lock bag with roast and brine overnight.
Next day discard the bag and brine.
Place roast in pan and roast in the oven or try grilling or a crock pot.
Slice roast thinly and serve on Kaiser buns spread with horseradish and stone ground mustard and topped with slices raw red onions
notes: Using a brine is valuable for leaner roasts originating from the round, bottom, eye of round, and rump roast. The brine helps the beef maintain moisture during cooking in a dry method such as roasting, grilling. The roast is not as prone to denaturing (i.e. squeezing out the water due to protein contraction) if it has been brined. Brining also imparts flavor. Brining a roast is simple. Any solution with salt counts as a brine. This recipe has great, distinctive flavour. Brine Ingredients :

title: Roast Beef with Yorkshire Pudding
instructions: Yorkshire pudding Ingredients: Rub seasoning into fat on the beef and place in large roasting pan.
Roast in 450ºF oven for 15 minutes. Reduce heat to 350’F and continue to cook meat until done to your own preference.
Prepare Yorkshire Pudding batter, mix together the eggs, milk and water.
Sift in flour and salt; beat well to form a smooth batter.
Remove roast from oven and pan and cover with a large sheet of foil and let rest while puddings are in the oven to ease carving.
Measure 1/4 cup pan beef drippings; stir into Yorkshire pudding batter.
Pour batter into muffin pans and bake for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown and well risen.
Serve with rice or vegetable dishes.

title: Prime Rib Roast
instructions: Salt the roast, cover with aluminum or butcher paper and let sit on counter for 3 hours before cooking so roast is at room temperature.
Preheat oven to 500°F.
Pat roast dry with paper towels and sprinkle with salt and pepper.
Place roast fat side up in roasting pan.
Brown roast at 500°F. for 15 minutes.
Reduce heat to 325°F. until roast temperature is 130°F. for medium. (about 15-20 minutes per lb)
Once roast is at 130°F. remove from oven, cover with foil and let rest 15 to 30 minutes before cutting.
Cut bones away from meat and slice ¼ to ½ thick slices.

title: Beef Gravy

ingredients.rawText: 3 – 4 cups water, milk, beer or stock

instructions: To make gravy, drain excess fat from roasting pan leaving ¼ cup fat plus browned drippings and meat juices.
Place roasting pan on stove element on medium high heat and scrape stuck on drippings with metal spatula.
When fat is bubbly, sprinkle a quarter cup flour over fat and drippings. Stir with a wire whisk letting the flour brown.
Slowly add 3-4 cups water, milk, beer or stock to gravy. Cook slowly and whisk constantly breaking up any flour lumps. Let gravy simmer and thicken to 2 cups of gravy.
Season gravy with salt and pepper and desired herbs.

title: Garlic, Mushroom, Parsley Roast
instructions: Heat oil in pan on stove top and sear the meat in the oil on all sides.
Cut a pocket crosswise and stuff it with the chopped up garlic, parsley and mushrooms.
Put it in a broiling pan and cook according to weight of roast in a 350ºF oven. Goes nicely with Parisian potatoes.

title: Mushroom Pot Roast (Arrosto Ai Funghi)

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 oz (15 gr) dry porcini mushrooms soaked in warm water
ingredients.normalizedName: dry porcini mushrooms soaked in warm water

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 lb (450 gr) dry fresh mushrooms, sliced

instructions: Sprinkle the outside of the meat uniformly with salt and pepper.
With the tip of a sharp knife poke 3 - 4 small holes.
Insert 3 of the garlic cloves in the holes. Tie with a kitchen string if necessary.
In a saucepan put 2 tablespoons butter and 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil, and turn the heat to medium low. When the butter starts foaming add the meat.
Brown the meat lightly on all sides for a few minutes.
Add the wine, turn heat to medium/high and let the wine evaporate.
Add the broth, cover, and simmer on moderate heat for about 1 hour. Occasionally turn the meat to cook on all sides, and add a little more warm broth if necessary.
Drain the soaked porcini mushrooms, and chop them coarsley.
In a skillet put 1 tablespoon butter, 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil, and the remaining garlic clove (chopped).
Add porcini mushrooms and fresh mushrooms, salt, and pepper. Sauté for few minutes until mushrooms are tender.
Transfer half of the mushrooms to a food processor and reduce to a coarse paste.
When the meat is tender add the mushroom paste, the sautéed mushrooms and the chopped parsley. Stir to combine.
Slice the meat when it is lukewarm and serve dressed with the warm mushroom sauce.

title: Roast Beef, Mustard (Arrosto Alla Senape)

ingredients.rawText: 1 tbsp of fresh herbs: Thyme, Marjoram, Sage, finely chopped

instructions: Brush meat evenly with mustard. Tie meat with kitchen string if needed.
In a large saucepan put olive oil, butter, and onion. Turn heat to medium and sauté until the onion is soft and translucent.
Add the meat and brown it evenly on all sides, turning it several times.
Add the fresh herbs and broth..

Turn heat to low, cover saucepan, and cook for about one and a half hours. Check occasionally and if the pan appears to be too dry add a little bit of broth. Cooking time may vary, therefore, taste for readiness.
When the meat is ready, remove it from the pan. Dissolve the cornstarch in 1/4 cup cold water.
Turn heat to medium. If liquid in pan appears scarce, add some broth. Using wooden spoon scrape residues of gravy from bottom of pan.
Add the cornstarch and cook until the sauce becomes thicker.
When the meat is lukewarm, slice and serve topped with warm sauce.

title: Easy Pressure Cooker Pot Roast

ingredients.rawText: 3 lbs boneless beef chuck or round roast, trimmed
Pinch seasoned salt, or to taste
pinch onion powder, or to taste
4 carrots, peeled and cut into bite-size pieces
4 large potatoes, peeled and cut into bite-size pieces

instructions: Heat oil in a pressure cooker over medium/high heat. Sear roast on all sides in hot oil until browned; season with salt, onion powder, and pepper.
Pour in beef broth and Worcestershire sauce; add onion and seal the lid. Bring the cooker up to full pressure. Reduce heat to low, maintaining full pressure and cook for 30 minutes.
Use the quick-release method to lower the pressure. Stir in potatoes and carrots and seal the lid; bring the cooker up to full pressure and cook for an additional 15 minutes.
Use the quick-release method again and transfer roast and vegetables to a serving dish.

title: Pressure Cooker Pot Roast

ingredients.rawText: 3 pounds beef chuck roast, pat dry with paper towels on both sides
4 cloves of garlic, peeled and minced
3 large parsnips, cut into ¾ in pieces
1 ¾ cups chicken stock preferably homemade (or beef stock)

instructions: Season the meat with salt and pepper on both sides.
Preheat the pressure cooker to high. Add in the oil.
Once the pot is hot, brown chuck roast, 3-4 minutes on each side.
Transfer meat onto a plate and cover with foil to keep warm.
Add in the onion, garlic, chicken stock, and thyme and give it a stir.
Put the meat back into the pot and secure the lid.
On pressure cooker, select manual, make sure that the steam release handle is turned to sealing position and cook at high pressure for 60 minutes.
When cooking is complete, use natural release for 10 minutes and then release the remaining steam.
Add in the potatoes, carrots, and parsnips. Be sure to submerge them in the cooking liquid.
Select manual and cook at high for 10 minutes.
When cooking is complete, use a natural release for 10 minutes and then release the remaining steam.
notes: Ready in less than 2 hours, perfectly easy, tender and juicy. *No parsnips? - Use 2 more large carrots instead. *Cooking a frozen roast in a pressure cooker is easy. Place the frozen roast in the pressure cooker with the trivet underneath to allow the heat to penetrate the entire surface of the roast and add an additional 20 minutes to the cooking time.

title: Two Day Garlic Roast Beef

ingredients.rawText: 6 garlic cloves each clove cut into 8 slivers

instructions: Day before cooking roast .
Make slits into roast. Push garlic sliver into each slit.
Put roast in casserole dish, cover and let rest in refrigerator for a day.
Cooking day: Let roast sit 2-3 hours on counter to bring roast to room temperature
Preheat oven to 450°F.
Put roast fat side up in greased or sprayed with Pam roasting pan
Cook 20 mins on high heat
Reduce to 350°F. and roast 20 min. If roast is 4 lbs cook 80 mins
Put meat on cutting board and cover loosely with foil and let rest for 30 mins or more.
Gravy Juice: Put pan on high heat burner. Add 1/2 cup white wine
Cook 8-10 min stirring and scraping little brown bits constantly
Add 2 cups beef stock. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium and cook for 20 minutes. Add salt and pepper
Slice roast and drizzle with gravy juice

title: Seasoned Beef Tenderloin Roast

ingredients.rawText: 2 lbs centre cut beef tenderloin, trimmed

instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºF.
Rub the roast with the olive oil until completely coated. Combine the rosemary, parsley, thyme, and garlic and cover the beef with the mixture by patting in on.
Once the beef is completely coated, season with salt and pepper.
Sear the beef over high heat in an ovenproof skillet. Turn until brown on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Place the skillet directly into the oven and allow beef to toast for 20 to 25 minutes.
Remove from oven and let stand for 10 minutes before slicing. Serve with green beans and grilled red onions. Serves 6

title: Sirloin Steak Marinade
instructions: Combine above and pour over steaks for 20 minutes up to 8 hours
Remove the steaks from the marinade and discard the marinade. Add the steaks to a hot grill.
For a perfect medium rare steak, grill a 1 inch thick steak for 4-5 minutes per side. For a steak that is 1 1/2 inches thick, add 1-2 minutes to the cooking time per side.

Insert an instant read thermometer into the steak. Remove the steak once it reads 130°F for a medium rare steak. For a medium steak, wait until it reaches 140°F and for a medium well steak, wait until it reaches 150°F. 1/4 cup (60 cc) dry white wine the grill and let it rest. Remove the steak from the grill and let it rest for 5-10 minutes. This ensures that the juices redistribute throughout the steak, leaving the juiciest steak! Sprinkle coarse kosher salt or sea salt flakes over the steak and optionally garnish with fresh chopped parsley before serving.
notes: Quick tip! A steak will rise approximately 5 degrees after you remove it from

title: Oven Baked Round Steak
instructions: Preheat oven to 300 º F
Trim excess fat from steak. Place meat in 9x13 baking dish
Mix soups, water, and gravy mix in a small bowl
Pour over round steak
Cover pan with aluminum foil
Bake at 300°F. for 3 hours.

title: Veal Chops with Red and Green Peppers

ingredients.rawText: 8 large peppers (green and red), seeded and sliced
Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

instructions: Heat the oil in a skillet and sauté the peppers, onion and garlic until tender, stirring often
Transfer to a bowl and add the olives, salt and pepper
Dust the chops lightly with flour
Heat the butter in the same skillet
Add the chops and brown on both sides
Place the chops in a covered casserole and cover with the pepper mixture
Bake at 350ºF for 40 minutes or until chops are tender

title: Chicken/Veal Cutlets Fettini di Pollo/Vitello
instructions: Wash and cut meat according to preference (finger/cutlet) and drain
Beat 2 eggs, some milk and a pinch of salt
After meat is drained, dip into egg and milk mixture
In separate dish or on wax paper, add breadcrumbs, grated cheese, pinch of pepper, parsley and garlic, and mix well
Take fettini one at a time out of the egg mixture and place in breadcrumb mixture
Pat with hands well and turn over one at a time
If any egg mixture is remaining, you can dip a second time and then into the breadcrumb mixture
Heat oil in pan well and add fettini. Heat should be high
Fettini should be golden brown, turn once and they are ready
When taken off heat, drain on paper towel
notes: Elvira & Frank F. & Dina M.

title: Milanese Veal Cutlets
instructions: In one bowl, whisk together eggs and milk.
In a second shallow bowl, combine breadcrumbs, Pecorino cheese, garlic powder, and chopped parsley.
Dip each veal cutlet into egg mixture, then press into breadcrumb mixture on both sides to coat evenly.
Heat oil and butter in a heavy frying pan over medium-high heat until hot.
Fry cutlets in batches for 1 to 2 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy (do not overcrowd pan).
Drain on paper towels and season with sea salt.
Serve immediately with fresh lemon wedges and a crisp tomato-arugula salad.
notes: Thin cutlets cook very quickly! The semolina breadcrumb crust creates an unforgettable crunch.

title: Veal Milanese Cutlets (Cotolette)

ingredients.rawText: Salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
Butter for frying the veal (or a mixture of olive oil and butter)

instructions: To get the crispiness you want, pound the veal cutlets to make them as thin as possible. Trim off any fat and salt them lightly (too much salt will make the veal dry) and then coat them first in egg (with a little salt added) and then in breadcrumbs.
When veal is coated, heat the butter / oil in a frying pan to a high heat.
Turn the heat down to about medium high and add the first cutlets.
Fry the cutlets on each side for a few minutes until golden brown.
Place on a plate with paper towel to drain the oil as you cook your way through the cutlets. If doing a lot, change the oil if it gets full of crumbs.
Serve with lemon wedges to squeeze over the cutlets. Enjoy!

title: Veal Cutlet Parmigiana

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup plus 4 tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese
1 tbsp each fresh parsley and basil, minced

instructions: Position a rack in the centre of the oven. Preheat oven to 350°F.
Combine the breadcrumbs, 1/2 cup of the Parmesan cheese, fresh herbs, salt and pepper in a pie plate. Set aside.
In a shallow bowl, whisk the eggs and water. Set aside.
On a plate, spread the all-purpose flour. Coat the veal scallops with the flour and shake off the excess.
Dip the veal into the egg mixture and then coat with the breadcrumb mixture, patting with your fingers to make crumbs adhere.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium/high heat.
Add the veal and sauté until lightly browned, 2 or 3 minutes.
Using tongs turn cutlets and continue cooking, 2 or 3 minutes longer.
Add a little more oil if the pan looks dry.
Remove veal scallops to a plate and blot with paper towels.
Lightly oil a baking pan. Spoon ½ cup of the tomato sauce into pan.
Arrange the veal scallops over the sauce, slightly overlapping them.
Sprinkle with 4 tablespoons of the Parmesan cheese. Cover with the remaining tomato sauce. Top with the mozzarella slices and the remaining Parmesan cheese.
Cover pan with foil and bake until heated through, 20-30 minutes.
Brown top by removing foil and placing under broiler for a few minutes.

title: Veal Lemon Piccata
instructions: Pound the veal slices with a mallet but do not make them too thin.
Season meat on both sides with salt and pepper and coat with flour.
Heat butter in a large skillet over medium/high heat and lightly brown both sides about 2-3 minutes. Salt to taste.
Measure the lemon juice and add an equal amount of water. Add to the pan and stir well, continue cooking until the sauce has reduced a little.
Arrange cutlets on a warm plate, sprinkle with the parsley and spoon the sauce over all.

title: Saltimbocca alla Romana
instructions: Dredge veal slices in flour with a pinch of salt; shake away excess.
Place a slice of prosciutto and a fresh sage leaf on top of each veal slice. Secure with a toothpick.
In a large frying pan, melt butter with olive oil over medium heat.
Place veal in pan and fry gently on both sides until lightly browned (about 2 minutes per side).
Pour in white wine, turn heat to medium-high, and let wine evaporate and reduce into a glossy pan glaze.
Remove toothpicks, arrange cutlets on warm plates, spoon buttery pan juices over top, and serve warm.
notes: Saltimbocca literally translates to 'jump in the mouth' because it is so mouthwatering.

title: Grilled Rosemary & Lemon Veal Cutlets

ingredients.rawText: 1 tablespoon Rosemary, finely chopped 3 cloves garlic, minced

instructions: In a medium bowl, mix the first eight ingredients to create your marinade.
Add veal cutlets to marinade mixture. Fold them in and completely coat.
Place cutlets in the refrigerator to marinate for 2-6 hours or overnight.
Preheat the grill to 500ºF. Shake the excess marinade off the cutlets and spray the grill grates with cooking spray.
Place each cutlet in a single layer on the grill. Grill veal cutlets for 1- 2 minutes per side.
notes: Pounding cutlets to an even thickness make them cook evenly and helps to prevent shrinking when they cook. Pound cutlets before putting them in the marinade. These cutlets are fast and easy! Serve with potatoes or a vegetable. This is a great dish to serve a crowd. Marinate veal cutlets overnight or at least 2-6 hours. The thin slices of meat soak up all the rosemary and lemon flavours. Put everything except the cutlets into a bowl and mix. Fold veal cutlets into mixture and refrigerate. When grilling , keep an eye on cutlets as they cook fast! Do not overcook the veal. Use a meat thermometer to ensure that the cutlets reach an internal temperature of at least 145ºF. It is hard to take the internal temperature of veal cutlets because they are very thin. Grill them about 2 minutes on each side. Make sure the cutlets move freely from the grill or skillet before flipping.

title: Fast-Fry Veal Scallopini

ingredients.rawText: A few slices of veal scaloppini, thinly sliced

instructions: Salt and pepper both sides of the scaloppini
Preheat skillet, when it is warm, coat the pan with olive oil.
Add the veal to the pan and for every 2 pieces of veal, squeeze 1/2 a lemon while cooking.
Flip after two minutes, cook the other side for an additional two minutes.
Serve warm with potatoes and salad

title: Veal Cutlet Lemon & Wine

ingredients.rawText: Juice of ½ lemon or more to taste

instructions: Preheat large skillet over medium/high heat, add butter, let melt and turn slightly brown.
Season the veal on both sides with salt and pepper. Dredge them in flour, shake off the excess and place them in a single layer in the hot skillet.
Let the veal cook for about a minute on each side.
Remove the veal from the skillet and place on a plate.
Place the skillet back on the burner and turn the heat up to high.
Add wine, season with salt and pepper, let wine reduce by about half, add lemon juice and parsley, cook it long enough so the sauce has thickened.
Spoon the sauce over the veal and enjoy!
notes: Serves: 2 Prep Time: 10 minutes Cook Time: 10 minutes

title: Glazed Celebration Ham

ingredients.rawText: 4 to 6 lbs boned ham, oven read1 cup ginger ale

instructions: Place ham on roasting pan. Score ham lightly.
Mix together sugar, mustard and ginger ale. Spoon mixture over ham.
Bake at 350ºF for 60 to 70 mins basting frequently until ham is browned.
Serve with scalloped potatoes and cooked green beans.

title: Baked Orange Ham with Mustard Fruits

ingredients.rawText: 1 fully cooked ham, weighing about 10 pounds
1 can (6 ox) frozen orange juice concentrate, thawed

instructions: Place ham, fat side up on a rack in a large shallow baking dish. (Do not add water or cover pan.)
Bake in oven (325ºF) for 1 1/2 hours. Trim off skin.
Score ham and stud with whole cloves. Mix orange juice concentrate and marmalade in a small bowl; brush over ham

Continue baking, brushing several times with remaining marmalade mixture, 30 minutes, or until richly glazed. Place ham on a heated large serving platter. Serve with Mustard Fruits 1 (8 1/2 oz) can pineapple 1 can (30) oz pear halves 1 (30 oz) can cling peach halves 1/2 cup light corn syrup 1 tbsp dry mustard 1/2 tsp ground ginger
Drain juice from sliced pineapples into a 1 cup measure; add enough juice from peaches to make 3/4 cup. Drain peaches and pear halves
Combine fruits in a 13 X 9 X 2 inch baking dish
Add corn syrup, dry mustard, ginger and cardamom to pineapple juice; stir to mix; pour over fruits
Bake, uncovered, with ham for 30 minutes, basting fruits with juices
Lift fruits out of the pan to a serving dish; cook juices in pan over direct heat until reduced by half. Stir in 1 slice lime or lemon.
Spoon over fruits.
notes: Mustard Fruits: 1/4 tsp ground cardamom

title: Pork Bones and Cabbage
instructions: Allow bones to stay in cold water overnight.
Drain and clean bones thoroughly.
Bring water to a boil and add bones and meat to pot. Ensure water covers bones. Bring to a boil.
Drain pork bones and meat and wash thoroughly.
Place washed pork and bones in boiling water pot again and cover.
Bring to a boil. If scum returns to the top, remove with a slotted spoon.
Add salt. When pork meat is cooked, remove and set aside.
Bring pork water to a boil and add washed and cut cabbage.
Bring to a boil and allow to cook until tender.
When cabbage is cooked return pork meat to pot and serve warm.

title: Pork and Broccoli Stir Fry

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb strips of lean, boneless pork, divided,
1 cup baby carrots, halved or sliced

instructions: In a bowl, stir together 1 tbsp of the cornstarch, 1 tbsp of the soy sauce, and sherry; add pork and stir to coat well.
In separate bowl, stir milk with remaining 1 tbsp cornstarch, remaining 2 tbsps soy sauce and hot pepper sauce; set aside.
Separate broccoli into florets; peel and chop stalks to make 6 cups in toal of broccoli.
In wok or large nonstick skillet, heat oil over high heat.
Add pork mixture, carrots and onion; stir-fry for 4 minutes or until meat is lightly browned. Stir in garlic, ginger and broccoli; stir-fry for 2 minutes
Stir in milk mixture; cook, stirring often, for 4 minutes or until sauce is thickened and broccoli is tender-crisp.

title: Pork Tenderloin Slices

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb pork tenderloin, cut into 1/2-inch slices

instructions: Spray 10-inch nonstick skillet cooking spray; heat over medium-high heat.
Cook pork and garlic in skillet 6 to 8 minutes, turning occasionally, until pork is light brown and no longer pink in center. Drain if necessary.

title: Serbian Pork Dinner

ingredients.rawText: 2 lbs boneless pork, baked and shredded
2 red peppers, julienne Salt to taste
2 or 3 hot peppers, cut in rings Rice or noodles to serve with pork

instructions: Heat oil and butter in skillet. Add onions. Cook until a soft gold color.
Sprinkle Arrowroot or flour over top and add the paprika. Stir well for a couple of minutes. Reduce heat, add pork, peppers, beef broth, tomato paste, garlic, salt and bay leaf. Stir to mix well.

Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer covered 1 to 1 1/2 hours. Serves 4 Note: It won't look like enough liquid but the Paprika will bring moisture you need. Serve over Basmati rice or noodles or tomato, basil noodles.

title: Serbian Pork Stew (Muckalica)

ingredients.rawText: 1 green bell pepper, cut into strips
2 oz. feta cheese, cut into 3/4-in. cubes

instructions: Trim fat from pork. Cut 1/2 in. pork slices; cut slices into 1/2 in. strips.
Heat oil in skillet until hot. Cook and stir pork in oil over medium heat until brown, about 15 minutes; drain.
Add water, onions, tomato, salt, paprika, pepper and red pepper. Cover and simmer until pork is tender, about 30 min. adding water if necessary.
Add green pepper. Cover and simmer until green pepper is crisp-tender, 5 to 10 minutes. Top with cheese. Serve with rice.

title: Teriyaki Pork Loin Kebobs

ingredients.rawText: green peppers cut into 1 inch squares

instructions: Soak wooden skewers for 30 min. in water.
Cut pork loin into 1 inch cubes.
Thread pork and peppers alternately onto skewers using 3 pork cubes and 2 pepper squares per skewer.
Place skewers on greased grill of barbecue preheated to medium.
Close lid and cook for 10 minutes, turning occasionally.

Brush with Teriyaki sauce and cook 5 minutes longer, turning frequently and brushing with more teriyaki sauce or until meat thermometer inserted in centre of pork reads 180°F. Allow 2 skewers per person.

title: Balsamic Pork Loin Roast

ingredients.rawText: 2 tsp fresh thyme leaves or 1 tsp dried
4 cloves garlic, minced or 1 tsp garlic powder
2 tsp fresh rosemary, chopped or 1 tsp dried

instructions: For the marinade, in a medium mixing bowl whisk together wine, vinegar, oil, honey, garlic, thyme leaves, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Pat the pork loin dry with a paper towel and add it to a large zippered freezer bag. Add the marinade and turn the pork to ensure it is coated.
Place in refrigerator. Marinate for at least 3 hours or overnight, turning occasionally.
Remove the pork loin from the fridge 30 minutes before cooking.
Preheat the oven to 350°F.
Add the pork loin and the marinade to a 9x13 casserole dish.
Roast uncovered for 1 to 1 ½ hours making sure to baste the pork every 30 minutes. Cook until a meat thermometer reaches 140°F.
Remove from the oven and transfer the pork to a plate. Let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Pork Loin Roast, Apple Cider Vinegar
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F.
With a small knife, pierce top of roast and force garlic slice into the cut 8- 10 times
Sprinkle roast with salt and pepper. Place bay leaves at the bottom of the roasting pan and set roast on top of bay leaves, fat side up.
Mix vinegar and thyme in a small bowl and pour over roast.
Bake 3 hours or until roast internal temperature is 145°F.
Using a baster or spoon, baste the drippings over the roast frequently while cooking.
Let the roast rest for 10 minutes when done before slicing.

title: Pork Roast Herbed, Arrosto Maiale con Erbe

ingredients.rawText: ½ cup (60 cc) dry white wine
About ½ cup (60 cc) broth (or water)

instructions: Finely chop together garlic, rosemary leaves, sage, thyme, cloves, salt and pepper.
With a sharp knife make incisions on the meat and fill with the herbs.
Rub the surface of the meat with the rest of the herb mix.
In a saucepan put olive oil and turn heat to medium low.
Place the meat in the pan and brown lightly on all sides for few minutes.
Add wine, turn the heat to high and when the wine is evaporated add about 1/2 cup broth (or water).
Cover and simmer on moderate heat for about one hour to one hour and 15 minutes. Occasionally turn the meat to cook on all sides, and add a little warm broth if necessary.
In a small bowl mix together the corn starch and 2 - 3 tablespoons water.
Remove the meat from the pan. Add the cornstarch mix to the pan, scraping the bottom to incorporate to the gravy. Stir and cook until thicker.
Cool the meat at room temperature, slice and serve dressed with the warm sauce. NOTE* The prosciutto is generally salty and salt is not necessary.

title: Italian Pork Loin Roast

ingredients.rawText: 1 long sprig fresh rosemary (preferred) or 1/2 tbsp dried

instructions: Rinse rosemary and strip leaves from stem if using fresh.

In a blender or food processor, combine garlic, rosemary, olive oil and salt; blend until mixture turns to a creamy paste. Rub over the roast; cover and let stand 30 minutes or overnight in the fridge.
Place on a greased baking rack, fat side up, in a roasting pan.
Bake, uncovered, at 325°F for 2 to 2 1/2 hours or until the internal temperature reaches 160 to 170ºF.
Let stand 15 minutes before slicing.

title: Pork Loin Roast, Mustard & Maple Sauce
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Allow ¼ lb raw pork per person.
Cut ¼ of pork loin off to roast. Refrigerate or freeze remaining loin.
Rub roast with Canola oil. And place in shallow roasting pan.
Mix together 2/3 cup maple syrup and 1/3 cup Dijon mustard and pour over roast.
Pour 1 cup water into pan.
Bake uncovered in centre of preheated 400F oven for 30 minutes per pound or until temperature in centre reads 180°F. Baste every 20 minutes with pan juices.
Add more water as needed during cooking time to keep pan drippings from burning.
Let rest 10 minutes before cutting.
Allow ¼ lb raw pork per person.

title: Pork Loin Roast, Mustard & Rosemary

ingredients.rawText: 3 lbs boneless pork loin, well trimmed

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a 13"-x-9” pan with foil and place a wire rack on top.
Roll the flap of the boneless loin into a cylinder and using kitchen twine, tie the pork loin every few inches. (This helps cook the pork more evenly.)

In a small bowl, mix together garlic, mustard, rosemary, thyme, kosher salt, and freshly ground black pepper. Rub mixture all over pork loin and place in roasting pan fat-side down. Bake for 30 minutes, then carefully flip the loin and bake until a thermometer inserted into the middle of the meat reads 145°, about 20 minutes.
Mix melted butter and brown sugar together, then brush on top of the pork loin. Broil for 2 minutes to let caramelize.
Let rest for 10 minutes before slicing into 1/3” pieces. Serve warm with pan juices.

title: Pork Roast With Orange Arrosto al’Arancio

ingredients.rawText: 2 tbsp fresh herbs (thyme, marjoram), finely chopped

instructions: Spread the herbs over the meat on all sides.
Uniformly cover the pork roast with the prosciutto slices.
Tie the pork roast with a kitchen string.
Place the olive oil in a sauté pan large enough to contain the meat. Turn heat to medium. When the oil is hot transfer the meat to the pan.
Brown the meat uniformly turning it on all sides.
Add the butter the orange juice and the chopped vegetables.
Stir, cover the pot and cook on medium/low for about 45 minutes. Turn the meat occasionally. Add a little broth if necessary.
When the meat is done, set aside the gravy and vegetables and let the meat cool to room temperature.
Place the butter in a large skillet on medium heat. When the butter starts foaming add the orange slices. Sauté briefly for 1 or 2 minutes, turning on both sides.
Slice the meat like in a fan, without separating the slices.
Transfer the meat in a oven-proof serving dish. Add the gravy with the vegetables on top and around the meat.
Cut the orange slices in half. Insert the orange slices among the meat slices. Place briefly back in the oven covered with aluminum foil to warm the meat before serving.

title: Rosemary Pork Loin Roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Crush garlic with rosemary, salt, and pepper making a paste.
Pierce meat with a sharp knife in several spots and press garlic paste into openings. Rub meat with remaining garlic mixture and olive oil.
Place pork loin into oven turning and basting with pan liquids. Cook until the pork is no longer pink in the centre about an hour.
An instant-read thermometer inserted in centre should read 145°F.
Remove roast to platter. Heat the wine in the pan and stir to loosen browned bits on the bottom.
Slice roast and serve with wine pan juices.

title: Tangy Glazed Pork Loin
instructions: Heat oil in medium saucepan, add onion and garlic. Sauté 5 minutes until onion is tender but not brown.
Stir in chili sauce, lemon juice, molasses, mustard and Worcestershire; bring to a boil, lower heat, cover, simmer 20 minutes. Stir in rum
Place meat on a rack in large baking pan. Do not add water or cover.
Roast in a slow oven (325ºF) for 2 1/2 hours. Brush meat with glaze
Continue roasting for 1 hour or until meat registers 170ºF on meat thermometer, basting frequently with additional glaze
Garnish with sugared grapes, spiced crabapples, whole canned apricots and chicory, if you wish.

title: Roasted Pork Shoulder Recipe

ingredients.rawText: A juicy, succulent pork with crisp, crackling skin slow-roasted pork shoulder.
1 bone-in skin-on pork picnic shoulder (6 to 10 lbs.)
ingredients.normalizedName: bone in skin on pork picnic shoulder

instructions: Let pork sit at room temperature for 30 minutes to an hour.
Preheat the oven to 275°F.
Mix together garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Sprinkle it all over the pork.
Put pork in a large roasting pan, skin-side-up. No need for a rack in pan.
