Add about half an inch of broth to the pan.

Roast uncovered until the internal temperature is 180°F, 45 to 55 minutes per pound. This may seem high for pork but your goal is really tender, slow-cooked pork, almost like the texture of pulled pork.

If at any point most of the broth evaporates, add more. Add enough to cover any browning on sides of pan from where previous broth evaporated away. This will dissolve that browning and flavor the gravy.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 30 minutes. To make gravy, transfer pork to a plate and use the drippings for the gravy. The pork does not need to be covered during resting time.
Preheat the oven to 500°F.

Put the pork in a clean roasting pan or on a rimmed baking sheet and roast uncovered until skin is crisped and puffy, 10-15 min., rotating pan every 3-5 min. (cover any parts that are getting overly browned with foil).
Cut or pull the pork into hunks and serve immediately. Do not let it rest now since it has already rested.

title: Slow Cooked Porchetta Roast

ingredients.rawText: Coarse salt and freshly cracked black pepper

instructions: Preheat oven to 450°F. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with foil.
Pat pork dry. Score crosshatch pattern (1/2 inch apart) through skin and fat, but not into meat.
Rub generous salt, pepper, and herbs into the slits and all over pork.
Make deep slits into meaty bottom of roast and push garlic pieces into each slit.
Roast uncovered at 450°F for 30 minutes to start the crust.
Remove, cover tightly with heavy-duty foil, reduce heat to 300°F, and roast for 5.5 to 6 hours until fork tender.
To crisp skin, remove foil and raise heat to 450°F for 10-15 minutes until skin is puffy, crispy, and crackling.
Rest 15 minutes, then carve or pull into succulent chunks.
notes: The pride of central Italian festivities. Crispy crackling on the outside, meltingly tender within.

title: Easy Bone in Pork Shoulder Roast

ingredients.rawText: 8–10 lb pork shoulder or any pork roast 1 tablespoon dried oregano
ingredients.normalizedName: pork shoulder any pork roast oregano

ingredients.rawText: 2 tbsp coarse Kosher salt (or 1tbsp if using table salt)

instructions: Combine all of the ingredients for your spice rub in a small bowl.
Remove pork shoulder from packaging and rinse under cold water.
Using your hands, pat the dry rub all over the surface of the meat.
Place in a large roasting pan skin side up.
Roast uncovered in a preheated 500 °F. oven for 20 minutes
Reduce heat to 300 °F. and roast for an additional 45 minutes per pound.
Total cooking time for an 8lb roast should be about 6 hours and 20 minutes.
Remove the pork roast from the oven and let rest for 30 minutes.
The hard outer shell should lift right off like a cap and can be broken or chopped into delicious meat chips! The meat should pull apart with forks. Shred, adjust seasoning , and serve!

title: Low and Slow Roasted Pork Shoulder
instructions: Pan Fixings: Preheat oven to 450°F.
Plalce pork shoulder on a rack in a roasting pan
Mix garlic, salt, pepper, thyme, oregano and olive oil in a small bowl.
Rub all over the pork shoulder.
Roast, uncovered at 450 F for 45 minutes.
Remove the pork shoulder from the oven, decrease heat to225 F.
Add slied onions, chicken broth, beer, and chili flakes to bottom of pan.
Baste the pork with the panliquids.
Tent tin foil over roast and return to oven, Check every hour of so to baste roast with liquids from pan, addig more chicken broth if needed.
Roast about 7 to 8 hours, basting every hour.
The roast is on whn he internal temperature is 170-175F.
Let roast rest25-30 minutes. Remove skin and fat before carving.

title: Apple Cider Pork Tenderloin
instructions: Coat each piece with a simple spice rub.

Sear pork in hot pan until nice and brown then put it to a baking dish. Searing pork before you bake it not only gives it a beautiful color, but it also adds flavor and seals in the juices so it stays more tender.
Deglaze the pan with some beef stock then pour this tastiness (and some apple cider vinegar) over the pork.
Dot top of the pork with butter, cover the pan, and bake 400 • 20-25 mins.

Do not overcook it. As with any lean cut of meat, if it is overcooked, it will be dry. The key is to cook it to 145 º Fahrenheit and no more. The pork will be a tiny bit pink in the centre and buttery soft.
Add a little liquid. Deglaze searing pan with some beef stock and add this to the roasting pan. It adds a fantastic flavor and keeps tenderloin juicy.
Pour a little apple cider vinegar over the pork. It will help tenderize the meat and give a delicious flavour to the sauce.

Making sauce for Pork Tenderloin: Beef stock deglazes the pan so that any of the delicious bits stuck on after searing the pork will be a part of the sauce. Pork juice , the liquid released as pork bakes, becomes part of the sauce. Apple cider vinegar adds the best flavor. Once the tenderloin is ready to serve, remove it from the pan and pour the pan juices over the sliced pork.

title: Italian Pork Tenderloin

ingredients.rawText: 3 tbsp fresh lemon, lime, or orange juice (or 1 tbsp of each)

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. and lightly grease a large baking pan.
Pierce tenderloins all over with a fork. Rub oil onto all sides of the meat.

Whisk together the Italian seasoning, garlic powder, cumin, salt, chili powder, smoked paprika (if using) and black pepper. Sprinkle mixture over tenderloin(s), patting it onto the surface of the meat on all sides. Place in prepared baking dish and drizzle lemon/lime juice over the top.
Bake for 25-35 minutes until outside is browned and crispy and centres are cooked through to desired doneness (you can take them out on the early side if you like the centers a little pink).

Spoon juices from the dish over the meat. Allow to rest on a cutting board or in the baking dish for 5-10 minutes. Slice into 1 inch pieces. Spoon any remaining juices from the pan over the slices, garnish with fresh chopped cilantro if desired, and serve.

title: Pork Tenderloins, Apple Cider Vinegar

ingredients.rawText: 1 apple peeled, cored and thinly sliced
½ cup cider or apple juice

instructions: Cut onions in half lengthwise and thinly slice crosswise.
In large skillet, heat 2 tsps of oil over medium heat and fry onions, stirring often until tender and golden, about 10 minutes.
Stir in apple; cover and cook until tender about 10 minutes. Let cool, set aside for up to 2 hours. Rewarm before using.
Season pork with pepper. In large ovenproof skillet, heat remaining oil over medium high heat and brown tenderloins all over.
Transfer to 350°F. oven; roast until juices run clear when pork is pierced about 20 minutes.
Transfer to a carving board; tent with foil and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Meanwhile pour off fat from skillet. Add stock and cider; bring to a boil over medium/high heat, scraping brown bits from bottom of pan. Boil until reduced to about ¾ cup.
Dissolve cornstarch in 2 tbsps cold water; stir in skillet, cook until thick.
Put onion mixture on hot plate. Fan pork slices and drizzle with salt.

title: Rosemary Pork Tenderloin Roast

ingredients.rawText: 2 cups fresh flat parsley, torn roughly

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. (190ºC.)
Rub the roast or tenderloin liberally with olive oil, and then spread the garlic over it. Place it in a 10x15 inch roasting pan and sprinkle with the rosemary.
Bake at 375°F. (190°C.) for 2 hours, or until the internal temperature of the pork reaches 145°F. (63 C.)

title: Air Fryer Pork Loin Chops

ingredients.rawText: 2 centre cut, bone-in pork chops, 1 1/2 – 2 inches thick

instructions: Preheat air fryer to 400ºF. for 5 minutes
Rinse pork chops with cool water and pat dry with a paper towel.
In a small bowl, mix together all the dry ingredients.
Coat the pork chops with olive oil and rub in the mix. Rub it in well and liberally. Use most or all of the rub mix for the 2 pork chops.
Cook pork chops in air fryer at 400ºF. for 12 minutes, flipping pork chops over after 6 minutes.

title: Pork Chops with Pears

ingredients.rawText: ¼ cup brown sugar, firmly packed
¼ cup dry sherry or orange juice

instructions: Grease bottom of large skillet with small piece of pork fat. Brown chops; place in shallow pan and season with salt and pepper.

Arrange pears hollow side-up around chops and drizzle orange juice over everything. Sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon; pour sherry over pears and chops. Divide margarine and place in hollow of pears.
Bake covered in preheated 350  oven for 50 minutes.
Uncover during last 20 minutes. Place chops and pears on platter.
Dissolve cornstarch in water. Add to juices in pan and heat until mixture boils and thickens, stirring constantly. Pour over chops and pears. 4-6 servings

title: Baked Pork Chops and Stuffing

ingredients.rawText: ¼ tsp poultry seasoning or 1/8 tsp sage and 1/8 tsp celery salt
10¾ oz can condensed cream of mushroom soup

instructions: Heat oven to 350ºF.
Grease bottom of medium skillet with small piece of pork fat.
Brown chops; place in single layer in shallow 2-2.5 quart casserole.
In small bowl, combine bread cubes, onion, poultry seasoning, 2 tbsps water and margarine. Top each chop with 1/4 of mixture.
Combine 1/3 cup water and soup in skillet used for browning chops; pour over stuffing and chops.

Bake uncovered at 350ºF for 1 hour or until chops are tender. Tips: Condensed cream of celery or golden mushroom soup may be substituted for mushroom soup. For 6 servings, use 6 pork chops and 3 cups bread cubes. Increase poultry seasoning to 1/4 teaspoon. Stir in remaining ingredients; cook until mixture thickens and coats pork.

title: Stuffed Pork Chops
instructions: Slice pork chops not quite in half so they may be stuffed.
Combine soft breadcrumbs, chopped onion, chopped apples, salt, pepper, poultry seasoning, melted butter and chopped celery.
Stuff the pork chops and pin together with toothpicks.
Bake 1 hour at 350°F.
notes: Georgina V.

title: Barbecued Pork Loin Chops
instructions: Cut pork loin crosswise into ¾ inch thick chops
Brush pork on all sides with barbecue sauce
Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste
Place on greased grill of preheated barbecue
Close lid. Cook over medium heat for 6-8 minutes per side, brushing with more barbecue sauce occasionally or until temperature is 160F in centre. Let stand for 5 minutes.

title: Baked Pork Chops
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Spray pan with Pam or cover with parchment paper. Place chops in pan.
Mix garlic, onion, paprika, oregano, salt and pepper to taste
Spread olive oil over chops. Sprinkle spices over olive oil. Bake 20 min.

title: Lemon Olive Pork Chops

ingredients.rawText: 1 tsp grated lemon rind 1 tbsp lemon juice

instructions: In plastic bag, shake flour with pepper
Add chops and shake one at a time to coat.
In skillet, heat oil over medium/high heat.
Brown chops, 2 to 3 minutes per side. Transfer to plate and set aside.
Add garlic to pan, cook, stirring for 1 minute
Add chicken stock, olives, capers, lemon rind and juice and bring to boil.
Return pork to pan. Cover and simmer over heat turning once for 3 to 4 minutes or until glazed and just a hint of pink remains.

title: Glazed Rack of Pork

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup beef or chicken broth or bouillon

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.

Make many shallow 1 inch slits over the surface of the pork, especially through the fat. Mix the garlic with the salt and spread mixture over the roast, pressing a little into the slits. Place in shallow baking dish.
Roast in centre of oven, uncovered, for 2 hours. Stir oil with Dijon mustard. Crush rosemary and add to mixture.

After initial 2 hours, cover the roast with the Dijon mixture then baste every 15 minutes for 30 – 45 minutes or until meat temperature is 155ºF. If roast browns too quickly, loosely cover with foil. Let roast sit outside oven for 5 minutes before carving.
Skim off and discard any fat from pan juices. Add broth and scrape up brown bits. Pour into small saucepan and boil gently for 5 minutes. Slice pork and serve with pan juices. Serves 8

title: Bar-Be-Que Ribs or Beef
instructions: Dip ribs in flour. Place in a large saucepan and brown in oil
Add all the rest of the ingredients.
Cook for 1 ½ hours on stove top. Serve
notes: Georgina V.

title: Country Style Barbecued Ribs

ingredients.rawText: 4 lbs to 6 lbs. Pork back ribs

instructions: Put ribs in a large pot; cover with water.
Bring to a boil; reduce heat, cover and simmer for 45 to 50 minutes until ribs are tender. Drain ribs and put in one layer in a large shallow pan.
BARBECUE SAUCE: Heat oil in large skillet.
Add onion and garlic; cook 4 to 5 minutes so onion is translucent.
Stir in remaining ingredients.
Simmer for 30 minutes (20 minutes if using vinegar), stirring occasionally, or until sauce coats a spoon. Coat ribs with sauce.
Cover with plastic wrap; refrigerate up to 24 hours.
To grill: Cook ribs 4 to 6 inches above hot coals for 10 to 12 minutes, turning and basting twice with sauce remaining in pan until ribs are well coated and browned.
To broil: Broil 4 to 6 inches from heat source.

title: Pork Ribs in the Oven
instructions: Remove the membrane (remember, this ensures fall off the bone ribs).
Generously season both sides with salt, pepper and paprika. This is also a great opportunity for adding more flavor with your favorite spice rub.
Wrap the ribs with aluminum foil with fold on top.
Put aluminum foil wrapped ribs on a baking pan.
Bake the ribs at 275°F for 2 ½ to 4 hours or until tender.
Take ribs out of oven. Unfold aluminum foil. Slather the baked ribs with barbecue sauce, then broil (grill or bake) the ribs for a few minutes until the sauce is caramelized.

title: Italian Ribs and Cabbage

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup fresh or canned tomatoes, chopped

instructions: Wash the ribs and pat dry. Cut between each bone to separate them, and season with salt, pepper and sugar.
Heat the olive oil in a heavy-bottomed pot over medium/high heat. Add the ribs and sear until golden brown. Add the garlic and onion and cook for a few minutes.
Pour in the wine and vinegar and cook until they evaporate. Stir in the tomato paste and then the tomatoes. Pour in the chicken stock, reduce the heat and simmer for about 20 minutes, covered.

In the meantime, remove each leaf from the cabbage and cut out the centre spine, splitting the leaf in two. Cut the cabbage into wide juliennes. Add the cabbage to the meat, season with salt and pepper, stir, and cover.
Simmer until the cabbage is tender about 10 minutes.

title: Pot Baked Ribs and Cabbage

ingredients.rawText: 1 large head of cabbage, sliced like for coleslaw
2 lbs pork ribs, cut into pieces

instructions: In a large pot, heat up the vegetable oil and sear the ribs on both sides. Season the ribs generously with salt and pepper and then remove them from the pot.
To the same pot, add the cabbage and cook for about 15-20 minutes, until it shrinks down. You may have to add it gradually allowing it to shrink more and more if your pot is not big enough.

Add the tomato paste and paprika and stir well. Place the ribs on top and add about 3 cups of water. (The water should completely cover the cabbage). Cover with a tight lid and cook for 1 ½ hours on low heat, stirring occasionally until the meat becomes tender. Taste if the dish has enough salt and adjust, if needed.
Transfer the cabbage into a large baking dish or tray. You should have a little liquid remaining at this point. Bake at 450 ⁰ F for about 15- 20 minutes until the liquid completely evaporates.
5. Garnish with freshly chopped parsley and serve. Makes 4 servings

title: Pot Ribs and Cabbage
instructions: Cover meat with cold water in a large saucepan, bring to a simmer, remove scum.
Simmer uncovered 1/2 hour.
Quarter cabbage and parboil in salted water then drain.
Add diced onion and vegetables to meat. Season with salt & pepper to taste and continue simmering ribs & other ingredients in a tightly covered pot about 1 hour or until ribs are tender.
Melt butter and blend in flour, dilute with a little of the meat stock.
Remove the vegetables in the pot before adding butter & flour mix. Pour over meat and cabbage and simmer covered 1/2 hour more. Makes 4 servings

title: Slow-Cooked Ribs, Sweet & Sour Sauce

ingredients.rawText: 6 lbs pork back or side ribs
2 jalapeno or chili peppers with seeds, finely chopped

instructions: At least a day before serving, in a large saucepan, stir tomato sauce with orange juice, onion, celery, vinegar, honey and ginger.
Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally over high heat. Reduce heat to medium/low. Simmer, uncovered, stirring occasionally to develop flavour, about 1 hour. Stir often near the end of cooking time.
Working in batches, puree in a blender, then put into bowl or jar. Cover and refrigerate at least overnight or up to 3 days.
Slice pork into four-rib portions and place in a very large bowl.
Finely chop or mince garlic and finely chop jalapeno including seeds.
Place garlic and jalapenos in a small bowl. Stir in oil, paprika and salt and rub over ribs. Cover and refrigerate overnight.
About 5 hours before serving, preheat oven to 250ºF.
Place ribs in a very large roasting pan. Pour sauce overtop. Turn to evenly coat. It’s OK if ribs overlap. Cover tightly with foil.
Bake in centre of oven for 1 ½ hours.
Remove and discard foil, turn ribs, spooning sauce overtop. Continue baking, turning ribs occasionally basting until very tender, (1 to 1½ hr.).
Remove pan to a heatproof surface. Place ribs on a platter. Spoon sauce in pan over ribs. For the ultimate comfort dinner, serve with baked or mashed potatoes and corn. Makes 6 to 8 servings

title: Serbian Goulash

ingredients.rawText: 1 green bell pepper, cut in strips

instructions: Add all ingredients to an eight quart stockpot.
Stir and bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for one hour, stirring occasionally.

title: Calabrese Sausage & Salami
contributor: Nonna Rosina, Fiore, Vito, Sam & Hunter

ingredients.rawText: Pork shoulder and belly, coarsely ground
Coarse sea salt (calculated strictly by meat weight)
Sweet and hot ground Calabrian red pepper
Natural pork casings, cleaned and soaked in vinegar/wine

instructions: Mix coarsely ground pork with salt, hot and sweet Calabrian pepper, and wild fennel seeds.
Turn the meat mixer vigorously until seasoning is completely incorporated.
Stuff prepared casings tightly using sausage horn, piercing air pockets with needle.
Tie links with natural twine.
Hang high on wooden rafters in the cold cantina to cure for several weeks to months.
notes: Sausage or Salami making is an all-hands family group effort. Generations gather in the cold winter cellar.
originalPhotoCaption: Nonna Rosina, Fiore, Vito, Sam & Hunter making sausages; Liver sausages hanging

title: Pigs in a Blanket

ingredients.rawText: 1 pkg sausage links, brown and serve type, skinless
Tip: *Hot dogs may be substituted for the sausages
ingredients.normalizedName: tip hot dogs may be substituted sausages

instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºF
Cook sausages according to directions on package. Remove sausages and drain on paper towels.
Roll sausages into uncooked crescent rolls, follow directions for rolling on package.
Place on cookie sheet or aluminum foil and bake in 350ºF oven 10 minutes or until golden.
notes: Chrissy Z.

title: Sausages and Onions

ingredients.rawText: White wine as needed (approximately ½ bottle)

instructions: Cut sausage links in half and set aside.
Slice onion into thin rounds, separate, and set aside.
Place sausage rounds in saucepan over medium heat until completely browned. (about 10 minutes)
Add onions and cook until them until they are soft, about 10 minutes.
Add white wine until sausage rounds and onions are covered.
Stir well and lower to simmer.
Simmer 1 and ½ hours or until onions are caramelized and develop into a nice sauce.

title: Fancy Pork & Beans
instructions: Stir all ingredients together in small saucepan.
Cook on medium heat until beans start to boil

Casing Preparation and Cleaning: We usually use medium size sausage casings and medium sized salami casings. They may be bought in whole or half bundles. One bundle of salami casings is good for 3 hams of meat. Casings are heavily salted for preservation. Gently untie and untangle the casings. Cut the plastic string that holds casings together. Once casings are untangled, cut them to a manageable length of about 12-14 feet.
Under running water wash off all the salt from the casings and let water pass through the casing.

Turn about an inch of the casing over on the outside of itself holding the index and middle finger in one end of the casing and reversing the casing back into itself by using the water pressure to turn the casing into itself and reversing the rest of the intestine. Keep the turned and washed intestine in a large bowl with warm water. The side of the casing with the fat is now on the outside of the casing.

Then get another bowl and put in warm clean water. Again under running tap water turn the intestine right side out by folding in a little of the beginning part of the intestine and running the water through it so that it turns right side out. Now fat lines should be on the inside of the casing.
Prepare the bowl with warm water and cut up lemons. Place all intestines into the lemon water bowl.
Salami Casings should be cut about a cutting board long (about 11 inches long) and tied at one end with a 12 inch length of string before putting them in the lemon warm water.
Ensure water in bowl is always warm. It may need to be changed during the stuffing process. Intestines will break if the water is cold. So be sure to check temperature of water frequently.
Mixing meat is cold, therefore, we put cotton gloves under nitrile disposable glove and put an elastic at the wrist so gloves do not fall off. A meat mixer avoids the cold hands.

title: Sausages

ingredients.rawText: 2 kg of pork meat, coarsely minced
60-70 grams salt (15 per kilo of meat)
Dried hot chili flakes to taste
Fennel seeds, whole or minced to taste Paprika to taste
Pincher to create air holes in sausages String for tying

ingredients.normalizedName: bushels prepared with cardboard newspapers at bottom

instructions: Mix meat, salt, pepper, chili, fennel seeds, and paprika together and allow to stand for about 3 hours.
Wash and prepare the sausage casings. Remove all salt, rinse two or three times and put in warm water with lemon. Intestines should be soft.
Weigh meat, add salt as per weight (15 gram salt per 1 kilo meat for sausages, 22 grams salt per 1 kilo meat for salami), add spices and mix.
Put some of the fixed meat into a small frying pan, heat and taste for flavour. Pork should be salty to taste. If it is not salty enough, add more salt, mix, cook and taste again.
If taste is good, make round balls with fixed meat to fit into sausage stuffer tube. Fill stuffer with the balls of sausage meat.

Take out one strand of casing and squeeze out moisture by holding casing between index and middle finger over the bowl. Gently gather the intestine over the end of the funnel. Tie the end of casing by making a knot.

Fill the casings until they are quite firm and prick any air pockets with a needle or pincher. It is important that there are no air pockets remaining that could cause the sausage to go moldy. When the casing is almost all filled, stop the machine and tie a string around the funnel and casing. Remove casing from funnel to tie tightly.

Gently squeeze sausage meat into evenly spaced links about 8 inches long and either twist and fold over or tie each sausage link with butcher twine. Tie a longer string in the middle of the sausage cord to hang up.
Salt both ends of the sausage cords.
Once filled, put sausage cords in tablecloth lined bushels. Let cords stay in bushel overnight.
Next day hang the cords of sausage high in airy cantina for at least 3 weeks for sausages and 6 – 8 weeks or up to 3 months for salami.

When salami are first hung, the humidity will be over 85%. Then over the next week the humidity will drop down to 75%. The humidity should be a bit less than the water content of the meat being cured. This stops the meat drying out too fast and developing case hardening. At the start of curing the meat has a lot of moisture in it so you want your curing humidity to almost match that. As the meat loses water you drop the cantina humidity down accordingly. Humidity should be kept about 70- 75%.

Indications that the sausages are ready are that they will start to shrink and feel firm to the touch. The salami are done when they have lost 35% of their initial weight. When ready vacuum pack sausages and salami. grams per 1 kilogram meat as the salt will only be used for flavouring rather than preservation. The sausages may be cooked right away or frozen.

title: Prosciutto 2023

instructions: DAY 1: SALTING PROCESS: Trim hind leg and bleed the femoral artery. Blot the blood with a paper towel. Trim leg to form shape.
Weigh leg. Let it remain in salt 2 days per kilogram or 1 day per pound.

Put leg in bin and coat leg with salt paying close attention to hock and ball joint areas. Put lots of salt under the skin. A thick layer of salt should be on the exposed meat. Put leg meat side down on bed of salt.

Put bin in cantina and cover leg with board and place weight of 1 case of water on board (33 lb or 3 gallons of water). Weight should be 1.5 times the weight of the leg. So if leg is 21 lbs, weight should be 31.5 lbs.

DAY 4: After 3 or 4 days , turn the leg over and salt the skin side of the leg and also the hock and ball joint areas. Put leg skin side down on salt in bin. Increase weight to 2.5 times weight of leg (50 pounds or 5 gallons of water). Put large bag over weight covering most of the bin to slow down the drying process.
DAY 11: After a week, toss out the liquid and resalt the leg, putting lots of salt on the ball joint and hock areas. Put leg skin side down on salt in bin and cover with bag and 2.5 weight.
DAY 18; After second week , repeat the process in step 6, toss out the liquid, clean the bin, resalt the leg, put skin side down and weight on leg with bag over it.

DAY 25; DRYING PROCESS: After third week prepare the leg for the drying process. Brush off the salt, rinse leg under cold running water or 50/50 water and vinegar wash. Put leg back into clean bin and give it a wine bath with 2-3 cups of red wine. Rub the wine into the leg.
Wrap a collagen sheet first over meat side of leg, making a hole with a scissors to expose the ball joint bone. Wrap the collagen sheet around the whole leg as it will slow down the drying process.

Pierce collagen sheet with sausage poker (awl) to remove air pockets. Weigh leg. This is the hanging weight. It will be done after it loses 30% of its weight. So if the leg is 21 lbs. It will be done when it weighs 14.7 lbs.

Wrap a long string a few times around the end of the leg bone, tie it tightly and hang in cantina. To ensure leg does not fall off the string, poke a hole with an awl through the hock area and thread string through the hole. Hang in cantina, humidity should average 80% and temp. 55°F. or 13 C.

AGING AND FINAL DRYING PROCESS: After about three months , if the leg reached the target weight of 14.7 pounds, remove collagen sheet. Make a 50/50 mixture of vinegar and water and clean off the leg to remove surface mold and blot dry with a paper towel.

Make the sugna with equal parts lard and rice flour and some black pepper and mix it until it is the consistency of putty or play dough. Cover the meat area with a mixture of lard and black pepper. No need to cover skin as the skin will protect the meat.

Hang in cantina 80% humidity, and 55 ⁰ F or 13 ⁰ C. temperature for 8 months or more. Two years is better. Thinly slice off hard skin and sugna from prosciutto. Then cut off chunks and vacuum pack or slice to enjoy. weight (65 lb), and covered with a bag after 3 days. title: How to Cook Chicken Breasts

instructions: cold run water, pat dry, and cook. Baking in Parchment: Preheat the oven to 425ºF. Spread parchment paper or heavy duty foil on your work surface and arrange thawed boneless, skinless chicken breasts on them. Top with lemon slices, bay leaves, or other spices and herbs. Bring the edges of the paper or foil together and fold (making sure to keep chicken in a single layer) then crimp to hold in the steam. Bake at 425ºF. for 10-15 minutes. Frozen chicken breasts can be baked with this method too. Simply place them in paper or foil, allowing space for heat expansion, and bake according to the package directions. The two kinds of frozen chicken breasts I buy have different cooking times; one cooks for 35 minutes, the other for 50. I test at the shorter cooking time with the thermometer.

Poaching: To poach boneless, skinless chicken breasts, place them in a large skillet and add 1-2 cups of water or chicken broth. Bring to a boil, reduce heat, cover, and cook for 9-14 minutes until chicken reaches 160ºF. about 15 minutes. You can also poach in the oven. Place chicken in a single layer in a roasting pan. You can add lemon slices, peppercorns, or any other spices or herbs. Bring 4 cups of water to a boil and immediately pour over chicken. Cover and bake at 400ºF. for 20-35 minutes, checking for an internal temperature of 160°F.

Microwave: Cooking chicken in microwave oven is risky it cooks unevenly. The same piece of chicken can be several different temperatures at the same time! If you have healthy people over the age of 5 in your household, this is an easy method for microwaving chicken. Place boneless, skinless chicken breasts in a glass dish with thin side of the breasts in the centre. Pour 3/4 cup buttermilk over the chicken, sprinkle with herbs and spices of your choice, cover plate with plastic wrap, and cook on high for 3 minutes. Check chicken, then cook for 2 minutes longer. Rearrange the chicken using tongs, cover again, and microwave for 3-5 minutes longer until internal temperature is 165ºF. Discard buttermilk mixture.

Crockpot: For fresh chicken breasts, stack breasts in crockpot, add 1/2 cup water or chicken broth cover, and cook on low for 5-6 hours, rearranging once during cooking time. For frozen chicken breasts, arrange in crockpot, add 1/2 cup chicken broth or water, cover, and cook on low for 8-9 hours, rearranging once during cooking time.
Steaming: To steam chicken breasts sprinkle with Mrs. Dash and place in a pan on the bottom rack of a steamer for 20 minutes for thawed and 30 minutes from frozen to produce a juicy result.

Sautéing: This dry heat method is quick and easy. Breasts pounded thin will cook for about 2-3 minutes a side over high heat. Unpounded breasts take a bit longer to cook; about 4-5 minutes per side. Coat a skillet with olive oil, heat over high heat, add breasts, cook for 4 minutes without moving them, then turn and finish cooking.

Pressure cooker: This is a moist heat method of cooking. Add thawed chicken breasts to the cooker, add sliced onions and lemons for flavour along with 1/2 cup water, cover and lock the cooker and bring the pressure up to high. Cook for 12 minutes, release pressure, and check internal temperature. You can cover, bring pressure back up, and cook for 2-3 minutes longer if necessary.
notes: Boneless, skinless chicken breasts are popular because they are quick and easy, with low fat. When not cooked properly, they can be dry, tough, and stringy. Keep a supply of cooked chicken meat on hand which can be used for many recipes. Chicken needs to be thoroughly cooked, whereas steaks can be served rare or medium rare. Chicken is less dense than beef, which allows bacteria to travel throughout the muscle. The way a chicken is processed spreads bacteria. The removal of the feathers forces bacteria into the crevices and into the meat. Therefore, cook the chicken to a safe internal temperature and your food will always be safe. Chicken should be cooked to a temperature of 165ºF. for 5.2 seconds to kill pathogens. Remember that the meat will continue to cook after it's removed from the heat; the internal temperature will rise about 5-10 degrees in the first few minutes it's off the heat. If you have young children, elderly persons, or those with a compromised immune system in your household, choose a higher temperature. Cool the meat very quickly, preferably in a container placed in an ice water bath. Keep the cooked chicken in the refrigerator no longer than 3-4 days. There are two basic methods for cooking: dry heat and moist heat . Dry heat methods include baking, roasting, grilling, sautéing, and deep frying. Moist heat methods include microwaving, poaching, baking in parchment, steaming, and slow cooking. The rule is when cooking chicken breasts with dry heat, use high heat and cook for a short period of time. When using moist heat, use low heat and cook for a longer period of time. That doesn't mean hours. Grilled chicken breasts cook in 8-10 minutes, while poached breasts cook in about 15 minutes. Tip: When cooking with dry heat, pound chicken breasts to an even thickness so they will cook evenly. Chicken breasts have little connective tissue; that means they can be cooked quickly because the long cooking time needed to soften connective tissue isn't necessary. They also have little fat, which means they can become dry if cooked too long. One way to ensure juicy, moist chicken is to brine it before cooking. To brine chicken, place thawed chicken breasts in a solution of salt and water for about 1 hour in the refrigerator. The cells will absorb water through osmosis. Buy a reliable meat thermometer and follow the instructions carefully to make moist, tender, juicy boneless, skinless chicken breasts. title: Baked Bbrrrr Chicken Breasts
instructions: Step 1: Brine: Brining chicken is super easy, it makes your chicken extra juicy, and best of all, it can be effectively done in just 15 minutes. Plus, if you brine chicken in lukewarm water, it also helps bring the chicken to room temperature, which makes for more even cooking. To brine chicken, simply fill a big bowl with lukewarm (not hot) water. Stir in a handful of salt until it mostly dissolves. Then add your chicken breasts and let them sit in the saltwater to brine for at least 15 minutes. If you are doing this in advance, you can cover and refrigerate the bowl of chicken and saltwater for up to 6 hours, but you don’t want to let the chicken brine for much longer than that. Remove the chicken from the brine. Give it a good rinse with cold water to wash off the salt and then pat it dry with some paper towels.

Step 2: Brush: Brush your chicken breasts with melted butter or olive oil. It adds great flavour and helps give a nice golden crust on the outside. Brush the breasts liberally on both sides to prevent the chicken from sticking to the pan and also to help the seasonings stick. Then place the chicken breasts in a parchment covered pan.

Step 3: Rub: If you really want to keep things simple, simply sprinkle some salt, pepper, garlic powder and paprika onto the chicken breasts. Chicken will pick up flavour of whatever seasonings you add.
Step 4: Roast: Bake it low and slow for 30 minutes at 350°F or roast chicken high and quick as in, 15 minutes at 450°F.

ROASTING AT 450°F. for 15 minutes is best.: Roasting chicken breasts on high heat makes a nice crispier “crust” on the outside of the breasts, which also helps to lock in the juices and keep the oven roasted chicken perfectly tender on the inside. Depending on the thickness of your chicken breasts, roasting chicken at 450°F should require a cooking time of about 15-18 minutes (depending on the thickness/size of your chicken breasts). Use an instant read cooking thermometer to ensure the chicken is 170°F.

Step 5: Rest: Let the baked chicken breasts rest before cutting into them — a tip which applies to cooking any meat. If you cut into right away, you will lose all of the amazing juices and some of the tenderness. If you give the freshly baked chicken breasts a brief rest it will finish cooking and lock in all of those delicious juices resulting in a tender, juicy and delicious baked chicken. Loosely tent a sheet of aluminum foil over the pan to keep the heat in while the chicken rests. After 5-10 minutes, you serve and enjoy. your perfectly- cooked chicken breasts.
notes: To make perfectly baked chicken bbrrreasts, you simply need to follow this 5- step acronym: B.B.R.R.R.

instructions: Brown chicken in a deep skillet with seasonings. Add celery or parsley
Mix soup with ½ can of water. Pour over chicken
Simmer for 30 minutes
Serve with rice or alternative. Quick, delicious and foolproof
notes: Sandy V.

title: Puntillo Special Stuffed Chicken Breast
instructions: Combine all ingredients together in food processor.
Split each chicken breast half way through center.
Stuff ingredients into each chicken breast.
Dip each breast into egg mixture then into breadcrumbs.
Sauté them for 2 minutes on each side.
Finish cooking them in a 450ºF in oven for 20 minutes.
notes: Franca P.

title: Spinach Stuffed Chicken Breasts

ingredients.rawText: (1 ¾ to 2 lbs, even sized pieces)
ingredients.normalizedName: (1 ¾ to 2 lbs, even sized pieces)

instructions: Preheat oven to 450˚F with a rack in the centre.
Defrost and drain frozen spinach
Mix drained spinach, shredded mozzarella, salt, parsley and Parmesan cheese in a mixing bowl until combined.
Lay ham slices on a plate and place 2 tablespoons of mixture at one end and roll up.

Lay chicken on a flat surface and cut slit 3/4 of the way through without cutting all the way through. Stuff each chicken breast with rolled, stuffed ham slices and seal horizontally with a toothpick (make sure the chicken breast can lay flat on the sides for searing.
Heat 1 1/2 tbsps olive oil in an ovenproof pan over medium heat.
Place stuffed chicken breasts in hot oil and turn to coat other side.
Place pan in oven. Bake for 5 minutes, turn breasts and bake another 5 minutes.
Pour chicken broth over breasts and cover pan with aluminium foil.
Turn heat down to 375 F
Return pan to oven and bake chicken breasts ½ hour.
Remove foil and allow broth to evaporate in oven.
Check breasts with thermometer. Cool and serve.

title: Baked Chicken Drumsticks
instructions: Put marinade in bowl, stir and coat drumsticks.
Put coated drumsticks into zip lock bag. Remove any air from the plastic bag. Massage the marinade into the chicken for a few seconds to coat.
Leave in fridge for 2-12 hours massaging and turning bag 2 or 3 times
Heat oven to 425°F.
Place drumsticks on parchment covered pan
Bake for 25 minutes, flip drumsticks and bake another 15 minutes. This ensures drumsticks will have a nice caramelized colour on both sides.

title: Chicken Drumsticks & Thighs

ingredients.rawText: 2 tbsp butter, optional for a crispy skin

instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 ° F.
In a bowl combine: olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, pepper, turmeric, oregano, thyme, cayenne and only ½ teaspoon sweet paprika.
Place the chicken in an oven-safe dish like casserole or cast-iron skillet;
Pour the mixture over the chicken and rub it on both sides; (This can be done a night before and kept refrigerated before cooking);
Place the chicken skin side up and sprinkle with the remaining 1/2 teaspoon of sweet paprika (for more intense color); Transfer the casserole to the hot oven.
Roast the chicken for 40-45 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 165 ° F.
After about 20 minutes of roasting you can add a little pat of butter on each piece of chicken for crispier skin. It is optional step and can be omitted;
Once the chicken reaches 165 °F. remove from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.

title: Chicken Thighs, Vegetables & Rice Bake

ingredients.rawText: Tip: Can be used with bone in thighs, but remove the skin as, it will get oily
ingredients.normalizedName: tip be used with bone in thighs

instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºF. Spray pan with cooking spray.
Scatter rice on the bottom of the pan. Layer chicken on top.
Season the whole pan generously with salt and pepper.
Remember, this will be seasoning the whole dish, not just the chicken.
Scatter the carrots between the chicken pieces.
Scatter bits of the butter around the pan. (optional)
Pour the boiling hot stock on top gently.
Cook for 65 minutes (If chicken pieces are large increase cooking time).
Right when coming out of the oven, toss with frozen peas.
Let sit for 3-4 minutes. Enjoy

title: Chicken Thighs, Rice, Clams & Mussels

ingredients.rawText: 1/4 cup grated tomato, cut in half, grate and discard the skin

instructions: Heat stock and keep warm.
Heat olive oil in large frying pan, add chicken and fry until golden. Add garlic and onions and sauté until translucent.
Add the rice, stirring until well coated, about one minute. Add the paprika and grated tomato. Stir, adding wine and hot stock.
Bring to a boil scraping the bottom of the pan then add red and green pepper strips, artichoke hearts, and peas. Boil slowly for 5 minutes.
Add the shrimp, clams and mussels and cook another 15 minutes or until rice is done.
Sprinkle with chopped parsley and serve. Serves 6

title: Sautéed Chicken with Mushroom Sauce

ingredients.rawText: 2 lbs skinless chicken thighs or drumsticks

instructions: Sprinkle chicken evenly with paprika.
In large nonstick skillet, heat oil over medium/high heat; cook chicken until well browned all over about 5 minutes on each side.
Add onion and mushrooms; cook, stirring often, for 10 minutes or until onions are tender and mushroom liquid has evaporated.
Whisk flour into cold milk until well mixed; pour into pan and cook, stirring, until thickened slightly.
Reduce heat to medium/low heat and cook for 15 minutes longer or until juices run clear when chicken is pierced.
Season with salt and pepper.

title: Chinese Wings

ingredients.rawText: ½ tsp Chinese five spice powder

instructions: Cut the wing tips off of wings and discard
Cut each wing into two sections
In a shallow glass or ceramic bowl combine soy sauce, honey, garlic, sherry, ketchup, peanut butter, sugar and five-spice powder
Add chicken wings and marinate several hours or overnight turning occasionally
Remove wings from marinade (reserve marinade) and place in a single layer in a shallow baking dish.
Cook in a 325ºF oven for about 15 minutes. Cook wings an additional 15 minutes, basting with marinade and turn them over.
Cook 10-15 minutes more
Baste with remaining honey just before removing from oven

title: Chinese Chicken Wings
instructions: Wash and clean the wings.

Sauté garlic in a deep well oiled skillet or wok. When it's golden, add the ground ginger, and soy sauce, honey, cherry liquor, and finally the chicken wings. Turn heat very low, adjust salt as desired and cook for about 25 minutes, stirring often.
Serve the wings with their sauce with a bowl of steamed white rice.

title: Sesame Wings
instructions: Cut off the wing tips and discard. Cut each wing into two sections
Combine honey, mustard, butter, lemon juice, curry powder, garlic, oregano, salt and pepper and place in a glass bowl
Add chicken wings and toss gently in marinade. Set aside for 30 minutes
Toast sesame seeds by placing them in a shallow pan and baking 350ºF oven for 10-15 min. or until golden brown, shaking pan from time to time
Remove wings from marinade. Broil over charcoal or under broiler 5 minutes. Brush with marinade and turn wings over on both sides.
Continue basting and turning for another 10 minutes or until wings are cooked. Remove from pan and roll in sesame seeds. Serve immediately

title: Chicken Feet Spaghetti Sauce

ingredients.rawText: 6 chicken feet, boiled for 40-45 minutes then scrubbed to remove the skin
10 fresh tomatoes or jar of tomatoes, chopped

instructions: Heat a large frying pan and add the oil. Once hot, add the garlic and chili into pan.
Add the chicken feet, wine and 5 tablespoons water. Bring to a boil then add the tomatoes and cook for 5-10 minutes.
In the meantime heat a saucepan of boiling, salted water and cook the spaghetti according to the package instructions.
Toss the drained spaghetti in the sauce and garnish with parsley.

title: Chicken Cacciatore

ingredients.rawText: 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp black pepper, 1 tsp salt

instructions: Heat oil in large deep skillet and sauté chicken pieces with garlic for 10 minutes until golden.
Pour off excess fat and add wine, letting it simmer and reduce.
Add chopped onion, sliced peppers, mushrooms, canned tomatoes, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Cover tightly and simmer over medium-low heat for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Serve hot over polenta, pasta, or with crusty bread for dipping.
notes: Calabrese style 'Pollo in Umido' can also be baked in the oven with zucchini and eggplant (Dina M. variation).

title: Calabrese Baked Chicken Cacciatore
instructions: Wash chicken well and drain
Add abundance of fresh peppers (red, green, yellow garden peppers), zucchini and eggplant
Add oil, garlic, oregano, salt and stir together
Transfer to a baking dish and cover with aluminum foil
Place in preheated over at 350/400ºF depending on oven for half hour
Remove foil and bake for another 30-40 minutes
notes: Pollo in Umido Dina M.

title: Chicken Pollo Cacciatora

ingredients.rawText: Salt and pepper to taste (or crushed red pepper)

instructions: Put vinegar, wine, rosemary leaves, and garlic in a small bowl.

In a skillet put the extra-virgin olive oil and turn the heat to medium. When the oil is hot, add chicken and sauté until lightly browned. Add salt and pepper. Stir in the flour. Add the vinegar/wine mixture, turn heat to high and let the liquid evaporate. Turn heat to medium/low, cover and cook for about 30 - 35 minutes or until the chicken is tender. Stir occasionally to prevent the chicken from sticking to the pan.
If the meat is almost ready but there is too much liquid, remove the lid and let the liquid evaporate until the sauce is thicker.
When the chicken is ready, add the anchovies to the skillet, stirring vigorously for a few seconds until dissolved. Serve hot.

title: Chicken Paprika with Noodles
instructions: Shake chicken in plastic bag with flour, 1 tsp salt and pepper until coated. Reserve 2 tbsps flour mixture
Brown chicken in butter in large skillet. Remove chicken and reserve.
Pour off fat into measuring cup. Measure and return 3 tbsps to skillet
Add onion and sauté until golden. Add paprika, 1/2 tsp salt and chicken cube dissolved in boiling water.
Bring to a boil, lower heat, return chicken and turn to coat. Cook, covered 30 minutes or until chicken is tender. Remove chicken and keep warm
Stir in light cream.
Make paste of reserved 2 tbsps flour mixture and sour cream; slowly stir into skillet. Cook stirring constantly over low heat until thickened
Serve over hot, buttered noodles. Sprinkle with parsley. Serves 6

title: Chicken and Rice
instructions: In a large non-stick pot sauté one onion with two tablespoons of butter for two minutes on medium heat. Add chicken and cover pot with lid. Brown chicken on both sides and season with salt and pepper. Keep covered and cook for 10 to 15 minutes on medium heat. Add nutmeg, chili pepper and one cup of water. Continue to cook with lid for another 10 minutes.
In a smaller pan sauté one onion with remaining butter. Add cashews and sauté until golden brown. Remove from heat and set aside.

Add tomato sauce to chicken, cover and bring to a boil. Spoon sour cream into the chicken stirring gently, and reduce heat to low. Let chicken cook for another five minutes. If necessary, season with salt and pepper again. For a spicier taste, substitute chili pepper for jalapeno pepper.
In a large pan, add layer of rice, then chicken and remaining rice. Top with sautéed cashews and onions.
Cover pan with aluminum foil and bake in oven for eight minutes in a 350ºF oven. Mix well before serving.
notes: Nick and Linda Vitale. Serves 4 people Preparation time: 35 minutes.

title: Chicken Meatballs
instructions: Combine all spices. Add ground chicken and mix lightly.
Shape into little balls. Place in foil pan and freeze or cook fresh with your favourite tomato sauce.

title: Chicken Gizzard Stew

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb. cleaned chicken gizzards [0.9 kg] 1½ tbsp salt (or to taste)
1 small red onion cut into slices
1½ tsp oregano dry, ground, plus a pinch

instructions: Add the gizzards and 1 quart of water to a large pot. Add a tablespoon of salt, 1 teaspoon of black pepper, 1 teaspoon of oregano, and the bay leaf,

Boil until the gizzards become very tender, which can be 60-90 minutes, add water if it becomes necessary to prevent it from drying out. A pressure cooker or Instant pot speeds up this step to about 20 - 30 minutes.
Drain water to separate gizzards from the water (set both aside). Discard the bay leaf.
In a large skillet or Dutch oven, heat the oil over medium heat. Add the chicken gizzards and cook and stir until any liquid left has evaporated and there's only meat and oil left in the pan.
Stir in bell pepper, onion, and garlic. Cook stirring until the onions become translucent.
Stir in tomatoes, olives, and half a teaspoon of oregano. Add the tomato sauce and a cup of the liquid from boiling the gizzards.
Cover with the lid, and simmer until the liquid has reduced to half (about 7 minutes).
The vegetables will be tender, and the sauce should be a bit thick.
Season with salt and pepper to taste. Add fresh cilantro, remove from the stove and serve.

title: Italian Chicken Gizzard & Heart Stew

ingredients.rawText: 5 or 6 oz chicken gizzards & hearts, cleaned and trimmed

instructions: Place gizzards, half of the onion, and lightly salted water to cover in medium saucepan, Cover, bring to boil, and reduce to a soft simmer.
Cook for 1 hour, checking to ensure enough water remains. After an hour, pour through a strainer, discarding the onion and stewing liquid.
Slice the remaining onion portion and roughly chop the stewed meat.
In same pan, heat oil and butter over medium high heat. Return gizzards to pan, along with sliced onion, and sauté until onion is soft and translucent.

5. Add tomato and sauté for a minute before adding peas, cloves, and a few tbsp of water to the pan. Season with salt and pepper, cover, and cook about 5 minutes or until peas are done. Serve immediately.

title: Tuscan Duck A L’ Orange Anatra All’arancia

ingredients.rawText: 4 oz (115 gr) prosciutto, finely chopped 2 + 1 oz (60 + 30 gr) butter
1 lemon, juiced, rind very finely diced
2 oranges, juiced, rind very finely diced 1 duck, cleaned and flamed
2 tbsp Grand Marnier, or other orange brandy

instructions: In a bowl combine prosciutto, orange rind, 2 oz butter, nutmeg, salt, and pepper. Spread the mixture inside the duck.
Close the opening of the duck with kitchen rope. Season the duck rubbing the outside with salt and pepper.
Put the 1 oz (30 gr) of butter in a large skillet over low heat. As soon as the butter starts foaming, add the duck and brown evenly on all sides.
Turn heat to medium/high, add the wine and let evaporate.
Add juice & orange rind, lemon juice and rind, salt, and pepper. Cover and cook on low heat for about 90 minutes or until the duck is tender. Turn the duck once to cook it evenly on all sides.
Add a small quantity of broth if necessary to prevent duck from sticking to pan. Remove duck from skillet, transfer to serving plate, keep warm.
Lower heat and add orange liqueur to skillet. Stir with wooden spoon, scraping cooking residues from walls and bottom of skillet. Filter the sauce through a fine strainer.
Decorate the duck with orange slices, cover with sauce, serve warm.

title: Holiday Turkey with Herb Stuffing
instructions: To make the stuffing, in a medium frying pan sauté onion in butter or margarine until soft. Stir in celery, chicken broth, poultry seasoning, salt, pepper and water. Bring to a boil and pour over bread and parsley in a large bowl. Toss lightly until mixed well. Set aside
Place turkey in roasting pan breast side up. Brush skin and cavity with oil or melted margarine. Season skin with garlic, onions, basil or parsley.
Spoon prepared stuffing into body cavity. Let stuffing sit loosely inside. Packing will not allow for even cooking.

Cover bird with a loose tent of aluminum foil. Cooking time will vary depending on weight of turkey. The general rule is 15-20 minutes per pound at 325°F. or 3 ¾-4 hours for a 12-16 lb bird. Serves 6-8

title: Traditional Turkey

ingredients.rawText: 14 to 16 lb fresh or frozen turkey
1/2 lb good quality fresh sausage meat

instructions: Sausage Meat Stuffing: If turkey is frozen, allow to thaw completely in refrigerator.

To make stuffing; cook onion in 2 tbsps butter or margarine until completely softened. Add the garlic and sage; cook for a further 5 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add remaining ingredients; mix well.
Pre-heat oven to 450°F.

Stuff turkey with prepared stuffing. Place bird on rack in roasting pan. Cover with foil. Place in oven, reduce heat to 350°F. and cook for 25 min./ pound; basting frequently. Remove foil for last hour so turkey browns.

Doneness: (To test for doneness, insert a sharp thin bladed knife into the thickest part of the turkey just under leg point, if juices run clear, turkey is cooked. If juices are still pink continue to cook testing every 15-20 mins.

Let the turkey stand covered with foil on the carving board for 20 minutes before carving. (This standing time makes for easier carving.) stored in the refrigerator. The leftover stuffing should be removed from the turkey, wrapped up well and stored separately in the refrigerator.
notes: Tip: Leftover turkey should be removed off the bone, wrapped up well and

title: Turkey Breast with Dry Fruit
instructions: Butterfly the turkey breast cutting almost all the way through.
Open flat and flatten slightly by pounding with a meat pounder.
Rub on the surface of the meat the paprika, ground cloves, salt, and black pepper. Place in a dish and set aside in the refrigerator.
In a small saucepan combine the wine, 1/3 cup apricot, 1/3 cup pear, and 3 tablespoons raisins. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until the fruit is tender.
Remove from heat. With a slotted spoon remove the fruit from the saucepan and reserve the wine.
Spread the fruit evenly on the turkey breast, roll up enclosing into a spiral shape and tie with kitchen string. Season with salt and black pepper.
In a sauté pan over medium heat put butter and extra-virgin olive oil. When the butter starts foaming, add the turkey breast and brown on all sides uniformly.
Turn heat to high, add the reserved wine and let the wine evaporate.

Turn heat to medium/low; add the broth, 1/3 cup whole apricot, 1/3 cup halved pear, 3 tablespoons raisins, chestnuts, walnuts, cloves, and bay leaves. Simmer for about 45 minutes to one hour until the turkey is thoroughly cooked turning the meat occasionally. Add a small quantity of broth if the sauce is too dry.
Remove the turkey breast from the pan and set aside to cool at room temperature.
Discard bay leave and clove, remove dry fruit from the pan.
Turn the heat to medium/low. Dissolve the cornstarch in a few tablespoons of water. Add the cornstarch to the pan and stir to dissolve, until the sauce is thicker.
Remove the string, slice the turkey breast when it is lukewarm and serve it accompanied by the warm sauce and fruit.

title: Turkey Chili

ingredients.rawText: 3 tbsp chili powder or to taste
1 can of kidney beans, drained and rinsed
1 can of black beans, drained and rinsed
¼ tsp cayenne pepper or to taste

instructions: In a large saucepan, heat oil over medium heat.
Add celery, onions, mushrooms and garlic.
Cook for 3-4 minutes or until golden and fragrant stirring occasionally
Add turkey; sauté until cooked through
Add tomatoes, kidney and black beans, chili powder, cumin and cayenne pepper.
Cover and simmer for 20 minutes. Serve warm.
notes: Georgina V.

title: Baked Turkey Gizzards
instructions: Carefully cut each of the gizzards in half lengthwise. Wash the gizzards thoroughly under cold water. Use your fingers to loosen and rinse away any debris or sediment. Peel away and trim the yellow lining from the gizzards and throw it away.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil and place the gizzards in it. Let them cook for one minute to get rid of any impurities.
Drain the gizzards and rinse under cold water
Place the turkey gizzards in an aluminum tray and add 2.5 cups of water. Then, add salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and cumin to taste.
Cover the tray well with aluminum foil. Make it as tight as you can.
Cook in the oven for 3.5 hours at 350ºF. (180°C,) Done!
notes: Optional : Fry the gizzards on a hot pan with butter for a few minutes.

title: Turkey Gizzard Stew

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 teaspoon thyme, or herbs of your choice such as oregano, marjoram, etc.

instructions: Tip: * chicken, turkey, goose or duck gizzards for this recipe.

Wash and trim the gizzards. Carefully cut each gizzard in half lengthwise. Wash the gizzards thoroughly under cold water. Use your fingers to loosen and rinse away any debris or sediment. Peel away and trim the yellow lining from the gizzards and throw it away.

Season and rest the gizzards . Sprinkle 1 teaspoon (6 g) of salt and 1 teaspoon (3 g) of black pepper over the prepared gizzards. Let the gizzards rest for 10 minutes at room temperature to absorb the seasonings
The gizzards may be prepared in advance and refrigerated overnight. There's no need to bring them to room temperature because they've been absorbing the seasonings as they've chilled.

Simmer the gizzards for 30 minutes . Put the seasoned gizzards into a 3- quart (2.8 liter) saucepan. Pour in 2 cups (473 ml) of water and turn the heat to high. Once the water starts boiling, turn the heat down to medium so the water bubbles gently. Put the lid on the pot and simmer the gizzards for 30 minutes.

Add the chopped onion, celery and carrots with the seasonings along with 1 tablespoon (15 g) of ketchup and 1 teaspoon (6 g) of hot sauce and simmer the mixture for 1 more hour. Keep the lid off the pot and let the mixture cook for 1 hour.

Stir the stewed gizzards every once in a while to ensure that everything cooks evenly. Keep an eye on the level of the liquid in the pot. If you'd like a thicker stew, let it reduce as it cooks. For a thinner stew, pour in more water as the gizzards simmer.
Serve the stewed gizzards. Serve the gizzards once they're completely soft and tender. Taste the gizzards and add more salt according to your taste.
Serve the gizzards over steamed rice or with flatbread.
Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for several days.

title: Seafood Marinades

ingredients.rawText: 2 tsp onion, chopped or parsley, minced

instructions: Wine Marinade : ¼ cup dry white wine ¼ cup oil 1 lemon thinly sliced 1 tbsp minced parsley Italian Marinade: 1 cup Italian salad dressing 1 tbsp lemon juice ¼ tsp salt
notes: Let fish marinate up to an hour in one of these tasty marinades before baking, broiling or grilling. Use remaining marinade to brush on fish during cooking. Lemon Marinade :

title: Baked Mixed Seafood

ingredients.rawText: Lemon juice, freshly squeezed White wine or brandy

instructions: Mix above ingredients well and bake for approximately 1/2 hour.

title: Baked Fish with Cream of Mushroom

ingredients.rawText: 1 can concentrated cream of mushroom soup

instructions: Wash fillets. Grease pan with some of the oil and place fillets in pan
Drizzle the remaining olive oil on fillets and add salt and pepper
Sprinkle breadcrumbs and spread the cream of mushroom soup on it.
Bake at 350ºF until flaky
Broil for about 5 minutes until browned

title: Barbecued Fish
instructions: For Barbecue : Let steaks marinate in ingredients above for 1 hour before barbecuing.
For Baking : Let steaks marinate for 1 hour and bake at 375ºF approximately 1/2 hour
notes: Use: Swordfish steaks, salmon steaks, halibut steaks, shark steaks, kingfish steaks, grouper steaks, tilefish steaks, tuna steaks, marlin steaks

title: Broiled Fish
instructions: Place on top oven rack, 4 to 5 inches from heat
Arrange fish on well greased baking dish
Mix butter, salt, parsley & lemon juice
Brush fish with butter mixture
Broil fish, keep brushing fish with mixture and then turn

title: Fried Fish Battered
instructions: Batter: Stir flour, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Gradually add water stirring until smooth. If batter is thick, add a bit more water.
Peel and devein shrimps.
Clean squid and cut into rings. Make sure the cartilage and eyes are removed. Cut fillets into pieces
Heat oil. Dip fish into batter.
Deep fry a few pieces at a time until golden brown.

title: Fried Fish Breadcrumbs
instructions: Mix eggs and put over fish
Mix together breadcrumbs and flour
Dip fish covered with egg into flour and then breadcrumbs
Put the breaded fish in deep frying pan (oil must be very hot before adding fish)
Fry until you see golden colour
notes: Shrimps, scallops, squid or fillets (sole, orange ruffy, turbot, cod)

title: Microwaved Fish
instructions: Arrange 4 fish fillets or steaks on a microwave-proof platter
Mix 2 tbsps of butter, 2 tsps lemon juice, salt to taste and other herbs
Brush mixture over fish
Cover fish with plastic wrap
Microwave on high setting for 5 minutes
Microwave at 1 minute intervals until fish is flaky

title: Bacalhau à Rosa (Salt Cod)

ingredients.rawText: 1.5 lbs salt cod, soaked in cold water 48 hrs with frequent changes
Fresh parsley and freshly ground black pepper

instructions: Drain thoroughly desalted cod and cut into portioned pieces.
Parboil sliced potatoes for 6 minutes; drain.
In a large baking dish, layer sliced onions, potatoes, and cod pieces.
Scatter black and green olives, drizzle generously with extra virgin olive oil and season with pepper.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 40-45 minutes until potatoes are golden and tender.
Garnish with chopped fresh flat-leaf parsley and serve hot.
notes: Rosa's festive salt cod specialty, savory and rich with olive oil.
originalPhotoCaption: Bacalhau à Rosa baked with golden potatoes, onions, and black olives

title: Baccala’ alla Romana

ingredients.rawText: 1 1/2 lb (600 gr) dry salt cod, soak in water overnight

instructions: Place the salt cod in a container to soak in water overnight, or as long as it's necessary to become tender, changing water occasionally. Eliminate the skin and eventual bones and cut the fish into large pieces.
In a saucepan, put oil and turn heat to medium. Add onion, red pepper, and sauté until onion will become soft. Eventually add 1-2 tablespoons of water if necessary.
Add tomato and cook stirring for about 10 minutes.
Add cod pieces and raisins. Distribute tomato evenly on the cod fish.
Cover and cook for about 10 minutes stirring occasionally, until the cod will be tender. Adjust salt after the cod is cooked and only if necessary.

title: Baccala alla Rosina
instructions: Buy salted deboned baccala.
Cut baccala into serving pieces and wash off salt.
Put baccala in a large covered bowl filled with cold water for a few days to get rid of most of the salt.

In the morning and night drain the baccala and wash well. Refill the bowl with water and return baccala to water. The cantina (wine cellar) is a good place to keep the soaking baccala but the kitchen counter will do just as well.
When ready to cook, wash out and flour baccala.
Put floured baccala in hot oil until crispy and golden brown.
Turn baccala over and cook other side.
The baccala is ready to eat as is or may be added to cooked sauce so it picks up the flavour of baccala. Do not overcook the baccala too long in the sauce or it will come apart.

title: Baccala Nfld Fish & Brew
instructions: Drawn Butter Ingredients: Break each bread into 2 or 3 pieces and soak for 6-8 hours overnight in cold water. Use lots of water, as it will be absorbed.
Soak salt cod in separate bowl of cold water for 6-8 hours or overnight. Change water once or twice if you prefer less salty.
If using fresh cod, add 1 tsp salted water when cooking.
In the morning, change water on cod and simmer gently until tender 5- 10 minutes. Remove from heat and drain.
Skin, bone and flake cod.
Place hard bread in saucepan with enough water to cover bread using the water in which it is soaked. Heat slowly just until it comes to a boil. Remove from the heat and drain immediately.
Add cooked flaked cod and mix. Keep hot.

Fry salt pork until golden brown and crisp. These scrunchions (pork rinds) and fat may be poured over fish and bread mixture when served or mixed in it. Serve hot. Drawn butter may be used instead of scrunchions (pork rind)
Melt butter in saucepan; add chopped onions and fry gently until lightly golden and soft about 10 minutes. Do not brown.

Sprinkle flour over onions and mix in thoroughly. Remove from heat. Gradually, while stirring add half of the water. Place back on heat and bring to a boil, stirring constantly. Beat until shiny and smooth. Slowly add remaining water or until desired consistency is reached. Cook over low heat 2-3 minutes.
Serve over fish.
notes: Georgina V.

title: Baccala with Potatoes

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb baccala (cod) soaked cut in pieces 1/4 cup oil

instructions: Sauté garlic and onion.
Add bay leaf, potatoes and water.
Cook potatoes until tender and if necessary add water
Add baccala, green pepper and olives. Cook until baccala is tender and flaky

title: Calamari, Breaded and Fried
instructions: Clean squid and cut into rings. Pat dry squid with paper towel
Beat egg with milk in a small bowl. Add squid and stir to cover well
Remove a few squid from egg mixture, place in a single layer on bread- crumbs
Repeat process to coat all squid
Let stand 10 to 15 minutes before frying
Heat vegetable oil. Fry until golden

title: Crustaceans Stew (Guazzetto Di Crostacei

ingredients.rawText: 1 small bunch Italian parsley, chopped pinch of crushed red pepper
1/2 lb (200 gr) fresh ripe tomato, peeled, seeded, and chopped
2 lb (900 gr) mixed crustacean and mollusc (crab legs, shrimps, scallops,

instructions: In a large sauté pan, put olive oil and garlic. Turn heat to medium.
Add crushed red pepper. Sauté briefly.
Do not allow the garlic to colour. Add tomato.
Stir in the chopped parsley. Cook shortly for about 2 minutes.
Add the crustaceans.
Stir to blend and cook covered for not longer then 10 minutes.
Serve warm, pouring over the toasted bread slices.

title: Fish Stew, Tomato, Parsley & Lemon

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb (500 gr) very ripe cherry tomatoes, chopped
2 lb (900 gr) white fish, orange roughy, bass or cod

instructions: Place the olive oil and garlic in a skillet large enough to receive the fish, on medium heat. As soon as the garlic starts colouring remove the garlic and let the oil cool.
Add water to the pan about 1/2 inch (1 cm) deep.
Add the some of the parsley, the lemon and the tomatoes.
Add the fish slices, top with the rest of the parsley. Season the fish lightly with salt.
Place the skillet back on the stove on medium heat and bring the water to a boil.
Cook for about 10 -15 minutes, turning the fish to cook on the both sides. Make sure the fish is only half covered by the water.
Adjust salt and add pepper if necessary. Serve warm.

title: Fried Breaded Calamari
instructions: Heat the oil in a pan or deep fryer to 180°C. or 350°F. If you are using a saucepan take care not to fill it more than a third full.
Sprinkle the squid with salt and a pinch of smoked paprika.
Dip them into the flour, followed by the egg and finally into the bread- crumbs.
Batch fry the squid in two batches in either a large saucepan or a wok.
Each batch should take 2 minutes to brown and cook through.
Remove from the pan and drain on kitchen paper before serving.
Air Fryer Instructions: Prepare the calamari in the same way as outlined above and then spray them with cooking spray.
Preheat the air fryer to 200°C or 400°F and cook for 9-12 minutes depending on the thickness of the squid rings.
Flip half way through the cooking time and spray with more cooking oil.

title: Fried Floured Calamari

ingredients.rawText: 1 lemon, cut into wedges to serve

instructions: Slice the calamari tubes into ¾-inch thick rings.
In a medium bowl, stir 1 teaspoon kosher salt in ½ cup milk.
Add the calamari rings to the milk mixture and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, oregano, black pepper, and cayenne (make sure the mixture is well combined).

Prepare a large colander and set it on top of a large bowl. Using a pair of tongs, take a portion of the calamari rings (about ½ of them) shake off excess milk and toss the calamari in the flour mixture. Toss the calamari to coat evenly. Put the coated calamari in the colander. Repeat with the rest of the calamari.
Turn your oven on a low 150ºF. Prepare a large sheet pan and set a wire rack on top. Top the wire rack with paper towel.

Heat 4 inches of grape seed oil in a small cooking pot (I used a 2.5 quart pot) to somewhere between 350 and 365ºF. To test your oil, drop one calamari ring, many bubbles will form around it and the calamari will begin to float.

Once your oil is ready, using a pair of tongs, gently add some of the calamari in and fry for about 3 minutes or until golden brown. Remove the calamari from the oil and arrange it on the paper towel on top of your prepared wire rack. Immediately season with kosher salt then transfer to your warm oven to keep warm while you work on the rest. Repeat until you have fried all the calamari.

Transfer the fried calamari to a serving plate and finish with a squeeze of lemon juice! Notes :  Don't skip soaking the calamari in the salted milk. This helps tenderize the calamari while also taming the fishy taste  Serve fried calamari hot with a side of marinara sauce or Tzatziki sauce.  To make this in the air fryer: Arrange the calamari in one single layer in your air fryer basket (you may do this in batches if you need to). Coat the calamari with cooking spray. Cook at 400°F. for 8 minutes or until the calamari turns golden and is cooked through  Leftovers & storage: leftovers will last in the fridge for up to 3 days. The calamari will lose its crunch, but will still taste good. Do not reheat leftover fried calamari

title: Fish Stew with Tomato, Parsley & Lemon

ingredients.rawText: 2 lb (900 g) white fish fillets (cod, haddock, bass, or orange roughy)

instructions: Place olive oil and garlic in a wide skillet over medium heat. When fragrant, remove garlic and let oil cool slightly.
Add water to pan about 1/2 inch (1 cm) deep.
Add half the parsley, lemon slices, and cherry tomatoes.
Place fish fillets in pan, top with remaining parsley, and season lightly with salt.
Bring water to a boil over medium heat. Cook 10-15 minutes, turning fish gently so both sides cook in the 'crazy water' broth.
Serve warm with crusty Italian bread to sop up the delicate poaching juices.
notes: 'Acqua Pazza' (crazy water) is an ancient Neapolitan fisherman's poaching method that keeps white fish extraordinarily moist.

title: Steamed Clams
instructions: Place all ingredients except clams in a deep pan. Sauté at medium heat
Wash clams well, add them to the deep pan and cook until clams open

title: Crab Cakes with Tomato Salsa

ingredients.rawText: 3 1/4 cups fresh breadcrumbs from crustless French bread

instructions: Mix first 9 ingredients in large bowl. Season with salt and pepper.
Mix in 1/4 cup breadcrumbs and egg.
Shape crab mixture into eight 2 1/2-inch-diameter patties, using scant 1/2 cup mixture for each. (Can be made 6 hours ahead. Cover; chill.)
Place 3 cups breadcrumbs in shallow dish. Coat crab cakes in breadcrumbs, pressing to adhere.
Melt 1 tbsp butter and 1 tbsp oil in heavy large skillet over medium heat. Add 4 crab cakes and cook until golden brown, about 4 minutes per side.
Repeat with remaining butter, oil and crab cakes.
Divide among 4 plates.
Serve with salsa Serves 8

title: King Crab Legs Marinated in Rum

ingredients.rawText: 8 frozen king crab legs, thawed and split in two

instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºF
Place crab legs in pan and pour in rum and marinate 5 to 6 minutes
Mix butter and remaining ingredients together and set aside
Drain crab legs from rum and spread butter mixture over crab
Place in oven and cook 5 to 6 minutes

title: Baked Lobster Tails
instructions: Piggyback Lobster Tails :

Cut the upper shell down the center of the back with scissors leaving the tail fan intact. Give the tail a good rinse and remove any intestinal vein and goop. Do not remove under-shell. Run fingers between the meat and the shell to loosen from each other. Lift uncooked tail through the slit to rest on top of the shell (you can put a little butter under tail too!)
Preheat oven to 350ºF.
Place prepared lobster tails on a baking sheet, Brush each tail with melted butter
Bake approximately 15 to 18 minutes (depending on tail weight) or until an instant-read thermometer registers an internal temperature of 140ºF. Do not overcook.
Remove from oven and serve with melted butter and lemon wedges.

How Long to Bake Lobster Tails: L: 6-7 oz. lobster tails: Bake for about 10-12 minutes. XL: 8-10 oz. lobster tails: Bake for about 12-15 minutes XXL: 16-20 oz. lobster tails: Bake for about 15-18 minutes XXXL: 20-24 oz. lobster tails: Bake for about 18-20 minutes

title: Baked or Broiled Lobster Tails
instructions: When lobster tail has defrosted, split the shell on the back side of tail and boil 3 - 6 oz size boil for 3 minutes 7 - 12 oz size boil for 5 minutes 20 - 24 oz size boil for 10 minutes
After boiling put lobster tails in tray with split side of tail facing upwards
Use: Allow tails to marinate in ingredients listed above for 1/2 hour
Broil lobster tails for 5 minutes no matter what size
When lobster tail has defrosted, split the shell on the back side of the tail
Use same ingredients used for broiling (no need to marinate)
Put tails in oven at 375ºF
notes: Baked Lobster Tails :

title: Baked Lobster Tails & Broccoli
instructions: Using a clean pair of scissors or kitchen shears, cut along the middle of the top of the shell towards the fins of the tail, making sure to cut in a straight line. Do not cut through the end of the tail.
Using a spoon, separate the meat from the two sides of the shell, then lift the meat up and out from inside the shell.
Press the two sides of the shell together then lay the meat over the seam where the two shells meet.

If you are having difficulty opening the shell up to lift out the meat, flip the tail over and make cuts along the carapace where the legs meet the bottom part of the tail. This will help break the rigid structure of the shell and allow it to be more flexible.
While cutting through the shell, you may have also cut into the meat, which is perfectly okay.
Make a shallow cut through the middle of the lobster meat so that you can peel down the thin layer of meat over the sides. This gives the lobster tail its signature look.
Preheat oven to 450°F (230°C).
In small bowl, combine butter, salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, lemon juice, and parsley. Then brush mixture evenly over lobster meat.
Place the tails onto a baking sheet.
Bake for approximately 12-15 minutes, until the lobster is fully cooked but not rubbery. Serve with a side of broccoli and a lemon wedge. Enjoy! Serves 2

title: Boiled Lobster
instructions: Bring a lot of water to a boil
Place the lobsters in the water.
Cover pan, cook 14 to 18 minutes depending on size
When cooked, remove from the water and let cool.
Cut lobster in half.
Clean inside of lobster by removing small intestinal sack
Crack claws.
Remove meat from tail.

title: Broiled Rock Lobster Tails
instructions: Prepare seasonings for basting: Place frozen lobster tails in covered bowl in fridge for 24 hours to defrost.
Scrub clean and cut shell and some of then flesh down the centre.
Loosen flesh and gently spread shell open.
Sprinkle tails with salt and fish spice.
Preheat grill to HIGH.
Place tails on broiling pan upside down for ½ of the cooking time.
Turn tails over and baste during rest of cooking time.
Cooking time is just over 1 minute per ounce of tail size.
notes: Margaret V.

title: Broiled Lobster
instructions: Place boiled lobster on ovenproof serving dish, set aside
Mix ingredients together in bowl.
Spread mixture over lobster flesh.
Broil 8 minutes on top rack in oven. 7 - 12 oz size bake for 45 - 50 minutes 20 - 24 oz size bake for 55 - 60 minutes
notes: 3 - 6 oz size bake for 30 - 35 minutes

title: Mussels Marinara

ingredients.rawText: 1 tsp basil, 1 tsp oregano, 1 bay leaf

instructions: In a deep pot, sauté onions and garlic in olive oil until soft.
Add tomato paste, red wine, chopped plum tomatoes, basil, oregano, bay leaf, salt, and pepper.
Simmer sauce for 15 to 20 minutes on medium heat until rich.
Add cleaned mussels to the boiling sauce. Cover with lid and cook for 5-7 minutes until shells open.
Discard any unopened mussels. Serve immediately with warm crusty bread.
notes: A Christmas Eve Feast of the Seven Fishes essential.

title: Italian Style Mussels in Tomatoe Sauce
instructions: Place cleaned mussels and water in a large pan
Add parsley, 1 garlic clove, 2 tbsps butter and crushed chilies.
Sprinkle in pepper and lemon juice, cover and bring to a boil
Remove mussels and set aside

Heat remaining butter in frying pan. When hot, add remaining garlic and cook 2 minutes over medium heat. Add wine and cook 2 minutes over high heat. Mix in tomatoes and season with pepper, cook for 1 minute.
Add oregano and finish cooking 7 to 8 minutes over high heat, stir occasionally.
Place mussels in tomato mixture. Cook 2 minutes and serve

title: Mussels M & M
instructions: Wash mussels and put into pot with boiling water & steam for 10 min.
Remove only mussels that are open (good ones). Shell by halving the mussels showing; discard the other mussels that do not open.
Pour sauce into saucepan; add 1½ tbsp flour to thicken.
Pour thickened sauce over mussels and serve.

title: Baked Salmon
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Cover baking pan with parchment paper.
Combine salt, pepper, olive oil, wine, soya sauce, and balsamic vinegar and mix well.
Place salmon on pan and brush mixture on salmon. Bake 15 minutes
Brush seasonings on salmon once again. Bake another 15 minutes.

title: Grilled Salmon

ingredients.rawText: Salt and ground black pepper to taste

instructions: Prepare grill for high heat.
Season the salmon fillets with salt and pepper and drizzle with olive oil.
Whisk together the mayonnaise, mustard, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, tarragon, salt and pepper; set aside.
Lightly oil the grill grate. Cook the salmon on the grill until the fish flakes easily with a fork, 5 to 10 minutes. Place on a serving plate and top with the prepared sauce.

title: Salmon & Peppers

ingredients.rawText: 2 cups sweet yellow, red, or green peppers, cut into 1” squares

instructions: Remove skin and bones from salmon; cut into 1” square pieces.
Place salmon into plastic bag & marinate with olive oil, garlic powder, and dried parsley.
Preheat oven at 400°F.
In a casserole dish, put salmon pieces and add peppers, red wine vinegar, salt, and stir to blend together. Bake covered for 20 minutes.
Soy Lemon Sauce: Stir together in a small bowl and serve on the side as dipping sauce.
notes: Margaret V.

title: Poached Salmon with Hollandaise Sauce

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup butter, cut into small pieces

instructions: Use a high-sided pan large enough to accommodate both salmon fillets side-by-side, without too much excess room; a small skillet or medium/sized saucepan should do.
