Pour lemon juice and olive oil into pan along with enough water to bring water level up to 3/4-inch. Season water to taste with salt and pepper, then add the salmon. Pour in enough water to just cover the salmon.

Place salmon over medium/high heat and heat until water is hot and steaming but not simmering (165ºF. (75ºC.); reduce heat if needed to keep water at proper temperature. Poach until the salmon turns opaque and is firm to the touch; or to an internal temperature of 140ºF. (60ºC.). Proceed making the Hollandaise sauce while the salmon is poaching.

Pour a few inches of water into another saucepan, and bring to a boil over high heat then turn heat to medium/high and maintain water at a gentle boil. Place the egg yolks in a metal bowl and whisk in hot water. Place the bowl over, but not touching, the boiling water. Whisk constantly until the yolks thicken, turn a light, opaque yellow, and double in volume. You may need to remove the bowl from the boiling water from time to time in order to keep from scrambling the yolks.

When yolks have thickened and increased in volume, begin whisking in butter, a cube at a time until it melts and incorporates into hollandaise sauce. Wait for each cube to melt and incorporate before adding the next. Once all of the butter has been incorporated, remove from heat, whisk in the lemon juice, and season to taste with salt and pepper.
To serve, drain poached salmon and place each piece onto a plate. Generously ladle with warm hollandaise sauce, and sprinkle with chives.

title: Blender Hollandaise Sauce
instructions: In the container of a blender, combine the egg yolks, mustard, lemon juice and hot pepper sauce. Cover and blend for about 5 seconds.

Place the butter in a glass measuring cup. Heat butter in the microwave for about 1 minute, or until completely melted and hot. Set the blender on high speed and pour the butter into the egg yolk mixture in a thin stream. It should thicken almost immediately. Keep the sauce warm until serving by placing the blender container in a pan of hot tap water.

title: Coquilles Scallops St. Jacques

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 lb scallops, cut into small pieces

instructions: In saucepan, combine wine, onion, scallops and mushrooms.
Cover and simmer 5 minutes
Meanwhile melt butter in skillet. Stir in flour and salt
Pour in light cream, cook stirring constantly until thickened
Add parsley then scallops
Combine mushrooms and scallop mixture
Fill cooked crepes and fold over.
Place in shallow baking dish and sprinkle with cheese
Heat in 350ºF oven for 10-15 minutes or until cheese melts

title: Scallop Kabobs
instructions: Wash scallops and carefully dry them
Sauté 3 minutes with 1 1/2 tbsp oil and 2 tbsps butter. Do not brown them. Drain and reserve liquid
Wash mushrooms, remove stalks and sprinkle caps with lemon juice
Slice mushrooms horizontally in half to form 2 disks
Chop onion and sauté in scallop juices
Add mushrooms after two minutes and add salt, pepper and cook for two minutes
Place prepared ingredients on skewers
Roll the kabobs in the breadcrumbs.
Broil for 6 minutes turning once

title: Deep Fried Scallops

ingredients.rawText: 2 beaten eggs mixed with 1 tsp oil

instructions: Place scallops in bowl
Add Tabasco sauce, Worcestershire sauce and lemon juice
Marinate 10 to 15 minutes
Coat scallops in flour, dip in beaten eggs and coat with breadcrumbs
Preheat oil. Fry until golden.

title: Broiled Shrimp and Scallops
instructions: Shell and devein shrimp.
Wash shrimp and scallops under cold water, pat dry with paper towels.
In large bowl, combine oil, parsley, garlic, breadcrumbs, salt and pepper. 4. Add shrimp and scallops to mixture. Mix until well coated
Let stand 1 hr.
Preheat broiler. Remove shrimp and scallops from marinade.
Gently press some extra breadcrumb mixture onto shrimp and scallops.
Place alternately on 4 to 6 metal skewers.
Put skewers under hot broiler. Broil 2 min. on both sides or until golden.
Serve immediately with lemon wedges. Makes 4 to 6 servings.
notes: Mary V.

title: Shrimp, Mussels and Rice
instructions: Peel and de-vein shrimps. Cut fish fillets. Clean mussels
Heat oil, add onion, pepper, chilies and garlic. Cook stirring until soft
Add rice and saffron. Cook stirring 1 minute.
Add stock and wine. Simmer uncovered for about 15 minutes.
Add shrimps and fish. Cook for 3 minutes.
Stir in mussels and corn, cook until mussels are tender

title: Pepper Shrimp
instructions: Place shrimp in pan with 1 1/2 tbsp black paper and lemon juice
Add butter, water and 1 tbsp paprika.
Stir and cover pan, bring to a boil
Remove pan from heat, turn shrimp over, let stand in hot liquid 3 to 4 minutes. Drain shrimp and transfer to bowl, add remaining pepper and paprika. Mix well.

title: Tiger Shrimp
instructions: Split the shell on the back of the shrimp and pull out the vein (leave the shell on)
Combine other ingredients and allow shrimp to marinate 1/2 hour
Bake for approximately 1/2 hour at 350ºF or barbecue for approximately 5 minutes

title: Smelt
instructions: Cut off heads and split down belly with scissors.
Remove guts from inside belly. Wash thoroughly
Coat smelt with salted flour.
Fry in hot oil quickly. Remove and sprinkle with salt. Serve warm

title: Snails in Tomato Sauce
instructions: Wash snails thoroughly
Put snails in a pot with cold water. Put on stove and boil for 15 minutes
Wash snails again
To prepare sauce: fry oil and onions and add plum tomatoes, parsley, salt and pepper.
Cook for 1/2 hour.
Add snails and cook another ½ hour.

title: Baked Sole

ingredients.rawText: 2 lbs of sole or ocean perch or flounder

instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºF. Grease baking dish. Arrange fillets in dish.
Sprinkle fillets with salt and pepper and dot with 2 tbsps butter
Bake 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork

In saucepan over medium heat add 1 tbsp hot butter and stir in flour until blended. Slowly stir in chicken broth and lemon juice until mixture thickens. 5. Mix egg yolks with 1 tbsp water. Stir small amount of hot sauce into egg mixture. Pour sauce over fish.

title: Deep Fried Sole Fillets
instructions: Heat oil to deep fry.
Sift flour in a bowl, make a well and work in egg yolk, 1/2 tbsp oil, salt and pepper. When smooth, fold in stiffly beaten egg white. Add beer
Wash and dry fillets. Dip fillets in the batter.
Place in hot oil and fry until crisp.

title: Squid in Wine

ingredients.rawText: 1 fresh tomato, peeled and cut in small pieces

instructions: Clean squid. Cut off the tentacles.
Stuff the squid’s body with the tentacles you have cut.
Heat oil in a saucepan and sauté the onions.
Add squid and sauté for a couple of minutes.
Add wine, pepper, tomato paste and fresh tomato and cook until squid are tender. Add some water if required.

title: Marinated Squid
instructions: Cook squid rings in boiling water, reduce heat, simmer for 10 to 15 minutes until squid is tender. Drain.
Mix together lemon juice, oil, carrots, cooked squid, garlic and parsley.
Refrigerate to marinate.

title: Trout in Foil
instructions: Place trout and spices in foil
Bake for 30-35 minutes at 375ºF.

title: Baked Whitefish, Mushroom Stuffing
instructions: Mix oil, lemon juice and Worcestershire sauce together. Set aside.
Simmer mushrooms in their own juice then drain.
Mix all mushroom stuffing ingredients together and use spices to taste.
Wipe fish inside and out with wet cloth then pat dry. Fill cavity with stuffing and close opening with toothpicks.
Place stuffed fish in shallow pan on thin bed of carrots, onion and celery.
Brush fish generously with oil mixture; keep some aside for basting.
Bake in a 370ºF oven for 20 to 30 minutes. Baste every 10 minutes.

title: Zuppa di Pesce
instructions: Fry oil with chopped garlic
When garlic has gold color, put the fish in and let cook for 5 minutes
Add white wine, parsley and tomatoes
Let cook for approximately 1/2 hour
notes: Monkfish, skate, cuttlefish, or squid, shrimps, scallops, shark, swordfish,

title: Boiled Eggs
instructions: Place eggs in the bottom of a saucepan. Be sure not to crowd the eggs in the pan. They should fit comfortably.
Fill the pan with cold water, 1 inch above the eggs.
Bring the water to a rapid boil on the stovetop over high heat.
Once the water comes to a boil, cover the pan with a lid and remove the pan from the heat. Do not lift the lid. Set a timer for the type of boiled egg you want, from 4 minutes to 12 minutes.
Fill a large bowl with ice and water.
When the eggs reach the desired cooking time, use tongs to remove the eggs from the hot water and immerse gently into the prepared ice water to cool, about 10 minutes.
Gently tap the eggs against a hard surface and peel away the shell. Rinse the egg under cold water
notes: Boiled eggs are cooked with their shells unbroken usually by immersion in boiling water. Hard-boiled eggs are cooked so that the egg white and egg yolk both solidify, while soft-boiled eggs may leave the yolk, and sometimes the white, at least partially liquid and raw.

title: Eggs Over Easy
instructions: Melt 1 tablespoon unsalted butter in a small nonstick frying pan over medium heat. Tilt the pan so the butter films the bottom.
Add 2 large eggs and season with kosher salt.
Cook until the whites are almost set. Let the eggs cook undisturbed until the whites are almost completely set and opaque except for the 1/2-inch area around the yolks, about 2 minutes.

Carefully flip the eggs. Use the edge of a flat spatula to cut and separate the eggs if needed. Gently slide the spatula under one of the eggs, making sure it is centered under the yolk and carefully flip the egg. Flip the second egg.
Season the eggs with black pepper and cook until the whites are completely set, about 30 seconds more. Gently slide eggs onto a plate.

title: Eggs Sunny Side Up
instructions: Heat oil in an 8-inch nonstick skillet over medium/low.
Gently crack eggs into pan. You should not hear a hiss and the eggs should lie flat and still. If you hear sizzling or the whites flutter or bubble at all, turn down the heat.
Cook 3 minutes or until the whites are mostly set with some still- runny whites near the yolks.

Tilt pan toward you so oil pools on the bottom edge; dip a spoon in the oil, and gently baste the uncooked patches of white until they are set. Be careful not to baste the yolks, or they'll cloud over like cataracts.
Sprinkle salt and pepper. Remove eggs from the pan, leaving excess oil behind.

title: Quick and Easy Eggs Benedict
instructions: In a skillet over medium/high heat, fry the Canadian bacon on each side until evenly browned.

Fill a large saucepan with about 3 inches water and bring to a simmer. Pour in the vinegar. Carefully break the 4 eggs into the water, and cook 2 to 3 minutes until whites are set but yolks are still soft. Remove eggs with a slotted spoon.
Meanwhile, melt the butter until bubbly in a small pan or in the microwave. Remove from heat before butter browns.

In a blender or large food processor, blend the egg yolks, heavy cream, cayenne pepper, and salt until smooth. Add half of the hot butter in a thin steady stream slow enough so that it blends in at least as fast as you are pouring it in. Blend in the lemon juice using the same method, then the remaining butter.
Place open English muffins onto serving plates. Top with 1 slice Canadian bacon and 1 poached egg. Drizzle with the cream sauce and serve at once.

title: Eggs Benedict
instructions: To Make Hollandaise :

Fill the bottom of a double boiler part-way with water. Make sure that water does not touch the top pan. Bring water to a gentle simmer. In the top of the double boiler, whisk together egg yolks, lemon juice, white pepper, Worcestershire sauce, and 1 tablespoon water.

Add the melted butter to egg yolk mixture 1 or 2 tablespoons at a time while whisking yolks constantly. If hollandaise begins to get too thick, add a teaspoon or two of hot water. Continue whisking until all butter is incorporated. Whisk in salt then remove from heat. Place a lid on pan to keep sauce warm.
Preheat oven on broiler setting.

Fill a large saucepan with 3 inches of water. Bring water to a gentle simmer then add vinegar. Carefully break eggs into simmering water, and allow to cook for 2 1/2 to 3 minutes. Yolks should still be soft in the centre. Remove eggs from the water with a slotted spoon and set on a warm plate
While eggs are poaching, brown the bacon in a medium skillet over medium/high heat and toast the English muffins on a baking sheet under the broiler.

Spread toasted muffins with softened butter and top each one with a slice of bacon followed by one poached egg. Place 2 muffins on each plate and drizzle with hollandaise sauce. Sprinkle with chopped chives and serve immediately.
notes: To Poach Eggs :

title: Eggs Benedict with Hollandaise Sauce

ingredients.rawText: 2 tsp lemon juice, or lime juice

instructions: For the Hollandaise sauce: Melt the butter in a small saucepan.
In a separate small bowl, beat the egg yolks. Mix in lemon juice, whipping cream, and salt and pepper.

Add a small spoonful of the hot melted butter to the egg mixture and stir well. Repeat this process adding a spoonful at a time of hot butter to the egg mixture. (Adding the butter slowly, a spoonful at a time will temper the eggs and ensure they do not curdle).
Once the butter has been incorporated, pour the mixture back into the saucepan. Cook on low heat, stirring constantly for just 20-30 seconds.
Remove from heat and set aside. It will thicken as it cools. Stir well and add another splash of cream, if needed, to thin.
Poach eggs as recipe above.: While the eggs are cooking, place the slices of Canadian bacon in a large pan and cook on medium/high heat for about 1 minute on each side.
To Assemble: Toast the English muffin.
Top each toasted side with a slice or two of Canadian bacon, and then a poached egg. Top with hollandaise sauce.

title: Poached Eggs
instructions: Fill a medium sized pot with about 3 inches of water.
Bring the water to a boil and then reduce heat until it reaches a simmer. You should see small bubbles coming to the surface but not rolling.
Add a little splash of vinegar to the water (this is optional, but it helps the egg white to stay together once it is in the water).
Crack one egg into a bowl. Lower the egg into the simmering water, gently easing it out of the bowl.

Cook egg in simmering water for 3-5 minutes, depending on how soft you want the egg yolk. Remove poached egg with a slotted spoon. Tip* *It is not abnormal for white foam to form on top of the water when poaching an egg. Simply skim the foam off with a spoon.

title: Eggs in Purgatory

ingredients.rawText: 3-4 tbsp grated Parmigiano or Romano cheese

instructions: In a wide skillet with lid, heat olive oil over medium-low; sauté onion, garlic, red pepper, and chili flakes for 10 minutes until soft.
Stir in chopped tomatoes, bring to a simmer, and cook uncovered 15 minutes until rich and thickened.
Use the back of a spoon to carve 4 deep wells in the simmering sauce.
Crack an egg into each well; season each with a pinch of salt.
Cover pan and gently cook for 2 to 3 minutes until egg whites are set and yolks remain golden and runny.
Remove from heat, shower with torn fresh basil and grated Parmigiano cheese.
Serve immediately right out of the skillet with thick slices of country bread.
notes: An absolute family comfort food classic. Dipping crusty warm bread into the runny yolk and spicy sugo is heaven.

title: Caviar Egg Salad
instructions: Boiling eggs: Place eggs in a saucepan just large enough to hold them all in one layer. Add water to cover by 1 1/2 inches. Add 1 tablespoon salt. Partially cover the pan and bring to a full rolling boil. Cover, reduce heat to low and leave on heat for 30 seconds. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 15 minutes. Pour off hot water and rinse eggs under cold running water for 5 minutes. Pour off water and shake the pans to crack the eggs. Peel under cold running water.
In a large bowl, finely grate the hard-cooked eggs; stir in mayonnaise, mustard, and salt. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve. Note : May be made up to 36 hours in advance.
Just before serving, gently fold caviar into egg salad being careful not to break the fish eggs. Makes 6 to 8 servings for lunch or 24 servings for appetizers.

title: Egg Salad Sandwich
instructions: Peel eggs and place into a medium bowl. Slice eggs and then coarsely mash them with the back of a fork. Add mayonnaise, salt, pepper, and dill; stir until well blended. Note : This mixture can be refrigerated, covered, up to two days.
Spread butter onto one side of each slice of bread. Spread the buttered side of 10 slices of bread with 2 tablespoons egg mixture. Top with remaining slices of bread, buttered side down.
Carefully cut the crusts from sandwich with a sharp knife. Cut in half diagonally, then cut in half again. Yields 10 whole sandwiches or 20 halves or 40 fourths.

title: Scrambled Eggs

ingredients.rawText: Salt and black pepper to taste
Chopped fresh chives, optional for garnish

instructions: Crack the eggs into a medium bowl and add the milk or water.
Whisk until smooth and combined, with no streaks of egg white remaining.
Brush a small nonstick skillet with olive oil or melt a little butter or margarine in a small nonstick skillet. Bring to medium heat.
Pour in the eggs, and let them cook for a few seconds without stirring. Pull a rubber spatula across the bottom of the pan to form large, soft curds of scrambled eggs.

Continue cooking over medium/low heat, folding and stirring the eggs every few seconds. Scrape the spatula along the bottom and sides of the pan often to form more curds and to prevent any part of the eggs from drying out.
Remove the pan from the heat when the eggs are mostly set but a little liquid egg remains. Season to taste with salt and pepper and garnish with chopped fresh chives, if desired.

title: Basic Omelette
instructions: Pour 2 tablespoons olive oil in a non-stick skillet on medium heat.
Lightly beat the eggs in a bowl, until fully combined.

When the oil is hot, pour the eggs in the skillet. When the egg starts to solidify, using a fork lightly scramble the centre to let all the egg penetrate on the bottom. Shake the pan lightly back and forth to loosen the frittata and use a fork to loosen it from the edges of the pan.

Lift the frittata to check the bottom is cooked and golden. Make sure the egg on the top is not too runny. Place a dish slightly wider than the pan on top of the pan. Rotate the pan and the dish together so that the frittata is upside down on the dish.
Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil to the skillet then slide the frittata back into the pan so that the uncooked face is now on the pan.
Lift the frittata to check that the bottom is golden. Slide the frittata on a serving dish and serve warm.
notes: Italian Style Open-face Omelette

title: Artichoke Omelette (Frittata Con Carciofi)
instructions: Clean and drain the artichokes and cut them in very thin slices.
Pour 2 tablespoons olive oil in a non-stick skillet on medium heat. Add the artichokes, salt lightly and sauté until they become soft.
Lightly beat the eggs in a bowl until fully combined. Add salt and pepper.

When the artichokes are ready, pour the eggs in the skillet. When the egg starts to solidify, using a fork lightly scramble the centre to let all the egg penetrate on the bottom. Shake the pan lightly back and forth to loosen the frittata and use a fork to loosen it from the edges of the pan. Lift the frittata to check that the bottom is cooked and golden. Make sure the egg on the top is not too runny then place a dish slightly larger than the pan on the pan. Rotate the pan and the dish together so that now the frittata is upside down on the dish.
Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil to the skillet then slide the frittata back into the pan so that the uncooked face is now on the pan. Lift the frittata to check that the bottom is golden.
Slide the frittata on a serving dish and serve warm.

title: Asparagus Frittata

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 pound fresh asparagus, cut in 1/2-inch pieces
1/4 tsp sea salt and 1/8 tsp black pepper

instructions: Boil cut asparagus in salted water for 3 minutes; drain thoroughly.
In a bowl, beat eggs with salt, pepper, grated Parmigiano, and breadcrumbs.
In a 9-inch skillet, heat olive oil over medium heat. Sauté asparagus for 2 minutes.
Pour egg mixture over asparagus, stirring gently for 2 minutes to distribute.
Cook until bottom is golden brown (about 6 minutes).
Place a flat plate over the skillet, flip pan and plate together, and slide frittata back into the skillet to finish cooking the other side.
Slide onto a platter, cut into wedges, and serve warm or at room temperature.
notes: The plate-flip technique ensures an evenly golden, tender frittata without tearing.

title: Mozzarella Omelette

ingredients.rawText: 3 oz (100 gr) fresh mozzarella cheese, diced
2 oz (60 gr) parmigiano cheese, freshly grated

instructions: Pour 2 tablespoons olive oil in a non-stick skillet on medium heat.
Lightly beat eggs in a bowl, until fully combined. Add salt and pepper.
Add the diced mozzarella and the grated parmigiano cheese.

When the oil is hot pour the egg mixture in the skillet.. When the egg starts to solidify, using a fork lightly scramble the center to let all the egg penetrate on the bottom. Shake the pan lightly back and forth to loosen the frittata and use a fork to loosen it from the edges of the pan. Lift the frittata to check that the bottom is cooked and golden.
Make sure the egg on the top is not too runny then put a dish wider than the pan rim. Rotate the pan and the dish together so that now the frittata is upside down on the dish.
Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil to the skillet then slide the frittata back into the pan so that the uncooked face is now on the pan. Lift the frittata to check that the bottom is golden.
Slide the frittata on a serving dish and serve hot at once.

title: Potato Omelette

ingredients.rawText: 2 oz (60 gr) un-smoked bacon, finely diced (optional)

instructions: Wash the potatoes, place them in a large stock pot filled with water and bring to a boil. Cook until the potatoes are soft without overcooking to prevent them from breaking. Cooking time may vary depending on the size of the potatoes.
Peel immediately and mash them on a large dish using a potato ricer or a food mill.

Place in a skillet 3 tablespoons olive oil, the (optional) bacon and the onion. Sauté until the onion is soft and translucent. Add the mashed potatoes. Stir until the potatoes are fully combined with the onion. Use back of spoon to even the edges and flatten the potatoes. Then use the back of a skimmer to flatten the surface and make it resemble a frittata. Lift edge to check when the bottom is cooked and light golden.
Place a dish slightly larger than the pan on the pan. Flip the pan and the dish together so that now the potatoes are upside down on the dish.
Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil to the skillet then slide the potatoes back into the pan so that the uncooked face is now on the pan.
Use the back of spoon to make surface and edges smooth and even.
The potatoes are ready when bottom surface is lightly golden. Serve warm.
notes: FRITTATA DI PATATE - Eggless Potato Frittata

title: Italian Easter Sausage Frittata

ingredients.rawText: 1 ½ cups sausage, cooked & crumbled ¾ cup hard salami, chopped

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Place farmer’s cheese and mozzarella in separate bowls
Combine sausage, salami and pepperoni in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat; cook and stir until warmed, about 5 minutes.
Stir ricotta cheese into meat mixture until melted and stringy 5 mins.
Stir farmer’s cheese and mozzarella cheese into meat mixture until warmed, about 5 minutes.
Blend eggs together in a blender until frothy; pour into meat-cheese mixture and stir until some of the liquid evaporates, about 5 minutes.

Pour egg mixture into a 9 inch pie pan. Bake until top has risen and is starting to brown, about 20 minutes. Cool frittata on a wire rack until set, at least 5 minutes. Note: Chop the meats and fry separately.

title: Sausage Frittata

ingredients.rawText: Salt and black pepper to taste

instructions: Remove the casings from the sausages and break the meat up.
In a large frying pan, cook crumbled sausage with one tablespoon extra virgin olive oil on low heat until brown.
When done, remove from heat and set aside on absorbent paper.
Beat eggs in a bowl.
Taste sausage first: it could be already very salty and then add the sausage, salt and pepper.
Heat the other tablespoon of oil and when it starts fizzling, pour in eggs and sausage mixture.
Cook for a couple of minutes on each side, until golden on the outside, but still moist inside (it will get firmer when cool)
Let cool to lukewarm on paper towels before serving.

title: Spaghetti Omelette
instructions: Pour 2 tablespoons olive oil in a non-stick skillet on medium heat. Add the spaghetti, and sauté until hot.
Lightly beat the eggs in a bowl, until fully combined. Add salt and pepper. Pour the eggs in the skillet over the spaghetti.

When the egg starts to solidify, using a fork lightly scramble the centre to let all the egg penetrate on the bottom. Shake the pan lightly back and forth to loosen the frittata and use a fork to loosen it from the edges of the pan. Lift the frittata to check that the bottom is cooked and golden. Make sure the egg on the top is not too runny then place a dish slightly larger than the pan on the pan. Rotate the pan and the dish together so that now the frittata is upside down on the dish.
Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil to the skillet then slide the frittata back into the pan so that the uncooked face is now on the pan. Lift the frittata to check that the bottom is golden.
Slide the frittata on a serving dish and serve warm.
notes: FRITTATA DI SPAGHETTI - Frittata with Spaghetti

title: Tomato Sauce Omelette

ingredients.rawText: 2 oz (60 gr) pecorino romano cheese, freshly grater

instructions: Make and cut a frittata in small strips and set aside.
Place in a skillet the olive oil and onion. Sauté until onion is soft and translucent. Add tomato, salt and pepper.
Stir to combine and add the mint leaves. Cook for about 15 minutes.
Add the frittata strips to the tomato sauce. Stir gently until the frittata is fully covered with the sauce.
Top with the pecorino romano cheese. Serve warm garnished with a couple of fresh mint leaves.
notes: FRITTATINE A TRIPPA - Frittata in Tomato Sauce

title: Vegetable Omelette

ingredients.rawText: 3 to 4 cherry tomatoes, cut in half and sprinkled lightly with salt
2 tablespoons basil, parsley, or herb of your choice, chopped

instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl. Add a small pinch of salt and beat the eggs with a fork until they are well combined.
In an 8-inch nonstick skillet over medium-low heat, melt butter.

Add the eggs to the skillet and cook without stirring until the edges begin to set. With a silicone spatula, push the edges toward the center of the pan and tilt the pan so the uncooked eggs move to the edge.
Repeat until the eggs are somewhat set but still a little soft in the centre, about 6 minutes.
Place the cheese, tomatoes, and herbs in a line down the centre of the omelette and cook for about 1 minute longer or until the eggs are mostly set but still a little soft in the centre.
Fold and plate the omelette: Slide spatula around one side of the omelette at the edge to loosen it. Slip it under the eggs and use it to carefully fold the omelette in half.
Slide spatula under folded omelette to loosen it from the pan. Tilt pan over a plate and use the spatula to nudge it onto a plate.

title: Vegetable Ham Frittata

ingredients.rawText: ½ cubed ham or bacon, crumbled
½ cup each red and green pepper, chopped
1 ½ cups old cheddar cheese, grated

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Mix together 1 ½ cups milk, 1 cup water, 6 eggs slightly beaten, 2 Oxo cubes, 3 tbsps Dijon mustard and ¼ tsp pepper.
Sauté all vegetables in butter, add meat and cook for a minute.
In a large 9 x 13 inch greased baking dish, put cubed bread across bottom of pan. Spread mixed vegetables over bread evenly. Sprinkle some cheese over vegetables.
Pour wet ingredients over top.
Melt 1/3 cup of butter and pour on top and sprinkle with the rest of the cheese. Cook for approximately 50 minutes.
When puffed up and nicely browned, remove from oven and let sit 5 minutes before serving.
notes: Georgina V.

title: Vegetable, Ham & Cheese Omelette
instructions: Crack and scramble eggs. Add salt and pepper to taste.
Heat oil in ovenproof frying pan. Sauté onions in hot oil.
Add desired vegetables and ham. Stir vegetables, ham and onions. Lower heat to medium high.
Add ½ of the scrambled eggs. Place cheese on top and add remaining scrambled eggs.
Turn on broiler in oven.
When bottom of omelette appears almost done, place frying pan in oven and broil until top of egg mixture is golden brown.
Remove from oven. Place plate over omelette and flip
Allow omelette to cool before serving.

title: Zucchini Omelette
instructions: NOTES *** Do not overcook the zucchini, they have to be firm. * Do not burn the onion or the frittata will assume a bitter taste. * If the vegetables are not ready but the bottom of the pan is dry, add 1 tablespoon of water.
Lightly beat eggs in a bowl until fully combined. Add salt and pepper.
Place vegetables in pan with 2 tbsps olive oil. When the vegetables are ready, pour the eggs in the skillet.

When eggs start to solidify, using a fork lightly scramble the centre to let all the eggs penetrate on the bottom. Shake the pan lightly back and forth to loosen the frittata and use a fork to loosen it from the edges of the pan. Lift the frittata to check that the bottom is cooked and golden.
Make sure the egg on the top is not too runny then place a dish slightly larger than the pan on the pan. Flip the pan and the dish together so that now the frittata is upside down on the dish.
Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil to the skillet then slide the frittata back into the pan so that the uncooked face is now on the pan. Lift the frittata to check that the bottom is golden.
Slide the frittata on a serving dish and serve warm.

title: Natasa Serbian Cheese Pie (Gibanica)

ingredients.rawText: 250 g white cheese (you can replace it with feta)
125 g unsalted kajmak (you can replace it with cream)

instructions: For filling: Preheat oven to 400°F
Mix water, a little bit of salt and ½ kg flour. Mix together and knead until you get firm and smooth dough.
Cut dough in six pieces. Roll them thin. They have to cover the bottom of the pan.
Leave slices on clean papers for a few hours to dry.
In a deep bowl mix 10 eggs, add cheese, kajmak (cream), fat (or butter) and milk.
Coat the bottom of the pan with butter or oil, then coat it with one slice of dough and put the filling evenly all over it.
Repeat it until you have no more slices of dough left.
Top with the sixth piece of dough.
Splash last slice of dough with pieces of butter.
Place in 400°F preheated oven,
Bake until top slice becomes golden like.
A real old recipe for gibanica. Try it, You will be more than just satisfied.

title: Serbian Cottage Cheese Pie

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb. farmer style cottage cheese, small curd

instructions: Beat eggs well and add cottage cheese, Jack cheese and Bisquick.
Mix well. Add milk and 1/2 melted butter to this mixture.
Use the other half butter to grease a 9" x 13" baking dish and then pour all the mixture in the dish.
Bake at 350  F. for 40 minutes.
Serve with some fresh salsa.

title: Serbian Cheese Pie
instructions: Pastry: Mix flour with salt and olive oil.
Add 300-400 ml warm water to the mixture. Beat until compact (approximately 10 minutes). Cut into two equal halves.
Spread 1 tablespoon of olive oil on the top of each half. Cover with tea towel or foil and leave it for 1 hour to settle down.
On lightly floured surface roll out dough to about 5mm thickness. Filling :
Beat eggs, add butter, grated cheese and stir with cream milk.
Spread the mixture over pastry. Carefully fold pastry and put in lightly oiled oven dish.
Bake at 180  C for 50 minutes or until well risen and golden.
To serve cut into pieces. Serve hot or cold.

title: Meatloaf and Mashed Potatoe Cake
instructions: For Creamy Mashed Potatoes: Idaho potatoes, enough to frost the cake and feed your family Minced garlic and salt to taste Cream cheese (to taste)
Peel and cut up the potatoes.
Add potatoes, salt and garlic to boiling water and cook until tender.
Combine potatoes and cream cheese and mash.
For the Cake: Make up your favourite meatloaf recipe.
Shape into springform pan or other round baking dish and bake.
Allow meatloaf to partially cool.
Frost with mashed potatoes and garnish with mixture of green, red, orange and yellow diced bell peppers.
Return to oven set on warm and heat through.
Remove from oven. Slice like a cake to serve. Yum!

title: Serbian Spinach Quiche

ingredients.rawText: 1 pkg fresh spinach, cooked & drained 6 tbsp flour

instructions: Preheat oven to 325ºF.
In a large bowl, combine all ingredients; mix well.
Pour into a well greased baking dish and cook for 1 hour or until just heated through. Serves: 2-4 people

title: Serbian Eggplant Moussaka

ingredients.rawText: 2 to 3 fresh tomatoes, peeled and chopped

instructions: Peel eggplant, and slice lengthwise in approximately 1/4" slices. Beat 2 eggs with a tablespoon of milk, heat 1/4 cup oil in a large skillet (two skillets will speed up the frying process). Dip eggplant in flour, shake off excess, dip in egg mixture and fry both sides at medium/low heat until golden brown. Drain between paper towels. This step can be done ahead of time. Keep leftover egg mixture to be used later.

Heat 2/3 tablespoons of oil in a skillet, add onion, and sauté until soft and golden at medium/low heat, stirring often. Add ground beef, garlic, salt & pepper to taste and cook until meat is brown, stirring to break up the particles. Add the green pepper, tomatoes, and parsley & let simmer for five to ten minutes. Remove from heat and break one egg and mix in well.

Oil a three-quart casserole dish and line bottom with 1/3 of the eggplant slices then spread ½ of the meat mixture. Layer another 1/3 of the eggplant slices, cover with remaining meat mixture and top with eggplant slices.

Beat 3 eggs with any leftover egg/milk mixture, add the 1.5 cups of milk, stir well, then pour over the eggplant. Bake at 350ºF. for 40-45 minutes, or until the moussaka is puffy and golden brown. May be eaten warm or cold; serves 6-8 people.

title: Potato and Cheese Quiche

ingredients.rawText: 2 large russet potatoes, peeled and shredded

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400ºF. (200ºC.)

Heat oil in a 12 inch skillet over medium/high heat. When skillet is hot, add the potatoes and fry until crispy and golden, about 15 minutes. Reduce heat to medium and add onions. Cook, stirring, until softened. Season with salt and pepper. Pour eggs over potatoes and onions.

Place the skillet in the oven for about 10 minutes or until eggs are firm. Remove from the oven, and sprinkle shredded cheese over the top. Return to the oven for about 5 minutes, or until cheese is melted.

title: Active Dry Yeast Proofing
instructions: Proof the yeast to activate it.
In a small mixing bowl, mix 3/4 cup warm water with the yeast and ¾ tbsp of sugar.
Wait 10 minutes, until the mixture foams and bubbles. (If yeast does not foam and bubble during the time, the yeast will not work, so you will need to buy fresher yeast).
Add the activated yeast to the mixing bowl with the recipes remaining warm water, sugar, olive oil, flour and salt. Then proceed with the recipe.
Baking with quick rise yeast: Set aside 1 cup all-purpose flour from total amount. Mix remaining flour and dry ingredients including Quick-Rise yeast in a large bowl
Heat margarine or butter or oil and all liquid ingredients (except eggs) until hot to the touch about 130ºF or as hot at hottest tap water.
Stir hot liquids into dry mixture. Mix in eggs if required
Mix in enough reserved flour and set aside in step one for desired dough consistency
Follow recipe directions for kneading, if required. Use additional flour if needed until dough is no longer sticky.

To knead, use a simple three-step motion until dough becomes very smooth and elastic according to recipe directions a. Fold the dough towards you with a rolling motion b. With the heel of hands, press down hard, pushing dough away. c. Turn the dough a quarter turn and repeat
Cover dough. Let rest 10 minutes. Shape dough as desired or place into baking pans. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk, about 30 - 60 minutes. Bake as desired.

title: Whole-Wheat Bread or Buns 2022

ingredients.rawText: 9 tbsp melted butter or olive oil
2 tbsp butter, melted or olive oil

instructions: In large bowl mix warm water, yeast and 1/3 cup honey and 6 tbsps olive oil or melted butter.
Add 5 cups white flour and stir to combine.
Let set 30 minutes or until big and bubbly.
Mix in 3 tbsps olive oil, 5 cups wheat flour and 1/3 cup honey.
Knead just until sticky to touch.
Place in greased bowl, burn to coat surface of dough.
Cover with dishtowel and let rise until doubled.
Punch down dough, divide and roll into 3 loaves or 12 buns.
Place on parchment covered cookie sheets.
Allow to rise.
Preheat regular oven to 350ºF Bake 25-30 minutes. CONVECTION 325ºF 25 minutes
Brush tops of loaves with 2 tbsps melted butter or margarine when done to prevent crust from getting hard.
Cool completely

title: Basic Homemade Bread in a Pan

ingredients.rawText: 1 pkg or 1 tbsp active dry yeast

instructions: In large bowl, dissolve yeast and 1/2 tsp of sugar in warm water, let stand until bubbles form on surface. Stir oil into yeast mixture.
Whisk together remaining 3 tbsps sugar, salt and 3 cups flour.
Pour oil and yeast mixture into flour mixture and beat until smooth. Stir in enough remaining flour, ½ cup at a time, to form a soft dough.
Turn onto a floured surface, knead until smooth and elastic, 8-10 minutes. Place in a greased bowl, turning once to grease top. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled. (1 to 1 ½ hours).
Punch dough down. Turn onto lightly floured surface, divide dough in half. Shape each half into a loaf. Place in 2 greased 9x5 inch loaf pans. Cover and let rise until doubled. (1-11/2 hours)
Bake at 375ºF until loaf is golden brown and sounds hollow when tapped or has reached an internal temperature of 200ºF or 30-35 minutes.
Remove from pans to wire racks to cool.

title: Easy Perfect Yeast Bread
instructions: In a large bowl mix together the yeast, sugar, salt and warm water. Let this stand until the yeast is dissolved, about 10 minutes
Gradually add flour, one cup at a time to the liquid and mix thoroughly until the dough pulls away from the sides of the bowl.
Turn the dough out on a floured surface to knead.

Knead it: Fold the far edge of the dough back over on itself toward you. Press the dough with the heels of your hands and push away. After each push, rotate the dough 90 degrees. Repeat the process in a rhythmic, rocking motion for 5 minutes, sprinkling only enough flour on your kneading surface to prevent sticking. Let the dough rest while you scrape out and grease the mixing bowl with a few drops of olive oil or baking spray. Knead the dough again for 2 or 3 minutes.
Let it Rise: Return the dough to the bowl and turn it over once to grease the top. Cover with a damp towel and keep warm until the dough doubles in bulk, about 1 to 2 hours.

Shape it: Punch down the dough with your fist and briefly knead out any air bubbles. Cut the dough in half and shape into two Italian or French style loaves. Place the loaves on a cookie sheet generously sprinkled with cornmeal or flour. Let the loaves rest 5 minutes.
Bake it: Lightly slash the tops of the loaves 3 or more times diagonally and brush them with cold water.

Place on aluminum roasting pan on the bottom of the oven. Fill 1 inch deep with boiling water. Slide loaves onto baking stone in a cold oven. Bake at 400°F. for 35 to 45 minutes until loaves are golden brown and sound hollow when tapped. for 45 minutes. Preheat the oven and roasting pan with water to 500°F. for 15 minutes. Brush the loaves with cold water, place in the oven and bake for 10 minutes. Lower the temperature to 400°F. and bake 10 more minutes. Remove from the oven and place on a cooling rack. Let cool for at least 30 minutes before slicing. not have as nice of a crisp crust.
notes: Alternate method: For a lighter, crustier bread, let your shaped loaves rise Tip: *If you do not have a baking stone use a cookie sheet. The bread will

title: Aiden's First Communion Italian Bread

ingredients.rawText: 9 cups all-purpose flour (up to 12 if needed)
1 large egg white for brushing on loaves

instructions: Knead flour, yeast, oil, sugar, salt, and warm water in stand mixer or by hand for 6-10 minutes until dough forms a smooth ball.
Place in greased bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let rise for 2 hours.
Gently punch down dough and let rise another 40 minutes.
Preheat oven to 425°F. Place a metal pan halfway filled with hot water on bottom rack for a steam bath to create a crispier crust.
Divide dough into 3 balls. Shape each into a 10-inch loaf and score vertical or horizontal slits along the top surface.
Bake for 10 minutes at 425°F, then lower temperature to 400°F and bake 30-35 minutes until tapping underside sounds hollow.
Cool loaves on a wire rack.
notes: Traditional celebratory Italian bread prepared for communion milestones and family feasts.
originalPhotoCaption: Aiden's First Communion Italian Bread; Samantha's First Communion Bread

title: Samantha’s Communion Refrigerator Bread
instructions: Dissolve yeast in ½ cup warm water and 1 tsp sugar. Set aside to proof and bubble up.
In bowl of mixer, combine 2 cups hot water, 3 tbsps sugar, 2 tbsps salt and half cup of oil. Add 3 cups flour and mix well with wooden spoon.
Stir in proofed yeast. Add 3 more cups of flour and mix well with spoon. Add remaining flour as needed and stir to combine.

Place bowl in standup mixer and use dough hook to knead dough 5 minutes until completely combined making sure there is no flour left at the bottom of the bowl. You can also mix the dough with your hands or a spatula. Making sure all the flour is incorporated.

Place dough in large greased pan, punch down dough and turn to oil all of it. Cover bowl, let sit at room temperature for 2 hours, punch down and refrigerate for 5-24 hours before using. Dough will last 2 weeks in fridge.
After 5 hours or first thing in the morning spray 9 x 5 inch loaf pan with Pam and put a strip of parchment paper at the bottom of the pan.

Remove dough from the fridge, sprinkle the top of the dough with 2-3 tablespoons flour and form dough into a long roll. Cut into four or five pieces. Shape each piece into a loaf and place in prepared loaf pans.
Cover pans with tea towel. Let rest 2-3 hours. Score 3 slanted lines.
Preheat oven to 400°F. and bake for 30 minutes.
Test bread with a toothpick or thermometer. Bread is done at 190-200°F.
When done, remove from pan and place it on a wire rack to cool.

title: Easy Artisan Bread Balls
instructions: In a large bowl with a lid, put sugar, salt, yeast and warm water and stir with a wooden spoon until salt is dissolved.
Add flour and stir until well mixed with wooden spoon or hands
Put lid on bowl with a little air vent or leave a little unsealed so lid will not pop off. Leave on counter for two hours. Dough will be doubled.

Sprinkle a little flour on top of dough and knock it down. Refrigerate in sealed bowl for use the following day or make into baseball sized balls and adding flour as needed to keep from sticking. Put dough ball with seam side down on parchment paper for 40 minutes.
Preheat oven 450°F. Put a pan with one inch water in bottom of oven.
Brush melted butter on bread and sprinkle with some sesame seeds if desired. Score with serrated knife 3 or 4 times.
Bake 30 minutes until golden. Place on rack to cool 30 minutes.

title: Briosche Bird Buns

ingredients.rawText: ½ cup milk + ½ cup water (more if required and 2-4 tablespoons more if
3 cups all-purpose flour/ whole wheat flour
Few black raisins or Choco chips for eyes
ingredients.normalizedName: few black raisins choco chips eyes

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk flour and salt. Put aside.
Mix milk and water and heat it until warm. Add sugar and stir to dissolve.
Add yeast. Mix and cover and let sit for 10 minutes. Add oil and mix.
Add dry ingredients and stir until shaggy dough forms.Transfer to board.
Knead to get a soft and smooth dough. Add more water if dough feels very dry. Transfer to greased bowl. Turn once to coat evenly with oil.
Cover and keep in a warm place to rise for 1 hour or until almost double.
Punch and knead for 1-2 minutes. Let dough rest for 5-6 minutes.

Pinch out small balls of dough. Roll out one ball at a time into a rope of about 6-8 inches in length. Tie each roll into a knot from the center. Lift one free end of the knot and shape it into the birds head. Pull out the beak. Shape the head and beak. The other free end of the knot will be the tail. Flatten it with the index finger and press it with a fork to make feathers or cut with a knife and shape the tail feathers.
Put rolls on lined pan. Cover and let rise for 30-45 min. or until puffy.
Preheat oven to 350°F. Bake 20-25 minutes or until a beautiful golden.
Transfer from the oven to the cooling rack. Brush warm rolls with butter.
With toothpick, make holes for eyes. Press Choco-chip/raisin into hole.
notes: Alternative Ingredients :

ingredients.rawText: 7 cups all-purpose flour/ whole wheat flour
1 cup milk + 1 cup water (more if required
and 2-4 tbsp more if using whole wheat
Few black raisins or Choco chips for eyes
ingredients.normalizedName: few black raisins choco chips eyes

ingredients.rawText: Briosche bird buns (knot buns shaped into birds
ingredients.normalizedName: briosche bird buns knot buns shaped birds

title: Homemade Italian Bread

ingredients.rawText: 2 cups hot water (hot to touch not boiling)
1 large egg white for brushing on loaves

instructions: Dissolve yeast, ½ cup warm water and ½ tsp sugar in a small bowl.

In large standup mixer bowl, combine 2 cups hot water, 3 tablespoons granulated sugar, salt and oil. Add 3 cups of flour to mixture and mix well. 3. Stir in yeast mixture. Add 2-3 cups more flour and mix until well blended. (dough should be sticky). Remove from mixer, leave in bowl, cover with a towel and let rise for 1 hour. No kneading is required.
After the rise, if the dough is too sticky to handle, add more flour until it’s workable. This can be up to a cup of more. Add flour by quarter cupfuls until its workable. Do not dry out the dough.

Divide dough into 3 pieces. Roll out each piece on a floured surface into the length desired then roll up lengthwise like a jelly roll. If it is too sticky add more flour until it is workable but not dry.
Put on greased cookie sheet, sealed side down and tuck the ends under. Slash the top diagonally across the top every couple of inches with a sharp knife. Cover and let loaves rise 30 more minutes.
While loaves rise, preheat oven to 400°F.
Brush whisked egg whites over the top of the loaves. Bake for 25-30 minutes.

title: Italian Garlic Bread
instructions: Melt butter and mix in equal amount of garlic juice with melted butter.
Lightly toast bread.
Spread melted garlic juice/butter mixture combination onto bread.
Again, lightly toast until garlic juice/butter combination are slightly bubbly. Serve warm . P.S. Do not forget to add garlic juice to your pasta sauce, too.
Italian garlic bread alternate method: Spray bread with garlic juice and toast lightly.
Remove from oven, spray again with garlic juice and spread butter on.
Toast bread lightly again until butter and garlic juice melt and enter the bread. Serve warm
notes: French bread or sourdough loaf, cut in half lengthwise in 6-inch sections.

title: Bruschetta Classica

ingredients.rawText: 4 slices of thick-crusted Italian country bread about 3/8 inch (1 cm) thick
Whole small dry red peppers, spicy (optional)

instructions: Preheat oven, broiler, or toaster, or light up a charcoal fire.
Grill the bread on both sides until golden brown.
Lightly rub the garlic on the surface of the bread.
If you like, lightly rub the red pepper over the bread.
Pour a thin stream of olive oil on the bread and sprinkle with salt.
Serve while still warm.

title: Bruschetta al Pomodoro

ingredients.rawText: 4 slices of thick-crusted Italian country bread about 3/8 inch (1 cm) thick

instructions: In a bowl mix tomato, basil, extra-virgin olive oil, salt, and pepper.
Preheat oven, broiler, or toaster, or light up a charcoal fire.
Grill the bread on both sides until golden brown.
Lightly rub the garlic on the surface of the bread.
Distribute the tomato on the bread slices uniformly and serve warm.
notes: Toasted Garlic Bread with Tomatoes

title: Serbian Bread (Pogaca)

ingredients.rawText: Nice simple Serbian flat bread. Yields 1 loaf
ingredients.normalizedName: nice simple serbian flat bread yields loaf

instructions: Preheat oven to 325ºF.
Dissolve yeast in warm water.
Add sugar, oil and egg.
Gradually stir in flour until combined and soft dough forms.
Knead in bowl for 1 minute.
Place dough in greased bowl, cover, and let rise until doubled.
Roll on floured board into large, slightly flattened circle.
Prick with fork all over.
Brush top with oil or butter and let sit for 20 minutes.
Bake for 30 minutes, or until lightly browned.

title: Serbian Pumpernickel Bread
instructions: Combine boiling water, chocolate, vinegar, molasses, caraway seeds and coffee in a large bowl until chocolate melts; cool to 105-110°F.
Dissolve yeast in the warm water; let stand 10 minutes.
Add to chocolate mixture and add sugar and salt.
Mix in rye flour and bran, kneading well.
Knead in white flour (use a food processor).
Grease the bread, cover and let rise until doubled.
Form into 2 round loaves; let rise again until doubled.
Bake at 350ºF. for 25 minutes; brush with egg white and sprinkle salt.
Bake another 20 minutes until loaves sound hollow.

title: Easy Serbian Yeast Nutbread (Povotica)

ingredients.rawText: 1 stick real butter, melted and cooled to room temp.

instructions: Filling: In large bowl, combine hot roll mix, required amount of milk, sugar and oil. Add beaten egg. Stir well, turn onto floured surface and knead 15 minutes or until dough springs back when poked with your finger.
Oil a clean bowl, add the ball of dough, turning to coat all sides. Cover and let rise until double in bulk.
Knead it again for a minute or two. Roll and stretch it to about 49" long and 34" wide.
Mix the filling and cook it slightly until it begins to thicken.
Spread the filling on the dough, roll up jellyroll style; cut it to fit into 2 or 3 greased bread pans; score tops if you desired.
Cover and let rise another hour.
Preheat oven to 350ºF and bake about 45 minutes until nicely browned.
Remove from pans and cool on wire racks.
notes: Dough: 1 box Pillsbury Hot Roll Mix (substitute milk for the liquid called for

title: Briosche Sweet Buns
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar.
Blend in water, oil and milk
Combine yeast and flour as needed.
Knead dough and let rise. Roll into long ropes. Shape into knots. Optional: Shape into birds as in Briosche Bird Buns.
Let rise until doubled.
Bake at 325ºF. for 25 minutes. (310ºF convection 25 minutes)
notes: Esterina Puntillo .

title: Briosche Panici
instructions: Note: Follow steps above but after rolling ropes, let rise then make knots.

title: Overnight Coffee Loaves
instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water
Combine flour, sugar and salt. Cut in butter until like meal.
Mix in yeast, egg yolks and milk until dough is smooth
Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours
Roll ½ of dough into 13 X 8 inches and brush with melted butter
Mix sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle half on the rectangle
Roll up the rectangle and place seam side down on parchment covered cookie sheet. Cover and let rise until doubled.
Place in 375ºF oven for one hour
Cover with foil the last 20 minutes. Frost with Glaze. Cool before slicing

title: British Hot Cross Buns

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup unsalted butter, softened, cut in pieces or 1 cup vegetable oil

instructions: Heat milk, combine with 2 cups flour & yeast and let stand until bubbly
Combine 7 cups flour, sugar, salt, cinnamon, cloves, ginger and nutmeg.
Add butter into flour mixture or oil into yeast mixture
Mix 4 beaten eggs into yeast mixture and then add flour.
Divide dough into 2 parts and in one part add 1 cup raisins.
Grease both dough parts, cover and let rise.
When doubled, roll dough into 4 loaves.
Cut slices and roll into balls and place on parchment covered pan.
With back of knife press a cross on each bun.
Cover and let rise (about an hour)
Preheat oven to 375°F. or 350°F. convection for 15 minutes.
Put cookies on wire rack and glaze immediately.
Glaze: Heat water and sugar to a boil.
Brush glaze on buns as soon as you put on wire racks to cool
Allow buns to cool 20 minutes
Icing: Combine icing sugar and water.
Put icing sugar in sandwich bag. Cut off corner of bag.
Pipe icing sugar in a cross shape over cooled buns and dry 30 minutes.
notes: Hunter stirs the fermented yeast. After dough has risen Hunter shapes a ball of dough.

title: Czech Sweet Bread Roll (Houska)
instructions: Mix the honey and warm water to dissolve and add yeast.
In small pan, heat milk almost to boiling point then remove from heat.
Combine scalded milk, sugar, margarine, and salt; cool to lukewarm.
Stir 1 cup of flour into milk mixture, beat well. Stir in the yeast mixture.
Add eggs, beat well and then add mace, raisins and almonds.
Add 3 more cups of flour stirring to make a soft dough.
Turn the dough onto a well-floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic, adding flour a little at a time to keep dough from sticking.
Put dough in lightly greased bowl, turning dough to grease all sides.
Cover and let rise in warm place until dough is doubledi (about 1 hour).
Punch dough and divide into 5 pieces, 3 the same size, 2 smaller.
The 3 larger pieces are rolled out to form a 17-inch roll and then braided together. This is the bottom row.
The 2 smaller pieces are rolled out and twisted together and placed on top of the 3-braid piece, tucking the ends under.
Assemble on a cookie sheet with parchment paper on the diagonal.
Let the Houska rise in a warm place until about double in size.
Brush the top with beaten milk.
Bake in a 350°F. oven for 30 minutes or until golden brown.
Brush the top lightly with butter when loaves are warm for a softer crust.

title: Hungarian Coffee Braid & Buns
instructions: 1 Measure 3 tbsps warm water in bowl, add 1 tsp. sugar. Stir to dissolve. Sprinkle yeast in water. Let stand in warm place for 10 min. Stir briskly. 2 Melt butter in small pan. Add ½ cup sugar, 3 tsp salt and stir to dissolve. Stir in sour cream over low heat till mixture is warm (do not boil). 3 Beat 2 warm eggs in large bowl until frothy. Add yeast mixture, sour cream mixture and 1 cup of flour. Beat with electric mixer for 3 minutes. Stir in all but the final ½ cup of flour. 4 Flour counter and turn out dough, scraping bowl clean. Flour hands and knead 10 minutes sprinkling reserved flour on counter as required. When kneading is complete rub underside of dough with flour to prevent sticking. Put on cookie sheet and cover with tea towel. Place 10 cups hot water in pan. Turn dough smooth side up, cover with tea towel, wrap in plastic bag and place on pan with hot water. Let rise until double.(1½ hrs) 5 Prepare Filling: Beat cream cheese light and smooth. Beat in cottage cheese, sugar, egg and vanilla. Fold in currants or raisins. Refrigerate. 6 Deflate dough by punching centre gently without tearing. Turn dough on counter. Slap down hard on counter to completely deflate dough. Cut dough in half. Knead each half into round ball. Cover and let rise 10 min. 7 Buns: Roll one half into a square 40 X 40 cm. Cut it in squares in both directions to make 16 squares. Place 15 ml. filling in centre of each square. Overlap and pinch diagonally opposite corners of the square together. Place on parchment covered sheets. Cover and let rise 1 hr . 8 Braid: Roll other half of dough into a 30X30 cm square. With a long knife cut 2 X 10 cm (1 X 4 inch) 12 strips along each opposite sides. Leave middle 4 inches in tact with strips. Spread remaining filling in a strip down the centre leaving 3 cm at each end. Cross first strip at an angle over filling, pressing end lightly into dough. Take strip from the opposite side and cross over first strip. Repeat with strips from alternate sides. Tuck last two ends underneath. Place on parchment covered pan. Cover and let rise 1 hr. 9 Glaze: Brush braid and buns with beaten egg. Let dry a few minutes and brush again to use all the egg. 10 Preheat oven to 375°F. Bake buns 12-15 minutes and braid 20 minutes 11 When deep golden brown remove and cool or wire racks.
notes: Georgina V.

title: Raisin ‘n Spice Coffee Ring
instructions: Set aside 1 cup flour. Mix remaining flour, yeast, cereal, brown sugar, cinnamon and nutmeg into a large bowl
Heat water, milk and margarine until hot and stir into dry ingredients
Mix in egg and raisins. Mix in enough reserved flour to make a soft dough that does not stick to the bowl. Turn out onto floured board and knead 5 minutes. Cover dough and let rest 10 minutes

Roll into 18” X 12“ rectangle. Roll up long side, jelly-roll fashion sealing the edges. Place seam-side down on a greased cookie sheet, shaping around an empty 4 inch can. Moisten ends of dough and pinch to seal ends into a circle. Slash ring about every 2 inches with a sharp knife
Place baking sheet over a shallow pan ½ filled with boiling water
Cover dough and let rise 30 minutes.
Bake at 375ºF for 20 to 25 min. or until brown. Cool on wire rack
Mix icing sugar and milk and drizzle over cake ring Makes one ring coffee cake

title: Sour Cream Dinner Rolls
instructions: Set aside 1 cup flour
Mix remaining flour, yeast, sugar and salt into a large bowl
Heat margarine, sour cream and water until hot to touch 130ºF
Stir hot liquids into dry ingredients. Mix in the egg
Mix in enough reserved flour to make a soft dough that does not stick to the bowl. Turn out onto floured board and knead 5 minutes
Divide dough into 12 equal pieces; shape each piece into a smooth ball pinching at the bottom to seal
Place seam-side down, almost touching in greased 9“ square or round cake pan.
Place pan on a baking sheet over a shallow pan half-filled with boiling water. Cover dough and let rise 40 minutes.
Bake at 350ºF for 15 to 29 minutes or until brown.
Brush with melted margarine.
Remove from pan and cool on wire rack. Makes 12 rolls

title: Rosina’s Traditional Taralle (2008)
instructions: Pour warm water into a large bowl. Add yeast, stir, and let bubble for 5 minutes.
Add oil, salt, and anise seeds.
Slowly add flour, mixing by hand. Turn dough onto floured board and knead until a fingerprint springs back.
Oil dough, place in bowl, cover, and let rise until doubled.
Divide dough into loaves, then cut into even slices. Roll each slice into an 8-inch rope (1/2 inch thick).
Form into circles and squeeze ends together firmly.
Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Drop 5 taralle at a time into boiling water. When they float to top, remove with slotted spoon onto dry cloth to dry.
Preheat convection oven to 350°F. Place boiled and dried taralle directly on oven racks.
Bake for about 30 minutes until golden brown on top and bottom.
Slide hot taralle onto clean tablecloth to cool. Can be frozen and reheated in oven before serving.
notes: Nonna Rosina's secret: Boiling the taralle before baking gives them their signature crisp, tender crumb and golden sheen.
originalPhotoCaption: Nonna Rosina rolling, boiling, drying on clean tablecloths, and baking golden taralle

title: Rosina Taralle 2001
instructions: Heat water and oil. Add salt
Combine yeast, flour and anice seeds. Knead dough
Oil dough and place in bowl. Cover and let rise
Cut into four equal parts
Roll each part into a loaf and cut slices
Roll each slice into a rope about 8” long and 1/2 “ diameter and form into a circle. Squeeze ends together so they do not come apart
Place circles on clean tea towels, cover so taralle do not harden.
Boil water in a large pot.
Drop taralle in boiling water and when they come to the top of the water remove and place on tea towel again to dry.
Preheat convection oven to 350ºF and place boiled taralle directly on oven racks
Bake until golden 30 minutes

title: Mixer Taralle
instructions: Heat water and oil and add salt.
Mix flour, anice and yeast by hand.
Put flour mixture in mixer bowl. Mix well.
Add water and oil mixture in well
Using dough hook mix together.
notes: Egg taralle after baking.

title: Glazed Egg Taralli

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 teaspoon baking powder and pinch of salt
3 cups icing sugar, 4 tbsp water, 2 tsp lemon juice (Glaze)

instructions: In a stand mixer with whisk, beat eggs on medium-high for 4-5 minutes until doubled in volume.
Add sugar, oil, vanilla, lemon zest, and Sambuca. Whisk together.
Switch to dough hook and knead in flour and baking powder for 7-10 minutes until soft and smooth.
Wrap dough in plastic and rest for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Divide into 8 pieces, then shape into small balls. Poke hole in center and stretch into donut rings.
Bring water to 200°F (just before boiling). Drop taralli in water; when they float (2-3 mins), remove to tea towel and air dry 15 minutes.
Preheat oven to 400°F. Score a shallow line around circumference with razor blade.
Bake at 375°F for 10 minutes, then lower to 325°F for 20-25 minutes until cracked and golden brown.
Warm icing sugar, water, and lemon juice in small pot. Dip cooled taralli in glaze and let dry on wire rack.
notes: Maria Vanelli's heirloom recipe: The crisp outer crust with sweet lemon glaze makes these irresistible.
originalPhotoCaption: Glazed Egg Taralli after baking with scored circumference and lemon glaze on wire rack

title: Sweet Taralli

ingredients.rawText: 1-2 tablespoons lemon juice/ water or milk (enough for desired thickness)

instructions: Glaze: In mixing bowl add the eggs, sugar, grappa and baking soda, beat on medium speed until light, about 5 minutes.
Add oil, combine, then add the salt and flour a little at a time, beating between additions. Knead the dough until smooth and soft.
Move the dough to a flat surface and knead 3 times to form a ball. Cover with a tea towel and let rest 30 minutes.
Cut into small pieces and roll into ropes about 6 long and 1/2 inch thick. Form into circles, wet ends to help them seal well, leaving a large hole.
Place on a clean tea towel. Bring water to boil In a large pot.

Drop 2-3 circles (making sure the hole is still quite large) into a pot of boiling water, stirring to make sure they don’t stick to the bottom of the pot. Once they rise to top, remove and place on clean towel and let cool.
Pre-heat oven to 400F (200C). Line 1-2 sheets with parchment paper.
Cut around the middle of the edge of the circle, in but not through.

Bake in pre-heated oven approximately 15 minutes, lower oven temperature to 300 ° F (150 ° C) and continue to bake for approximately 15-20 minutes or until lightly golden. The cookies bake up very light
Place cookies on wire rack to cool completely then cover or dip in the glaze. Sprinkle with sprinkles and serve. Enjoy!

title: Tea Crumpets

ingredients.rawText: 4 crumpet rings or 7.5cm/3 inch plain pastry cutters, greased
ingredients.normalizedName: crumpet rings cm inch plain pastry cutters

instructions: Place flour and salt in large bowl. Stir in sugar and yeast making a well in the centre. Pour in warm milk and water and mix until batter is thick. Beat well until completely combined and cover with tea towel or cling film.
Leave in a warm place to rise for about an hour until it's a light, spongy texture. Stir well to knock out any air and pour into a large jug.

Heat a non-stick frying pan over a very low heat with a drop of oil. Wipe the pan with kitchen paper to remove excess oil. Sit the greased crumpet rings in the pan and leave to heat up for a couple of minutes.

Pour in enough mixture to fill the rings just halfway up over the sides. Leave to cook until plenty of small holes appear on the surface and the batter has just dried out. This will take about 8-10 minutes.
Remove the rings and turn over the crumpets to cook for a further minute or two on the other side. Sit the first batch of crumpets on a wire rack while continuing to cook the remaining mixture.

title: Walnut Roll

ingredients.rawText: Icing sugar, for dusting 50g butter, melted

instructions: For the filling: Dissolve yeast and 1 tsp of sugar in warm milk. Allow yeast to rise for 10 minutes or until foamy.
Sift flour and salt into large mixing bowl. Add yeast mixture, egg yolk, sugar, butter and lemon rind, and mix to form a soft dough.
Turn out dough on floured work surface and knead for 5 minutes or until dough is smooth. Place in mixing bowl, cover and let rise in a warm place for about 1 hour or until doubled in size.
To make filling, pour boiling milk over walnuts, sugar, raisins, butter, rum and cinnamon and mix well. Set aside to cool.
On floured work surface roll dough out into a rectangle 5mm thick.

Spread the filling evenly over the dough and roll up, making sure that the filling is sealed inside. Place, seam side down on greased baking sheet and allow to rise in a warm place for another 30 minutes.
Brush roll with the beaten egg white and bake in preheated oven 170°for 40 minutes or until golden. Cool before slicing and dust with icing sugar.

title: Active Dry Yeast Proof
instructions: The temperature in the room should be around 68–75°F. (20–24°C) for the dough to rise properly. Whisk the sugar in 100°F. water to dissolve. Add the yeast, stir gently and let it sit 5-10 minutes. When it is a creamy foam the yeast is alive and should be combined with the other dry ingredients. If there is no creamy foam the yeast is dead, so start over with a new packet of yeast.
notes: Proofing yeast tests it vitality and proves it’s vigorous enough to make dough rise. Active dry yeast, instant (or rapid-rise), or fresh yeast needs to multiply and grow in a moist, nutritious (sugar) and warm environment. To proof yeast, dissolve the yeast with sugar and wait 5-10 minutes until it’s creamy- looking with many small bubbles.

title: White Pizza Topping No Sauce
instructions: Combine ingredients and stir in a bowl.
Place ingredients on pizza as desired

title: Rosina’s Authentic Pizza Dough
italianTitle: Pasta per la Pizza di Nonna Rosina

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 cup olive oil (or rendered pork fat)

instructions: Mix olive oil and lukewarm water in a large bowl.
Combine flour, salt, white pepper, and yeast; blend into oil and water.
Knead until smooth and elastic. Place in large greased bowl, turn to coat, cover with tea towel until doubled.
Punch down dough and knead four or five times.
Divide and stretch dough onto baking sheets.
Add toppings of choice (tomato sauce, mozzarella, mushrooms, pepperoni, fresh basil).
Bake in a preheated hot oven at 425°F for 20 minutes until crust is crispy and golden.
notes: Nonna Rosina's secret touch of rendered pork fat or pure olive oil produces an airy, golden crust with unmatched flavor.

title: Pizza Dough II

ingredients.rawText: 2 packets (1/4 oz each) active dry yeast
1/4 cup extra virgin olive oil, plus more for bowl and drizzling
4 cups all-purpose flour, plus more for work surface

instructions: Pour the water into a large bowl; sprinkle with yeast and let stand until foamy, about 5 minutes.
Whisk in the sugar, oil, and salt. Add flour and stir until a sticky dough forms.

Lightly brush another large bowl with a little olive oil. Place dough inside and drizzle a little oil over the top. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside in a warm, draft-free place until dough has doubled in size, about 1 hour.
Turn out onto a lightly floured work surface and gently knead 1 or 2 times forming into a ball. Let rest for about 10 more minutes.
Use or store as is for 1 large pizza, or divide into 4 equal portions for individual pizzas. own personal pizza
notes: Grandchildren love to make and eat their

title: Basic Pizza Dough

ingredients.rawText: 1 tablespoon active dry yeast, or 1 oz (25 gr) brewer’s yeast

instructions: In a small bowl, sprinkle the yeast on the warm water, and stir to dissolve. Set aside until the yeast bubbles in about 5 minutes.
Sift the flour. Pour the flour into a large bowl or on a work surface. * Mold the flour in a mound shape with a hole in the centre.
Pour the yeast mix, olive oil, and a pinch of salt in the centre
Using a spatula draw the ingredients together.
Then mix with your hands to form a dough.
Sprinkle some flour on work surface. Place dough on floured surface.
Knead the dough briefly with your hands pushing and folding. * Knead just long enough for the dough to take in a little more flour and until it no longer sticks to your hands.
With your hand, spread a little olive oil inside a bowl.
Transfer the dough into the bowl.
On the top of the dough, make two incisions that cross and spread with a very small amount of olive oil. This last step will prevent the surface of the dough from breaking too much while rising.

Cover the bowl with a kitchen cloth, and set the bowl aside for approximately 1½ – 2 hours until the dough doubles in volume. The time required for rising will depend on the strength of the yeast and the temperature of the room. When the dough is double its original size, punch it down to eliminate the air bubbles.
On a lightly floured work surface, cut the dough into three equal pieces.
On the work surface, using a rolling pin and your hands, shape one piece of dough into a thin round layer. Make a pizza about 12 inches in diametre.

Make a pizza about 12 inches in diametre and transfer it to the pan. Using your fingertips, push from the centre to the sides to cover the entire surface of the pan with a thin layer of pasta. Repeat this step with the other 2 dough pieces to obtain 3 pizzas.
At this point the pizza is ready to receive its topping (see recipes).
Add your preferred topping onto your pizza. Sprinkle with a pinch of salt and pepper if indicated by the recipe.
notes: Makes 3 - 12 inch (30 cm) pizzas  Cook the pizza in a regular oven at 500°F. (260°C.) for 20–25 minutes.  The cheese for a home made pizza, if present in the recipe, should be added 5 – 10 minutes before removing the pizza from the oven.  To check for readiness, lift one side of the pizza. The pizza is ready when the bottom surface is light brown.

title: Pizza Freeze
instructions: In the bowl of a standup mixer, combine yeast, water, and sugar, and let sit for 10 minutes. The liquid should be foamy and bubbly, indicating that the yeast is alive.

Add bread flour, olive oil, salt, and stir using the dough hook or a wooden spoon, until roughly combined. Fit the bowl and the dough hook onto the standup mixer and knead on medium low speed for 10 minutes until smooth. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and let rise for about 30 minutes, until the dough has doubled in size.
Remove the dough to a lightly floured surface and divide into four even pieces. Shape each piece of dough into a ball.
The dough is now ready to be rolled out and baked, or ready to freeze.

To freeze pizza dough, place the pizza dough balls into resealable plastic bags. Make sure that if you put multiple balls of dough in one bag, you use parchment paper or wax paper to keep them separated.
To thaw, place the pizza dough in the refrigerator the morning before you want to make dinner, then roll and bake as usual.
To bake, preheat oven to 500ºF. Roll thawed (or freshly made) dough and bake each pizza about 10–15 minutes.

title: Topping for 1 pizza

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup (250 gr) tomatoes, puréed in a blender
2 oz (60 gr) fresh mozzarella cheese, sliced

instructions: *Prepare the basic pizza dough as per recipe
Preheat oven to 500°F. (260°C).
Place the tomatoes in a bowl. Stir in 1 tablespoon of the olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread the tomato evenly over the pizza.
With your hands, break the basil leaves into small pieces. Distribute the basil uniformly over the pizza.
Spread the rest of the olive oil on the pizza. Add salt.
Bake the pizza for approximately 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and add the mozzarella cheese.
Cook for 10 more minutes approximately. Lift one side to check for readiness. Pizza is ready when the bottom surface is light brown.
Top with a few more fresh basil leaves if desired and serve.

title: Pizza with Arugula and Beef Prosciuto

ingredients.rawText: 2 oz (60 gr) beef prosciutto, finely sliced
1 oz (30 gr) aged parmigiano reggiano shavings

instructions: Topping for 1 pizza: Prepare the basic pizza dough
Preheat oven 500F (260 C). Top the pizza with only 2-3 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil.
Bake the pizza for approximately 25 minutes or until thoroughly cooked but still very light brown and soft.
While the pizza is cooking, place the arugula in a bowl. Top with 2 - 3 tablespoons of extra-virgin olive oil and salt. Toss thoroughly.
Spread the beef prosciutto slices evenly over the pizza.
Top with the arugula.
Add the parmigiano shavings. Cheese shavings can be easily done with a vegetable peeler.
Serve immediately when the pizza is still warm.

title: Pizza al Tomato, Mushrooms, Mozzarella

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup (250 gr) tomatoes, puréed in a blender
4 oz (120 gr) brown cremini mushrooms, finely sliced
2 oz (60 gr) fresh mozzarella cheese, diced

Place the tomatoes in a bowl. Stir in 1 tablespoon of the olive oil, salt, and pepper. Spread the tomato evenly over the pizza.
Distribute mushrooms uniformly on the pizza.
Spread the rest of the olive oil on the pizza. Add salt and pepper.
Bake the pizza for approximately 10 minutes. Remove from the oven and add the mozzarella cheese.
Cook for qpproximately 10 more minutes. Lift one side to check for readiness. Pizza is ready when the bottom surface is light brown.

title: Pizza with Potatoes & Rosemary
instructions: Topping for 1 pizza: Prepare the basic pizza dough
Preheat oven to 500°F. (260°C.)
Evenly spread potato slices over the pizza.
Top with the rosemary leaves.
Spread the olive oil on the pizza.
Add salt and pepper.
Bake the pizza for about 20 - 25 minutes.
Lift one side to check for readiness.
Pizza is ready when bottom is light brown. personal pizza.
