title: Tomato-Spinach Roulade (Bread Roll)

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup Swiss, Mozzarella or Fontina cheese, grated

instructions: Puree tomatoes and their liquid in blender.
Pour into a medium-sized saucepan and heat gently to 115ºF.
Remove from heat and stir in yeast and sugar.
Let stand until foamy, about 10 minutes.
Transfer tomato-yeast mixture to a large mixing bowl.
Add finely chopped onion, garlic, basil, oregano, celery seeds, salt and grated cheese; stir to mix.
Stir in enough flour, 1 cup at a time, to make a firm dough.
Knead on a floured surface until smooth and elastic, about 10 minutes, adding more flour if necessary.
Place dough in a large buttered bowl and turn to butter evenly
Cover with a damp towel and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk, 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
While dough is rising, melt the butter in a medium sized saucepan over medium/low heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, 5 to 7 minutes
Stir in spinach and cook 5 more minutes.
Stir in cheese, Marsala, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Refrigerate covered until firm enough to spread.
Punch down dough and divide in half. Roll each half into a rectangle about 3/4 inch thick and spread with spinach filling.
Roll each rectangle like a jelly roll & place on greased sheets.
Cover loosely with plastic wrap and let rise 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 375ºF
Beat egg and 2 teaspoons of water in a small bowl.
Brush each loaf with the egg wash.
Bake until loaves are lightly browned and sound hollow when thumped, 40 to 50 minutes.
Allow to cool on baking sheets for 10 minutes.
Place on wire racks and cool completely before cutting and serving.

title: Stuffed Rolled Pizza Bread

ingredients.rawText: Stir fried potatoes, zucchini, onions, peppers and eggplants,

instructions: Stuffing: Optional: beaten egg white or beaten milk for brushing
With rolling pin roll out pizza dough into a large disc.
Spread stuffing on top.
From one end roll up the dough and form into a loaf.
Squeeze both ends together to keep stuffing inside.
Let rise until doubled.
May be brushed with beaten egg whites or milk to give crust a sheen.
Bake 375°F. for 30 minutes.
Cool, slice and serve.

title: Unbelievable Spinach Calzones
italianTitle: Calzoni Ripieni di Spinaci e Ricotta

ingredients.rawText: 1 package (32 oz) pizza dough or bread dough, thawed
1 package (10 oz) frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a large bowl, mix together ricotta, eggs, Italian seasoning, mozzarella, Parmesan, and well-squeezed spinach.
Divide bread/pizza dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll each piece out to an 8-inch circle.
Spoon about 1/2 cup of ricotta-spinach filling onto one half of each circle.
Fold over into half-moons and crimp edges firmly with fork tines to seal.
Place onto greased cookie sheets and bake for 30 minutes until golden brown.
Serve hot with warm marinara dipping sauce.
notes: Calzones are classic Italian 'finger food' turnovers. Perfect for casual family gatherings.

title: Unbelievable Spinach Calzones

ingredients.rawText: 1 (10 ounce) package frozen chopped spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
1 (32 ounce) package frozen white bread dough, thawed

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400ºF. (200ºC.).
In a large bowl, mix together the ricotta cheese, eggs, Italian seasoning, mozzarella cheese, Parmesan cheese and spinach. Set aside.

Divide the bread dough into 8 pieces and roll each piece out to about an 8 inch circle. Spoon about 1/2 cup of the ricotta filling onto each circle, fold over and seal the edges. Place onto a greased cookie sheet.
Bake for 30 minutes in the preheated oven, or until nicely browned on the tops and bottoms. Serves: 8
notes: Delicious, satisfying and very easy to make. They may be served with warmed spaghetti sauce to dip them in and a salad. Yum!"

title: Enchiladas
instructions: Tortillas: Enchiladas sauce : 1 can (28 oz) tomatoes 2 tbsp oil 2 cloves garlic, minced 2 tbsp onion, minced 3 tsp chili powder 1 tbsp flour 1 tsp crushed red peppers 1 tsp salt
Tortilla filling: To make tortilla filling :
Mince onion in blender and grate cheese in blender
Mix grated cheese, minced onion and salt thoroughly
Cover and set aside
To prepare enchilada sauce: Drain tomatoes reserving 3/4 cup of juice
In saucepan, brown onion and garlic in oil until golden
Stir in flour until smooth. Add tomato juice, tomatoes and seasonings
Cover and simmer until thickened To prepare tortillas: Batter should yield 12 tortillas
Combine flour, corn meal, salt, egg and water in a large mixer bowl and beat with electric mixer on low speed until smooth
Preheat electric griddle or frying pan to 375ºF
Spoon batter, 3 tbsps at a time onto the hot, ungreased surface
Spread batter to make very thin, 6-inch pancakes
Turn tortillas when edges begin to look dry, not brown
Bake other side and keep warm in covered pan.
To prepare enchiladas: Place a large spoonful of tortilla filling on each tortilla, roll up
Arrange, seam down in a 13 X 9 X 2 inch baking dish
Cover with enchilada sauce and sprinkle with remaining filling
Bake in 350ºF oven 25 - 30 minutes or until hot and bubbling Additional time is required for chilled or frozen enchiladas; allow about 1 1/4 hours to heat when frozen. Servings 4-6
notes: Sandy V. Tip: **Enchiladas may be prepared in advance and refrigerated or frozen.

title: Cottage Cheese Enchiladas

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 tsp each chili powder and oregano

instructions: In large skillet over medium heat cook beef, stirring to break it up for 5 minutes or until brown; pour off fat.
Add garlic, onion and pepper, cook until tender
Stir in chili powder, oregano and hot pepper flakes, salt, pepper, water and lemon juice
Stir in cottage cheese and Parmesan cheese
Simmer 5 minutes
Place 1/4 cup of meat mixture across centre of each tortilla
Roll up and place seam-side down in lightly greased shallow baking dish
Top with salsa and mozzarella.
Bake at 350ºF (180ºC) oven for 10 minutes.
Serve with dollop of sour cream

title: Focaccia with Rosemary
instructions: In a bowl combine flour, salt, yeast, and 6 tbsp olive oil. Slowly add warm water mixing with a fork until pliable dough forms.
Knead on work surface for 10 minutes, shape into a ball, and let rise in a warm place covered for 1 hour.
Work dough briefly, then press out onto a round 14-inch baking pan greased with olive oil.
Poke deep dimples all over the dough with fingers. Let rise again for 1 hour.
Brush generously with extra-virgin olive oil and sprinkle coarse sea salt.
Bake in preheated oven at 450°F for 15-20 minutes.
Halfway through baking, brush with olive oil and scatter fresh rosemary leaves on top.
Bake until golden brown. Serve warm with sliced prosciutto and provolone.
notes: Dimpling the dough allows olive oil and salt to pool in pockets, creating iconic flavor bursts.

title: Focaccia Cold Pizza

ingredients.rawText: 1 thin crust focaccia pre-cooked pizza shell
ingredients.normalizedName: crust focaccia pre cooked pizza shell

ingredients.rawText: 1 pkg of cream cheese at room temperature
3/4 oz light miracle whip or mayonnaise

instructions: Mix and cream all above ingredients until smooth
Smooth evenly onto the focaccia pre-cooked pizza shell
Top with assorted pre-cut vegetables
Cool.
Cut into pizza slices

title: Focaccia

ingredients.rawText: 1 pkg or 1 tbsp dry active yeast

instructions: In a large bowl, stir potato flakes with hot milk. Set aside to cool slightly.
Stir sugar into warm water until dissolved. Sprinkle yeast over top but do not stir. Let stand until top is foamy before stirring, about 10 minutes. then stir until blended.
Stir 1 cup flour into potato puree. Stir in yeast mixture, olive oil and table salt. Stir in flour, 1/2 cup at a time, until dough becomes stiff. (Some flour will be left over at this point).

Turn dough out onto a floured surface. Lightly flour hands. Knead dough working in more flour as dough becomes sticky. When dough becomes smooth and springy, after about 7 minutes of kneading, form into a ball. (All flour may not be used.) Sprinkle flour beneath and overtop of dough. Loosely cover with plastic wrap or waxed paper and cover with a damp tea towel. Let rise on counter until doubled in size, about 30 to 45 minutes then punch down.

Place dough on a greased cookie sheet. Pat dough into a rectangle about 1/2 inch thick. Brush with additional olive oil. Sprinkle with coarse salt and toppings. Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes. Meanwhile, arrange rack below oven centre and preheat oven to 375ºF.
Poke deep indentations on top of crust, about 1 inch apart, to break any air bubbles. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until golden brown.
Cool on a wire rack and serve warm.
Focaccia toppings;: Coarsely chop 1/2 cup toasted pine nuts. Press into top of focaccia along with coarse salt.

Coarsely chop 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes packed in oil, or sun-dried tomatoes that have been soaked in hot water until softened. Work drained tomatoes into kneaded dough just before first rising. Replace coarse salt with 1/4 tsp freshly group black pepper.

Coarsely chop half a sweet Spanish onion. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a frying pan set over medium heat. Sauté onion until softened and lightly browned, about 5 minutes. Stir in 1 tsp balsamic vinegar. Work into kneaded dough just before first rising.

Add 1/2 cup Parmesan cheese to potato puree in step 3 of focaccia recipe. Mix 1 crushed garlic clove with 1 tsp olive oil. Spread over shaped focaccia just before second rising. Sprinkle with 1 tsp each of dried basil and leaf oregano.
Sprinkle 2 to 3 tsp dried rosemary leaves over unbaked focaccia.

title: Spring Rolls
instructions: Mix ground meat, vegetables, eggs and seasonings well.
Put a tbsp of mixture on spring roll wrapper. Roll into a tube.
Deep fry into boiling oil on medium/high heat until spring roll is golden brown or meat is cooked.
Serve with your choice of dipping sauce and enjoy.

title: Beef Tacos

ingredients.rawText: 1 - 7 1/2 oz can tomato sauce or barbecue sauce
1 cup grated cheese or strips of processed cheese

instructions: Brown meat in oil and then add onion and sauté
Stir in seasonings and cook 5 minutes. Add stock and tomato sauce
Simmer uncovered 3/4 hour or until sauce in thick
If desired you may add 1/2 tsp flour to thicken sauce but remember to stir constantly.
Mixture should not be soupy, cook longer if necessary
Spoon beef mixture into taco shells and top with shredded lettuce and grated cheese fat, holding edges apart with tongs or forks until brown and crisp
notes: Tip: *To make taco shells, dip tortillas into hot fat. Bend in half and fry in hot

title: Chicken Tortillas

ingredients.rawText: 2 (9 oz) package of frozen cooked chicken breast strips, thawed
4 oz can green chilies or jalapeno peppers, chopped
1 cup questo blanco (white Mexican cheese) or Monterey Jack cheese

instructions: Shred chicken and set aside. Heat oil in heavy skillet and sauté onions and garlic until softened.
Beat cream cheese until smooth and add heavy cream. Mix well.
Stir in chicken, onions, and garlic. Add crumbled cheese and set aside.
In food processor bowl or blender, place tomatillos and chili sauce. Puree or blend until smooth.
Add green chilies, chopped cilantro, and 1 cup heavy cream.
Soften tortillas in microwave on high heat for 1-2 minutes.
Fill tortillas with cream cheese/chicken mixture, roll up, and place in 9”x13" glass baking dish.
Pour tomatillo/chili sauce over filled enchiladas and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake at 350°ºF. for 20-30 minutes until bubbly and heated through. Serves 10

title: Refrigerator Cookies

ingredients.rawText: Cookie dough may be stored in the refrigerator for several days, or carefully
ingredients.normalizedName: cookie dough may be stored in refrigerator several days

instructions: wrapped and stored in the freezer for several months.
notes: Refrigerator cookies are the answer to having fresh cookies on a moment’s notice. They are usually made with a rich dough which is very stiff and shaped into long rolls 1 or 2 inches in diameter. Because they are refrigerated before baking, they can be sliced quite thin for a very tender cookie. For a festive touch, roll the entire roll in finely chopped nuts or coloured

title: Basic Refrigerator Cookies

ingredients.rawText: ½ cup firmly packed brown sugar

instructions: In a large bowl, combine white sugar, brown sugar, margarine, vanilla and egg; blend well.
Stir in flour, baking powder and salt; blend well.
Stir in nuts. Divide dough in half on 2 sheets of waxed paper; shape each half into a roll 1 1/2 inches in diameter.
Wrap; chill until firm, about 2 hours.
Heat oven to 425ºF.
Cut dough into 1/4 inch slices.
Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 425ºF for 5 to 7 minutes or until light brown. Immediately remove from cookie sheet.
notes: * For Orange or Lemon Refrigerator Cookies , add 1 tablespoon grated peel with flour. *For Spice Refrigerator Cookies , add 1 teaspoon cinnamon, 1/2 teaspoon nutmeg and 1/4 to 1/2 teaspoon cloves with flour. *For Coconut Refrigerator Cookies , add 1 cup coconut with nuts. *Cookie dough keeps for up to 2 weeks in refrigerator and up to 6 weeks in the freezer. Slice and bake frozen dough as directed above.

title: Fruit and Nut Refrigerator Cookies
instructions: Mix flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt.
Cream butter, shortening, sugar, eggs and vanilla. Mix together.
Add nuts and fruit. Shape into 2 rolls.
Wrap; chill until firm.
Slice into ¼ inch slices.
Preheat oven 375F and line cookie sheets with parchment paper.
Bake on ungreased sheets in a 375°F. oven for 8-12 minutes.

title: Oatmeal Refrigerator Cookies
instructions: In large bowl, combine first 4 ingredients; blend well.
Stir in flour, soda and baking powders and salt; blend well.
Add remaining ingredients; mix well.
Divide dough in half on 2 sheets of waxed paper; shape each half into a roll 2 inches in diameter.
Wrap; chill until firm, about 2 hours.
Heat oven to 375ºF.
Cut dough into 1/4 inch slices.
Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375ºF for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.
Immediately remove from cookie sheet.

title: Almond Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºF
Beat eggs and add sugar
Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well
Drop mixture by tsp on cookie sheets covered with parchment
Bake for 20 minutes
notes: Assunta Cristinziano.

title: Almond Crescents
instructions: Cream butter (softened at room temperature) with icing sugar until fluffy with spatula or wooden spoon
Stir in four and almonds gradually.
Add vanilla and cold water and mix until well blended
Roll and shape dough a tsp at a time into small crescents
Place 1 inch apart on parchment covered cookie sheets
Bake at 350ºF for 12-15 minutes until lightly browned
Roll warm crescents in icing sugar
Cool on wire racks

title: Almond Orange Crescents
instructions: Combine all ingredients
With hands, by heaping tsp form into balls then crescents
Place on parchment paper covered cookie sheets
Bake at 350ºF for 10 minutes
When cool, sprinkle icing sugar and store in metal containers

title: Almond Loaves
instructions: Make dough softer than Easter bread
Shape dough into three loaves
Place on parchment covered cookie sheets
Bake at 350ºF for 20 minutes
Test with a toothpick

title: Almond Slices

ingredients.rawText: 3 or 4 drops almond or anisette extract

instructions: Beat eggs well and gradually add sugar
Add oil. When well mixed remove from mixer and add flour, baking powder and salt
Add nuts
Form into loaves and place on aluminum foil cookie sheets. Dough should be very soft. Therefore, separate the three loaves with aluminum partitions into between the loaves.
Bake at 350ºF. 15 minutes.
Remove and cut into slices
Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon
Return to oven and bake until golden

title: Amaretti Cocoa

ingredients.rawText: 4 oz almonds, roasted and finely grated

instructions: Mix eggs and sugar. Add and blend in oil and almond extract
Add grated lemon rind
Combine cocoa, flour, baking powder and add to mixture stirring until well blended. Add grated almonds and stir until blended
Drop by teaspoon and roll in sugar
Place rolled sugared dough onto greased cookie sheet
Place whole almond or coffee bean on cookie if desired
Bake 10 minutes at 350ºF

title: Assunta’s Amaretti
notes: Assunta C.

title: Cherry Covered Amaretti

ingredients.rawText: ½ small bottle of almond extract

instructions: Mix together to form a stiff dough. Form into small balls like walnuts
Roll in icing sugar and top with cherries. Bake at 350ºF for 15-20 mins.

title: Julie’s Amaretti
instructions: Combine ingredients
Drop by tsp into icing sugar and roll
Place on parchment covered cookie sheets
Place whole or half almond or coffee bean in centre if desired
Bake 15 minutes a 350ºF

title: Amaretti Cookies

ingredients.rawText: 2 ½ cups almond flour or 3 cups of blanched slivered almonds, finely ground

instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F. and line baking sheets with parchment paper
In a food processor mix together the almond flour and sugar.
Add the vanilla and almond extract and pulse for a few seconds
Add eggs, one at a time, and continue to process until dough is smooth.
Place teaspoons of dough on the parchment paper and dust with sugar.
Bake for 24-30 minutes or until golden.
Cool completely before serving. They will be slightly chewy at first, but they will be nicely crispy as a day or two goes by. Store in a cool, dry place.

title: Traditional Almond Biscotti (Cantucci)

ingredients.rawText: 4 teaspoons baking powder and 3/4 tsp salt

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line two cookie sheets with parchment paper.
Beat sugar and butter until light and fluffy. Add eggs one at a time, beating well.
Mix brandy, anise extract, and vanilla together. Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt.
Alternately add dry ingredients and brandy mixture to butter cream. Stir in whole almonds and anise seeds.
Drop dough onto sheets to form two 2x13 inch logs. Smooth tops with moistened fingers.
Bake 30-35 minutes until golden and firm. Cool completely on racks (15 mins). Reduce oven to 300°F.
Cut logs on diagonal into 3/4-inch slices with a serrated knife. Lay slices flat on sheets.
Bake 20 minutes (turn after 10 mins) until crisp, dry, and lightly toasted.
notes: 'Biscotti' means twice-baked ('bis-cotto'). Perfect for dipping in espresso, Vin Santo, or sweet dessert wine.

title: Chewy Almond Amaretti Cookies

ingredients.rawText: 2 1/2 cups almond flour (or 3 cups blanched almonds, finely ground)

instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F. Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
In a food processor, pulse almond flour and sugar together.
Add vanilla and almond extract. Pulse briefly.
Add egg whites one at a time and process until a smooth, stiff paste forms.
Roll teaspoons of dough into balls, roll in powdered sugar, and place on parchment.
Bake for 24-30 minutes until golden on the outside with delicate crackles.
Cool completely. Crisp outside, tender and chewy almond marzipan center.
notes: Naturally gluten-free and dairy-free! Stored in an airtight container, they stay chewy and delicious for weeks.

title: Almond Apricot Biscotti

ingredients.rawText: ½ stick (1/4 cup) cold salted butter, cut into small pieces
1 cup whole almonds with skins (5 ½ oz), toasted and cooled
1 large egg yolk, beaten with 1 tablespoon water for egg wash

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
Blend in butter with a pastry blender or your fingertips until mixture resembles coarse meal.
Add whole egg, milk and extracts stirring with a fork until a soft dough forms.
Knead in almonds.

Divide dough between 2 sheets of wax paper then firmly form into 2 equal mounds and flatten each mound into a 5 inch disk. Put half of the apricots in centre of one disk and fold dough over apricots to enclose them (use wax paper as an aid if necessary).

Transfer roll to a parchment lined baking sheet. Form into a 14 by 2 ½ inch log lengthwise on one side of baking sheet spreading dough with wet hands. Repeat with the other half of the dough and apricots. Put second log about 4 inches from the first log.
Brush logs with egg wash and bake in middle of oven until pale golden and firm, about 20 minutes. Cool on baking sheet on a rack for 20 minutes.
Reduce oven to 300°F. while logs cool.
Carefully transfer baked logs to a cutting board using 2 wide metal spatulas then cut logs diagonally into ½ inch wide slices with a large heavy knife.

Line baking sheet with clean parchment paper. Stand slices, curved sides up, ½ inch apart on baking sheet and bake in upper rack of oven until biscotti are dry, about 30 minutes (they will become hard as they cool) transfer biscotti to rack to cool. instead of half and forming into 3 logs, using a third of the apricots for each. Biscotti keep well layered between sheets of wax paper in an airtight container at room temperature for 2 weeks.
notes: Note: Smaller and more biscotti can be made by dividing dough into thirds

title: Almond Biscotti di Mandorle Concetta
instructions: Food colouring may be added for different colours
ALMOND BISCOTTI SLICES (A Fette) Bruna & Kathy 6 eggs 24 oz flour 8 oz sugar 1 pinch of salt 6 oz milk 4 oz oil 1 cup whole roasted almonds 1 lemon rind, grated 5 tsp baking powder
Blend all ingredients together and roll into a log
Bake at 350ºF until golden brown and slice when warm.
notes: Concetta S.

title: Almond Imma Biscotti
instructions: Preheat oven to 300°F.
Grease and flour two baking sheets.
Mix dry ingredients together in a large bowl.
Whisk the eggs and vanilla extract together then stir into the dry ingredients. Add the almonds and stir them into the dough. Dough should be sticky.
Divide dough into 2 parts. Shape each part into a flat loaf about 10 inches long. Cut into thin slices about ¼ inch wide.
Lay the slices on the baking sheets and cook for 10-15 minutes. Turn over each slice and cook for a further 10-15 minutes or until slices are golden brown.
Remove from oven and allow to cool.
When cool, store in an airtight container. The biscotti will keep for a couple of weeks. Makes 3 dozen.

title: Almond Biscotti Variations

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup (2 sticks) butter at room temperature
5 large eggs, at room temperature (take out of fridge about 10-20 minutes
2 cups almonds (whole or lightly toasted, coarsely chopped)

instructions: Optional: Chocolate chips to use for dipping after biscotti are baked: Preheat oven to 350ºF.
Prepare two sheet pans with parchment paper. Set aside.
Prepare two cutting boards. One for rolling and one for cutting, or use one and wash after rolling.

Roast almonds in a conventional oven for about 10 minutes at 350ºF. Almonds should look light brown inside and not white in colour. Cool. Coarsely chop in food processor if desired. Leaving almonds whole gives your batter more of a butter taste. Set aside.
Drop oven to 325ºF.
Combine flour, baking powder and salt.
Beat butter and sugar with electric mixer at medium speed until light and fluffy, about 3 minutes. Scrape sides and bottom of bowl.

Add vanilla and almond extract to eggs. Then add egg mixture to butter/sugar mixture in four or five parts . Mix well after each addition until light and fluffy, about 2 minutes. Scrape sides and bottom of bowl after each addition. Repeat until all egg mixture is added.
Add flour mixture and almonds. Mix at low speed until combined.

Place dough on a cutting board lightly dusted with flour. Dust hands with flour. Use only enough flour so dough does not stick to board or your hands. Do not overwork dough. Divide dough in half. Roll a log about 13 inches long and about 1 ½ inches diameter.

Transfer log to baking sheet. Press down to form a log about 4 ½ inches wide by ½ inch high. Logs will spread ½ to 1 inch when they bake. So place unbaked logs 1 ½ to 2 inches apart from each other on pan.
Bake in preheated oven at 325ºF for 35 minutes or until a light gold colour (do not over bake). Remove from oven.
Increase oven to 350ºF.
When logs are cool enough to handle (10-15 minutes) slice with a knife. Okay if completely cooled. Cut straight or on diagonal about ½ inch in width.
Flip side down on baking sheet.
Return to oven about 10 minutes or until browned to preference. Watch them so that they do not burn.

Storage: Store biscotti in an air tight container or bag for several weeks. Keep away from heat and humidity especially if dipped in chocolate. Freeze if desired by double bagging or using an airtight container
notes: * For chocolate covered biscotti , melt chocolate chips in a double boiler. Dip biscotti in chocolate. Let dry. Serve. For thinner dipping chocolate use 2 tablespoons of heavy cream for every 1/3 cup chocolate chips. * For miniature biscotti , divide dough in four parts. Roll each part into a log, about 15 inches long and 1 inch in diameter. Press down to form a log about 2 ½ inches wide about ½ inch high. Rest of recipe is the same. * For chocolate biscotti . Remove almonds and almond extract. (combine 1/3 cup cocoa powder lightly packed into flour mixture and 2 cups chocolate chips. Dip in melted chocolate chips if desired for a more chocolaty taste. Rest of recipe remains the same. * For lemon biscotti. Remove almonds and almond extract. Add ¾ teaspoon of natural lemon oil. Rest of the recipe remains the same. * For vanilla biscotti. Remove almonds and almond extract. Dip in melted chocolate chips if desired. Rest of the recipe remains the same. Mixing hint; Batter typically takes on the temperature of the room and weather. If mixing in a hot kitchen (70-75 F) to avoid a sticky batter, you may need to reduce missing times to 1 minute or less when adding eggs and mix just enough until eggs are absorbed into the mixture. Rolling hint: If your kitchen is hot (70-75F) dough may be sticky. Add enough flour so you can roll it and dough does not stick to your fingers. Toasting hint: In warmer weather or humidity, you may need to toast longer to get a dry crisp texture, but be careful not to burn them. As soon as they are cool, bag, or place in tin immediately.

title: Italian Almond Biscotti
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. and line 2 cookie sheets with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, cream the butter and sugar together.
Add eggs one at a time; beat until fluffy.
Stir in the anise and vanilla extracts.
Sift together the flour, baking powder and salt. Add flour mixture to the egg mixture along with the chopped almonds.
Stir with a wooden spoon as dough comes together.
Knead by hand.
Divide dough into 4 parts. Roll each part into a log about 15 inches long. Place logs onto cookie sheets, 2 per sheet, the long way.
Flatten logs out until they are about 3 inches wide with a slight hump down the middle.
Bake for 25 – 30 minutes until loaves are firm.
Remove, cool until able to handle. Cut loaves on a cutting board into diagonal slices ½ inches wide.
Toast on one side then turn them over to toast the other side. This should take 7 to 10 minutes.

title: Raffalini Almond Biscotti
instructions: Boil almonds, drain
Put almonds on a dish towel and rub dry. Skin will come off
Grind peeled almonds in food processor
Mix almonds, flour, sugar and cinnamon and make a well
Add eggs and mix lightly
Drop by tsp on parchment paper covered cookie sheet
Bake 6 minutes at 350ºF then 1 minute under broiler ¼ lb butter 6 oz milk Icing sugar
Melt butter and mix in icing sugar and milk
Mixture should be liquidy
Pour with finger when cookies are cool
notes: Rita V. Icing:

title: Biscotti Arrotolati Rolled jelly-nut Crescent
instructions: Filling: 1 tsp cinnamon 1 lb nuts, crushed (walnuts) 7 oz grape jelly
Melt yeast and 1 of tsp sugar in ½ cup warm water.
Put flour and pinch of salt in bowl and make a well.
Mix eggs, ½ cup sugar, vanillina, grated lemon, Crisco and pour in well.
Mix all together, cover and put in refrigerator overnight.
Next day take dough out of the refrigerator and make small balls and flatten with rolling pin.
Combine filling ingredients and place on flattened balls and roll up.
Place rolled biscotti on cookie sheets and bake at 350°F. for 15-20 minutes

title: Biscotti Arrotolati Concetta Crescents
instructions: Dissolve yeast in water
Mix in above ingredients and refrigerate for 24 hours
Filling: Mix filling ingredients together
Make dough into size of walnuts and roll out into circles
Place filling onto rolled circle and roll up into crescents
Dip rolled crescents in sugar on top side only
Bake at 350ºF until golden
notes: (Rolled Crescents) Concetta S.

title: Almond Cranberry Biscotti

ingredients.rawText: ½ cup almonds, sliced or ¼ cup cranberries

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line pans with parchment paper

In a large bowl, stir together flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, almonds, and orange zest. Make a well in centre of flour mixture. Add all the eggs, oil, and almond extract. Stir or mix by hand until the mixture forms a ball.
Separate dough into 2 pieces and roll each piece into a log about 8 inches long. Place logs on pans and flatten to about ¾ inch thick.
Bake for 20-25 minutes.
Cool slightly and remove from sheets and put on cutting board.
Slice diagonally into ½ inch thick slices with a serrated knife.
Set cookies onto cookie sheet and bake for 10-15 minutes, turn over after 7 minutes or half way through the time.
Finished cookies should be hard and crunchy.

title: Anise and Almond Biscotti
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. and line 2 cookie sheets with parchment paper
In large mixing bowl beat sugar and butter until light and fluffy.
Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition.
Combine brandy, anise extract and vanilla in a small bowl.
In a medium bowl combine flour, baking powder and salt.
Alternately add dry ingredients and brandy mixture to the butter mixture beginning and ending with dry ingredients.Stir in almonds and anise seed.
Drop dough by spoonfuls on cookie sheet, forming two 2 by 13 inch long strips on each sheet. Smooth dough into logs with moistened fingers.
Bake 30-35 minutes or until golden and firm to the touch.
Place cookie sheets on racks and cool completely.
Reduce the oven temperature to 300°F.
Cut cooled logs on diagonal into ¾ inch thick slices with serrated knife.
Place slices, cut side down back on cookie sheets.
Bake 20 minutes, turning after 10 minutes until dry and slightly brown.
Remove to a rack and cool.

title: Anise Biscotti
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Put parchment paper on cookie sheets.
In a medium bowl, beat together the oil, eggs, sugar and anise flavouring until well blended.

Combine flour and baking powder and stir into the egg mixture to form a heavy dough. Divide dough into two pieces. Form each piece into a roll as long as your cookie sheet. Place roll onto the cookie sheet and press down to ½ inch thickness.
Bake 25-30 minutes until golden brown. Place on wire rack to cool.
Slice each roll crosswise into ½ inch slices. Place cut side up back on baking sheet.
Bake 6 to 10 minutes on each side. Slices should be lightly toasted

title: Anise Walnut Biscotti
instructions: Preheat oven 375°F. Line cookie sheets with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, cream together butter and sugar.
Gradually add the vanilla and eggs while mixing.
Sift together the flour and baking powder and stir into the egg mixture.
For plain biscotti do not add the anything else.
Stir in the anise extract and anise seeds.
Add walnuts if desired.

Divide dough into 4 parts and put on cookie sheets. Wet or grease hands and shape dough out into 4 logs as long as baking sheet. Pat logs to about ¾ inch height and 3 inches wide. Brush with beaten egg yolk.
Bake 15 minutes until golden brown.
Slice logs at an angle, cutting pieces into ½ to ¾ inch wide cookies.
Place slices back onto the cookie sheet, standing upright if possible, leave a gap between the slices.
Return to oven and bake until cookies are dry and lightly toasted about 20 minutes more.

title: Candied Fruit Biscotti
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F. and line cookie sheets with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, cream butter and sugar. Blend in eggs and anise extract
Sift together flour, baking powder, and salt and stir into egg mixture.
Stir in the candied fruit. Refrigerate dough for an hour.
Divide dough into 4 equal parts and roll into a log about 12 inches long.
Place two logs on each cookie sheet and press down slightly. Leave space between the logs. Bake in oven for 25 – 30 minutes.
Remove from oven and let cool on pans about 5 minutes.
Place on cutting board and slice diagonally into ½ inch thick slices.
Put slices cut side down on baking sheet, return to oven for 16-18 min. or until lightly toasted. Cool on racks and store in airtight containers.

title: Chocolate Chip Fruit Slices Biscotti

ingredients.rawText: 200 gr. Butter (a little less than a cup)
12 oz toasted almonds, cut in half

instructions: Cream together eggs, sugar, butter and grated lemon peel
Stir in by hand chocolate chips, toasted cut almonds and mixed fruit
Mix together baking powder, flour and salt
Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients by hand
On a greased and floured cookie sheet form 1 1/2 “ wide “loaves” (the mixture will be sticky). Yields about 7 “loaves”.
Bake at 350ºF for 30-40 minutes until golden in colour. Slice loaves.
notes: Toni D.

title: Biscotti Limone
instructions: Dissolve yeast in a little water.
Mix in above ingredients and refrigerate if sticky.Shape into 4-6 loaves.
Place on parchment covered cookie pans.
Bake at 350°F. 25-30 min.
Slice while warm and return to oven for another 10 minutes until toasted on all sides.

title: Chocolate Chip Biscotti
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. and line parchment paper on cookie sheets
Whisk together the flour, baking powder and salt to evenly distribute the baking powder throughout the flour. Set aside.
Using a standup mixer, cream the butter until light coloured and fluffy. Add the sugar and continue to cream for another minute.
Grind the anise see in a grinder and add to the butter mixture along with the anise extract, brandy and egg. Mix until fully incorporated and for another 2 minutes.
Fold in the dry ingredients by hand with a spatula in thirds.
Fold in the chocolate chips.
Place the dough on a lightly floured board and roll into a log 2-3 inches in diameter and the length of a cookie sheet.
Bake in the upper third of the oven until golden brown about 30 minutes.
Remove from the oven and let cool on a cutting board for about 20 minutes or until the chocolate chips begin to harden up a bit.
Slice ½ to ¾ inch slices with a serrated knife. It is important to make each slice in one clean cut and to clean the knife of any chocolate between cuts to avoid chocolate “schmeers”.
Lay the slices back on the cookie sheet and return to oven for a final baking.
Bake until golden brown – about 10 minutes on each side.
Remove and cool completely before glazing with Orange Anise Glaze

Orange Anise Glaze: Mix all ingredients together. Add additional confectioners sugar, if needed, to get a thick consistency. If it’s too liquidy, it won’t harden well enough to pack the biscotti in a pretty jar.
Dip the biscotti in the glaze, smoothing out the glaze with a plastic basing brush as needed. Work quickly as once it starts to dry, it’s not too forgiving.

title: Cinnamon Mocha Biscotti

ingredients.rawText: ½ cup butter or ½ cup margarine, softened
½ cup miniature semisweet chocolate chips
1 tbsp instant espresso or 1 tbsp instant coffee granulates
½ cup cinnamon baking chips or ½ cup miniature chocolate morsels.
ingredients.normalizedName: cinnamon baking chips miniature chocolate morsels

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup chopped pecans or 1 cup special k cereal

instructions: Preheat convection oven to 325°F. or 350°F. regular oven.
Line cookie sheets with parchment paper.
Combine butter, sugars and espresso in a large bowl and beat with an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time, beating well after each addition. Add vanilla and mix briefly.
Add flour, baking powder, salt and cinnamon and mix until well blended. Fold in pecans, chocolate morsels and cinnamon chips.
Scoop dough out onto paper and form into a large rectangle, ¾ inch thick. Bake 25 minutes or until firm.
Use a serrated knife to cut the dough into ½ inch thick slices.
Place on cookie sheet and return to oven for 8 minutes.
Turn slices and bake another 8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Cool completely on wire racks before storing in airtight container.

title: Cinnamon Sugar Biscotti
instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F. Line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Sift together flour, cinnamon, baking powder, salt and set aside.
In a medium bowl, cream together 2/3 cup sugar and butter.
Beat in 1 egg, egg yolk and vanilla. Stir in the dry ingredients

On a lightly floured surface, divide dough into two pieces. Roll each piece into a log about 9 inches long and 1 ½ inches wide. Place logs on baking sheet and flatten slightly. Brush logs with beaten egg.
Bake for 25-30 minutes until golden and firm to touch.
Let cool for 15 minutes. Put on cutting board and slice each log crosswise at a diagonal into ½ inch thick slices using a serrated knife.
Place slices cut side down on baking sheet and sprinkle with a mixture of the remaining cinnamon and sugar.
Bake an additional 15 – 20 minutes until toasted.
Cool on wire racks and store in an airtight container.

title: Cranberry Orange Biscotti

ingredients.rawText: 1 (6 oz) pkg sweetened dried cranberries (such as craisins) or to taste.

instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Beat butter and sugar together in a bowl until mixture is creamy.
Beat in eggs, orange zest, orange and almond extracts.
Whisk flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a separate bowl.
Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients to make a stiff dough.
Mix sweetened cranberries into dough.
Form dough into a ball, cut into halves and shape each half into a log.
Place logs onto baking sheet.
Bake 20-25 minutes until the edges are lightly browned.
Let logs cool on wire racks completely
Cut logs into slices on a slight diagonal and return slices to cookie sheets
Bake biscotti until crisp and lightly golden brown about 7 minutes.

title: Gingerbread Biscotti
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F. Line cookie sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, mix together oil, sugar, eggs and molasses.
In another bowl mix flour, baking powder, ginger, cinnamon, cloves and nutmeg. Mix dry ingredients into egg mixture to form stiff dough.
Divide dough in half and shape each half into a roll the length of the cookie sheet. Place rolls on cookie sheet and pat down to flatten the dough to ½ inch thickness.
Bake for 25 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool.
When cool, place on cutting board and cut into ½ inch thick diagonal slices with serrated knife
Place sliced biscotti back on cookie sheet and bake an additional 5 to 7 minutes on each side or until toasted and crispy.

title: Soft Honey Biscotti
instructions: Preheat oven and line cookie sheets with parchment paper.
In a bowl mix eggs, honey and sugar.
In another bowl mix flour, baking soda and baking powder.
Add liquid mix to flour and mix well.
Take one tbsp of mix and place on baking sheet to form long strips
Bake 15 minutes. Once cooled, cut biscotti about ¾ inch wide.

title: Mocha Chip (Nut Free) Biscotti

ingredients.rawText: ½ cup miniature semi-sweet chocolate chips

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. and line baking sheets with parchment paper
Combine flour and baking powder and set aside.
Beat butter and ¾ cup sugar until creamy.
Beat in eggs and vanilla.
Dissolve 1 tablespoon instant coffee granules into teaspoon of warm water and add with eggs.
Add flour mixture and mix well.
Stir in ½ cup miniature semi-sweet chocolate chips into dough.
Divide dough in half. Form each half into a 7 by 2 inch log.
Lightly spray with non-stick cooking spray and place each log on cookie sheet about 4 inches apart.
Bake 30 minutes.
Remove pan to cooling rack. Let logs cool in pan 15 minutes.
Carefully us a flat spatula or two to put logs on cutting board.
With a serrated knife, gently cut logs diagonally into ½ inch thick slices.
Place slices upright on cookie sheet about 1 inch apart.
Bake 20-25 minutes or until dry and crisp.

Cool completely on a cooling rack. To drizzle with chocolate , microwave 1/3 cup miniature semi-sweet chocolate chips and 2 tablespoons butter or margarine on high 1 minute and stir. Continue microwaving 10-30 seconds or until mixture is smooth when stirred. Drizzle over biscotti. Refrigerate 20 minutes or until chocolate is firm.
notes: Tips: Store in a tightly covered container.

title: Orange Polenta Biscotti

ingredients.rawText: 1 ¾ cup light muscovite sugar or substitute dark brown sugar
ingredients.normalizedName: light muscovite sugar substitute dark brown sugar

ingredients.rawText: 3 cups self-rising flour (or substitute 3 cups flour, 3 tbsp baking powder and 1

instructions: Preheat oven to 325°F. and line cookie sheets with parchment paper.
Beat together the butter and sugar until smooth.
Beat in the egg, then orange rind and juice, flour, baking powder, cinnamon and polenta.
Put mixture on lightly floured surface and knead.
Place dough on baking sheet and flatten with the palm of hand to make a rectangle approximately 25 by 18 inches.
Bake 25 minutes, remove from oven and leave to stand for 5 minutes until slightly cooled.
Using a sharp knife, carefully cut the mixture width ways into thin sticks about 1 cm wide.
Space the cookies out slightly on the baking sheet
Bake for a further 20 minutes until crisp.
When cool dust with icing sugar.
notes: These crisp, crunchy biscotti contain no nuts and are slightly softer.

title: Peach Rolled Biscotti (Pesche Arrotolati)

ingredients.rawText: 2 tbsp yeast melted in ½ cup water with 1 tsp sugar
ingredients.normalizedName: yeast melted in water with sugar

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup 7 oz peach jam or 1 can of peaches

instructions: Mix all dough ingredients and refrigerate.
Drain peaches, chop and stir in cinnamon and oats.
Shape dough into loaves. Cut slices and roll into 5 inch circle or make dough into size of walnuts and roll out into circles.
Place 1 tbsp of filling in centre, roll up into crescents and pinch ends.
Dip rolled crescent in sugar on to side only.
Place peach crescents on parchment covered pans.
Bake 350°F. until golden. Cool on wire racks.

title: Snickerdoodle Biscotti
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Line cookie sheets with parchment paper.
Measure flour into a large bowl
Add 1 cup sugar, baking powder and salt and mix well
Mix oil, vanilla and 3 eggs in a small bowl.
Add oil mixture to flour mixture and mix well. Dough should be dry and quite crumbly. Turn dough on floured surface and knead 7 to 8 times.
Divide dough in half. Shape each portion about 8 inches long and place them 6 inches apart on cookie sheet. Flatten each roll to 1 inch thick.
Combine the 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon.
Beat egg white and gently brush the tops of the rolls with the beaten egg white and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar.
Bake for 10 minutes. Remove and cool cookies 15 minutes on racks.
Reduce oven to 325°F.
Place cooled rolls on cutting board, cut diagonally into ½ inch thick slices and lay them cut sides down on the cookie sheet again.
Bake 10 more minutes, turn cookies over and bake another 10 minutes
Place on racks to cool. They will harden as they cool.

title: Special K Cereal Biscotti

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup sliced almonds or 1 cup slivered almonds or increase Special K cereal
ingredients.normalizedName: almonds slivered almonds increase special k cereal

ingredients.rawText: by one cup or add 1 cup chocolate chips

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. and line cookie sheets with parchment paper.
Combine eggs and sugar in a mixer until fluffy.
Add in the oil, beating well. Add in all the dry ingredients, combine well.
Fold in all the cereal and nuts, combining with clean hands.
Shape into logs. Put on parchment lined cookie pan & flatten tops lightly.
Bake 15 minutes. Turn oven off and leave in for another 15 minutes.
Remove loaves from oven, onto a wire rack and cool 10 minutes.
Reset oven to 325°F.
Slice with serrated knife and place back onto sheets cut side down.
Bake 7 minutes. Turn each slice over.
Bake another 9 minutes until golden and toasty. Cool on racks.

title: Walnut Biscotti
instructions: Blend all ingredients together
Shape into loaf
Bake at 350ºF for 30 minutes
Slice while warm and reheat to get dark and toasted on both sides
notes: Hunter decorated cookies with his mom, Jenna.

title: Easy Cookie Recipe
instructions: Reheat oven 375°F. Line cookie sheets with parchment paper
In a small bowl, stir together flour, baking soda and baking powder.
In a mixer cream butter, sugar, egg and vanilla until well blended.
Slowly add the flour mixture, beating on medium speed until mixture is completely combined.
Roll rounded tsps of dough into balls. Sprinkle with coloured sugar.
Place coloured ball on cookie sheets.
Bake 7 to 9 minutes or until golden.
Let cookies stand two minutes before removing from the cookie sheets to cool on wire racks.

title: Basic Italian Cookies
instructions: Sift flour and resift with sugar and baking powder onto a flat surface.
Cut shortening into dry ingredients until it resembles coarse cornmeal.
Make a well in flour and break eggs into it.
Add vanilla, and knead dough well for about 5 minutes until it is smooth adding a little more flour if dough seems too soft and sticky.
Pinch off bits of dough about the size of an apricot and form into desired shapes. Cookies may be baked in rings, strips or in letters such as an S.
Place 1 inch apart on parchment covered cookie sheet and bake in hot 450F oven for 10 minutes until golden brown.
Watch carefully because they burn easily.

title: Assunta Anise Biscotti
instructions: Mix eggs and sugar. Blend in all other ingredients
Drop by tsp on parchment paper covered cookie sheets
Bake for 25 minutes in 375ºF preheated oven
notes: PASTE AL ANICE Assunta C.

title: Becel Caramel Cookies

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup firmly packed light brown sugar

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Combine flour, baking soda and salt in medium bowl and stir.
Beat margarine with sugars in large bowl.
Beat in eggs and vanilla until blended.
Gradually add in flour mixture, beat just until blended.
Stir in toffee and butterscotch chips.
Drop by tablespoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheets 2 inches apart. Evenly sprinkle with sea salt.
Bake 7 minutes or until edges are golden. Cool cookies on parchment sheets on wire racks for 2 minutes; remove cookies from sheets and cool completely.

title: Camouflage Hunter Cookies

ingredients.rawText: green, brown and black food colouring

instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Stir butter and sugar together until smooth
Stir in egg and vanilla
Stir together flour, baking soda, and baking powder
Add dry mixture to wet and combine well.
Make 4 equal portions.
Add 12 drops green food colouring to one portion of dough and knead until colour is visible and vibrant.
Repeat # 7 with the brown and black food colouring.
Pull a bit from each of the four dough balls and roll to combine in hand and form cookie design.
Place formed cookies onto parchment covered cookie sheets.
Drop rounded cookies on sheet.
Bake 8-10 minutes.
Cool on wire rack for 4 minutes.

title: Chocolate Cocoa Cookies
instructions: Icing Sugar: 1 cup of icing sugar ¼ cup milk ¼ cup butter 1 envelope vanilla
Mix cookie ingredients together and make small balls
Place balls on cookie sheet.
Bake at 350ºF for 12 minutes precisely and allow to cool
Melt butter and mix in icing sugar, milk and vanilla
Dip cooled cookies in icing sugar mixture

title: Chocolate Gianna Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs one at a time
Mix sugar, oil, melted chocolate and vanilla and add to eggs
Stir in milk. Add flour and baking powder into mixture. Chill 2 hours
Using a teaspoon roll into balls and then into icing sugar
Place on parchment covered cookie sheet. Bake 15 minutes at 325º
notes: Gianna Q.

title: Chocolate Chip Crisco Cookies

ingredients.rawText: ½ lb Crisco at room temperature

instructions: Beat eggs and add sugar. Add vanilla, grated lemon and Crisco
Combine baking powder and flour to make soft dough
Stir in chocolate mini chips
Drop by teaspoon into sliced unroasted almonds
Place on parchment covered cookie sheets
Bake at 350ºF 10- 14 minutes

title: Fudgey Chocolate Stripe Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350 ºF.
Cream sugar and margarine until fluffy, beat eggs and vanilla
In a separate bowl, combine flour, cocoa, baking soda, salt, stir into creamed mixture chocolate and nuts and stir
Divide dough into four portions.
On each of the two lightly greased baking sheets, shape two portions into logs 12 x ½ inches, place about 2 inches apart.
Bake for 15-18 minutes (toothpick must come out clean)
Cool on racks, 10 minutes.
Drizzle with white chocolate and slice on the diagonal into one inch slices. Makes 4 dozen cookies

title: Chocolate Chip Butter Cookies

ingredients.rawText: ¾ cup firmly packed brown sugar
½ cup margarine or butter, softened
6 oz pkg (1 cup) semi-sweet chocolate chips
½ cup nuts, chopped or sunflower seeds

instructions: Heat oven to 375ºF.
In large bowl, combine first 6 ingredients; blend well.
Stir in flour, soda and salt; blend well.
Stir in chocolate chips and nuts; mix well.
Drop by rounded tsp 2‘’ apart onto ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 375ºF for 8 to 10 minutes or until light golden brown.
Immediately remove from cookie sheet
notes: Lorena V. For Oatmeal-Chocolate Chip Cookies decrease flour to 1 1/4 cups and add 1 cup quick-cooking rolled oats. Bake at 375ºF for 10 to 12 minutes. For Peanut butter-Chocolate Chip Cookies decrease margarine to 1/4 cup, add 1/2 cup peanut butter and 2 tbsp milk; increase eggs to 2.

title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Decadence

ingredients.normalizedName: kahlua simply substitute both ingredients white chocolate milk

Continue layering until all the cookies (except 2-3) are finished or until you reach the top of the pan. The last layer should be whipped cream.
Crush the 2-3 left over cookies and sprinkle over top layer of cream.

Serve with a dollop of ice cream or not, enjoy!

title: Chocolate Kisses
instructions: In a medium mixing bowl, beat butter, sugar, egg yolk, milk and vanilla extract until light and fluffy.
Combine flour, cocoa and salt, gradually add to creamed mixture.
Cover and chill 1 hour or until firm enough to roll into balls.
Meanwhile, in a small bowl, lightly beat the egg white.
Shape dough into 1 inch balls, dip into egg white then roll into nuts.
Place on greased baking sheets. Make an indentation with thumb in centre of each cookie.
Bake at 300ºF. for 10-20 minutes or until centre is set. Remove from oven.
Combine first four filling ingredients (confectioner’s sugar, butter, milk and vanilla) in a small bowl; mix until smooth.
Spoon ¼ tsp filling into each warm cookie

title: Chocolate Chip Large Cookie Cake

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 cup (1 stick) butter or margarine softened
2 cups (12 oz pkg) Nestle Semi-Sweet Chocolate Morsels, divided

instructions: Preheat oven 375ºF. Combine flour, baking soda and salt in small bowl
Beat butter, brown sugar, granulated sugar and vanilla in large mixer bowl and beat in egg. Gradually beat in flour mixture
Stir in 1 cup morsels by hand or wooden spoon.
Spread into greased and wax paper-lined 8 1/2 or 9” heart shaped pan
Bake for 18 - 20 minutes or until light golden brown
Let stand for 10 minutes; remove to wire rack to cool completely
Microwave remaining morsels in microwave-safe bowl on HIGH (100%) power for 1 minute and stir. Microwave an additional 10 to 20 second intervals, stirring until smooth. Spread over cookie
Chill for 30 minutes or until chocolate is set. Decorate as desired pan. Bake in preheated 375ºF oven for 18 to 20 minutes or until light golden brown. Follow as above.

title: Coffee Cookies

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup sugar + some to roll balls

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Combine sugar, oil, milk and coffee and mix well
Add one egg at a time beating well after each addition
Combine flour, baking powder and salt and gradually add to mixture
Roll into ¾ inch balls and roll into additional sugar
Place 2 inches apart on parchment covered cookie pans and flatten with fork. Bake at 400°F. for 8-10 minutes or until edges are firm.
Place on wire racks to cool. Makes 5 dozen cookies.

title: Coffee Delfina Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients. Put in oven for 1 hour in a 350ºF oven
notes: Delfina M.

title: Consiglio’s Chocolate Coffee Cookies

ingredients.rawText: 2 cups brewed espresso (16 ounces, slightly cooled)

instructions: Icing: 2 cups sifted confectioner sugar 2-3 tbsp lemon juice
Preheat oven to 350°F. Line 3 large baking trays with parchment paper and lightly spray with non-stick spray. Set aside.
Brew 2 cups (16 oz.) espresso, set aside.
In a food mixer fitted with paddle attachment, cream Crisco and sugar together, scraping sides once to ensure all ingredients are incorporated.
In a small bowl crack 2 eggs, and add the zest of one lemon.
Add to creamed sugar mixture one egg at a time, fully incorporate.
Repeat with second egg and zest.
In a separate bowl sift together the flour, baking powder, cocoa, cinnamon and cloves. Whisk together to fully incorporate dry ingredients.
Slowly add ½ cup of espresso to the Crisco and sugar mixture in food mixer on low speed and incorporate.

Add roughly ½ cup of the dry ingredients and incorporate. Alternate wet and dry ingredients, ensuring everything is incorporated before moving on. Repeat this process until all wet and dry ingredients are added. Make sure to scrape the bowl with a spatula once or twice during this process to guarantee the batter at the bottom is being combined.
Drop the dough by tablespoonful onto prepared baking trays, leaving 1 ½ inches (4 cm) between cookies.
Bake for 14-15 minutes, until cookies puff up. You will know the cookie is ready when you gently press on the top of one and it springs back.
Let cookies cool on tray for 5 minutes then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely.

In a medium bowl sift confectioner sugar and add 2-3 tbsps of lemon juice. The icing should be a thick consistency. Ice each cookie and set on wire rack or baking tray until the icing hardens and dries.
notes: Cookies can be stored in airtight containers for up to 3 days.

title: Super Chocolate Chip Cookies

ingredients.rawText: ½ cup chopped pecans or walnuts
½ cup dried fruit (raisins, cranberries, cherries, etc.)

instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºF. Grease cookie sheets with Pam. Cream butter and sugar.
Beat in eggs, juice and zest.
Sift flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Combine with butter mixture. Stir in oats, chocolate, fruit and nuts.
Drop large spoonfuls on cookie sheets leaving space between cookies as they spread.
Bake in a 375ºF oven for 8 to 10 minutes. Cool for 3 to 5 minutes before removing from pan. Makes 5 dozen cookies.

title: White Chip Orange Dream Cookies

ingredients.rawText: 2 cups (12 oz pkg) Nestle Toll House Premier White Morsels
ingredients.normalizedName: nestle toll house premier white morsels

instructions: Combine flour, baking soda and salt in small bowl
Beat butter, granulated sugar and brown sugar in large mixer bowl until creamy
Beat in egg and orange peel
Gradually beat in flour mixture. Stir in morsels
Drop dough by rounded tbsp onto ungreased baking sheets
Bake in preheated 350ºF oven for 10 - 12 minutes or until edges are a light, golden brown
Let stand 2 minutes, remove to wire racks to cool completely
notes: Sandy V.

title: Cinnamon Crescent Cookies

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb butter (room temp) 2 cups warm milk

instructions: Coating: Heat milk.
Mix dough ingredients in covered bowl.
Dough will be soft so put lid on bowl and place it in a bag and refrigerate overnight or 8-10 hours so dough will become harder.
Take dough out of refrigerator and knead it. Divide dough into 12 equal portions or balls. Leave balls covered in bowl.
Combine the almonds, cinnamon and sugar with fork. Drop 3 tbsp of coating on a board.

Using hands, flatten a ball of dough on 3 tbsp of coating so both sides are covered. Then using a rolling pin roll each portion of dough into a large10 inch diameter circle. Dough should be very thin and pick up the 3 tbsp of sugar and cinnamon. Keep flipping the dough over so both sides are coated with the sugar and cinnamon mixture and does not stick to board.
Cut dough into 16 equal pieces or wedges with a serrated knife or crinkle pizza cutter.
Roll up each section from the widest side to the point or narrowest end and form a crescent by turning in ends of crescent
Place on parchment covered cookie pans, cover and let rise for 1/2 hour or until desired.
Bake at 350ºF for 20-22 minutes
notes: Sandy V.

title: Funghi (Mushroom Cookies)

ingredients.rawText: 2 eggs, beaten one at a time

instructions: Mix ingredients together and allow to cool in refrigerator for 3 hours
Remove from fridge and roll into small balls. Shape half of the balls into stems and other half into caps and place on cookie sheets
Bake at 350ºF until golden, about 15 minutes. When warm, with knife make small hole in bottom of cap and stick stem into cap to form mushroom

title: German Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients, mix well and roll into smooth teaspoon size balls
Place on parchment paper covered cookie sheets
Bake at 350ºF for 12 minutes and cool
Glaze: Beat egg whites with icing sugar and lemon juice until thick
Roll cooled cookies into glaze and place on waxed paper to dry

title: Granola Munchies
instructions: Cream together Crisco and brown sugar
Beat egg and vanilla and add to mixture
Combine flour, baking soda and salt and blend well into mixture
Blend in granola and peanuts or raisins with wooden spoon
Drop by teaspoon on greased cookie sheets.
Bake 10 minutes at 350ºF

title: Honey Cookies
instructions: Combine and mix above ingredients well
Make 2 inch thick ropes and cut into 2 inch slices
Place on baking sheet. Bake at 350ºF for 30 or 40 minutes
notes: Iolanda V.

title: Lemon Cookies

ingredients.rawText: ½ lb or less of Crisco
8 oz or 3 oranges or lemons, squeezed

instructions: Mix eggs and sugar. Add juice, vanilla and Crisco
Add and mix flour and baking powder
Drop by teaspoon into icing sugar and roll
Place on baking sheet with parchment paper. Bake at 350ºF

title: High Tea Lemon Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºF. In a large bowl, beat butter until creamy looking. Add powdered sugar; mix until light and fluffy. Add lemon zest and vanilla extract; beat well. Add flour and cornstarch into butter mixture and mix until well combined. NOTE: At first the dough will look dry - but don't worry, as the dough slowly comes together as you mix it and the butter melts into the dry ingredients.

Do not refrigerate this dough, as the butter will harden and make the dough unmanageable for rolling. Using your hands, roll cookie dough into 1-inch balls. Place onto ungreased cookie sheets and bake 15 minutes or until bottoms are light brown. Remove from oven, carefully remove from baking sheet and cool on wire racks (when warm the cookies are delicate). When cool, spread Lemon Frosting onto top of cookies.
notes: butter). If not your cookies turn out crumbly. ** Yes, this is correct - use 1 1/2 cups cornstarch.

title: Lemon Frosting

ingredients.rawText: 1/3 to 1/2 cup freshly squeezed lemon juice

instructions: In a medium bowl, combine butter, lemon zest, lemon juice, and powdered sugar; stir until well mixed. NOTE: Additional lemon juice or water may be needed to get the frosting thin enough.
Dip the top of the cookie into it and let dry.

title: Lemon Sables - Lemon Butter Cookies

ingredients.rawText: 2 tbsp grated lemon zest (from 2 to 3 lemons)
1 egg white plus 1 teaspoons water (for coating) (Yield 40 cookies)

instructions: In a small bowl, sift the flour and baking powder together; set aside.

Using paddle attachment of mixer, beat butter until creamy. Add the powdered sugar and beat for another minute. Add granulated sugar and beat additional minute until combined. Add lemon zest and salt; mix just briefly. Add egg yolks and mix until just combined.

With mixer on low, gradually add the flour mixture and blend just until the flour is incorporated. NOTE: It is better to under beat than over beat at this point. Be gentle when you mix in the flour, as tender cookies depend on a tender touch.

Divide dough between two 1-foot long sheet of plastic wrap or parchment paper. Dough will be quite soft at this point. Shape each dough piece into a rough log approximately 1 1/4 inches thick. Wrap the plastic wrap around the dough. Shape and roll to form a nice round log. Twist end of the plastic wrap and tuck under each log. Refrigerate 2 hours or up to 3 days. The dough can also be stored in the freezer for up to 1 month. NOTE: Refrigerating the dough relaxes the gluten and also helps the cookies hold their shape during slicing and baking.
When ready to bake cookies, preheat oven to 350ºF. Place rack in middle of oven. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper.

Lay a 3rd piece of plastic wrap or parchment sheet on counter and pour out a ridge of granulated sugar, about the length of the logs, for rolling them in. In a small bowl, whisk egg white and water together.
Remove the logs of dough from the refrigerator, unwrap them, and brush them lightly with a little egg white.

Roll chilled dough logs, one at a time in granulated sugar, pressing the sugar gently to get it to stick if necessary. Completely coat logs with sugar. Using a sharp knife, slice the logs into 1/4-inch thick slices. Lay the slices about 1-inch apart on the prepared baking sheets.

Bake for 12 to 15 minutes (turning the baking sheets halfway through baking) until golden on the edges only. Remove from oven and let cool on baking racks. Store in an airtight container. These cookies are best after sitting a couple of days. These cookies are not suitable for freezing because of the sugar coating. For Christmas, roll dough in larger- grained, crystal, or coloured sugar.
notes: Sable cookies are a classic French cookie originating in Normandy. Sable is French for "sand," which refers to the sandy texture of the delicate shortbread-like cookies. * Because the dough is made with powdered (confectioners) sugar, the cookies are softer and more tender than most butter cookies.

title: Lemon Glaze
instructions: In mixing bowl sift flour, baking powder and salt.
In large bowl whisk eggs until slightly thickened (3-4 minutes)
Add sugar, Continue to whisk until well blended
Add oil, vanilla extract, juice, and zest of lemon and combine well.

225 gr package Dalton’s Glace fruit cake mix

Add remaining ingredients and stir well
Drop by tsp onto parchment paper covered cookie sheets
Bake 20 minutes at 325ºF (17-18 minutes sometimes)
Remove from waxed paper immediately. Not suitable for freezing
notes: Rita V.

title: Mincemeat Cookies

ingredients.rawText: 3 cups all-purpose flour or (2 cups all-purpose & 1 cup whole-wheat)

instructions: Beat butter. Cream in sugar. Add eggs and beat well
Combine flour, baking soda and salt and add to mixture
Beat until well combined. Stir in mincemeat plus walnuts
Drop by tsp onto greased cookie sheets and space 2” apart
Bake at 350ºF for 12-14 minutes.

title: Mocha Nut Cookies
instructions: Cream together margarine, sugar and vanilla until light
Add instant coffee, cocoa, flour and salt and mix well
Add nuts and blend with a wooden spoon
Refrigerate for 1/2 hour
Shape into 1 tsp balls and place on parchment covered cookie sheets
Bake at 350ºF for 18 minutes. When cookies are cool, roll them in icing sugar.
notes: Gianna Q.

title: Molasses Loaf Slices
instructions: Heat molasses until boiling. When cool, add oil and orange juice
Add 1 cup of flour to molasses mixture. Add eggs.
Add remaining flour to make dough like bread
Put it on a floured board and knead
Shape into loaves and place on aluminum or parchment paper covered or Pam sprayed cookie sheets
Brush egg white on top of loaves
Bake at 350ºF for 20 minutes. Cool before slicing loaves.

title: Oatmeal Cookies
instructions: Beat egg and add brown and white sugar and mix well
Add water, vanilla extract and gold Crisco softened
Combine flour, salt and baking soda then mix well into egg mixture
Stir in rolled oats and drop by tsp onto parchment covered cookie sheets
Bake 10 - 14 minutes at 350ºF

title: Oatmeal Monster Cookies
instructions: Beat butter with peanut butter, corn syrup and vanilla until light then beat in eggs
Combine rolled oats with brown sugar, white sugar, baking soda, coconut and chocolate chips or raisins and beat into peanut butter mixture
Place mixture on parchment paper lined (or non-stick) cookie sheets in mounds about 2“ rounds and bake in preheated 350ºF oven for 10-15 minutes
4. Cool on racks Makes about a 100 cookies

title: Rolled Oatmeal Cookies

ingredients.rawText: 4 oz (115 g or ½ cup) butter

instructions: Preheat oven 375°F. (350°F. convection) and line cookie sheets with parchment paper.
Cream the butter and sugar. Add the beaten egg.
Combine all the dry ingredients. Add to egg mixture and mix well.
Roll into balls, place onto cookie sheet and press down firmly with fork.
Bake 12-15 minutes.
Place on wire rack to cool
Store in an air-tight container.

title: Orange Crisco Cookies (Biscotti al’Arancia)
instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Roll and drop balls onto cookie sheet
Bake at 350ºF for 12 minutes
After cooked and cooled, sprinkle or dunk in icing sugar.

title: Orange Oil Delfina Cookies
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix well. Roll and drop balls onto pan.
Bake in a 350ºF oven for 20 minutes.
notes: Delfina M.

title: Orange Juice Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs and add sugar. Mix in Crisco and juice from the 2 oranges
Mix in flour, baking powder and vanilla
Roll tsp sized ball of doe into icing sugar and place on parchment covered sheets. Bake at 350ºF for 10 - 15 minutes

title: Emma’s Orange Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs and mix in sugar
Add Crisco and the juice of the 2 oranges and mix well
Combine flour, baking powder and vanilla and mix into egg mixture
Roll cookie by tsp into icing sugar.
Place on parchment covered cookie sheets. Bake at 350ºF

title: Orange or Tangerine Cookies
instructions: Mix eggs with sugar
Add melted Crisco and orange or tangerine juice
Mix in flour and baking powder
Form dough into balls and roll in icing sugar
Place cherry on top if desired
Place on parchment covered cookie sheets
Bake at 300ºF for 15 minutes

title: Peaches Mary C
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar then add oil and milk
Mix in combined baking powder, vanilla and flour and let rest
Roll into small balls about the size of a hazelnut
Bake at 350ºF until done
Scoop out the insides of peaches with a pointed serrated knife
Moisten insides of peaches with vermouth, some plum jam and roasted, grated almonds. Mix well and insert moistened insides back into the hollow
Peaches may be coloured by dipping them into white vermouth or water coloured with pink or green food colouring
Roll the wet peaches into sugar and attach two together where they were hollowed out and decorate with plastic leaves (optional)

title: Peaches, Mikes’ Favourite
instructions: Filling: 1 jar of ED Smith Lemon Jam
Dressing/Colouring: Vermouth plus food colouring (mix red & yellow) or (blue & yellow)
Mix all dough ingredients together and roll into small balls
Bake at 350ºF for 12 minutes
Remove and scoop out a little dough from the middle of each cookie from the bottom flat side.
Fill scooped out centre with ED Smith Lemon Jam
Attach two similar looking cookies by the filling and place on cookie sheet. The two cookies should look like a peach.
Mix vermouth with food colouring
Dip each peach in food colouring and vermouth mixture
Roll in sugar
Place in muffin paper cups

title: Peaches (Pesche)

ingredients.rawText: 2 envelopes of Bertolini yeast or (4 tsp baking powder and 2 tsp vanilla)

instructions: Cream eggs and sugar, then mix in oil, milk and vanilla
Add flour and baking powder gradually
Roll into 2 inch balls with oiled hands and place on baking sheet
Bake at 325ºF oven until bottom is golden
When cool, scoop out inside from bottom with sharp knife.
Crumble inside and mix with a little jam and vermouth to make a paste. Return paste into peaches and join two from the bottom a few drops food colour (yellow, red, green) 1/2 cup water
Combine vermouth, water and food colouring to desired colour
Roll baked formed peaches into food colouring.
Place coloured peaches on waxed paper to dry
notes: Colour: 1/2 cup vermouth

title: Peaches Concetta
instructions: Filling: Cream eggs and sugar, then mix in oil, and milk.
Add flour and baking powder gradually
Roll into 2 inch balls with oiled hands and place on baking sheet
Bake at 325ºF oven until bottom is golden
When cool, scoop out insides from bottom with sharp knife.
Combine filling ingredients with crumbled scooped out crumbs.
Crumble inside and mix with a little jam and vermouth to make a paste.
Return paste into peaches and join two from the bottom
notes: Concetta S.

title: Peach Crescents (Arrotolati)

ingredients.rawText: Optional crushed oatmeal to absorb peach 4
2 tbsp yeast, melted in 1 cup warm water + 1 tsp sugar

instructions: Dough Filling: Melt yeast in warm water and tsp sugar
Put flour in bowl and make well
Break eggs and put in well with Crisco
Add sugar, vanillina, grated lemon, risen yeast and mix well.
When all mixed, put paper over dough + tea towel
Refrigerate over night or for a few hours
Preheat oven to 350°F. Line cookie sheets with parchment paper.
Make small balls and flatten with wooden rolling pin.
Combine filling ingredients and place on flattened circles and roll up into a crescent. Pinch ends so filling does not come out.
Place on cookie sheets with fold down.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until golden. Remove and cool on racks.

title: Pineapple Cookies
instructions: Dough: Mix flour with margarine. Mix in sugar and make a well.
Dissolve yeast in water, add the mixture to the well.
Add eggs and mix everything in the well.
When mixture is a good consistency, divide into 14 balls, place on parchment paper on a cookie sheet, cover and refrigerate for 7 hours.
Filling: Pour crushed pineapple into a pot.
Add 4 tbsp. of cornstarch then 1 cup of sugar.
Mix well and let it come to a low boil, stirring constantly.
Cook for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Cool in fridge overnight.
Put Together: Take each ball of dough and roll out to ½ cm over icing sugar.
Cut into triangles
Put filling on each piece and roll up like a croissant.
Place croissant on cookie pan and bake at 350°F.until golden.

title: Ricotta Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar. Add ricotta, put in warm Crisco & blend well
Add rest of ingredients and stir well
Drop by rounded tsp on parchment covered cookie sheets
Bake at 350ºF

title: Mexican Wedding/Swedish Tea Cakes

ingredients.rawText: ¾ cup finely chopped toasted nuts*

instructions: To toast nuts – Spread nuts in a single layer on a baking pan (one with walls is best) for toasting in the oven. Cook at 400ºF. for 7 to 10 minutes or until the nuts start to turn golden. Shake the pan halfway through toasting.
In a large bowl, cream butter, powdered sugar, and vanilla extract until light and fluffy. Sift in flour and salt; stir until well mixed. Mix in nuts. Refrigerate 1 hour.

Preheat oven to 400ºF. Roll dough into 1-inch balls. Place onto ungreased cookie sheets. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until set but not brown. Remove from oven and cool slightly on wire racks. While cookies are baking place the powdered sugar in a shallow dish.

While still warm, roll cookies in powdered sugar. When cookies have cooled, roll them again in the confectioners sugar to give them a nice even coating of sugar. Store in an airtight container. Yields 4 dozen cookies.
notes: This holiday cookie is known by different names such as Mexican Wedding Cakes, Swedish Tea Cakes, Italian Butter Nut, Southern Pecan Butterball, Snowdrop, Viennese Sugar Ball, Sand Tarts, and Snowball. They always contain finely chopped nuts and are twice rolled in powdered sugar. Variation: Substitute 1 cup miniature semisweet chocolate chips for nuts. S Cookies shaped by kids

title: Samantha's S Cookies

ingredients.rawText: 2 tsp ground cinnamon mixed with 1/3 cup sugar or colored sprinkles

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F (180°C). Grease or line cookie sheet with parchment paper.
In a small bowl, combine cinnamon and 1/3 cup sugar for coating.
In a large bowl, combine eggs, 1 cup sugar, and oil. Add flour and baking powder; mix well.
Divide dough into two loaves. Cut 1/3 inch slices (or use 1 tablespoon of dough for each cookie).
Roll dough into a rope about 1 cm in diameter and 5 inches long.
Shape each roll into an 'S' shape.
Drop upside down in cinnamon-sugar mixture or colored sprinkles.
Place on parchment paper-lined cookie sheet. Bake for 12-15 minutes until golden.
Cool on wire racks.
notes: A wonderful family tradition for kids of all generations to roll, shape, and decorate together.
originalPhotoCaption: S Cookies shaped by kids with cinnamon sugar

title: S Grandma Cookies
instructions: Mix dry ingredients and cut in shortening.
Add milk, eggs, and extract. Use enough liquid to make sticky dough.
Roll dough into finger width strips and cut 3-4 inches length. Shape into “S”. Place on parchment covered cookie sheets.
Bake at 350° for 8-10 minutes or until just slightly golden on bottom.
Cool on racks.
Frost with powdered sugar and milk glaze.

title: Salami Dolce

ingredients.rawText: 1 pkg social tea cookies broken into little pieces
½ glass liqueur (Creme de Cacao or Amaretto)

instructions: Melt margarine and add sugar and eggs
Add cocoa, cookies, almonds and liqueur and mix well on stove
Dump onto aluminum foil or saran wrap and roll into a salami shape
Refrigerate. Sprinkle with icing sugar before cutting into slices and serving
notes: Mary C.

title: Sasamielle
instructions: Blend all ingredients together. Roll into log. Brush egg yolk on top. Bake 20 to 30 minutes in 325ºF oven

title: Savoiardi Cookies
instructions: Beat eggs and sugar and add oil
Combine flour and baking powder and mix into egg mixture
Dough should be sticky
Drop by tbsp into icing sugar and turned so it’s coated evenly
Place on parchment paper covered cookie pan
Bake at 325ºF for 15 minutes

title: Shortbread
instructions: Cream butter, sugar and vanilla
Add flour in 3 parts
Divide into 3 parts and put food colouring of choice and mix well
Roll into teaspoon balls and flatten with fork
Bake at 300ºF 18 to 29 minutes

title: Prize Shortbread Cookies

ingredients.rawText: Red and/or green Maraschino cherries or dragees for decorating
ingredients.normalizedName: red green maraschino cherries dragees decorating

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Cream softened butter, sugar, salt, nutmeg and egg yolk.

Add flour, a little at a time until mixture is too stiff to work with a spoon. Turn out onto a floured surface and gently knead, adding a little flour at a time until dough just begins to crack at the edges.
Roll out dough and cut into shapes or roll into 1 tsp balls and gently flatten with thumb. Decorate by gently pressing small slices of maraschino cherries or dragees into the dough prior to baking.
Bake 10 minutes or until delicately golden at edges.
notes: Georgina V. makes 42 cookies

title: Whipped Shortbread
instructions: Preheat oven to 325ºF.
Cream butter and icing sugar (with fork) until very fluffy.
Beat in cornstarch, vanilla and then flour.
Beat until batter is light and very fluffy. Stir in nuts
Drop batter by teaspoon onto lightly greased baking sheets.
Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden.
If desired, dust lightly with sifted icing sugar
notes: Anna B. Makes 60 cookies

title: Snowball Cookies

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup Land O Lakes Butter, softened

instructions: Heat oven to 325ºF. Line pans with parchment paper.
In large mixer bowl, combine flour, nuts, sugar, butter and vanilla.
Beat at low speed, scraping bowl often until well mixed for 3 to 4 minutes.
Shape rounder teaspoonfuls of dough into 1 inch balls.
Place on pans. Bake for 18 to 25 minutes or until very lightly browned.
Remove immediately.
Roll in powdered sugar while still warm and again when cool.
notes: Mary F. makes 3 dozen cookies

title: Snowball Walnut Cookies

ingredients.rawText: Snowball cookies are buttery and nutty with an airy, melt-in-your-mouth
ingredients.normalizedName: snowball cookies are buttery nutty with airy

instructions: texture.
2 ¼ cups flour ¾ cup walnuts, finely chopped ½ teaspoon salt 1 cup butter, unsalted and softened 1 teaspoon vanilla ½ cup powdered sugar plus extra for dusting
Preheat oven to 400°F. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine flour, walnuts and salt in a small bowl. Set aside.
Beat butter, vanilla, and powdered sugar with a mixer until creamy.
Turn the mixer to low and add flour mixture until combined.
Form dough into 1" balls and place on prepared pan.
Bake 8-10 minutes or until bottom edges of cookies are lightly browned.
Cool a few minutes until you are able to handle the cookies.
Roll in powdered sugar and place on a rack to cool completely. give them a pulse or two in the food processor. You want them very finely chopped but not powdery. A few bigger pieces are ok too.
