title: Oatmeal Snowball Cookies
instructions: Cream sugar, shortening and eggs and add vanilla
Add sifted dry ingredients (flour, salt, baking soda, baking powder)
Add oatmeal one cup at a time and mix well. Chill several hours.
Preheat oven 375°F. and line cookie sheets with parchment paper.
Form dough into small balls and place 5 at a time in a bowl of powdered sugar.
Shake bowl to ensure dough is all coated with icing sugar.
Place balls with space between them on the cookie sheets. Do not flatten balls as they will flatten as they bake
Bake 8-10 minutes. Cookies will not look done but they will be. Do not overcook.
Cool on rack. Oatmeal Snowball Cookies

title: Snickerdoodle Cookies

ingredients.rawText: ½ cup softened margarine or butter

instructions: Heat oven to 400°F.
In large bowl combine sugar, butter, vanilla, eggs and blend well
Stir in flour, cream of tartar, soda, salt and blend well.
Shape dough into 1 inch balls
Combine 2 tablespoons sugar and cinnamon and roll balls in mixture
Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet.
Bake 400°F. for 8 to 10 minutes or until set. Immediately remove from cookie sheet.
Makes 48 cookies.
notes: Tip: *Open a new box of baking soda, as fresh soda will make cookies rise.

title: Sour Cream Cookies
instructions: Heat oven to 350ºF. Line cookie sheets with parchment paper.
In large bowl, combine first 5 ingredients and blend well
Stir in remaining ingredients
Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart on prepared cookie sheet.
Bake at 350ºF. for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.
Immediately remove from cookie sheet. Cool on racks.
notes: *If desired, add 1 cup chopped dates, chopped apricots or flaked coconut or 1/2 cup raisins or chopped nuts. *For Chocolate Sour Cream Drops, omit nutmeg and add 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa with flour or 1 envelope pre-melted, unsweetened baking chocolate flavour with vanilla.

title: Special “K” Cookies
instructions: Cream melted Crisco and sugar together
Add beaten egg and vanilla to mixture
Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt and mix well into mixture
Add Special K and coconut and blend into mixture with wooden spoon
Drop by heaping teaspoon on greased cookie sheets
Bake 8-10 minutes at 350ºF

title: Best Rolled Sugar Cookies
instructions: In a large bowl, cream together butter and sugar until smooth
Beat in eggs and vanilla.
Stir in the flour, baking powder and salt.
Cover and chill dough for at least one hour (overnight)
Preheat oven to 400°F.and line cookie sheets with parchment paper.
Roll out dough on floured surface ¼ to ½ inch thick.
Cut into shape with cookie cutters.
Place 1 inch apart on cookie sheet.
Bake 6 to 8 minutes. Cool completely.

title: Grandma’s Sugar Cookies 2022
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F. and line cookie sheets with parchment paper.
Sift dry ingredients.
Cut in butter and blend with pastry lender until like cornmeal.
Stir in beaten egg, cream and vanilla.
Blend well. Chill if desired.
Roll dough to ½ inch thick. Sprinkle with sugar and cut out shapes.
Transfer shapes to baking sheets. Bake 6-8 minutes.

title: Sally’s Sugar Cookies

ingredients.rawText: ¾ cup unsalted butter, room temperature

instructions: Whisk flour, baking powder and salt.
In bowl of mixer, using paddle, beat butter and sugar.
Add egg, vanilla, almond extract and beat at high speed for 1 minute.
Scrape down sides of bowl and up bottom of bowl and beat again as needed to combine.
Add dry ingredients and mix at low speed until combined. Dough should be soft, and sticky for rolling. Add 1 tablespoon of flour.
Divide dough in half.
Put on floured surface and roll to ¼ inch thick. Use more flour if sticky.
Dust rolling pin with flour to prevent sticking.
Put parchment paper on top and roll out second piece of dough.
Put on top of other rolled dough. Cover with plastic wrap or aluminum paper.
Refrigerate 1 – 2 hours up to 2 days.
Preheat oven 350°F. Line 3 cookie sheets with parchment paper.
Remove dough from fridge. If it sticks, run hand under it to remove.
Cut dough with cookie cutter. Reroll remaining dough and cut.
Place cut shapes 3 inches apart on cookie sheet.
Repeat with second piece of dough.
Bake 11-12 minutes or until brown on the edges.
Cool on baking sheet 5 minutes and transfer to wire rack or cool completely. Decorate with glaze. Makes 24 – 3 inch cookies.

title: Thimble Cookies Rolled in Walnuts

ingredients.rawText: ½ cup lightly packed brown sugar

instructions: Cream butter with sugar until fluffy. Beat in egg yolk and vanilla
Mix in flour until dough is smooth
Shape a tsp at a time into small balls
Dip balls in slightly beaten egg white & roll in chopped walnuts
Roll in hands again so nuts adhere to dough
Place on ungreased baking sheets
Make an indentation with thimble
Bake at 350ºF for 15 minutes
Spoon jam into hollows as cooled
Store in tin cans with waxed paper between layers

title: Thimble Cookies
instructions: Cream butter and sugar
Add egg yolks, vanilla and beat until light and fluffy
Stir in flour if necessary and chill about an hour
Shape into 1“ balls. Using a lightly floured thimble make a small indentation in centre of each cookie and fill with jam
Bake 25 minutes at 325ºF

title: Tender Biscotti
instructions: Melt butter and Crisco
Beat eggs and sugar
Add milk, butter and Crisco to eggs and sugar mixture
Add flour, baking powder, vanilla and lemon peel
Roll piece about 1 inch thick and cut about 1 inch long
Place one cut side down and pinch top
Bake on ungreased cookie sheet at 350ºF for 7 minutes and then 2 minutes under the broiler
Icing: Melt butter and mix in milk and icing sugar making it liquidly
Frost with finger
notes: Rita V.

title: Toll House Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºF. Line cookie sheet with parchment paper.
In small bowl combine flour, baking soda, salt and set aside.
In large bowl combine butter, sugars, vanilla then beat in eggs.
Gradually add flour mixture. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts.
Drop rounded teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet. Bake 8 to 10 minutes.

title: Tootoo
instructions: Blend Crisco and flour, add dry ingredients and add milk and eggs.
Roll into balls. Place on parchment covered cookie pans.
Bake in a 350ºF degree oven for 10 minutes.
Remove from oven, cool.
Make icing with icing sugar and water. Dip cookies in the icing.

title: Tony the Tiger Cookies

ingredients.rawText: 3 cups Frosted Flakes crushed, to 1 1/2 cups

instructions: Stir together flour, soda and salt and set aside
In large bowl, beat margarine and sugar until light and fluffy
Add eggs and vanilla and beat well
Add flour mixture, mix until well combined
Stir in cereal and drizzle melted chocolate over dough
With knife, swirl melted chocolate gently through dough to achieve marbled appearance taking care not to over mix
Drop by rounded tablespoon onto ungreased baking sheets
Bake at 350ºF about 12 minutes or until lightly browned. Remove immediately from baking sheets and cool on wire racks

title: Torroncini
instructions: Mix above ingredients together
Batter will appear hard but roll into 2 inch ropes
Roll ropes into icing sugar
Put in 350ºF oven and take it out when brown on bottom
Cut when warm

title: Torcetti Cookies

ingredients.rawText: Extra sugar (Brown or regular) {for the sugar coating}

instructions: Add sugar and yeast to warm water and mix well. Set aside for 2-3 minutes
Mix flour & salt and add cold pieces of butter to the dry mix. With a fork, break up the butter pieces into the flour until it resembles breadcrumbs. (Or do it in the food processor)
Mix vanilla with the yeast mixture and add the liquid to the flour. Mix together until the dough comes together. (Don't over process or knead).
Let it rest in a warm spot for an hour. The dough will look puffy.
Punch down the dough, cover with plastic wrap and chill in refrigerator for 1-24 hours.
Remove the dough and cut into equal pieces.
Roll each piece of dough in palms to form a thin rope.
Place it on a work surface that has sugar sprinkled on it and roll the rope so the sugar crusts the dough uniformly.
Form the “rope” into a loop crossing it over before the ends.
Again roll on some sugar (I used raw brown sugar)
Place on baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Let it rest for 20 minutes until the Torcetti cookies look puffed up.
Preheat oven 325°F. or 160°C.
Brush with melted butter or egg wash and bake for 25-30 minutes.
Let it cool a bit and enjoy.
notes: Makes: 12 small Torcetti cookies

title: Gabriella’s Vanilla Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven 350°F. and line cookie sheets with parchment paper.
Beat eggs and sugar together.
Add vanilla and beat.
Add milk and mix.
Sift 4 cups flour with baking powder and add into eggs by hand.
Batter should not be sticky. Roll into ropes and make into a knot.
Place on cookie sheets
Bake for 15 – 20 minutes until golden.
Place on racks to cool.

title: Walnut Butter Cookies
instructions: Cream butter until smooth, add sugar, mix well, add 1 cup flour, egg yolks then remaining flour.
Beat egg whites until fluffy.
Roll dough into teaspoon size balls
Roll into egg whites then into crushed walnuts.
Place on greased cookie sheet.
Bake 5 minutes and then remove from oven.
With thumb, put an indentation in the centre of the cookie.
Bake 20 more minutes.
When cooled fill centre of cookies with jam.

title: Pizzelle della Nonna

ingredients.rawText: 3/4 teaspoon baking powder and pinch of salt

instructions: Preheat pizzelle iron.
In a medium bowl, sift together flour, baking powder, and salt.
In mixer bowl, beat eggs until frothy and thickening (2-3 minutes). Add sugar and continue beating 3 minutes until thick.
Add oil, vanilla, and anise extract; mix well.
Slowly add flour mixture on low speed until soft sticky dough forms.
Drop 1 tablespoon of batter onto the hot pizzelle press.
Close lid firmly and cook for 30 to 45 seconds until light golden.
Carefully remove with a fork or spatula and let cool flat on a rack.
Chocolate option: Replace 1/4 cup flour with 1/4 cup unsweetened cocoa powder.
notes: Crisp, wafer-thin snowflake cookies that evoke Italian Christmas and Easter celebrations.
originalPhotoCaption: Justin sifts flour and drops batter on pizzelle iron; Pizzelle removed when golden

title: Pizzelle with Oil

ingredients.rawText: 1 tsp anise extract or anisette, to taste

instructions: Mix together eggs, oil, vanilla and anisette.
Add in the sugar and mix well
Add in the flour by sifting it a little bit at a time and mixing with mixer until all the flour is gone.
When the Pizzelle press is heated put one small teaspoon of the mix in each section and cook until light golden brown.
After they have cooled and before serving sprinkle with powdered sugar or you can spread some Nutella on them.

title: Crisco Pizzelle

ingredients.rawText: ½ box of Crisco (at room temperature and cut into pieces)

instructions: Beat eggs, sugar and 1 cup of flour in mixer.
Cut Crisco into chunks and add eggs, lemon juice and vanilla.
Add the 3 remaining cups of flour gradually a cup flour at a time and mix.
A little more flour may be added, if mixture appears too soft. As the dough becomes thick, use the dough hook to continue mixing.
Mixture needs to be refrigerated for a couple of hours or overnight.
Heat electric pizzelle iron and wait for it to heat up. Spray with a dash of vegetable spray if iron is new. No other lubrication is required (Crisco in recipe will prohibit the dough from sticking).
With a teaspoon, take some batter and push it out into the centre of each cooking area and shut iron tight. Hold for about 50 seconds.

Quickly lift pizzelle from iron with spatula and place flat on tray to cool straight. After cooling for a few minutes, stack pizzelle on top of each other. To retain crispness, do not store in plastic or covered containers.
notes: (wafer thin waffle cookies) Margaret V.

title: Franca Filice Oil Pizzelle
instructions: Beat eggs, sugar and anice well. Add oil and mix well.
Stir in flour and baking powder.

title: Crispy Pizzelle July 2018

ingredients.rawText: ½ cup melted butter or oil

instructions: Whisk eggs, sugar, anice and vanilla to combine.
Stir in melted butter or oil. Add flour, salt and baking powder and mix until smooth or batter is thick and soft.
Heat pizzelle iron. As iron heats batter will stiffen.
Cook pizzelle 45 sec to 2 ½ minutes to brown.
Remove pizzelle from iron and cool on rack or parchment covered cookie sheet. Dust cooled pizzelle with icing sugar if desired.

title: Pizzelle Chocolate

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup flour + ¼ cup unsweetened cocoa powder and skip vanilla .
ingredients.normalizedName: flour unsweetened cocoa powder skip vanilla

instructions: In a bowl sift flour, baking powder and salt.
In large bowl beat eggs until frothy. With whisk attachment beat until frothy and beginning to thicken (3-4 minutes)
Add sugar and continue to whisk until thickened.
Add oil and extract. Mix well.
Slowly add flour mixture until well combined. Dough will be soft and sticky.
Heat iron.
Drop 1 tablespoon batter on hot iron.
Close lid and cook 45 seconds or until slightly golden.
Use a fork to remove from press.
Transfer to flat surface or rack to dry or mold into desired shapes.

title: Pizzelle Butter December 2022

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 cup unsalted butter (1 stick), melted and cooled slightly

instructions: Preheat a pizzelle maker
Place the eggs, sugar, anise seed, vanilla, and anise extract in a medium bowl and whisk to combine.
Stir in the melted butter.
Add the flour, baking powder and salt, and mix until smooth.
Place about a tablespoon of batter on each of the hot pizzelle maker plates and close the lid.
Cook until only a few wisps of steam are escaping from the pizzelle maker, and the pizzelle look lightly golden.
Use a fork or small spatula to remove cooked pizzelle to cool on rack.
Dust with powdered sugar, if desired.
notes: The thinnest, lightest, most crisp pizzelle recipe ever! They're just as light as air and this recipe is truly authentic with plenty of sweet anise flavour.

title: Justin’s Southern Italy Pizzelle

ingredients.rawText: 2 sticks (1 cup) butter or margarine melted

instructions: Beat eggs and sugar. Add cooled butter, vanilla and anise seeds.
Sift flour and baking powder.
Add eggs and sugar mixture.
Batter will have a dough like consistency.
Bake on pizzelle iron. Lid is closed and pizzelle removed when golden.
notes: Justin sifts the flour and baking powder. Mix eggs, sugar, butter, vanilla and anise. Mixture has a dough like consistency. Tablespoon of mixture is dropped on iron.

notes: Cover dough and let rise. Dough rises to double its size. Cut out outer circle with large glass and inner circle with small glass.

title: Air Frying

ingredients.rawText: 2 piece non-stick copper crisper basket and flat tray to catch crumbs. It is

instructions: great for baking and crispy foods. C: Preheat the crisper basket so the parts of the food that make contact with the basket crisp.
notes: Air fryers use convection to circulate hot air (and, in some cases, oil) around food in order to cook it. This achieves crispy results with less oil. Convection ovens use a fan to circulate hot air, like an air fryer. To transform a convection oven into an air fryer, the following are required: A: Extra Airflow: A crisper tray and elevated basket to allow airflow under the food. If more airflow is desired put the crisper tray on the oven rack below the crisper basket. To ensure no crumbs fall on the bottom of the oven – which can burn and smoke the next time the oven is used, put a sheet pan on the lower rack. title: Donuts, Air Fryer

ingredients.rawText: 4 tbsp hot water or as needed

instructions: Air fryer donuts made from scratch with yeast dough taste like the real deal. Better than baked and less fat than deep-fried!

1 cup milk, lukewarm (about 100°F)° 2 1/2 tsp active dry yeast or instant yeast 1/4 cup granulated sugar plus 1 tsp 1/2 tsp salt 1 egg 1/4 cup unsalted butter, melted 3 cups all-purpose flour Oil Spray (Coconut oil works best)

For the Glaze: In the bowl of a standup mixer fitted with the dough hook, gently stir together lukewarm milk, 1 tsp of sugar and yeast. Let it sit for 10 minutes until foamy (If nothing happens the milk was too hot or the yeast is too old, so start over).

Add sugar, salt, egg, melted butter and 2 cups of flour to the milk mixture. Mix on low speed until combined then with the mixer running add the remaining cup of flour slowly, until the dough no longer sticks to the bowl. Increase speed to medium/low and knead for 5 minutes, until the dough is elastic and smooth.
Place the dough into a greased bowl and cover it with plastic wrap. Let rise in a warm place until doubled. Dough is ready if you make a dent with your finger and the indentation remains.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface, punch it down and gently roll out to about 1/2 inch thickness. Cut out 10-12 donuts using a 3-inch round cutter and a 1 inch round cutter to remove centre.
Transfer donuts and donut holes to lightly floured parchment paper and cover loosely with greased plastic wrap. Let donuts rise until doubled in volume, about 30 minutes.
Preheat Air Fryer to 350 ° F. and spray Air Fryer basket with oil spray.
Carefully transfer donuts to Air Fryer basket in a single layer.
Spray donuts with oil spray and cook at until golden brown, about 4 minutes. Repeat with remaining donuts and holes.
While donuts are in the Air Fryer, melt butter in a small saucepan over medium heat. Stir in powdered sugar and vanilla extract until smooth.
Remove from heat and stir in hot water one tablespoon at a time until the icing is somewhat thin, but not watery. Set aside.
Dip hot donuts and donut holes in the glaze using two forks to submerge them. Place on a wire rack set over a rimmed baking sheet to allow excess glaze to drip off.
Let sit until glaze hardens, about 10 minutes.

title: Zeppole-Zippoli Calabrese

ingredients.rawText: Deep fryer or medium fry pan

instructions: Filling Ingredients: Fill a bowl with 2 cups warm water and dissolve 1.5 tbsp salt by stirring.
In a separate bowl, prepare up to 3kg/6.6lbs of plain flour.
Pour 3 tbsp of dry yeast into warm water and stir to dissolve before adding 3 tbsp of extra virgin olive oil and continue to stir.
To ensure the yeast is activated, place a flat plate over the top of the bowl with the yeast mixture and leave for at least 15-20 minutes or until bubbles have formed on the top layer.
Once the bubbles have formed, stir it again, create a small well in the middle of the flour and gently pour the mixture in.
Keep a bowl of warm water next to you at all times, as you will need to keep adding this to your zeppole dough.
Mix through the liquid using your hands to ensure there is no dry flour left and keep gradually adding water until you get a consistency that is thick and sticky,
For this zeppole recipe, each time you add water, knead the dough and turn it over so it combines really well.
Once you have reached the right consistency (it will take at least 15 minutes), cover the bowl with a kitchen towel or folded tablecloth so no air is let in, leaving it for at least an hour to rise.
Before you start cooking the zeppole, heat up the desired amount of vegetable oil in the fryer or saucepan to approximately 180 ºC. (356F).
Place a small bowl with oil next to you as you will need to keep your hands moist at all times through this process.
Prepare a large plate or tray with paper towel so you can place your zeppole inside and this can absorb any excess oil.
Remove cover from the dough and moisten your hands using the oil.

Pull up a piece of dough and roughly flatten it out on the palm of your hand. Take an anchovy (sardine or your desired filing), place it in the middle and then fold the dough over, and twist it on both ends gently to encase the anchovy, making sure there are no holes and that the dough is not too thin around the filling.
Place it into the fryer/saucepan, and add a few more without overcrowding them.
Using a long set of tongs, tap the zeppole to turn them over and once they are completely golden, they are ready!
Remove them from the oil and place them on a plate or tray and serve.
Repeat until the dough is finished.
Optional: Make this zeppole recipe plain with no filling, or leave some dough until dessert time and dip plain ones with cinnamon and honey.
