Preheat oven to 350ºF (180ºC).
Dissolve coffee granules in boiling water and let cool. Lightly grease or spray 13”X9” inch (3 L) baking dish with nonstick cooking spray and line bottom with waxed paper.
In large bowl, mix together flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Whisk milk with yogurt until blended; add to flour mixture; and beat at medium speed for 2 minutes.
Pour into prepared pan. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until top springs back when lightly touched. Let cool in pan on rack for 20 minutes.
Remove from pan; and cool completely on rack.
In small saucepan, mix sugar with cocoa; whisk in milk until smooth.
Over medium heat, bring to a simmer, stirring constantly. Continue stirring and cook for 2 minutes. Remove from heat; stir in vanilla.
Let cool for 2 hours (icing thickens upon cooking). Spread over cake top
notes: Chocolate Icing :

title: Delicious Chocolate Cake

ingredients.rawText: 1 Duncan Hines Devil Food Cake Mix
ingredients.normalizedName: duncan hines devil food cake mix

ingredients.rawText: 1 pkg chocolate Jello instant pudding (4 portions)

instructions: Mix in bowl with fork.
Put into greased and floured cake pans
Bake at 350ºF for 40 minutes
Cool in pan. Turn onto racks Tip: Icing: Monarch – Chocolate Fudge or Betty Crocker Chocolate Deluxe

title: Chocolate “Mini Chip” Coffee Cake

ingredients.normalizedName: squares baker s semi sweet chocolate squares

instructions: Cake: Sift together flour, baking powder and salt. Set aside
Combine baking soda and sour cream. Set aside
Cream shortening with sugar until light and fluffy
Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition
Add vanilla
Alternately blend in flour mixture and sour cream in thirds
Blend on low speed of electric mixer
Fold in chocolate chips
Pour into greased and floured 9” square cake pan
Topping: Combine cereal, brown sugar and cinnamon and mix well
Sprinkle evenly over surface of batter
Bake at 350ºF for 45-50 minutes or until done
Partially melt chocolate squares with shortening over hot water
Remove from heat and continue stirring until completely melted
With small spoon, drizzle over topping

title: Chocolate Chip Cookie Cake
instructions: In spring form pan, add layer of cookies that have quickly been dipped in milk, (white or chocolate) Cover with cool whip
Repeat step above until you reach top of the pan (last layer should be cream) or you’ve run out of cookies. There should be at least 3 layers. Reserve 3 cookies for topping of cake.
Crumble remaining 3 cookies and sprinkle over top.
Cover with saran wrap.
Refrigerate overnight or at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Chocolate Lava Cakes

ingredients.rawText: 3 (1 oz/28g) squares bittersweet chocolate, cut into pieces

instructions: Line bottoms of 4 ramekins or small custard cups with circle of parchment paper, grease and set aside.
In medium microwaveable bowl, microwave margarine and chocolate on high for 45 seconds or until chocolate is melted, stir until smooth.
Whisk in sugar, flour and salt until blended. Beat in eggs, egg yolks and vanilla.
Spoon even amounts into prepared ramekins. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour or until ready to bake (up to 24 hours).
Preheat oven to 450°F. (230°C.) Bake 13 to 15 minutes or until edges are firm but centres are still slightly soft (do not overbake).
Let cool on wire rack for 5 minutes. To serve, carefully run sharp knife around cake edges. Unmold onto plates, remove parchment paper.
Dust tops with icing sugar. Serve with fresh raspberries.
notes: Margaret V.

title: Chocolate Walnut Cake
instructions: Combine dry ingredients and blend well
Cream eggs and sugar and add oil, milk and mix well
Mix in blended dry ingredients
Blend in walnuts last with a wooden spoon
Pour into cake pan and bake 1 hour at 350ºF

title: Honey Almond Coffee Cake
instructions: Glaze: Set aside 1 cup flour from total amount
Mix remaining flour, yeast and salt in a large bowl.
Heat milk, water, almond extract, honey and 2 tbsp margarine or butter until hot to touch (125ºF to 130ºF)
Stir hot liquids into dry ingredients
Mix in egg
Stir in enough reserved flour to make a soft dough that does not stick to the bottom of the bowl
Turn out on floured surface and knead 5 minutes
Cover and let rise 10 minutes while making filling
Combine 2 tbsp honey, 2 tbsp margarine or butter, cinnamon and cardamom and mix well
Roll dough into a 14 by 10 inch rectangle
Spread filling on dough, leaving a 1 inch margin around outside.
Sprinkle 3/4 cup almonds over filling
Roll jelly-roll style along the edge.
Seal edge by pinching dough firmly together; fold ends under and pinch to seal.
Place sealed edges down on greased baking sheet curving slightly to form a crescent
Place over a shallow pan half-filled with boiling water
Cover with greased wax paper and let rise 30 minutes
Bake in a preheated 350ºF oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown
Remove from pan and cool on rack
To make glaze, heat honey and margarine or butter together, mixing well
Brush on crescent
Sprinkle almonds on top
Slice and serve

title: Coffee Cake Walnut Filled
instructions: Beat eggs and add sugar and then melted Crisco until well blended
Combine 2 cups flour, soda, baking powder and salt and add to above
Combine 1 cup flour and sour cream and pour into mixture
Pour half of the batter into greased pan
Topping and Centre: Combine and blend all walnuts, sugar, vanilla and cinnamon
Pour half of the topping mixture on top of the batter in the pan
Pour remaining batter onto of topping mixture
Bake one hour at 300ºF
When cool pour remaining topping mixture on cake.

title: Corn Meal Bundt (Proja)

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup of very fine corn flour

instructions: Mix all ingredients together.
Put it in oiled Bundt cake shaped pan and bake in preheated oven on 450ºF for about 30 minutes. baked inside. Serve with milk or hot chocolate drink.
notes: Rajka Ratkovic (Sugar, lactose, gluten free) Note: the mixed ingredients will be liquidy. Pierce with a knife to see if it is

title: Date and Nut Loaf
instructions: Combine all above and bake for 55 minutes in a 350ºF oven

title: Espresso Panna Cotta

ingredients.rawText: 1 small white chocolate bar, for garnishing
1 small dark chocolate bar, for garnishing

instructions: Place milk in heavy, small saucepan. Sprinkle gelatin over and let stand for 5 minutes to soften gelatin. Stir over medium heat just until gelatin dissolves but milk does not boil, about 2 minutes. Add cream, espresso powder, sugar and salt. Stir over low heat until sugar dissolves, about 3 more minutes. Remove from the heat and let cool slightly.
Pour the cream mixture into 2 martini glasses, dividing equally. Cover and refrigerate, stirring every 20 minutes during the first hour. Chill until set, at least 6 hours and up to 2 days.
When ready to serve, use a vegetable peeler on the chocolate blocks to create about 1 tbsp each of the white and dark chocolate shavings. Sprinkle the shavings over each panna cotta and serve.
notes: Mary V.

title: Honey Loaves Lina’s Mustazzolli
instructions: Heat honey in large pot and put on cold burner.
Add oil, juices, grated rinds and 1 cup flour to cool honey.
Beat eggs, add to cooled honey, mix well so as not to “cook “ egg yolks.
Combine flour, baking soda, and cinnamon and mix into honey mixture.
Add optional roasted almonds and peels. Mix well. Put on board, knead and form into loaves. Place loaves on parchment covered cookie sheets.
Bake 350°F. for 20 minutes until golden and light.
Brush beaten egg white on top. Slice when cool. May be frozen.
notes: Lina Vitale makes 6-7 loaves

title: Irish Tea Brack

ingredients.rawText: ¼ cup chopped candied mixed peel

instructions: In bowl, combine raisins, currants, peel, sugar and hot tea.
Cover bowl and let sit overnight.
Combine flour, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt. Add this to the fruit mixture alternately with beaten egg.
Spoon mixture into a 9 X 5 inch loaf pan and bake in a 325F oven for 1 ½ hours or until done. Cover/Tent it with foil loosely so top won’t burn.
Remove foil 10-15 minutes before it is done. Test doneness by inserting toothpicks while it is baking.
Cool on wire rack for 5 minutes then remove loaf from pan and cool. ZORAN will have plenty of time to get a week’s worth of ironing done as this loaf takes a while to bake.

title: Lemon Cake Recipe
instructions: Blend all ingredients together and bake 35 minutes at 350ºF

title: Lemon Sour Cream Cake
instructions: Cream margarine or butter with sugar until light and fluffy
Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition.
Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt
Add lemon rind and flour mixture to eggs and beat at high speed until well mixed, about 2 minutes. Mix in sour cream and stir in chips and nuts.
Spoon batter into a greased 9 X 13 inch baking pan or a Bundt pan
Bake in preheated 350ºF oven 60 minutes or until done

title: Meringue Cream Torte

ingredients.rawText: 2 tbsp hazelnut flavoured liqueur or cold espresso
¾ cup semisweet chocolate curls, optional

instructions: *Superfine sugar dissolves faster than table sugar.
Preheat oven to 300ºF.
Butter and flour an 8-inch cake pan with a removable rim at least 3 inches tall (such as a springform pan).

In a large bowl with a mixer on high speed, beat egg whites and cream of tartar until frothy. Continuing to beat at high speed, add sugar in a slow, steady stream; continue to beat until mixture holds stiff peaks, 8 to 12 minutes. Beat in vanilla extract.
With a flexible spatula, scrape mixture into prepared cake pan; spread mixture out to edges of pan and smooth out top.
Bake approximately 25 minutes until top is lightly browned and feels firm when gently pressed in the centre. Remove from oven and let stand for 20 minutes (meringue may shrink a little as it cools).

To remove from pan, run a thin knife between meringue and pan rim, then remove rim. Carefully invert meringue onto a plate then slide a long, thin spatula between pan bottom and meringue and gently lift the bottom off. Invert meringue again onto another plate so that it is right side up. Let cool completely.
In a bowl, whisk hazelnut liqueur into chocolate/hazelnut spread.

In another bowl, whip cream until it holds soft peaks. Stir about ¼ cup of the whipped cream into the chocolate/hazelnut mixture until no white streaks remain. Fold chocolate mixture into remaining whipped cream, then whisk gently until mixture has a loose, spreadable consistency (take care not to overbeat or it will curdle).

With the spatula, spread chocolate/hazelnut cream around sides and over the top of the meringue. If desired, sprinkle chocolate curls over the cake. Chill torte uncovered for at least 1 hour, or cover with a large, inverted bowl (it should not touch the cream) and chill up to 24 hours.
Cut torte into wedges to serve. Makes 6 to 8 servings.

title: Meringue Layers
instructions: Preheat oven to 225ºF. In mixer, beat egg whites, salt, cream of tartar and vanilla extract until soft peaks form. Gradually beat in sugar and continue beating until meringue is stiff and glossy.
Line baking sheets with parchment or waxed paper. Trace three, eight- inch circles on paper.

With a rubber spatula, spread meringue evenly and equally over top of the circles. Bake approximately 2 hours or until meringue becomes bisque coloured. NOTE: The low temperature will prevent them from browning too quickly. Then turn off oven, open oven door and let meringues “rest” in oven another 15 minutes. Remove from oven and carefully peel off parchment or waxed paper. Put cake on racks to dry until thoroughly cool.

Once cooled, meringues may be wrapped in saran and frozen. large plastic container for freezing. Remove from freezer at least an hour before assembling. Storage: 3 days at room temperature, 3 weeks refrigerated (individually wrapped in plastic wrap to prevent drying), or 3 months frozen.
notes: NOTE: Wrap each meringue in several saran layers, then stack (gently!) in a

title: Mincemeat Nut Bread

ingredients.rawText: 3 tbsp vegetable shortening, melted and cooled

instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºF. Grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan. In a large bowl, sift together flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.

In a medium bowl, cream eggs, vegetable shortening, and vanilla extract until light and fluffy. Fold in mincemeat and walnuts. Pour egg mixture into flour mixture and stir until dry ingredients are moistened.

Pour batter into prepared loaf pan and bake 55 to 60 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in centre comes out clean. Remove from oven and cool on a wire rack 10 minutes and remove from pan. Cool completely before slicing. Sprinkle top with powdered sugar. Yields 1 loaf.

title: Mocha Oatmeal Cake

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup Quaker oats (quick or old fashioned uncooked)
¾ cup butter or margarine softened

instructions: Combine coffee powder and boiling water. Pour over oats and stir. Cover, set aside and let stand for 20 minutes.
Beat butter until creamy. Gradually add sugars, beating until fluffy
Put in eggs one at a time. Blend in vanilla.
Add oatmeal mixture and blend well
Sift together flour, soda, salt, and cocoa. Add to creamed mixture, blending well. Pour batter into greased and floured Bundt cake.
Bake 50-55 minutes in 350ºF oven
Remove from oven and cool 10 minutes. Frost if desired.

title: Orange Loaf Lemon Glazed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºF. Spray a 5 X 9 inch loaf pan with nonstick spray. Dust with flour and tap out the excess.
Batter : Whisk together the flour, orange zest, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl and set aside.
In a medium bowl whisk together the granulated sugar, orange juice, oil eggs and vanilla.
Add the orange juice mixture to the flour mixture, stirring until well combined. Pour into the pan.
Bake until a toothpick inserted into the centre of the loaf comes out clean approximately 40-45 minutes.
Let cool in the pan on a rack for 1 minute.
Remove loaf from pan and let cool completely on the rack.
Orange Glaze: Whisk together confectioners’ sugar, lemon zest and orange juice in a medium bowl until smooth.
With a narrow metal spatula, spread glaze evenly over top of the loaf.
Let stand until glaze sets, about 10 minutes. Cut into 16 pieces.

title: Outrageous Oreo Cake

ingredients.normalizedName: you ll never make anything else

ingredients.rawText: 4 to 5 packages of the Oreo wafer cookies (not the sandwich Oreos, just the wafer
ingredients.normalizedName: oreo wafer cookies not sandwich oreos

ingredients.rawText: 3 to 4 tubs of Cool Whip, thawed

instructions: THAT’S IT!!! People will think you spent hours doing this one!: In a nice baking dish, layer Oreo wafers, then cool whip until dish is full.
Sprinkle crushed Oreo wafers on top.
Refrigerate overnight.

title: Orange Poppy Seed Bread
instructions: Tip: * Toasting Poppy Seeds - Toast poppy seeds in a 350ºF oven or in a dry frying pan over medium heat. Stir occasionally, toasting only until seeds begin to brown.
Preheat oven to 350ºF. Grease two 9x5 inch loaf pans.
In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, poppy seeds, baking powder, and salt. Add eggs, milk, vegetable oil, orange zest, vanilla extract, and almond extract; stir until dry ingredients are moistened.
Pour batter into prepared loaf pans.
Bake 55 to 60 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in centre comes out clean. Remove from oven and place on wire racks.

While still hot, using a long-tined fork, poke holes in the top of baked loaves. Pour Orange Glaze over loaves. Cool in pans for 10 minutes; remove from pans. Cool completely before slicing. Yields 2 loaves.

title: Orange Glaze
instructions: In a medium bowl, combine powdered sugar, orange juice, vanilla extract and almond extract and stir until well blended.

title: Orange Nut Loaf
instructions: In medium bowl combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt and stir in ½ cup nuts.
In small bowl lightly beat eggs with oil, orange juice and vanilla. Add liquid all at once to dry ingredients. Stir just until moistened.
Pour into greased 9 x 5 inch loaf pan. Sprinkle with remaining nuts (press into batter). Bake in a 350ºF oven for 50 to 55 minutes, until golden on top. Makes 16 slices to a loaf.

title: Uncle Jimmy’s Chocolate Pound Cake

ingredients.rawText: 1 (8-ounce) semi sweet chocolate bar or chocolate chips
ingredients.normalizedName: semi sweet chocolate bar chocolate chips

instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºF. Grease and flour a 12-cup Bundt pan, leaving 2 inches at the top for the cake to rise.
In a large bowl, cream butter and sugar together until fluffy. Add eggs, one at a time; beat until fully incorporated.
In a heavy saucepan over low heat, melt chocolate bar or chocolate chips; stirring until smooth. Remove from heat. Add chocolate syrup and butter/sugar mixture and stir until well mixed.
Add ½ the milk mixture to chocolate mixture. Add 1 ½ cups flour, mixing well. Add remaining milk mixture and remaining 1 ½ cups flour; beat until well incorporated. Pour into prepared Bundt pan.

Bake approximately 1 hour 20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the centre comes out clean. Remove from oven and cool 15 minutes on a wire rack; remove from pan and invert onto a cake plate. Makes 16 servings.

title: Peanut Butter Cake

ingredients.rawText: ½ cup coarsely chopped peanut brittle (optional)

instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. Butter bottoms and sides of three 8 inch round cake pans. Line bottom of pans with round buttered parchment papers.
Sift the flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking soda and salt in a large bowl. Whisk to combine them well.
Add oil, sour cream and whisk to blend.
Gradually beat in water. Blend in the vinegar and vanilla.
Whisk in the eggs and beat until well blended. Scrape down the bowl to ensure batter is well mixed.
Divide and pour batter into the 3 prepared pans.
Bake 30-35 minutes or until a cake tester or wooden toothpick inserted in the centre comes out almost clean.

Let cool in the pans for about 20 minutes. Invert onto wire racks, carefully peel off paper liners and cool completely. Note: These cakes are very, very soft. It is easier to work with after firming them up in the freezer for 30 minutes. Cakes will defrost quickly once assembled.

To frost cake, place one layer, flat side up on a cake stand or large serving plate. Spread 2/3 cup of the peanut butter frosting evenly over top. Repeat with next layer. Place the last layer on top and frost the top and sides of the cake with remaining frosting. Note 1: Make a crumb coat of frosting in a thin layer that binds the dark crumbs to the cake so they don’t show up in the final outer frosting. Once you “mask” the cake, let it chill 15 – 30 minutes until firm. Use the remainder of the frosting to create a smooth final coating. Note 2 : Once the cake is fully frosted, it helps to chill it again and let it firm up. The cooler and more set the peanut butter frosting is the better the drip effect you’ll get from the Chocolate-Peanut butter glaze.

To decorate with the Chocolate-Peanut Butter glaze, put the cake plate on a large baking sheet to catch any drips. Simply pour the glaze over the top of the cake, and using an offset spatula, spread it evenly over top just to edges so that it runs down the sides of the cake in long drips.
Refrigerate uncovered for at least 30 minutes to allow the glaze and frosting to set completely. Remove about 1 hour before serving.
Decorate the top with Peanut Brittle.
notes: Georgina V.

title: Poppy Seed Cake
instructions: Spice Mixture: Glaze: Soak poppy seeds in milk for at least 1 hour.
Mix together cake mixture, pudding, eggs, oil and water then add poppy seed mixture.
In a small bowl combine spice mixture ingredients.
Grease and flour a Bundt pan. Pour in a layer of cake mixture and sprinkle with spice mixture, repeating until all is used.
Bake at 350 degree for 1 hour.
Combine glaze ingredients.
Turn cake out and while still warm, drizzle glaze mixture over cake.

title: Pumpkin Tea Cake

ingredients.rawText: 1 (15-oz.) can of 100% pumpkin puree 1 cup of vegetable oil

instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºF. Grease and flour a 9 x 13 inch baking pan or two small Bundt pans.
At a medium speed, with an electric mixer, beat together pumpkin puree, vegetable oil, eggs, and sugar and set aside.

In a separate bowl, blend together flour, baking soda, baking powder, cinnamon, salt, and vanilla extract until evenly and smoothly mixed together. Pour in the pumpkin batter and stir until thoroughly mixed. Pour mixture into prepared baking pan or Bundt pans.
Sprinkle the top with additional ground cinnamon.

Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until centre allows a tooth pick to come out clean. (If nuts are desired, after 20 minutes of baking, remove cake from oven and sprinkle nuts on top. Return to oven and bake until done.

Remove from oven and allow to cool. Cut into squares and serve either “as is” or with whipped cream topping. Variation : This recipe will also work when baked in small loaf shape pans, cupcake pans, muffin pans or cake pans. Only fill each pan to the half way mark as the batter rises.

title: Ricotta Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. (175°C). Grease and flour a 9x13 inch pan.
Prepare the cake according to the directions on the package
In a medium bowl, combine ricotta, sugar, eggs and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Drop by spoonfuls on top of uncooked cake.
Bake for 1 1/2 hours, or until a toothpick inserted into the cake comes out clean. Sprinkle cooled cake with confectioners’ sugar.
Keep refrigerated.

title: Shortcake

ingredients.rawText: ½ cup margarine, butter or shortening

instructions: Grease a 9 inch round cake or 8 inch square pan.
In large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
Using pastry blender, cut in margarine until consistency of coarse meal.
Add milk and eggs; stir just until dry ingredients are moistened.
Spread dough in prepared pan and bake in preheated oven at 375ºF for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Serve warm.

Split and fill with sweetened fruit and whipped cream. Tip: Shortcake may be cut into wedges or squares before splitting. Fill each individual piece with sweetened fruit and whipped cream. For individual shortcakes , drop dough by rounded tablespoons, 2 inches apart, on greased cookie pan. Bake 450ºF for 10-12 min. until golden brown.

title: Sour Cream Cake, Chocolate Chip Topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºF. Grease and flour 9X13 inch baking pan.
Beat butter, 1 cup sugar and eggs at high speed for 10 minutes
Sift dry ingredients together and blend by hand into creamed mixture
Mix sour cream in well and mix with wooden spoon
Pour batter into pan. Scatter chips over top, sprinkle with 1 tbsp sugar
Bake for 35 minutes or until cake begins to pull away from sides of pan
Let cool in pan on rack Makes 16 to 20 servings

title: Spice Cake
instructions: Cream softened butter. Add eggs yolks and sugar, alternately.
Until sugar is dissolved, start adding flour, spices and enough milk so that the batter falls loosely from the spoon.
Beat egg whites until peaks form and fold into batter.
Pour batter into greased and floured spring form pan.
Bake at 350ºF for 1 hour.

title: Pane DI Spagna - Sponge Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F. (175°C).
Butter a round cake pan of about 9 inches (22 cm) in diameter x 2 inches (5 cm) deep. Line the pan with a disk of parchment paper.
In the bowl of an electric mixer, combine the eggs, vanilla, and sugar.
Beat vigorously with an electric mixer for about 10 – 15 minutes, or until the mixture is very soft and doubled in volume.
In a bowl or plate, sift the flour, cornstarch and a pinch of salt together.
Sift the flour mixture into the beaten eggs.
Fold the mixture thoroughly with a rubber spatula, 3 – 4 times, mixing gently with a round, top to bottom movement.
Pour into the pan and level with a spatula. Bake for about 30 – 45 minutes, or until golden.
Remove from the pan turning upside down. Remove parchment paper.
Transfer on a rack to cool to room temperature.

title: Sponge Cake alla Bruna
instructions: Combine ingredients together in a bowl over another cold bowl of lukewarm water. Pour into a Bundt pan.
Bake 30-40 minutes in 300ºF oven until golden on top (check so as not to burn)

title: Lemon Sponge Cake
instructions: Mix eggs until fluffy. Add sugar and oil slowly making sure it is mixed in well. Add grated lemon, lemon juice, vanilla, and baking powder.
Add flour and mix well. Pour into a greased Bundt pan.
Bake in a 300ºF oven for 35 to 40 minutes.
Allow to cool before removing from pan. Once cooled, enjoy!
notes: Mary V.

title: Sponge Cake Lemon Almond

ingredients.rawText: A little more than 1/3 cup oil
Pkg of vanilla (little black ones or 1 tsp vanilla
1 cup roasted almonds combined with grated chocolate (optional)

instructions: Beat eggs and sugar together
Add oil and lemon rind and vanilla
Combine flour and baking powder
Mix dry ingredients with egg mixture well
Bake at 350ºF for 45 to 60 minutes

title: Nonna Teresa Sponge Cake
instructions: Mix sugar, eggs and lemon peel well
Combine flour with baking powder
Add flour mixture gradually (a tbsp at a time) and mix well after each addition
Bake at 350ºF until centre springs back when pushed down or a spaghetti is inserted in middle of cake and comes out clean

title: Zucchini Bread
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºF. Lightly grease and flour two 9x5 inch loaf pans.

In a large bowl, cream eggs, sugar, and vegetable oil until light and fluffy. Mix in flour, salt, cinnamon, baking powder, and baking soda. Add cloves, zucchini, nuts, and vanilla extract and stir until well blended.

Pour batter into prepared loaf pans and bake 55 to 60 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in centre comes out clean. Remove from oven and cool on wire racks 10 minutes and remove from pans. Cool completely before slicing. Yields 2 loaves.
Combine above ingredients and pour over hot cake after it comes out of the oven.
notes: * Young tender zucchini need not be peeled or seeded * Use the large holes of the grater to grate the zucchini Topping: ½ cup icing sugar Juice of ½ lemon 2 tsp orange juice

title: Zucchini Cake
instructions: Mix eggs and sugar, add oil and vanilla and mix well
Combine flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon and salt and add into egg mixture mixing well
Stir in shredded zucchini
Pour into greased bread pans
Bake at 350ºF for 1 hour

title: Butter Cream Icing

ingredients.rawText: 1 tsp white vanilla or almond flavouring

instructions: In a large mixing bowl cream first three ingredients
Alternately add water with icing sugar
Mix all ingredients thoroughly, store in an airtight container.

title: Crisco Icing

ingredients.rawText: 1 tsp white vanilla or almond flavouring

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, cream first three ingredients
Alternately add water with icing sugar
Mix all ingredients thoroughly, store in an airtight container.
notes: *The above Crisco and Butter Cream amount of icing will decorate and ice a 9x12 inch cake. *When icing a cake dilute some of the icing to seal in the crumbs. Wait half an hour and then put on the icing. *This icing will also make flowers. Add the colour of your choice. Use the various tips to create the flowers and leaves.

title: Chocolate Icing
instructions: In small saucepan, mix sugar with cocoa; whisk in milk until smooth.
Over medium heat, bring to a simmer, stirring constantly. Continue stirring and cook for 2 minutes.
Remove from heat; stir in vanilla. Let cool for 2 hours (icing thickens upon cooking). Spread over top of cake. See Lite and Easy Chocolate Cake

title: Easy Cookie Icing
instructions: With fork mix sugar, salt, water, vanilla and corn syrup
Add ½ tbsp water and stir with whisk. Sets in 24 hours.

title: Icing Sugar
instructions: Stir vanilla and powdered sugar.
Slowly stream in milk until frosting/icing reaches desired consistency.
Scrape sides and whip again until light, fluffy and smooth, 1-2 minutes.

title: Royal Icing

ingredients.rawText: 3 tablespoons of meringue powder (obtained at a bulk food store)

instructions: Wet all ingredients with a wooden spoon in a large mixing bowl to avoid splattering icing sugar all over the counter.
Mix all ingredients for 5 minutes.
Store in a glass jar then use that day or next.
notes: To hold gingerbread creations together you will need:

title: Royal Icing Antoniette

ingredients.rawText: 1/3 cup water (leave a little bit and use only if needed)

instructions: Mix for 5 minutes until white and holds peak.
Keep covered in a bowl with a white tea towel to ensure moistness otherwise the icing will dry quickly See Gingerbread House
notes: Antoniette C.

title: Chocolate Frosting

ingredients.rawText: sugar, cocoa powder, vanilla and milk.

instructions: In a large bowl, sift together butter and cocoa until smooth.
Stir in vanilla and powdered sugar.
Slowly stream in milk until frosting reaches desired consistency.
Scrape sides and whip again until light, fluffy and smooth, 1-2 minutes.
notes: This Chocolate Frosting recipe is a chocolate buttercream because it is made with lots of softened butter that is whipped together with powdered Hint: Frosts 1-9 or 8 inch round layered cake or 24 cupcakes .

title: Butter Frosting
instructions: In a large bowl, melt 1 tablespoon of butter. Add in confectioners’ sugar.
Stir in milk, stirring to incorporate well to a desired consistency for frosting the cookies.
Brush on cookies or use a spoon, apply sprinkles right away and return to rack to set.
Let cool completely and store in airtight containers. See S Cookies

title: Cocoa Frosting
instructions: Blend frosting Ingredients; beat until smooth and spread over completely cooled cake. See Texas Brownies
notes: Frosting:

title: Coconut Cream Cheese Frosting
instructions: Melt butter in skillet and add coconut and stir well.
Add cream cheese and brown sugar and mix well. Bring cream, butter, brown sugar and coconut to a boil, stirring constantly.
Reduce the heat and simmer gently for 2 minutes.
Spread the frosting on the hot cake and broil until golden brown 2-3 minutes. See Carrot Cake Frosted

title: Coconut Cream Cheese Frosting II
instructions: Cream butter with cream cheese and add milk and sugar alternately
Add vanilla and stir in 1¾ cups of coconut, saving a ¼ cup to sprinkle on top of the cake
Frost between cooled cake layer and on top
Sprinkle frosted cake with remaining coconut See Carrot Cake Coconut Frosted

title: Cream Cheese Frosting

ingredients.rawText: 8 oz pkg cream cheese, room temperature

instructions: Add cream cheese frosting ingredients together, drizzle over cool cake. See Carrot Cake Cream Cheese Frosted

title: Cream Cheese Vanilla Frosting
instructions: In medium bowl, blend Frosting Ingredients; beat until smooth and spread over completely cooled cake. See Carrot Cake Frosted

title: Cream Cheese Vanilla Mixer Frosting II
instructions: Mix all four ingredients and pour over cooled cake See Lundy Luscious Carrot Cake

title: Cream Cheese Orange Frosting
instructions: Mix above ingredients together and pour over cake

title: Orange Frosting
instructions: Combine above ingredients and pour over hot cake right out of the oven. See Lemon Sour Cream Cake

title: Fudgy Cocoa Frosting
instructions: Melt butter. Combine 3 tbsp melted butter with ¼ cup Fry’s cocoa.
Blend in ¼ cup milk, ½ tsp vanilla and 2 cups sifted icing sugar until smooth. See Brownies

title: Peanut Butter Frosting

ingredients.rawText: 10 oz cream cheese at room temperature
1 stick (4 oz) unsalted butter at room temperature

instructions: In a large bowl with an electric mixer, beat the cream cheese and butter until light and fluffy.

Gradually add the confectioners’ sugar 1 cup at a time, mixing thoroughly after each addition and scraping down the sides of the bowl often. Continue to beat on medium speed until light and fluffy 3-4 minutes.
Add the peanut butter and beat until thoroughly blended.
notes: Georgina V.

title: Peppermint Frosting
instructions: Blend frosting ingredients together. Spread frosting evenly over cooled brownies See Texas Brownies

title: Vanilla Frosting
instructions: In a medium bowl, using an electric hand mixer, beat the butter until light and smooth.
Stir in vanilla and powdered sugar.

Slowly stream in milk until frosting reaches desired consistency. Scrape sides and whip again until light, fluffy and smooth, 1-2 minutes. consistency you want. *If your frosting is too thin , add a little extra powdered sugar little by little to get the consistency you want.
notes: Tips: * If your frosting is too thick , slowly add in milk little by little to get the

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Glaze

ingredients.rawText: ½ cup half and half cream

instructions: In top of a double boiler or in a bowl set over simmering water, combine the chocolate, peanut butter and corn syrup.
Cook whisking often until the chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth. Remove from the heat and whisk in the half and half beating until smooth. Use while still warm.

title: Lemon Glaze
instructions: Whisk together the confectioners’ sugar, lemon zest and juice in a medium bowl until smooth.
With a narrow metal spatula, spread the glaze evenly over the top of the loaf.
Let stand until glaze sets, about 10 minutes. Cut cake

title: Apple Butter

ingredients.rawText: Grated zest and juice of ½ Lemon (Mylar)
Grated zest and juice of 1/3 orange
Sugar (1 ½ cups per 2 ½ cups of apple pulp) 2 ½ cups dry apple cider

instructions: Peel, core and slice the apples.

In a large saucepan, place apple cider and bring to a rapid boil. Keep boiling until the apple juice is reduced by 1/3. When apple juice is reduced add sliced apples to the pan. If needed, add water to cover the apples. Half cover the top of the saucepan and simmer, gently stirring and crushing the apple pulp until the apples are pulpy, soft in the reduced liquid. NOTE: If pulp remains lumpy, remove and process in a food processor or blender to a crude puree.

Remove from heat and measure the crude puree and then return to saucepan. Add 1 ½ cups of sugar for every 2 ½ cups of measured apple puree. Mix in orange and lemon zest and juice, cinnamon, and cloves.

Over low heat, stirring frequently, cook until the sugar has completely dissolved. After sugar dissolves, continue to simmer, stirring frequently, until the majority of the liquid is gone. When sliding spoon across the top leaves an indent, the mixture is ready. Remove from heat.
Place apple mixture into a clean, room temperature jar. Refrigerate.
Serve with scones. Yield: 2 to 3 small jars.

title: Chocolate Cream
instructions: Combine all ingredients and mix together

title: Cannoli Cream

ingredients.rawText: ¼ cup semi sweet chocolate chips

instructions: In medium bowl stir dry ricotta (drain in cheesecloth if wet), sugar, citron, orange peel and cinnamon until smooth. Stir in chocolate chips.
Just before serving spoon ricotta mixture into prepared cannoli shells.
Sprinkle ends with pistachios and dust with icing sugar. Note: Cannoli shells can be made with pizzelle recipe and shaped into a roll when warm.

title: Cream Cheese Filling
instructions: Beat cream cheese and sugar together. Beat 1 egg at a time and pour over crust. Bake in a 325ºF oven for 20 minutes.
Sprinkle gelatin over water and let stand 5 minutes.
Put canned pumpkin, sugar, egg yolks, cinnamon, salt, and milk into saucepan. Heat and stir until boiling and thickened. Remove from heat, stir in gelatin.
Beat egg whites and add sugar gradually beating until stiff. Fold into pumpkin mixture. Pour over cheese layer and chill.
Top with whipped cream.

title: Devonshire Mock Cream
instructions: In a large bowl, combine cream cheese, sugar, and salt then stir until well blended. Stir in whipping cream.
With an electric mixer, beat mixture until stiff. Store in refrigerator.
notes: This thick, buttery cream often used as a topping for desserts originally came from Devonshire County, England. It is also known as Devon or clotted cream. It is thick and has a golden crust like soft butter. Before pasteurization, milk from the cows was left to stand for several hours so the cream would rise to the top. Then this cream was skimmed and put into big pans. The pans were floated in trays of constantly boiling water in a process known as scalding.

title: Lemon Curd

ingredients.rawText: ½ cup fresh lemon juice (4 to 6 lemons)

instructions: In a medium saucepan over medium/high heat, combine lemon zest, lemon juice, and sugar. Bring just to a boil; reduce heat to medium/low and simmer 5 minutes. Add butter and stir until it has melted.
Remove from heat and cool to room temperature.

Beat eggs into cooled lemon mixture until well blended. Return to heat and cook over medium/low heat, stirring constantly for 10 to 15 minutes or until mixture thickens and coats spoon. Remove from heat. Store in refrigerator.

title: Lemon Cream
instructions: Beat egg yolks. Add sugar and mix well
Add flour and mix well. Add milk slowly until all mixed
On slow heat add lemon peel

title: Italian Pastry Cream

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 lemon peel, grated or vanilla or cocoa

instructions: Add egg yolks, sugar and grated lemon peel or vanilla and stir until dissolved. If making chocolate cream combine cocoa with flour
Add flour to egg mixture stir until all flour is dissolved
Put over medium heat and add milk slowly, stirring constantly
Keep at medium heat stirring constantly until pastry cream is thickened.
Cool before using

title: Pastry Cream
instructions: Prepare package of pudding with milk following label directions
Whip 1/2 cup heavy cream until stiff; fold into pudding and cover with plastic wrap; chill

title: Pumpkin Filling
instructions: Combine all ingredients together. Blend well

title: Vanilla Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients together
Place on burner and bring to a boil then simmer and stir constantly until cream thickens

title: Christmas Biscotti

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup candied red and green cherries (may be omitted if desired)

instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºF
Beat eggs and sugar and add softened butter and anice
Combine 3 cups flour, baking powder and salt and add to egg mixture. Beat until just mixed then increase speed to medium and beat 3 minutes
Stir in cherries, almonds and remaining 2 cups of flour with a wooden spoon. Wrap dough with plastic wrap and place in freezer for 30 minutes
Divide dough in quarters
On well floured surface, with floured hands shape each half of dough into a 10” X 3” loaf.
Place each loaf 2” apart on greased cookie sheet
Bake 25 minutes. Place loaves on a cutting board and with serrated knife, cut hot loaves crosswise into 3/4 inch thick slices
Lay slices cut side down on same cookie sheet
Return to oven and bake cookies 5 more minutes

title: Anise Christmas Biscotti
instructions: Preheat oven to 375 F, grease two 9 by 5 inch loaf pans
Cream together butter and sugar in a large bowl.
Add eggs and mix until smooth.
Sift flour and baking powder together and stir into the egg and sugar mixture.
Stir in anise oil and vanilla and knead until dough is smooth.
Place loaves in greased pans and bake 15 minutes or until pick comes out clean.
Line two cookie sheets with parchment paper.
Remove pans from oven and let loaves cool slightly. Remove loaves from the pan.
Cut loaves into 1 inch crosswise slices and place slices on parchment covered cookie sheet.
Toast slices about 1 to 2 minutes under broiler watching closely and turning to toast other side.

title: Naples Jam Filled Cookies (Bocconotti)
instructions: Preheat oven to 425°F. and line baking sheet with parchment paper.
Combine flour and sugar.Mix in oil and enough water to make soft dough.
Roll pastry out thinly on floured surface and cut out 2 to 3 inch rounds.
Place dab of jam in centre of round then fold in half and press edges together with a fork to seal.
Lay on baking sheet and brush with egg yolk.
Bake for about 20 minutes or until golden brown.
Cool and serve.

title: Calcioni
instructions: Glaze: Blend all dough ingredients together to a hard dough consistency.
Work like lasagna and lay/roll dough flat.
Mix either the filling or stuffing ingredients well and using a teaspoon, drop filling placed 3 inches apart on flattened dough.
Carefully fold over the dough so as to cover the filling to resemble pillows
With a cookie cutter, cut around each cookie to shape the pillows.
Each pillow will then be deep fried until golden brown.
Let cool for 30 minutes
Mix honey and water in a pot and bring to a boil
Dip cookies in honey mixture. Yum Yum

title: Caragnoli
instructions: Glaze: Blend all ingredients together to a consistency of hard dough
Work like a lasagna pasta

Roll into rope like pieces 12” each in length ½ “ thickness like a pen. You will need a rolling board that can be purchased from an Italian gourmet bakery or hardware store. With the rolling board, the dough can be wrapped and shaped, like an S with a ring around it
Cookie is then deep fried and placed on a cookie sheet to cool.
Then mix 2 parts honey, 1 part water and bring to a boil.
Dip cooled caragnoli cookies in honey mixture.

title: Florentine Biscotti

ingredients.rawText: A swirl of white chocolate adds a new twist to this traditional Italian Christmas cookie. This fruit
ingredients.normalizedName: swirl white chocolate adds new twist this traditional italian christmas cookie this fruit

instructions: and nut biscotti is traditionally iced on the bottom with dark chocolate. 6 tbsp butter 1/3 cup milk ¼ cup sugar 2 tbsp honey 1 cup almonds, sliced ¼ cup flour ½ cup candied mixed fruits and peel, finely chopped ¾ cup semi sweet chocolate chips 2 tbsp shortening 2 oz white chocolate bar 2 tsp shortening
Preheat oven to 350°F. and line baking sheets with parchment paper.
Combine, butter, milk, sugar and honey; bring to a full rolling boil stirring occasionally. Remove from heat (mixture will appear curdled) then stir in almonds and candied fruits.
Stir in flour; drop by level tablespoons 3 inches apart on baking sheet. NOTE: Do not use insulated baking sheet for these cookies.
Spread dough to make 3 inch circles.
Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until edges are lightly brown.
Cool on tray for 1 minute then remove from tray to rack to cool completely.
In small saucepan over low heat melt semi sweet chocolate with 2 tbsp shortening; spread bottom of each cookie with 1 tsp of melted chocolate.
In another small saucepan melt over low heat the white chocolate with 2 teaspoons shortening; drizzle white chocolate over dark chocolate of each cookie with fork to make marble effect.
After chocolate sets, store cookies in refrigerator.

title: Gengi or Ribbon Cookies

ingredients.rawText: ¼ cup butter cut into flour

instructions: Glaze: Mix all ingredients, use more flour if needed
Roll into long ropes and pass through the pasta machine and cut into 1 inch diameter ribbons. Cut the ribbons into 6 inch lengths.
Drop the 6 inch lengths in hot oil in a deep fryer for a few minutes until golden and ribbons float to top. Dust with icing sugar after fried.
Honey Topping: Melt honey in pot slowly and pour over ribbons ensuring each is coated.
notes: Rita V.

title: Gingerbread House
instructions: Sift four, soda, salt, nutmeg and ginger
Melt Crisco in big saucepan. Add sugar, molasses and let cool. Then add 2 eggs and mix well.
Slowly stir in 4 cups flour mixture then work in remaining flour mixture
Divide dough into 1/3’s. Roll piece between 2 sheets of waxed paper to 1/4” thickness. Cut out pieces and prick with fork to avoid uneven rise
Cool in fridge and put on pan
Bake in 375ºF oven 13 to 15 minutes
Straighten pieces by cutting when warm to ensure even sides
10, Attach together with Royal Icing below and in ICING SECTION
notes: Antoniette C.

title: Royal Icing

ingredients.rawText: 1/3 cup water (leave a little bit and use only if needed)

instructions: Mix for 5 minutes until white and holds peak.
Keep covered in a bowl with a white tea towel to ensure moistness otherwise the icing will dry quickly
notes: Antoniette C.

title: Gingerbread Cookies

ingredients.rawText: 10 tbsp (2/3 cup; 145g) unsalted butter, softened to room temperature
3/4 cup (150g) packed light or dark brown sugar
Optional : Easy cookie icing or Royal icing

instructions: or buy McCall’s Royal icing in 3 kg buckets .
In a large bowl using a standup mixer with paddle beat the butter for 1 min. on medium speed until smooth and creamy.
Add the brown sugar and molasses and beat on medium high speed until combined and creamy looking. Scrape down the sides and bottom of the bowl as needed.
Beat in egg and vanilla on high speed for 2 minutes. Scrape down the sides and bottom of the bowl as needed. If butter separates, it but is ok.
In a separate bowl, whisk the flour, baking soda, salt, ginger, cinnamon, allspice, and cloves together until combined.
On low speed, slowly mix dry mixture into the wet ingredients until combined. The cookie dough will be quite thick and slightly sticky.
Divide dough in half and place each onto a large piece of plastic wrap.
Wrap each up tightly and pat down to create a disc shape.
Chill discs for at least 3 hours and up to 3 days. Chilling is mandatory for this cookie dough.
Preheat oven to 350°F (177°C). Line 2-3 large baking sheets with parchment paper. Set aside.
Remove 1 disc of chilled cookie dough from the refrigerator.

Generously flour a work surface as well as your hands and the rolling pin. Roll out disc until 1/4-inch thick. Tips for rolling– the dough may crack and be crumbly as you roll. What is helpful is picking it up and rotating it as you go. Additionally, you can use your fingers to help meld the cracking edges back together. The first few rolls are always the hardest since the dough is so stiff but re-rolling the scraps is much easier.
Cut into shapes. Place shapes 1 inch apart on prepared pans. Re-roll dough scraps until all dough is shaped. Repeat with remaining dough disc.

Bake cookies for about 9-10 minutes. If your cookie cutters are smaller than 4 inches, bake for about 8 minutes. If your cookie cutters are larger than 4 inches, bake for about 11 minutes. Rotate the pan once during bake time if using a regular oven to avoid hot spots. The longer the cookies bake, the harder and crunchier they will be. For soft gingerbread cookies, follow the suggested bake times.
Allow cookies to cool for 5 minutes on the cookie sheet.

Transfer to cooling rack to cool completely. Scoop royal icing into medium zip lock freezer bag, zip closed, tie top with twist tie, cut hole in one corner, decorate as desired and let children decorate. .

Cookies stay fresh covered at room temperature for up to 1 week. Notes: * Make Ahead & Freezing Instructions: Baked and decorated (or not decorated) cookies freeze well – up to three months. Unbaked cookie dough discs (just the dough prepared through step 2) freeze well – up to three months. Thaw overnight in the refrigerator and continue with step 11. * Not for Gingerbread Houses : This cookie dough is not sturdy enough for gingerbread houses.
notes: These are soft in the centres, crisp on the edges, and perfectly spiced. Make sure to chill the cookie dough discs for a minimum of 3 hours.

title: Scrumptious Anise Cut Out Cookies

ingredients.rawText: 1 tsp anise flavouring 3 ½ cups flour

instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºF. Line ccokie sheets with parchment paper.
Beat eggs, sugar and anise flavouring together.
Sift flour, salt and baking powder together.
Gradually pour sifted dry ingredients into egg mixturea 1/3 at a time alternating with some milk.
Mix thoroughly after each addition.
Flour counter and rolling pin.
Pour batter onto counter and knead a minute or two to ensure even consistency of dough.
Roll flat to about ½ inch thickness.
Using cookie cutters cut dough into shapes.
Place on flour dusted baking sheet.
Bake about 6 minutes. Quantity of cookies and baking time varies with size of cookie cutters, about 8 dozen cookies.
Remove from trays and let cool completely.
When ready of serve, mix milk, powdered sugar and anise flavouring together in a shallow bowl.
Dip tops of cookies in icing sugar. Place on holiday tray or dish and sprinkle with candy sprinkles.

title: Serbian Christmas Bread Cesnica
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºF.

Combine flour, yeast, shortening and salt. Knead with enough warm water to moisten until dough separates from hands. Dough should be firm, not tacky. Place on greased pan. Let rise for 10 minutes in warm area. Perforate dough with fork, insert clean coin (quarter or gold dollar) and spread dough flat like a pizza.
Bake for 25 minutes until brown. Makes 16 servings

title: Pull Apart Presto Bread Wreathe
instructions: In large bowl, whisk together 4 cups of flour, sugar, yeast and salt.
In small saucepan, melt butter over medium/high heat; remove from heat, add milk and let stand until milk is warmed, about 1 minute.
Pour milk mixture into flour mixture; add egg, Parmesan and 4 tbsp of the pesto. Using wooden spoon, stir until soft ragged dough forms.

Turn onto lightly floured board; knead, adding as much of remaining flour as needed to prevent dough from sticking and until smooth and elastic (dough will be slightly tacky to touch but won't stick to hands), 5 to 7 min.
Transfer to large greased bowl. Cover with plastic wrap; let rise in warm draft-free place until doubled in size, about 1 1/2 hours.
Line 16-inch round pizza pan with parchment paper; place 3 1/2-inch diameter bowls upside down in centre of pan.
Punch down dough. Turn out onto lightly floured work surface; divide dough evenly into 25 pieces.
Shape 1 piece into ball, folding ends underneath and pinching at bottom; roll on work surface in circular motion, seam side down into smooth ball. Repeat with remaining dough pieces.

Arrange balls in ring shape around a bowl; arrange remaining balls around first layer. Remove bow or arrange the dough balls in a tree shape instead of a wreath. Cover with plastic wrap; let rise in warm draft- free place until doubled in size, about 1 hour.
Preheat oven to 375°F. Bake until rolls are golden and sound hollow when tapped, 18 to 20 minutes.
Brush with remaining pesto. Let cool for 10 minutes before serving. Makes 25 Rolls

title: Christmas Vanilla Biscuits/Sugar Cookies

ingredients.rawText: These cookies are made for cutting out into shapes because they hold their
ingredients.normalizedName: these cookies are made cutting out shapes because they hold their

ingredients.rawText: shape when baking! They are plain, sweet vanilla biscuits that are perfect for
ingredients.normalizedName: shape when baking they are plain

ingredients.rawText: icing and decorating and wonderful served plain too. NO CHILL!
ingredients.normalizedName: icing decorating wonderful served plain too no chill

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup (225g) unsalted butter, softened (if using salted, skip salt)

instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C / 350°F. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment.
Beat butter and sugar in a large bowl until creamy (1 minute on speed 5)
Add egg and vanilla and beat until completely combined.
Add flour, baking powder and salt.
Start mixing slowly then beat until flour is incorporated - it will be clumpy.
Dust work surface with flour and scrape dough out of bowl. Pat together, cut in half then shape into 2 discs.
Roll out to; 0.3cm (1/8") for thinner, crispier cookies or 0.6cm (1/4") for thicker, softer cookies, sprinkling with flour under and over the dough so it does not stick.
Use cookie cutters to press out shapes and use a knife or spatula to transfer shapes to prepared baking sheets. (Keep dough that does not fit in the oven in the fridge).
Bake for 10 minutes, swapping trays halfway, until the surface is pale golden and the edges are just beginning to turn light golden.
Allow cookies to cool completely on trays as they finish cooking on trays
Decorating options:  Icing – see recipe in icing section.  Melt chocolate then dip the surface into chocolate.  Dot with icing sugar and decorate with silver balls  Dust with icing sugar.
notes: *Number of cookies will depend on cut out size and how thick the dough is rolled. It fills 3 baking trays. *Swapping trays halfway - this means that you put both trays in the oven with one in the middle of the oven and the other underneath. Halfway through the bake time, switch them around so the one underneath moves to the top shelf, and the tray on top moves to the shelf underneath. This ensures they both bake evenly because the top shelf bakes faster than the shelf underneath. *Storage - Keeps in an airtight container for a week. After this, they are still edible and totally delicious but they do start to dry out a touch

title: Ukrainian Christmas Bread (Kolach)

ingredients.rawText: 1-1/2 cups (3 sticks) unsalted butter, room temperature
1 egg yolk, beaten, mixed with 1 tbsp milk

instructions: Sprinkle a large baking sheet with cornmeal or use a Teflon pan.
In a mixing or mixer bowl cream by hand or with a mixer with flat beater the butter, egg yolks, sugar, salt, lemon zest, and juice.
Mix the milk with the butter and egg yolk mixture. Measure in 2 cups flour. Add the yeast.

Stir to blend well. When the batter is smooth, add flour, 1/2 cup at a time, and each time stir vigorously. When the dough has formed a mass that can be lifted out of the bowl and placed on the floured work surface, the dough is ready to knead. Or, if with a mixer, attach the dough hook.
Sprinkle more flour if the dough continues to be sticky during the kneading period.

Knead the dough with an aggressive push-turn-fold motion or under the dough hook for 10 minutes or until the dough is smooth and elastic. At this point it should not stick to the work surface or to the sides of the mixer bowl.

Attach the short plastic dough blade. The sequence for adding ingredients varies from above. Place the butter, egg yolks, sugar, salt, lemon zest and juice in the work bowl and pulse several times to cream.
Measure 3 cups flour into the bowl and add the yeast. With the machine running, pour the milk through the feed tube.

When the dough is a smooth batter, stop the machine and add flour, 1/4 cup at a time, either through the feed tube or by removing the cover. If flour around the edges of the bowl is not pulled in by the blade, remove the cover and scrape the flour into the center and under the blade. KNEADING (60 secs.)

When the dough becomes a mass and rides around the work bowl on the blade, knead for 60 seconds. As it spins, the dough will clean (somewhat) the sides of the bowl. When the dough is first turned from the bowl it may seem quite moist so sprinkle with flour and knead for a few moments.

Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover tightly with a length of plastic wrap and put aside at room temperature to double in bulk, about 1 hour. If using a new fast-rising yeast at the recommended higher temperatures, reduce the rising times by about half.
When the dough has risen, turn onto a floured work surface and divide in half. Divide each half into 3 equal parts. With the palms of your hands, roll each part into a rope about 24" long.
Braid. Place the braid on the baking sheet and coil it. Tuck the end of the braid into the coil so that it does not break loose as the dough rises.
With your hands, gently push the coils into a symmetrical shape.
Cover the 2 coils with parchment paper or a cloth and put aside at room temperature until the dough doubles in bulk, about 50 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 350°F. about 20 minutes before baking.
Brush the loaves with the egg-milk glaze, and carefully push the nuts into a pattern over the top of the loaves.

Place the baking sheet in the moderate oven and bake until golden, about 1 hour. Turn one of the loaves over. If it is brown and sounds hard and hollow when tapped with a forefinger, the loaves are done.

If using a convection oven, reduce heat by 50°. Some convection ovens will not accommodate a baking sheet suitably large to take both loaves at once. It may be necessary to bake separately placing the reserved loaf in the refrigerator or cool place while the first loaf bakes.
notes: This is an egg and butter-rich bread that is braided and then cooled on the baking sheet to rise impressively into a loaf of twined golden brown ropes. The loaf is baked and served on one's patron saint day “l’onomastico” (in Italian), but it is equally good anytime. ". BY HAND OR MIXER (10 mins.) KNEADING (10 mins.) BY PROCESSOR (6 mins.) FIRST RISING (1 hour) SHAPING (15 mins.) SECOND RISING ( 50 mins) PREHEAT OVEN 350°F .

title: Fried Chinulille

ingredients.rawText: 1/3 cup (70 ml) Extra virgin olive oil

instructions: Mix flour, sugar, grated lemon zest, eggs and baking powder in a bowl.
Add vermouth and oil and knead until dough is smooth well blended.
Roll out the dough into a thin sheet and with a 10 cm round glass cut circles or discs.
Put jam into a bowl and if using nuts stir them into the jam.
Put a teaspoon of jam and nuts into centre of discs.
Fold over the disc to form a half moon and with tines of a fork crimp the open part of the half moon to bind the two pieces together.
In a pan, heat the vegetable oil and fry the chinulille for about 3-4 minutes, a few at a time.
Drain them on paper towels and, once cold, sprinkle with icing sugar.

title: Baked Turdilli & Chinulille

ingredients.rawText: 18 cups (5 lbs) All-purpose Flour (plus extra flour for dusting)
3-4" Diameter Circular Cookie Cutter, Jar or Coffee Can

instructions: Make Dough: In a very large mixing bowl, whisk oil, sweet vermouth, salt and sugar.

In a separate, very large mixing bowl, stir together the flour, orange zest and cinnamon. Create a pool in the centre of the flour. Crack the eggs into the pool and beat them until they begin to absorb the flour.
Incorporate the wet ingredients into the flour, slowly folding them together. Knead with your hands until the mixture is the consistency of a thick paste. Cover the bowl with a towel and let stand.
MAKE Chinulille Filling: Heat 1 cup of honey in a medium sized sauce pan over medium heat.
Stir in the Raisins, Crushed Walnuts and Jelly. Keep warm.
Assembling The Chinulille: Preheat the oven to 375°F. Dust the counter with flour and add a large handful of dough.
Using a rolling pin, roll the dough evenly until it is fairly thin
Cut 3-4" circles out of the dough
Add 1 tbsp of filling to each circle, fold in half and crimp closed with a fork
Bake on a greased cookie sheet (for 20 minutes or until the edges start to brown.
Remove cookies and let cool.
Creating The Turdille: Dust the counter with flour and add a large handful of dough
Roll the dough into a pipe, about 1/2" in diameter
Cut on a slight angle into 1 1/2 inch long, diagonal segments
Using the tines of a fork, push backwards on the dough to shape "gnocchi" with fairly deep grooves
Bake on greased cookie sheet for 20 minutes or until edges start to brown.
Remove cookies and let cool
Glazing: After the cookies have cooled, add about 1" of honey to a medium sized saucepan over high heat. 2. When honey begins to boil, remove it from the burner and add a couple handfuls of cookies
Using a slotted spoon, stir and coat the cookies.
Drain the excess honey and allow cookies to cool.
Add more honey reheat and repeat as necessary.
Allow the cookies to cool for at least an hour before serving.

title: Chinulille Baked

ingredients.rawText: 4.5 oz walnuts chopped finely 4.5 oz almonds chopped finely

instructions: Make Filling: Soak raisins in liquor for 30 minutes. Do not discard liquor.
Mix all ingredients together in bowl including raisins and liquor.
Using spatula or hands, mix together until it is a paste like mixture.
Make Dough: Preheat oven to 325 ℉ . Line two baking sheets with parchment.
In bowl of stand mixer, mix eggs and sugar until well beaten. Add lemon zest and oil and continue to beat until well incorporated.
Start adding flour a little at a time. Add Bertolini leavening agent. Continue to add flour until dough reaches a consistency that can be rolled out to a surface.
Continue to knead dough and roll out to ¼" thickness.
Place dollops of filling about 3" from the bottom of the dough and 2 inches horizontally between each filling.

Take glass, cookie cutter or knife and cut around filling creating a cookie that looks like a half moon. Use a fork to press along the edge of the seam to prevent the filling from coming out as it bakes.
Place cookies on baking sheet and bake for 18-20 minutes.
Remove from oven once hard to touch (no need to let bake until golden) and let cool completely before icing.
Make Icing: Add a tsp of water to the icing sugar at a time until you get a thick paste that you can spread on the cookie.
Immediately pour a few sprinkles on top and let dry on a baking sheet or cooling rack.
Let dry for about 12 hours before storing in an airtight container lined with a paper towel.

title: Chinulille Calabrese
instructions: For the filling: To complete : 3 2/3 cups (500 ml) Vegetable Oil for Frying a pinch of Icing Sugar
Mix flour, sugar, grated lemon zest, eggs and yeast in a bowl.
Make well, add Vermouth and oil. Mix with wooden spoon knead until dough I smooth and homogeneous. Let rest for a few minutes.
Prepare the filling. In a bowl, mix the ricotta with the sugar and anise and flavour with cinnamon. Use a fairly dry ricotta or let it drain for a couple of hours before using it
Roll out the dough with a rolling pin until you get a fairly thin sheet.

Use a pastry cutter to make 10 cm diameter discs, place a spoonful of ricotta filling in the centre of each one and close it into a half-moon shape. Seal the closure well by pressing with the prongs of a fork or by turning edge and forming a small string.
Heat oil in a pan and once it reaches 170°C, start frying the Chinulille a few at a time for 5-6 minutes, turning them halfway through cooking.
When chinulille are uniformly golden, drain them on a sheet of absorbent paper, and once cold, finish with a sprinkling of icing sugar and serve.
Filling Variations: *Grape and walnut jam.

title: Cuddruriaddri (Calabrese Potato Donuts)

ingredients.rawText: 250 g (1 cup) potatoes, boiled and mashed
Oil for frying (peanut or sunflower oil)
Granulated sugar for sweet version, or anchovies for savory

instructions: Boil potatoes in skins until tender; peel and press through potato masher into large bowl.
Dissolve yeast in warm water. Alternately mix flour, mashed potatoes, and yeast water with a fork to make soft dough.
Add salt halfway through. Knead lightly on floured board until soft and slightly sticky.
Divide dough into 15 balls, folding edges underneath to maintain fluffiness.
Place balls on floured cloth, cover, and let rise in a warm spot for 2-3 hours until doubled.
Heat oil in deep pan. Lightly oil hands, take one ball, poke a hole in center and twirl around wooden spoon handle to form donut ring.
Gently lower into hot oil. Fry until puffed and golden brown on both sides.
Drain on paper towels. Immediately toss in granulated sugar for dessert, or insert anchovy inside before frying for dinner!
notes: Traditionally eaten on the Eve of the Immaculate Conception (Dec 8) and throughout the Christmas season.
originalPhotoCaption: Anna fries and places Cudorelli on paper towels; Risen dough balls and donuts

title: Lulu’s Calabrisella Cullurielli

ingredients.rawText: Oil for frying (peanut or sunflower oil is best)

instructions: Boil potatoes (with skins), remove skins and then pass them through a potato masher into a large bowl.
In a small bowl, dissolve the yeast in some water.
Add some flour to the mashed potatoes and mix.
Add some water and mix with fork (use fork as dough is very sticky) to create batter.
Add the yeast and alternate between flour and water to form a soft dough.
At the halfway point, add the salt.
Lightly flour board and transfer dough to the flat surface.
Knead the dough adding flour as needed – dough should remain soft and a bit moist and it should still stick a bit to your hands.
Let the dough rest for about 10-15 minutes. Once you have left it to rest a bit, you can start dividing the dough into 15 balls but you can make them as big or small as you like.
Form the balls by folding the dough around and under, this helps to maintain its fluffiness when it is time to fry them.
Place the balls on a tray sprinkled with flour – space them out as they will double in size. (or use a kitchen towel with flour sprinkled on it so they will not stick as much to the surface).
Cover with a kitchen towel and leave in a warm place for 2-3 hours to rise. Balls are formed and placed on teatowel. Dough balls double after resting covered.

title: Cudorelli 2020 Fried Dough

ingredients.rawText: 3 cups all-purpose flour, unbleached, plus extra for working with the dough
2 teaspoons vegetable oil (plus more for frying - see below)
Use confectioners sugar, maple syrup, honey, chocolate syrup and fruit

instructions: Toppings: Make the dough :
Whisk together the flour, sugar, yeast and salt in the bowl of a mixer.
Add in the water and the 2 tablespoons of oil. Place the dough hook on your mixer and mix the dough together on medium/low speed.

Scrape down sides a few times and mix dough for about 4 to 5 minutes. It will start to gather around dough hook at this point. If the dough seems too dry, sprinkle in tablespoons of water as it finishes to bring it together.
Grease a large mixing bowl and scrape the dough into it. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap. Place the bowl in a warm, draft-free place for 1½ - 2 hours, until the dough has doubled in size.
Heat the oil: Line a cooling rack or plate with paper towels, and place near cook top.
Have a metal slotted spoon or spatula ready.
Melt the ¼ cup of butter and have this nearby, along with a pastry brush.
When the dough has finished rising, pour vegetable oil into a large, heavy-duty pot - like a cast iron or enameled cast iron pot.
Heat the oil over medium/high heat to 350°F. and check the oil often with a thermometer.

Lightly flour a work surface and keep a little extra flour nearby. Tip the dough onto the floured surface. Sprinkle the top with flour, then roll out the dough. It does not have to be super thin - aim for ½-¾ inch thick.
Use a knife or pizza cutter to cut the dough into about 10 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a circle, pinch ends together and lay on cookie pan.
When the oil is ready at 350°F., get a piece of dough, if it is sticky, dust the dough and your fingers with a little flour to make it easier to handle.
Give the dough piece a few gentle stretches. Carefully lay the piece of dough in the oil - it should immediately begin to puff as the oil bubbles around it.

Use your slotted spoon, spatula, or tongs to move the dough in the oil, turning it as you see the underside begin to brown. Continue frying and turning the dough until it is browned on all sides: this should take 2 to 2½ minutes.
Remove the dough from the oil to the paper towel-lined rack.

Continue frying the other pieces of dough this way. Check the temperature of the oil frequently as you fry to maintain the temperature of 350°F. and adjust the heat under your pan as needed. If the oil is way too hot, carefully slide the pan off the burner for a minute or two to help bring the temperature down.
When all the pieces have been fried, brush them with the melted butter. No matter what other toppings you add, this melted butter is key for the moisture and flavour it adds.

Add your favourite toppings! *A thick dusting of confectioners sugar and a drizzle of pure maple syrup. *Chocolate sauce, caramel sauce, or honey are also delicious. *To make it a real treat, try fruit sauces like blueberry or simmered apples.
Enjoy the warm dough immediately. Makes about 10 pieces. Leftover dough can be stored covered at room temperature for a day or two.
notes: While the oil heats, prepare the dough : Fry the dough : Add the toppings : You can save and reuse your cooking oil for your next batch of fried dough or other fried food. Let the oil cool, then pour it through a paper towel-lined strainer to remove the solids. Save the oil in a closed bottle or other container. Used oil can be put in a large plastic gallon labeled used oil and put out next to the green bin for recycling. *Maintaining the proper oil temperature is key to getting great fried dough. *Heat the oil to a temperature of 350ºF. and adjust the heat as you cook to maintain this temperature. An instant read digital thermometer is the best way to get the temperature you need. *Melted butter brushed on the hot fried dough gives a crucial (and delicious!) flavour. After the butter, add your favourite toppings like powdered sugar, pure maple syrup, chocolate syrup or caramel. Cooked apples or blueberry sauce are also good. *This recipe is based on recipes for pizza dough. *The rise time for the dough is an important step, so do not skip it. Frying dough that has not risen creates something more like fried cake with no chew at all. Let the dough rise so gluten can develop.

title: Zia Maria Cudorelli Fried Dough

4 tablespoons vegetable oil (plus more for frying - see below)

title: Cudorelli

ingredients.rawText: Lukewarm water (enough to make a soft dough)

instructions: For dough: Boil the potatoes and then mash them.
Mix the fresh yeast in 1 cup lukewarm water and wait until it bubbles up.
Mix the flour, salt and mashed potatoes with the proofed yeast, adding as much water as is needed to make a soft dough.
Form the dough into a ball.
Place the dough in a greased container and cover. Allow the dough to rest in a warm room, until it doubles in volume.
When the dough is risen, take a piece of the dough and shape into a donut, or into an irregular log (about 6 inches long, 3/4 inch thick).
Repeat the process until all the dough is used up.
Heat up the oil and fry until golden brown.
Before serving sprinkle sugar on the fritters.

title: Scalille (Calabrese Honey Ladders)
instructions: Beat eggs and oil together.
Add flour and baking powder; knead until smooth and a fingerprint holds in the dough.
Roll dough into 1/2-inch ropes, 6 inches long. With a rolling pin flatten slightly.
Traditional shaping: Wind dough around a floured dowel or wooden spoon handle to form little ladders ('scalille'), or braid 3 strips.
Fry in hot oil until they puff up to the surface and turn golden brown. Drain on parchment.
Heat honey with a splash of water in a skillet until foaming.
Drop fried scalille into hot honey, turn to coat thoroughly, and transfer to a colander to drain excess.
Store in tins with parchment paper between layers.
notes: 'Scalille' means little ladders, representing climbing to heaven at Christmas time.
originalPhotoCaption: Maya, Rita, Chiara and Sandy forming scalilli; Braided ladders and honey glaze

title: Scalilli
instructions: Knead until finger print stays in dough.
Make loaves and cut slices.
Shape the Scalili
Fry in hot oil. Scalilli will rise to the surface quickly then turn with fork.
Put into large aluminum pan lined with parchment paper.
Heat up honey in frying pan. Add fried scalilli and coat evenly.
Place honeyed scalilli on rack to drip off extra honey. Then return to parchment paper covered aluminum pan, cover and store in cantina.

title: Scalilli Anice Delfina
instructions: To egg whites add sugar, oil and anice and mix until fluffy
Combine egg yolks into egg white mixture.
Add flour about 4 cups and knead until bubbles form

title: Scalini Christmas
instructions: Beat eggs, add sugar, oil
Add baking powder, salt to flour and mix well
Mix dry ingredients to egg mixture to make medium dough
Shaping scalille: Roll one slice into a ½ inch diameter and 6 inch long rope.
Flatten a rope with a rolling pin. With curly cutter make two cuts lengthwise to make 3 strips leaving top end intact.
Braid the 3 strips and close bottom 3 strips together by pressing them firmly together.
Method B: Roll a slice into a ¼ inch diameter 15 inch long rope.
With curly cutter cut bottom 1/3 of rope into two strips and braid.

Bring the 2/3 rope around braided 1/3 to form an oval and with finger press ends together to close. Braided Scalilli Long rope is looped around braid to form an oval And pressed down firmly so dough will connect and not separate during frying.

title: Scalilli Lemon

ingredients.rawText: 1 ½ tsp vanilla or anice extract

instructions: Mix eggs, oil, vanilla, lemon peel and sugar.
Make well with flour, pour in wet ingredients and work in flour to make stiff dough. Roll dough, cut and form into ladders.
Deep fry in oil until golden. Dip in honey while warm.

ingredients.rawText: 5 cups flour, enough to make soft dough

title: Lina’s Scalette #3
instructions: Maya, Rita, Chiara and Sandy forming scalilli 2024.

title: Scalilli Ribbon Cookies
instructions: Mix flour and salt in a large bowl.
Beat eggs until creamy and add 1 cup of oil. Pour into flour mixture. Mix well and knead dough until smooth. Make into desired shapes.

Cookie Formation . Work with a baseball size of dough. Roll out on a floured board until you see the wood grain through the dough. Cut into long strips with a pizza cutter in one direction about ½ to 1 inch wide. Cut into strips crosswise – about 1 ½ - 2 inches long. Cut a small slit into the centre of each. Gently remove strips and run one end of dough strip through slit and cut in the centre. This will create a twist. Lay them out on cookie sheets and keep covered with a damp towel.
Deep fry in small batches. When cool, coat with warm honey.
Heat honey in large skillet and thinning with water slightly as needed.
Dip cooled scalilli into honey to coat thoroughly and lay on wire racks.
Store in airtight containers in a cool place.

title: Scalilli Struffoli Neapolitan Honey Balls

ingredients.rawText: 1 tbsp sweet dessert wine or orange juice
Decorations: white nonpareils, diced candied orange peel

instructions: In large bowl, whisk flour, sugar, and baking powder and salt until blended.
Make a well in centre. In a 2 cup measuring cup, whisk eggs, oil, zest and 1 tbsp wine until well blended and pour into well.
With hand or large wooden spoon, gradually work flour into egg mixture until a soft, pliable dough forms.
Turn dough out on lightly floured surface with floured hands, knead dough 3 minutes or until smooth. Wrap in plastic; let stand at room temperature for 1 hour.

Pull off small walnut-size clumps of dough; with lightly floured hands, roll between palms into a thin rope, slightly less than ½ inch thick. Repeat with remaining dough (keep ropes loosely covered with plastic wrap.)
Cut ropes into little nuggets, about ¼ to ½ inch wide.
Line a large baking sheet with paper towels.
Heat canola oil in large 5 quart pot or deep fryer to 360°F.

Place about 30 dough balls onto a large skimmer or spider; lower into the oil. Fry 2 minutes, stirring as they fry and until puffed and golden. Transfer to paper towel to drain. Repeat with remaining dough balls.

Boil honey and ½ cup wine in a large 6 quart pot (mixture will bubble up high in the pot). Boil 3 minutes, remove pot from heat. Add balls all at once to honey mixture, gently toss with a slotted spoon for several minutes until well coated. Let balls cool to room temperature stirring several minutes.
Spoon honeyed struffoli on large serving platter. With hands lightly oiled or moistened with water to prevent sticking, arrange balls in a pyramid shape, wreathe or Christmas tree.
Sprinkle with nonpareils and candied orange peel

title: Tortelli
instructions: Boil together vermouth, oil and sugar
Add lemon and orange peel and enough flour to form stiff dough
Roll into long ropes about an inch in diameter and cut into two inch length
Roll tortelli on fork tines or bottom of basket with straight reeds
Fry in medium hot oil until golden and cooked in middle.

title: Delfina’s Tortelli
instructions: Boil vermouth, oil, sugar and grated peels
Take off heat.
Put flour in a bowl and add hot liquid
Roll into one inch thick roll and cut into pieces.
Roll on fork and fry

title: Christmas Turdille

ingredients.rawText: Equal amounts of water and melted and cooled Crisco
ingredients.normalizedName: equal amounts water melted cooled crisco

ingredients.rawText: Equal amounts of all-purpose and pastry flour (at least 6 cups)
ingredients.normalizedName: equal amounts all purpose pastry flour

instructions: Beat eggs in a measuring cup
Measure the same amount of water and melted and cooled Crisco as eggs. For example if the 4 beaten eggs measure 12 oz then measure 12 oz water and 12 oz melted and cooled Crisco
Add and mix in water and melted Crisco to beaten eggs
Combine equal parts (e.g. 3 cups all-purpose and 3 cups pastry flour) flour and mix in egg mixture until dough is no longer sticky and can be kneaded.
Let rise.
When doubled, divide dough into four parts. Roll one part into a long rope about an inch in diameter.
Cut rope into 2 inch long pieces. On gnocchi board roll dough pieces so indentation of middle and index fingers are inside and lines from gnocchi board are on outside.
Put on clean tea towel and let rise
Heat oil and fry Turdilli over medium heat so all can be cooked evenly
When frying is complete melt honey and pour over and cover Turdilli with melted honey.
notes: Frances G.

title: Nonna’s Turdilli

ingredients.rawText: 8.5 ounces sweet Moscato wine (or sweet white/vermouth)

instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine flour, extra-virgin olive oil, sweet wine, cinnamon, and grated orange zest.
Work dough gently until smooth and cohesive.
Roll dough into 1-inch flat strips, then cut into 1-inch pieces.
Roll each piece on the back of a fork or gnocchi board to impress ridges and curl into small hollow cylinders.
Deep fry in hot oil (350°F) until golden brown and cooked in the middle. Drain on paper towels.
In a pan over low heat, melt honey with fresh orange juice.
Pour warm honey glaze over Turdilli and toss to coat completely.
Allow to cool before serving. They keep well for over a week!
notes: Calabrese deep-fried and honeyed Christmas cookies made with fragrant wine and citrus.

title: Turdilli Italian Christimas Cookies
instructions: Put all dry ingredients in a bowl and mix.
Pour wet ingredients in the centre
Mix
Roll and cut into 1 by 2 inch pieces.
Roll on back of basket, gnocchi board or fork on a slant to make indentations.
Prepare rack over a pan.
Fry in hot oil 2 to 3 minutes and place on rack to drain oil.
In a large frying pan, add 2 tablespoons of water and 1 tsp sugar.
When boiling, add 4 tbsp honey and when it foams, add 9 to 10 Turdilli to coat.
Put honeyed Turdilli on plate and start over with honey mixture.
For an added touch coat with candy sprinkles.

title: Turdilli Whiskey

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup Muscat white wine (no other substitute)

instructions: Boil wet ingredients (butter, oil, whiskey, Crisco, water and sugar together and cool. Do not boil for long.
While above mixture is boiling measure 12 cups flour
In a large bowl, beat two large eggs just to blend.
Add 12 cups flour and 1 cup at a time and knead.
Place dough on floured board and knead dough until smooth.
Cover with towel or plastic wrap.
Cut a small amount and roll until about 12 to 15 inches long and 1 inch thick.
Cut about 1 ½ to 2 inches long.
Take the 2 inch Turdilli and roll on basket or gnocchi board that has ridges to make indentations and place on cookie sheet.
Heat oil in fry pan to 350°F.
Use wooden spoon to stir from bottom of fry pan and they will float to the top and cook until nice and brown.
Use slotted spoon and place in bowl with paper towel to absorb oil.
Let cool and coat in warm honey, let dry and dip again

title: Turdilli Michael Chiarello
