instructions: Sift flour, nutmeg, cinnamon, allspice, baking powder, and salt
Mix olive oil, vermouth, and eggs until well blended
Add dry ingredients all at once until mixture becomes a cohesive mass
Put dough on floured board and knead until smooth
Shape dough into a ball, flatten in a bowl and cover and refrigerate for a few hours or overnight
Cut dough into 16 pieces

Cut into 1/2 inch pieces roll each piece or gnocchi over a fork or basket
Heat oil to 350 F
10, Fry in four batches until puffed and medium to dark brown colour (about 1 ½ minutes)
Put in basket or sieve and put in oil

Cookies first turn light gold then light brown then a light milk chocolate colour
Drain on paper towels

Cookies keep for up to one week

title: Turdilli S.A.L. 2025
instructions: Boil white wine, oil and orange rind and allow to cool.
Mix flour, sugar, yeast and make well.
Remove orange peel from wine and oil mixture.
Pour wine mixture into flour well and knead.
Cover with towel or plastic wrap.
Cut a small amount, roll to about 16 inches long, 1 inch thick.
Cut into 1 ½ inch pieces. Roll on gnocchi board.
Fry in hot oil, cool and coat warm honey.

title: Maria’s Christmas & Easter Pizza Figliata

ingredients.rawText: 1 kg of walnuts, coarsely shredded in a food processor
1 kg of honey must be available separately.

instructions: Pasta: A little limoncello (shot glass) white wine to help knead.
Dough preparation: Make a well in the flour and add all ingredients except white wine.
Stir and knead adding white wine until dough is soft but elastic.
Stuffing: Combine the above ingredients except for the honey.
Divide dough into four parts and shape loaves and place on clean cloth.
Flour the work surface. With a rolling pin, roll out each loaf to get a thin sheet (1-2 mm thick) without holes, about 50 cm long and 20 to 30 cm wide.
Spread ¼ of the filling on the sheet stopping about 1.5 cm from the edge.
With a spoon, drip at least 2 generous spoonfuls of honey in a spiral onto the filling.

Quickly roll up the dough from the longer side in a uniform way and folding the side edges inwards with the dual purpose of not letting the filling come out and to make sure that filling is evenly spread throughout.
The final edge should be wet with a little water and welded to the rest of the roll.
With lightly floured hands, compact the roll by slightly turning the left half clockwise and the right half in the opposite direction, (or how they once squeezed clothes).
The roll is then rolled up like a snake (in a large spiral) and placed in a round pan covered with parchment paper and in turn, brushed with oil.
Bake the dessert immediately (the delicate pastry will break if left in the air for a long time) at 450°F. for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven when it is golden brown and immediately place on a serving dish and left to cool slightly.
Using a kitchen brush or spoon spread honey over dessert and cool.

It may be eaten immediately but, if you want to respect tradition, it is best to wait a week, leaving the dessert in a cool, dry place. and/or candied orange peel and/or raisins and/or hazelnuts - the more modern ones can add chocolate chips. When hot decorate the glaze with tiny coloured sugars. (www. casertamusica.com – 2009 )
notes: Pizza Figliata is a typical dessert of the upper Caserta area. It is like a strudel with walnuts and honey wrapped in a wine/flour pastry and rolled into a circle. The ingredients are typical of the peasant tradition: flour, wine and herbs for the pastry, walnuts and honey for the filling. Once baked, the dessert "must" mature (it is so low in fat that it should be allowed to combine with the walnut filling and mature). Ingredients for 4 pizzas with a diameter of 20 cm Variations: In addition to the walnuts, the filling is enriched with dried figs

title: Pita ‘Impigliata Entangled

ingredients.normalizedName: dough strips filled with honeyed almonds raisins shaped wreathe

Slice cooled rolls and serve.

title: Crown of Thorns

title: Easter Bread
instructions: Beat eggs, add sugar and beat well
Boil milk and water and cool a little before adding to eggs and sugar
Mix in oil, lemon juice and grated lemon rind
Combine yeast and 4 cups of flour and mix into egg and sugar mixture and add flour and knead until consistency of bread.
Roll into 2” diameter, 24” long ropes and braid three into a circle shape.
Add washed and dried eggs into braided circle and covered with thin ropes of dough in an X pattern over the eggs.
Ropes can also be braided into a straight loaf and placed on parchment paper covered pans.
Let loaves rise until doubled.
Beat egg whites and brush on loaves
Bake at 325ºF for one hour. Cover loaves with aluminum paper to ensure that they do not get too brown

title: Cucullo 2019
instructions: Combine all and bake at 300°F. in convection oven for 60 minutes

instructions: Beat eggs and sugar
Boil milk and water
Let milk and water cool by adding juices, rind, Crisco, anice and oil
Add cooled liquids to eggs and sugar
Mix 4 tbsp yeast to 6 cups flour and add to mixture and allow yeast to make little bubbles
Add remaining flour as needed

Allow breads to rise

Roll dough into two long strips 2 inches in diameter
Braid dough and attach into a circle
Place eggs in four places if desired and criss-cross top of eggs with thin strips of dough
Cover and let rise. Beat reserved egg white.
Brush dough with egg white. Bake at 350ºF until golden brown

instructions: Beat eggs, add sugar beat well
Add melted Crisco and anice and mix well
Combine flour, cinnamon and yeast and add to mixture
Form into ropes 1” wide by 24” long and braid into circle or loaves.

Bake at 350ºF and lower to 325ºF after 10 minutes

4 cups scalded milk, cooled to room temperature

instructions: Combine yeast, warm milk, salt, butter, eggs and sugar.
Add half of the flour and beat until smooth with dough hook.

Knead until smooth

Place on parchment covered backing sheet

Preheat oven 350 F
Brush bread with beaten egg and water wash
Put on sprinkles.
In middle of ring, place an Easter egg making indentations with egg
Bake 350°F. until golden (20-25 minutes)
Cool on rack

title: Rice Krispie Nests

ingredients.rawText: Nests are the perfect, no-bake Easter goodies!

instructions: Grease a 12-cup muffin tray and set aside.
Place marshmallows in a large microwave-safe bowl and heat for 25-30 seconds. Stir well, and repeat heating as needed.
Add melted coconut oil and vanilla extract to marshmallows and stir well.
Add the rice cereal one cup at a time, gently folding it into the marshmallow mixture until all of the cereal is incorporated.
Scoop 1/4 cup Rice Krispies mixture into the prepared muffin tray.
Wet your hands and press the Rice Krispies into a cup or tart-shape.
Place in the fridge for 2 hours or overnight to set.
When the nests have had a chance to set and harden, pop them out of the muffin tray using a butter knife and fill with treats such as mini eggs, jellybeans, chocolates or some berries. Makes 12 nests

title: Easter Ricotta Cheese and Rice Pie
instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºF.
Mix and beat flour, water and ½ cup sugar until smooth.
Mix beaten eggs, ricotta cheese, cooked rice, and ½ cup sugar until well blended. If desired add cinnamon and/or nutmeg.
Grease 9X12 inch pan with 1 tbsp oil.
Place pan in oven for a few minutes so oil heats up a little.
Remove pan from oven and pour half of the batter into hot pan. Pour ricotta and rice mixture on batter. Top with ricotta with remaining batter.
Bake at 400F for 40 minutes until golden. Serve with hot vanilla sauce.
Hot Vanilla Sauce: Whisk above in heavy saucepan until smooth.
Heat over medium heat (10-12 minutes) until thick and sauce coats back of spoon. Stir in 1 tbsp vanilla extract.

title: Easter Pie Pasqualina

ingredients.rawText: 2 boxes (10 oz each) frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
6 large eggs (2 for filling, 4 cracked whole inside)
Pinch of dried oregano, salt, and black pepper

instructions: Make crust: Pulse flour, salt, and 1/4 cup olive oil in food processor; add ice water until dough forms a ball. Chill 1 hour.
Make filling: Sauté onion and spinach in 2 tbsp olive oil with salt for 2 minutes; cool. Stir in ricotta, 2 beaten eggs, Parmigiano, oregano, and pepper.
Roll out 2/3 of dough to line bottom and sides of a 9-inch springform pan.
Fill with spinach-ricotta mixture. Make 4 deep wells in filling and crack 1 whole raw egg into each well.
Roll out remaining dough, place on top, crimp edges tightly, cut a small vent slit, and brush with olive oil.
Bake at 400°F for about 1 hour until deeply golden brown.
Cool completely before un-molding and slicing to reveal the whole baked egg cross-section.
notes: The classic Italian Easter masterpiece symbolising rebirth, with beautiful baked whole eggs revealed inside each slice.

title: Easter Rice and Ricotta Pie

ingredients.rawText: 1 lb ricotta, drained (16 oz or 450 gr)

instructions: To cook the rice: Combine milk and rice in a large saucepan over medium/high heat.
Add salt, vanilla bean, and lemon peel and stir.

Once milk begins to simmer, reduce heat to low, cover slightly and stir occasionally until the milk is absorbed, about 15-20 minutes. Stir constantly toward the end of this time to prevent milk from scalding.
Rice should be cooked but still firm as it will continue to cook in the oven.
Remove lemon peel and vanilla bean. Set aside to cool.
Spray a 9 ½ inch spring form pan with non-stick spray (can also use parchment paper to line bottom of the pan). Set aside.
To make the crust: (optional): Beat eggs with hand held beater or whisk.
Add sugar, oil, lemon zest and whisk together.
Sift flour and baking powder together and add to egg mixture.
Whisk together.
Spread mixture at the bottom of the pan. Set aside.
To make the filling: In a large mixing bowl (of standup mixer) with whisk attachment, beat eggs until light and frothy. Can also use a hand held blender or whisk.
Gradually whisk in the sugar. Beat for 1-2 minutes.
Add ricotta, zests and cinnamon. Whisk until incorporated (about 1 min)
With a mixing spoon, gently combine the rice mixture, breaking up any clumps of rice.
Pour into pie plate (over baked crust).
Bake for 60 min. or until golden and top bounces back when lightly touched.
Allow to cool completely. Can be served warm or cold.
Dust with icing sugar before serving.
notes: *Take out ricotta and eggs from refrigerator about 30 minutes before starting recipe. *If you do not have a spring form pan, use a deep 10 inch pie plate or 9 X 13 large rectangular baking dish. *The total baking time will depend on the pan you use. To check for doneness, gently shake the pan towards the end of the baking time, if the centre jiggles slightly, it is done. Look for an area of 2 inches. The rest of the pie should also feel firm.

title: Fiadone Easter Mini Ricotta Pies

ingredients.rawText: 900 grams (2 lb) whole milk ricotta, strained overnight
2 egg yolks with 1 tsp milk (egg wash)

instructions: Make dough: Whisk 6 eggs with 6 tbsp sugar and oil; knead in flour until soft, smooth dough forms. Rest covered 1 hour.
Make filling: Mix strained dry ricotta with 6 tbsp sugar and 2 beaten eggs until creamy.
Roll dough thinly to 1/16-inch thick. Cut out 6-inch circles.
Place 1 tablespoon ricotta filling on each circle, fold over into half-moons, and seal edges tightly with fork tines.
Brush tops with egg yolk wash. With scissors, make three small steam vents in each pie.
Bake at 350°F for 20 minutes, then lower heat to 325°F and bake 25-30 minutes until golden brown.
Cool on wire racks. Can be frozen and enjoyed throughout Easter.
notes: Bruna Sabusco's cherished recipe. Savory cheese variation uses grated Pecorino, Caciotta, and parsley.
originalPhotoCaption: Fiadone egg washed and cut, ready for baking; Baked Fiadone ready for serving

title: Fiadone Puffs
instructions: Place the flour with a pinch of salt in a large bowl .
In a smaller bowl, whisk together two of the eggs with the oil and wine.
Make a well in the centre of the flour and pour in the egg mixture . Using a wooden spoon, bring the mixture together, then use your hands to knead the dough.
Tip onto a lightly floured work surface and knead for a few minutes until smooth and elastic.
Cover with plastic wrap and set aside whilst you prepare the filling.
For the filling: combine the cheeses, 2 eggs, yeast and pepper in a bowl.
Preheat the oven to 200°C. Line a large baking tray with baking paper.
Work with half of the dough at a time, for ease. Roll out the dough on a lightly floured surface to 2-4mm thick – the thickness is a personal preference.
Cut out 10cm circles and place one tablespoon of filling in the centre of each circle.
Fold over and pinch the dough with your fingers to seal. Use a fork to secure the edges if you wish. Transfer the fiadoni to the baking tray.
Lightly whisk the egg yolk with a dash of milk or water and brush the tops of the fiadoni. Using a sharp knife, make a small incision in the top of each.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until puffed up and golden. Fiadoni are best served warm . Note: Substitute 400 gr ricotta strained for cheese + 3 tbsp sugar + 1 egg slightly beaten

title: Panettone Italian Easter Bread

ingredients.rawText: 1/4 cup commercial vanilla sugar plus 1/4 granulated sugar OR 1/2 cup

instructions: Dissolve sugar in water; over this sprinkle yeast and let stand for 10 minutes until frothy
Pour milk into a large mixing bowl
Stir yeast mixture then add to milk
Beat in 1 1/2 cups flour until well mixed
Cover bowl with a tea towel or plastic wrap and let stand in a warm place until light and full of bubbles (about 1 hour)
Stir in sugar, salt, melted butter, rum, lemon rind and eggs.
Beat in one cup flour and mix vigorously by hand or with electric mixer.
Toss fruit with one cup flour and stir into yeast mixture
Gradually mix in more of the flour
Turn dough onto a floured surface; knead eight to ten minutes, working in the remaining flour. Shape into a smooth ball and place in a greased bowl, rotating dough to grease surface
Cover bowl with a damp cloth or plastic wrap and let rise until doubled (about 2 hours)
Punch down and divide into 2 parts. Shape into round loaves about 2 inches in height and place on greased cookie sheets
Cover and let rise in a warm place for 45 minutes
Brush with cream or milk. Bake at 375ºF. for 30 to 35 minutes until brown on top and makes a hollow sound when tapped.
notes: Star Newspaper makes 2 – 24 oz breads

title: Pinge di Pasqua
instructions: Blend all ingredients until medium textured dough. Dough should not be too hard
Place dough in greased plastic container (with oil lining) overnight to rise
Bake at 300ºF for 2 to 3 hours depending on pan.

title: Panettone Anisette

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup diced candied fruit or peel

instructions: Dissolve yeast in warm water with pinch of sugar. Set aside until bubbly.

Warm the milk in a saucepan over medium heat just until it begins to steam but not boil. Add sugar, butter, salt, oil, anisette liquor and vanilla to milk and stir to dissolve sugar and melt butter. Set aside to cool
Combine 10 cups of the flour, fruits and peel.
Beat the eggs with the cooled milk mixture and the yeast mixture.
Add the wet mixture to the flour mixture and mix well, either with a spoon or a dough hook on a stand up mixer. Add as much of the remaining cup of flour as needed if the dough is too sticky.
Knead until you have a smooth, elastic dough, about 8 minutes.
Place dough in large, buttered bowl and turn dough to grease all sides.
Cover with plastic wrap or a cotton tea towel, place in a draft free area and let rise until doubled (10-12 hours if using regular yeast, less if using rapid yeast).
Punch down the risen dough. Place dough on a floured board, and cut into four equal pieces. Place each piece in a buttered round casserole (2 quart at least) or panettone pans.
Let rise again until doubled in size.
Bake at 300°F. until golden brown on top and cake sounds hollow when tapped with fingers, about 50 to 60 minutes.
Cool completely on wire racks before slicing.

title: Panettone Buns

ingredients.rawText: All-purpose flour as needed (dough should not be too hard)

instructions: Beat eggs and add sugar and lemon rind
Melt butter and pour into milk and oil and add to egg mixture
Combine yeast, vanilla, and flour and gradually add to egg mixture making a medium soft dough
Knead for approximately 10 minutes
Shape into 3 inch diameter balls and place on parchment covered cookie sheets
Cover and let rise until doubled
Bake at 350ºF for 10-15 minutes until golden brown

Let rise in a warm place.
Punch down and knead dough and form into shapes
Let rise again in a warm place. When doubled and ready to bake brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with icing sugar to form a crust (optional)

instructions: Crust: Filling : 1 1/2 cups cooked pumpkin puree 1.3 cup lightly packed brown sugar 1 tsp freshly ground nutmeg

instructions: Combine cake mix, canned pumpkin, eggs, oil and instant pudding mix in bowl. Beat at low speed until blended then at medium speed for 3 minutes, scraping down sides of bowl occasionally.

Thoroughly blend flour, baking powder/soda, spices and salt
Combine melted shortening, sugar, eggs, pumpkin and vanilla

Bake 30 minutes or until golden brown
Cool in pan and cut into bars

title: Pumpkin Torte
instructions: Crust: Melt butter, stir in crumbs and sugar, press into ungreased 9x13” pan. Filling :
Beat cream cheese and sugar together.
Beat in 1 egg at a time, pour over crust.
Bake in a 325ºF oven for 20 minutes.

Measure next six ingredients into saucepan. Heat and stir until boiling and thickened. Remove from heat, stir in gelatin.
Beat egg whites, add sugar gradually beating until stiff. Fold into pumpkin mixture.
Pour over cheese layer and chill. Top with whipped cream.

title: Asparagus Rolls
instructions: Cook asparagus just until tender crisp.
Rinse with cold water, drain and set aside
Roll puff pastry to 1/16 “ thickness and cut into 2 1/2 “ strips.
Wrap 4 asparagus stocks with a ham slice, then wrap a layer of puff pastry around the centre.

Refrigerate 1 hour
Preheat oven to 425ºF.
Before baking, brush pastry with egg glaze (1 egg yolk and 2 tbsp water)

Meanwhile, slowly melt butter over low heat setting.
Warm lime and lemon juice.
Place 3 egg yolks in double boiler top and cook over hot water until thickening begins.

Beat until sauce is thick

instructions: Put in mixing bowl until creamy

3. Bake at 350ºF for 15 minutes Makes 18 tarts

title: Puff Pastry
instructions: Blend 3 cups all purpose and 1 cups cake and pastry flour together.
Place 3 cups blended flour in a large plastic bag. Set aside 1 cup flour.
Quickly cut cold butter into quarters lengthwise then cut in half inch sections. Add butter cubes to bag and coat with flour by shaking.
Add water to bag and mix by kneading bag with fingers 30 to 45 seconds
Sprinkle 2 tbsp of the remaining cup of flour on a pastry board or counter top. (This cup of flour is to be used during the rolling process)
Empty contents of bag on the board. Scrape dough clumps off bag. The dough will look terrible but don’t worry.
Use your hands to lightly mold clumps of dough into rectangle.
Sprinkle a little reserved flour on top and roll to a 15 by 24 inch rectangle.
Carefully lift each end of the dough with a spatula and fold it into the centre. If there are stray cubes of butter, place them in the centre.
Fold this in half again lengthwise to produce a 15 by 6 inch rectangle.
Flatten rectangle with rolling pin to make it easier to fold crosswise.
Fold each end into the centre, then fold in half. This produces a very compact cube about 6 inches square with 16 layers.
Sprinkle surface with flour and roll out dough again to an 18 by 24 inch rectangle. The dough will look like pie crust and will still be easy to roll.
Fold the dough as instructed above to produce another 16 layers to make a total of 256 layers

Sprinkle rolling surface with flour and roll the dough for the third and final time to a 15 by 24 inch rectangle. This time the dough will be very springy and more difficult to work with. If you have worked quickly enough the dough will still be cold to touch. If the dough worms up and feels soft or if you smell butter, refrigerate 30 minutes.
Fold dough as instructed above. This folding will produce 4,096 layers.

Place dough in a plastic bag and refrigerate for at least 6 hours. If it is baked too soon the dough will shrink too much. Note: While rolling the dough, use as much of the remaining flour as necessary. Remember that this flour was part of the 4 cups needed to make the pastry.
Keep dough in the refrigerator no more than three days. If you do not plan to use it in that time, freeze it for later use. It keeps for up to six months in the freezer.
Cut all edges in order for the pastry to rise properly. Even when an edge looks straight, cut it. Crooked edges, when folded, would give rise to a hinged (off centre) puff pastry.
Roll the dough out to about 1/3 inch for small pastries and appetizers. This will rise to about 1 1/2 inches
To roll dough out to an even thickness, use stacked sheets of cardboard on either end of the dough as a guide. The dough must be rolled evenly or you may have a lopsided puff.

Always bake puff pastry on a set baking sheet. The French say the dough needs “feet”. As steam is released, the energy is released upwards - not outward or sideways. Anchor your pastry on a wetted baking sheet to insure maximum rising.
Refrigerate dough for at least six hours after the third double turn.
Then roll it out, cut out the shapes required and brush with an egg wash (2 tbsp of cream mixed with one egg yolk.)

Refrigerate again for one hour before baking. Puff pastry must be well chilled or frozen when it is placed in the oven. Otherwise, gluten starts to inhibit the bubbling. Bake rock-hard frozen dough the same length of time as you would chilled dough.
To properly puff this pastry, always start with a hot oven: it is the rapid expansion of trapped water and air that pushes up or puffs the dough.
Bake larger pastries in a 425ºF oven for 10 minutes then reduce temperature to 375ºF and bake an additional eight minutes or until pastry is crisp and brown.

title: Mille-Feuille
instructions: Roll pastry to 1/16 inch thickness and cut into 3 rectangles (8 by 6 inch).
Trim edges to a 45º angle with a sharp knife.
Reverse dough onto slightly dampened baking sheet.
Prick surface with a fork and refrigerate 1 hour. Preheat oven to 425ºF
Bake pastry in preheated oven until golden brown, about 10 to 15 minute.
Remove and cool on wire rack.
Scald milk in a heavy saucepan, then stir in chocolate
Beat egg yolks, then add sugar and beat until light in colour.
Beat flour into egg yolk mixture. Whisk or stir in hot milk slowly
Place pan over high heat and whisk to the boil.
Boil 1 minute, whisking constantly to prevent scorching or sticking.
Remove pan from heat and pour into a bowl.
Cover surface with plastic wrap or softened butter and refrigerate.
Whip cream until stiff, then fold into cooled chocolate custard.
To assemble, place one pastry rectangle on a serving plate and spread half the chocolate custard mixture over it. Place second layer on top and spread with remaining chocolate mixture
Top with remaining rectangle and sprinkle confections’ sugar over top
To serve, cut with a serrated knife into 3 by 2 inch servings. Makes 8

title: Shu (Cream Puffs)
instructions: Boil water and add salt. Put in Crisco until melted and bring to boil
Add flour until well mixed. Cool dough
Add 1 egg at a time and mix constantly so dough does not stick on pan
Drop on parchment covered cookie sheets by tsp. Try to make lots on uneven points on dropped dough.
Bake in preheated oven at 400ºF
Allow to cool then slice in half
Cut puffs in half and cream between halves and put halves together
Sprinkle top of cream puffs with icing sugar

title: Lina’s Cream Puffs
instructions: Mix flour, oil and water and heat in saucepan and stir vigorously with wooden spoon in pan on stovetop until it clumps together.
Let mixture cool off of stovetop. Mix in eggs.
Drop by teaspoons on parchment covered cookie sheet.
Bake at 350ºF until golden and puffed.
When cooled, cut in half and add desired cream.
Put two halves together. Dust with icing sugar just before serving.

title: Teresa’s Cream Puffs
instructions: Bring eggs to room temperature either by leaving on counter a few hours or putting them in warm water for 10 minutes.
Boil water, oil and salt together in pan.
Add 2 cups flour to boiling water to form a paste and let rue cool down
Put rue in mixer with paddle
Add 5 eggs (one at a time) fully incorporating each one
Preheat oven to 400°F. Put parchment paper on two baking sheets
Form puffs – drop one teaspoonful of dough on baking sheets
Bake 30 minutes at 400 F, reduce heat to 350°F. and bake another 15 minutes.
Remove from pan and cool on racks.
Cut puffs in half and add cream or Nutella just before serving.
With sieve sprinkle tops of puffs with icing sugar.

title: Cream for Puffs

ingredients.rawText: 1/4 cup anice liquor or your favourite sweet liquor or just lemon juice
ingredients.normalizedName: anice liquor your favourite sweet liquor just lemon juice

instructions: Strain all ingredients over a small pot
Stir constantly over medium heat to boiling point
Cool completely, stirring occasionally so "skin" does not form on the hot cream
Cut the cream puffs in half and fill with the cream. Arrange on your serving tray and dust with icing sugar - voila! You are ready to enjoy.
notes: Mix together: Cream Puffs at Hunter’s Communion

title: Italian Pastry Cream
instructions: Add egg yolks, sugar and grated lemon peel or vanilla and stir until dissolved. If making chocolate cream combine cocoa with flour
Add flour to egg mixture and stir until all flour is dissolved
Put over medium heat and add milk slowly, stirring constantly
Keep at medium heat stirring constantly until pastry cream is thickened. Cool before using

title: Lemon Cream
instructions: Beat egg yolks, add sugar and mix well
Add flour and mix well then add milk slowly until all mixed
On low heat add lemon peel

title: Vanilla Cream
instructions: Mix all ingredients together
Place on burner and bring to a boil then simmer and stir constantly until cream thickens

title: Pastry Cream
instructions: Prepare package of pudding with milk following label directions
Whip 1/2 cup heavy cream until stiff then fold into pudding and cover with plastic wrap and chill.

title: Cannoli Cream

ingredients.rawText: ¼ cup semi sweet chocolate chips

instructions: In medium bowl stir dry ricotta (drain in cheesecloth if wet), sugar, citron, orange peel and cinnamon until smooth. Stir in chocolate chips.
Just before serving spoon ricotta mixture into prepared cannoli shells.
Sprinkle ends with pistachios and dust with icing sugar. Note: Cannoli shells can be made with pizzelle recipe and shaped into a roll when warm.

title: Dream Cream for Puff Pastry (Dremsnite)

ingredients.rawText: 4 tsp vanilla sugar (or substitute equal parts vanilla and sugar)

instructions: Bring evaporated milk and regular milk to a gentle boil in a double boiler.
While waiting for milk to boil, in a separate bowl, mix together the yolks, granulated sugar and vanilla sugar at medium speed with a mixer.
Add flour to the yolk mixture until blended.

Remove 2 cups of milk from the double boiler and add this milk to the flour mixture while continuously beating at low speed. When blended, return this mixture to the milk still in the double boiler and continue to cook until thick while stirring very frequently.
Mix together gelatin with the cold water, let stand for 1 minute and then add boiling water, mixing well with a fork or small whisk.
Add gelatin to your custard mixture in the double boiler and continue to cook for about 5 minutes, continually stirring as it thickens .
Cool custard in ice water when removed from heat.
In a separate bowl, beat the whipping cream until stiff peaks form.

Fold whipped cream into the cooled custard (make sure the custard has cooled to room temperature before adding the whipped cream). Refrigerate mixture for about 20 minutes so that it stiffens a bit and is easier to spread.

Trim the edges of the puff pastry sheets to fit a deep tray or baking dish. Place one layer of puff pastry on bottom. Spread evenly with custard and then place second layer of puff pastry on top, pressing down slightly.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours.
Sprinkle with powdered sugar before serving and cut into oblong piece.

Add cooled roasted almonds (if almonds are not roasted the skins will come off)
Pour into a square pan and set in refrigerator to harden
Break almonds by hand

instructions: Mix above ingredients with a wooden spoon
Form balls and roll into sugar

Repeat making at least 4 layers

Put toothpicks on top of filling and cover with saran wrap

Melt the chocolate and pour over the nut and cereal mixture
Drop onto wax paper

instructions: Combine egg yokes, sugar and salt
Slowly add milk
Cook in double boiler until mixture coats spoon

Stir into hot mixture

Add vanilla

Chocolate Wafer Crust: Combine 1 1/4 cups chocolate wafer crumbs with 1/3 cup melted butter or margarine.

Homemade chocolates: Boil water in bottom of a double boiler.
Take off the burner.
Put candy melts in top section of double boiler and place over bottom section of double boiler and set aside.

Bake in a very hot over (450ºF) for 10 minutes or until brown. Cool on racks
Spoon a small amount of Pastry Cream into each cooled shell. Decorate with fruits
Melt jelly with sugar in a small skillet over low heat; cool slightly; brush over fruits. Chill

Pour batter onto cookie sheet and spread flat

Slice and serve swirls of cake and ice cream

title: Praline Ice Cream Cake
instructions: Prepare Almond Praline as directed below. Sprinkle 3/4 cup of the praline powder over the bottom of a 10” X 2 ¾” inch springform pan

Whip cream with sugar in medium sized bowl until stiff peaks form. Spread side of layers, then with a ring of cream pressed through pastry bag.

Layer bottom of 9” X 12 “ or round glass pan with dessert topping
Dip Graham crackers in sweetened espresso coffee and layer on top of dessert topping

Drop by tsp onto a cookie sheet

3 oz or 2 cups can or box or chow mein noodles

Add marshmallows; stir until melted and well blended.

Place marshmallows in large bowl and fold in chocolate mixture

title: Easy Rum Balls
instructions: Crush wafers then add milk and vanilla and mush together with hands
Place mixture in fridge for 1 hour
Mix in walnuts then roll into small balls and coat with icing sugar.
Freeze or refrigerate. Allow 10 minutes to defrost. Makes 4 dozen

title: Rum Balls

ingredients.rawText: ¼ cup light or dark corn syrup

instructions: In a bowl, mix dry ingredients. In a separate bowl mix liquid ingredients
Mix all ingredients together until well blended
Form balls and roll into sugar
Drop on cookie sheet and let harden
Store in a cool place

title: Cool Lemon Souffle
instructions: Fold a length of heavy-duty foil in half lengthwise and long enough to go around a 4 cup soufflé dish. Fasten around dish to make a collar 2 inches above rim.
Sprinkle gelatin over water in small saucepan; let stand 10 min. to soften. Stir over low heat until gelatin is dissolved. Remove from heat and cool.
Beat eggs and sugar in a large bowl with electric mixer at high speed, until very thick and light, about 7 minutes
Beat 1 ½ cups of the cream in a medium-size bowl until stiff; refrigerate
Stir lemon rind and juice into cooled gelatin; pour mixture into egg mixture. Beat at low speed until well blended
Chill mixture over ice and water until it mounds when softly spooned

Fold in whipped cream until no streaks of white remain. Pour in prepared dish. Refrigerate at least 3 hours or until set. Remove collar gently; whip remaining cream. Garnish soufflé with cream, lemon slices and grapes

title: Sweet Maries or O’Henry Balls
instructions: Cream peanut butter and icing sugar. Add butter, fruit and nuts
Roll into teaspoon sized balls.
Dip balls in glaze made of ¼ slice parowax and 4 squares semi-sweet chocolate melted in double boiler. Put on waxed paper to set

title: Torroncini
instructions: Toast almonds
In a large pan or deep pot melt butter and marshmallows
Add chocolate chips and mix well
Add almonds (making sure they are very hot) and mix well
Pour over one wafer. Put other wafer on top
Press firmly but gently. Refrigerate for about one hour
Remove from refrigerator and cut. Return to refrigerator or freezer

title: Jelly Roll Trifle
instructions: Slice jelly-roll and place in dish to cover bottom
Sprinkle (or pour) sherry over jelly-roll
Drain fruit salad, conserving the syrup
Spread fruit salad over jelly-roll
Make Jello – use conserved syrup for the cold liquid
Pour Jello over fruit and jelly-roll layer. Refrigerate until set
Make custard according to directions on container
Spread on set Jello and allow to cool
Decorate for the occasion.
notes: Sandy V.

title: English Trifle

ingredients.rawText: 1 (18 ¼-ounce) package yellow cake mix or bought sponge cake
ingredients.normalizedName: yellow cake mix bought sponge cake

ingredients.rawText: 1 cup raspberry jam, divided or you can use your favourite jam
½ cup sherry, or brandy, divided (optional)

instructions: Prepare the yellow cake according to package directions using a 9-inch cake pan (reserve one layer for another use). Slice one baked cake layer horizontally into two equal layers.
Place one sliced layer into a trifle dish or a large glass bowl with straight sides; cover with ½ cup jam and half of the sliced peaches.
Pour approximately half of the reserved peach juice over the cake or until it is moist but not sloppy. Pour ¼ cup sherry or brandy over the top as evenly as possible.
Place second sliced cake layer on top and cover with the remaining jam and peaches then pour remaining peach juice and sherry or brandy over the top.

Prepare the vanilla pudding according to package directions, using the 3 cups of milk. Pour hot pudding over the top of the cake; let cool. When cool, spread with whipped cream. Decorate with toasted sliced almonds. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Fantastic Fruit Trifle

ingredients.rawText: Sooooo easy and a true crowd pleaser…
2 packages (4 serving size) of Instant Jello Pudding (Vanilla, Butterscotch or
Fresh fruit of the season (strawberry, kiwi, raspberry, blueberry, banana…)
Sponge cake, cut in cubes (buy it, don’t make it…)

instructions: Beat both packages of instant Jello pudding with the milk, until thick.
Stir in the cool whip.
In a glass trifle bowl, layer pieces of the cake, the fruit, then the Jello pudding mixture. Repeat until trifle bowl is full!
Top with shaved chocolate…..mmm.

title: Red, White and Blue Trifle

ingredients.rawText: 1 (18 ¼-ounce) package yellow cake mix or bought sponge cake
ingredients.normalizedName: yellow cake mix bought sponge cake

ingredients.rawText: 3 cups fresh raspberries and blueberries, divided or strawberries
½ cup sherry, or brandy, divided (optional)

instructions: Prepare the yellow cake according to package directions using a 9-inch cake pan (reserve one layer for another use).
In a large bowl, mix together berries and sugar; let set at room temperature for at least 30 minutes to let juices form.

Slice one baked cake layer horizontally into two equal layers. Place one sliced cake layer into trifle dish or large glass bowl with straight sides; cover with ½ cup raspberry jam and ½ of berries and juice.

Pour ¼ cup sherry or brandy over top, as evenly as possible. Place the second sliced cake layer on top and cover with remaining raspberry jam, berries, and berry juice; pour remaining sherry or brandy over top.

Prepare vanilla pudding according to package directions, using only 3 cups of milk. Pour hot pudding over top of the cake; let cool. When cool, spread with whipped cream. Decorate with toasted sliced almonds. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight. When ready to serve, decorate top with whole berries. Makes 10 to 12 servings.

title: Pineapple Swirl Truffle

ingredients.rawText: 2 pkg (3 oz each) vanilla pudding and pie filling
2 envelopes (2 oz each) of dessert topping mix (Dream Whip)

instructions: Drain pineapple slices
In small bowl pour ½ cup cold milk and sprinkle in the envelope of unflavoured gelatin
Follow directions on vanilla pudding and pie filling package using the 3 cups of milk
Remove from heat
Immediately add softened gelatin and stir until dissolved
Mix in 1 tbsp vanilla extract
Allow mixture to cool
Line 9 inch springform pan or better a trifle bowl with 4 pineapple slices alternated with 4 jelly-roll slices
Prepare the dessert topping mix as per the instructions
Fold whipped topping into pudding
Spoon a third of pudding into pan
Arrange a layer of jelly-roll slices over pudding
Repeat layers, ending with pudding
Top with remaining pineapple slices
Chill for 5 hours before serving
notes: Teresa R.

title: Chocolate-Orange Truffles
instructions: Combine chocolate and butter in small saucepan
Place over very low heat just until melted
Remove from heat
Stir in icing sugar until well blended
Add egg yolks one at a time
Beat in orange rind
Chill until mixture is firm enough to shape
Pipe mixture into candy cups
Refrigerate until firm

title: Valentine Easy Truffles

ingredients.rawText: Nuts, finely chopped or unsweetened cocoa powder

instructions: In a double boiler, melt chips over hot water.
Remove from heat and stir in condensed milk (Evaporated milk will not work)
Chill until firm enough to handle, about 2 hours
Form into ½“ balls and roll in nuts or cocoa
Garnish with drizzle chocolate

title: Berry Special Not Baked
instructions: Combine crumbs, sugar and margarine
Press into bottom of 9 inch pan
Bake at 325ºF for 10 minutes
Increase oven to 450ºF
Combine softened cream cheese and sugar
Mix at medium speed until well blended
Add eggs one at a time, mixing well
Blend in vanilla
Pour mixture over crust
Bake at 450ºF for 10 minutes
Reduce oven to 250ºF for 25-30 minutes
Cool or chill. Add topping before serving

title: Black Forest Cheesecake
instructions: In a small bowl, combine wafer crumbs and melted margarine.
Press into bottom on a 9" (1.5L) springform pan.

In a small saucepan, sprinkle Knox Gelatin over water. Stir over low heat until gelatin is all dissolved. Add 1/4 cup (50 mL) of the gelatin mixture to the cherry pie filling. Stir in 2 tsp. (10 mL) of almond liqueur. Pour cherry mixture over chocolate crust. Refrigerate about 30 minutes.

In a large bowl, beat cream cheese and sugar until light and fluffy then stir in sour cream. Add remaining gelatin mixture and remaining almond liqueur. Fold in whipped cream; spread over cherry base. Refrigerate until set, about 3 to 4 hours or overnight.
Remove sides of pan and garnish with chocolate curls, if desired.
notes: Margaret V.

title: Cheese Cake
instructions: Blend all ingredients together
Pour over crust
Add topping and refrigerate
notes: How to make crust: Bake 10 minutes and cool

title: Cheesecake Antoniette
instructions: Mix melted butter and crumbs and make crust
In large bowl beat 4 eggs. Add other ingredients slowly
Add ricotta and then coffeerich and mix well
Pour ingredients into pan
Bake at 300ºF - 350ºF preheated oven 1 - 1 1/2 hours
Leave in warm oven for 1 hour
Spread cherries on top when cake is cool
Refrigerate for 24 hours before serving
notes: Antoniette C.

title: Cream Cheesecake Baked

ingredients.rawText: 1 pkg white or chocolate cake mix
Fruit & Dr. Oetkers glaze or use 1 can pie filling
ingredients.normalizedName: fruit dr oetkers glaze use pie filling

instructions: Preheat oven to 300F
Reserve 1 cup of cake mix
In a bowl combine remaining mix, 1 egg and oil and press into bottom of a cream cheese and sugar crust
Add 3 eggs and the 1 cup of remaining cake mix
Beat one minute and add milk, vanilla and lemon juice
Mix until smooth
Pour into crust
Bake at 300ºF for 1 to 1 ¼ hours or until centre is firm

title: Cottage Cheesecake Baked
instructions: Filling: Preheat oven to 350ºF.
Combine crumbs, brown sugar and shortening and press over bottom and up sides of a 9” springform pan
Beat egg yokes well
Add sugar and cottage cheese, beat until smooth
Stir in sour cream, lemon rind, lemon juice, vanilla, salt and flour.
Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites.
Pour mixture into prepared crust.
8. Bake 1 ½ hours Makes 8 servings

title: Classic Chiffon Cheesecake
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºF.
In small saucepan, melt butter, stir in crumbs and sugar.
Pat crumbs firmly on bottom of buttered 9” spring-form pan.
Bake 7 minutes, cool while preparing filling. Reduce oven temperature to 300ºF.
In large mixing bowl, beat cream cheese until light and fluffy. Add sweetened condensed milk and egg yolks and beat until smooth. Stir in lemon juice then set aside.
In small bowl, beat egg whites with salt to soft peaks. Fold into milk mixture and turn into prepared pan.
Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched about 1 inch from centre. Cool slightly and chill
Remove rim of pan. If desired, top with your favourite fruit topping before serving.

title: Chocolate-Cheese Layer Cake

ingredients.rawText: 2 - 8 oz pkg cream cheese ½ tsp

instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºF
In large bowl with mixer at low speed, beat flour, cocoa, shortening, salt, baking soda, baking powder, 1 egg, 3/4 cup sugar and ½ cup water until mixed
Increase speed to high and beat 2 minutes
Pour batter into greased 9” X 3” springform pan
Bake 25-30 minutes
Cool cake pan on wire rack
In small saucepan, sprinkle gelatin over ¼ cup water and let stand for one minute. Cook until gelatin is dissolved
Separate 2 eggs
Grate 1 tsp lemon peel and squeeze 1 ½ tsp juice.
In large bowl with mixer at low speed, beat cream cheese, vanilla, lemon juice, yolks and ½ cup sugar and then beat in gelatin mixture until smooth
In small bowl, with mixer at high beat egg whites to stiff peaks
Fold whites and lemon peel into cream cheese mixture and pour into pan over cake
Cover and refrigerate for 3 hours
Chocolate Wedges: Remove side of pan to prepare for Chocolate Wedges
Cover side of dessert with grated chocolate.
Mark then cut dessert into 12 wedges
Garnish with strawberries and chocolate wedges
notes: Teresa R.

title: Cheese Cake Unbaked
instructions: Make the Jello first and refrigerate
Mix cream cheese & cool whip together until there are no lumps
Add icing sugar, mix well.
Add Jello
Pour into crusts
Refrigerate until set
When the Jello sets, add the topping of your choice Jello liquid.
notes: Jennifer Mazzeo. Tip: If you want to make one cheesecake, do not forget to add only half the

title: Frozen Chocolate Cheese Cake
instructions: Combine crumbs, sugar and butter; spread in bottom of 9 inch spring form pan and chill.
In large bowl beat cream cheese until smooth.
Gradually beat in condensed milk and chocolate syrup.
Dissolve instant coffee in hot water; add to cheese mixture. Blend thoroughly.
In separate bowl whip cream until stiff peaks form. Fold gently into cream cheese mixture.
Pour into spring form pan; freeze (at least 6 hours) until ready to serve. Serve frozen. Garnish with shaved chocolate.

title: Light Lemon Cottage Cheesecake

ingredients.rawText: 2 cups Gay Lea Real Whipped Cream

instructions: Sprinkle gelatin over lemon juice to soften; set aside
Combine egg yolks and milk in top double boiler
Cook over simmering water, stirring until mixture thickens slightly
Remove from heat
Stir in gelatin mixture until it dissolves
Add sugar, vanilla, cottage cheese and lemon zest
Chill, stirring occasionally until mixture mounds when dropped from a spoon
Combine graham cracker crumbs, melted butter, cinnamon and nutmeg and press into 9“ spring form pan
Fold whipping cream into cottage cheese mixture
Chill until set for at least 4 hours or overnight
Garnish with chocolate curls and/or lemon slices

title: Pistacchio Dessert
instructions: Mix first 4 ingredients, press into ungreased 9 x 13 inch pan.
Bake for 15 minutes; let cool.
Mix remaining ingredients; pour ½ mixture over first mixture and let cool.
Beat together 2 boxes pistachio instant pudding and 1 ½ cups cold milk; let thicken. Pour over second layer.
Spread remaining Cool Whip over top.

title: Low Calorie Cheesecake
instructions: Combine lemon juice, water and gelatin for 10 seconds in a blender
Add egg and sugar and blend briefly
In a saucepan, heat milk just to boiling point
Add to egg mixture with vanilla and blend until combined
Add cottage cheese, blend at highest speed until creamy, about 30 secs.
Pour cheese mixture into prepared crust and refrigerate until firm.
7. Top with fresh fruit just before serving. Makes eight servings

title: Luscious Turtle Cheesecake
instructions: Filling: In bowl, stir together graham crackers, pecans, butter and sugar until well combined.
Press into bottom and up sides of 9 inch springform pan.
Bake in 300 degree oven for 12 minutes or until golden and firm.
Refrigerate until chilled.
In large bowl, using electric mixer, beat cream cheese, sugar and vanilla until smooth.
Beat in eggs, one at a time and flour.
Gradually beat in evaporated milk and sour cream.
Stir in Turtles and pour over prepared crust.
Bake in 350 degree oven for 25 minutes.
Cover loosely with foil and bake 30-40 minutes or until edge is set and centre jiggles.
Let cool in pan on rack at room temperature. Run small knife around edge of pan and remove pan side.
notes: Filling Directions :

title: Pumpkin Cheesecake

ingredients.rawText: 2 lbs cream cheese, at room temperature
2 cups canned or fresh pumpkin puree

instructions: To make crust: Generously grease a 9 inch springform pan
Combine crumbs, sugar, cinnamon, nutmeg and melted butter in a bowl until well blended
Press crumb mixture as evenly as possible onto bottom and sides of pan
Chill pan while making filling
To make filling: In a large bowl with electric beater, mix cream cheese with sugar until fluffy and light
Beat in flour and seasonings; add eggs one at a time until blended (A wooden spoon and a strong arm may be used instead of electric beater)
Fold in the pumpkin puree
Pour mixture into the prepared crust
Bake cheesecake in a preheated oven (325ºF) for one hour and 15 minutes or until firm around edges (cake will be soft in middle)
Turn off the heat; open oven door and let cake stand in oven for 30 minutes
Remove to a wire rack and let cool another hour
Chill two hours or overnight, loosely covered, in refrigerator
Remove sides of springform pan and garnish with whipped cream and grapes or whole nuts Serves 10-12
notes: To serve :

title: Classic Italian Tiramisu

ingredients.rawText: 1/4 cup dark rum or Marsala wine

instructions: Beat egg yolks with sugar until creamy and pale yellow.
Add mascarpone cheese and whisk gently until smooth and velvety.
In a clean dry bowl, beat egg whites with a pinch of salt until stiff peaks form.
Gently fold beaten egg whites into mascarpone cream with a spatula using top-to-bottom strokes.
Combine espresso coffee and rum in a shallow bowl.
Quickly dunk Savoiardi biscuits one by one in the espresso mix and arrange a layer in the bottom of a rectangular glass dish.
Spread half of the mascarpone cream over the biscuits and sprinkle with grated dark chocolate.
Add a second layer of dipped ladyfingers, top with remaining cream, and smooth the surface.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours (preferably overnight).
Generously dust with unsweetened cocoa powder just before serving cold.
notes: Four family variations in the cookbook (Rita, Lina, Teresa, and Classic) celebrate this beloved dessert.

title: Tiramisu Lina
instructions: Separate eggs and beat whites until stiff then add egg yolks and sugar and beat again. Blend mascarpone cheese into these ingredients until smooth and creamy. Add Tia Maria and stir.
Dip lady fingers one by one in coffee and place in rectangular dish.
Cover lady fingers with cheese mixture. Sprinkle with powdered cocoa.
Repeat until ingredients are finished. Top off with powdered cocoa and shaved chocolate (optional). Serve well chilled.
notes: Lina F.

title: Tiramisu Rita
instructions: Mix sugar and eggs together in a bowl.
Add and mix mascarpone until creamy.
In another bowl beat egg whites until stiff peaks form, add sugar, eggs and cheese mixture.
Put 1/3 of mixture in glass tray, slightly rounded.
Combine coffee and rum in bowl. Dip savoiardi in coffee mixture and put on cheese mixture, sprinkle with chocolate.
Repeat steps above until top of plate is reached.
Sprinkle top layer of cheese mixture with grated chocolate.
Refrigerate for 6 hours, serve cold.
notes: Rita V.

title: Tiramisu Teresa
instructions: Separate egg yolks from egg whites
Beat egg yolks with sugar and mascarpone cheese
Beat egg whites in separate bowl until fluffy
Fold beaten egg whites into the cream and blend together with spatula
Put espresso coffee into bowl with 4-5 spoonfuls of sugar
Dip each savoiardi cookie into coffee and line them standing up around pan and flat at the bottom.
Spread half of cream on top of bottom cookie layer.
Place another layer of coffee dipped cookies on top of cream.
Pour remaining cream on top of second cookie layer
Sprinkle cocoa or shaved chocolate on top.
notes: Teresa R.

title: Walnut Cream Crescent Rolls

ingredients.rawText: 1 pkg 125 g (4 oz) cream cheese softened

instructions: Heat oven to 375ºF
Lightly grease cookie sheet
In a small bowl combine cream cheese, 1/2 cup icing sugar and walnuts and set aside
Combine 2 tbsp icing sugar and sugar
Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles.
Dip 1 side of each triangle in icing sugar/sugar mixture
Spread 1 rounded tbsp cream cheese mixture over unsugared side of each triangle
Roll up, starting at shortest side of triangle and rolling to opposite point
Place rolls point side down on greased cookie sheet
Curve each into crescent shapes
Bake for 11-15 minutes or until golden brown
Sprinkle with any remaining icing sugar/sugar mixture

title: Apple Pie Bruna

ingredients.rawText: 1 unbaked ready made 9 inch piecrust 1 cup dark raisins (optional)
ingredients.normalizedName: unbaked ready made inch piecrust dark raisins

ingredients.rawText: 6 medium baking apples, peeled, cored, and thinly sliced (about 2 lb)

instructions: Glaze: Spray a 9 inch deep dish pie plate with vegetable cooking spray
In a large bowl, combine brown sugar, granulated sugar, flour, lemon peel, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Mix well
Add apples to sugar mixture and stir until coated. Stir in raisins. Spoon into prepared plate
Place piecrust on top of filling. Trim edges pressing against edge of pan. Using a sharp knife, cut steam vents in piecrust.
To glaze, brush beaten egg lightly on piecrust. Sprinkle with sugar
Bake until piecrust is golden brown about 35-40 minutes at 425ºF.
Remove from oven and place on a wire rack and cool for 30 min. Serve warm.

title: Fresh Peach Pie
instructions: Combine sugar, flour, cinnamon and salt in a small bowl
Drop peaches into boiling water for 15 seconds; drain, peel, halve, pit and slice into a large bowl. Sprinkle with lemon juice and almond extract then toss to coat. Add sugar mixture then mix gently
Prepare pie crust mix following label directions. Roll out 2/3 to 12 inch round on a lightly floured surface and fit into a 9 inch pie plate. Trim edge to a 1 inch overhang. Spoon in filling

Roll out remaining pastry to an 11 inch round pan then cut into 10 strips. Weave strips over top of pie pressing strips firmly to bottom crust. Turn edges under flush with rim; press to make a stand-up edge flute. Flush pastry with milk or water, sprinkle with sugar
Bake in a hot oven (425ºF) for 15 minutes. Lower heat to moderate (350ºF); bake 35 minutes longer or until pastry is golden brown and juices are bubbly. Cool

title: Apple Pie
instructions: Mix above ingredients into mixing bowl
Roll on counter top until dough is soft but can be picked up without breaking
Place on pie plate and pour in desired filling (sliced apples with lemon juice or sugar and cinnamon)
Bake at 450ºF for 15 minutes then 350ºF for 1/2 hour more
notes: Crust Bride’s pastry (electric mixer pastry)

title: Pear Tart
instructions: Cream butter and sugar. Add yolks
Mix in ground almonds and flour into dough and blend rapidly
Turn the dough into a ball and cut into 4 equal pieces.
Place the pieces on top of one another
Press them together and repeat the cutting, stacking and pressing 3 more times.
Wrap the dough in plastic and chill for 1 hour

Preheat oven to 400ºF. Butter a 10 inch tart pan with removable bottom. On a lightly floured surface, roll out dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch and transfer it to the pan. Line the pan with a sheet of aluminum foil, fill with dried beans and for weight and bake 20 minutes.
Remove foil and beans and bake 3 minutes until crust is golden.
While crust is baking, peel, core and cut pears into large cubes.
Melt butter in skillet over a medium flame. Sauté the pears until they are tender.
Sprinkle with sugar and continue to cook until caramelized
Place the filling in the crust.
Brown the almonds for 1 minute under the broiler
Sprinkle sliced almonds over the tart
Serve warm Yum Yum

title: Ricotta Pie Crostata di Ricotta

ingredients.rawText: 3/4 lb (300 gr) ricotta cheese, drained of its water in a colander
2 oz (60 gr) pine nuts soaked in warm water and drained
ingredients.normalizedName: pine nuts soaked in warm water drained

instructions: Preparing the dough: Pour the flour on a work surface in a mound shape with a hole in the centre.
Add in the well the sugar, diced butter, one whole egg, one egg yolk, vanilla, and pinch of salt.
Mix ingredients, combine the flour and knead to form a smooth dough.
Shape like a smooth ball, cover with a plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator for about one hour.
Preparing the filling: Separate yolks from whites and reserve the whites.
In a bowl put ricotta cheese, sugar, egg yolks, and mix together to obtain a smooth cream. Stir in “amaretti” crumbs, rum, candied fruit, and raisins.
Beat the reserved egg whites in a bowl until stiff. Combine egg whites to the mix, stirring gently with a top to bottom motion.

Assembling the cake: Preheat oven 375°F. (190°C.) Butter a 10“ pan with removable bottom, and sprinkle with a small amount of flour. Remove the dough from the refrigerator. Cut one third of the dough and reserve.
Reduce the dough to ¼” (0.5 cm) thick disk with the help of a rolling pin.
Place the dough over the pan and cover bottom and sides of the pan with the dough, trimming the dough evenly around the edges.
Prick the surface of the pastry evenly with a fork. This step is necessary to prevent the dough from puffing while baking.
Fill with the ricotta cheese mixture and level with a spatula.
Reduce rest of the dough to ¼” (0.5 cm) thick and cut strips ¾” (2 cm) wide. Place the strips on the cake, crossing them in a diamond shape.
One last strip is placed as a closure all around the border of the pan.
Prepare the egg wash lightly beating the egg white and the milk together in a small bowl. Brush the egg wash on the dough strips.
Bake for about 35-40 minutes.
Let the cake cool at room temperature and un-mould. Serve lukewar
notes: Roman Ricotta Cake For the dough:

title: Prostitute Pie

ingredients.rawText: 1 pkg (4 portions of instant chocolate pudding)
ingredients.normalizedName: 1 pkg (4 portions of instant chocolate pudding)

instructions: Mix together and press firmly into 9” X 13 “ pan
Bake at 350ºF for 25 minutes and let cool 1st Layer: 1 cup of icing sugar 1 cup of cool whip 1 - 8 oz pkg softened cream cheese
Mix together and spread on top of crust
2nd Layer: Mix above ingredients until thick and spread over top of 1st layer 3rd Layer : 1 pkg (4 portions) of instant vanilla pudding 1 ½ cups milk
Mix together until thick. Spread over top of 2nd layer
Spread remainder of Cool Whip on top of 3rd layer.
Shave chocolate bar with cheese grater on top of Cool Whip
Refrigerate at least 12 hours. Called Prostitute pie because it’s delicious to lick, not cheap but easy and fun.
PUMPKIN PIE Mike’s Favourite: Mix all together and pour into pie shell
Bake at 350ºF for 35-40 minutes
notes: Crust: ¼ lb melted butter

title: Rum Cream Pie

ingredients.rawText: ½ cup rum or Fruit Cured Demara

instructions: Beat egg yokes with sugar until light and fluffy.
In saucepan, soak gelatin in water and bring to a boil
Add to egg mixture and cool
Add rum to whipped cream and fold into egg mixture
Pour into pie shells and sprinkle with almonds or chocolate
Serve when chilled

title: Sex in a Pan Monica

ingredients.rawText: 8 oz cream cheese at room temperature 1 cup of icing sugar
ingredients.normalizedName: cream cheese at room temperature icing sugar

instructions: To make crust :
Grease pie pan and mix together flour, butter and chopped nuts.
Spread mixture in the bottom of the pan and pat down.
Bake 10 - 12 minutes at 350ºF and cool. To make Pie Filling :
Combine cream cheese, icing sugar and ½ of cool whip and spread over cooled crust. To make topping :
Blend chocolate pudding and milk.
Layer the chocolate mixture over the pie filling mixture.
Place the remaining cool whip on top of the chocolate mixture.

Sprinkle shavings of chocolate over the top of the final whip cream addition. SEX IN A PAN ORNELLA Ornella Fusco 1 cup ground pecans 135 gram (3 cups) pkg vanilla 1 cup flour prepared instant pudding ½ cup butter, melted 135 grams (3 cups) pkg chocolate 1 L Cool Whip Pudding 8 oz Philadelphia Cream Cheese 5 cups milk (2½ cups per pkg) 1 cup icing sugar
Mix pecans, butter and flour, press into pan.
Bake in a 350ºF oven for 25 minutes, cool.
Combine cheese, icing sugar and 1 cup whipped cream, spread over baked crust.
Prepare pudding with 2 ½ cups milk (package calls for 3 cups), but use 2 ½ cups; let set for 15 minutes.
Spread chocolate pudding first, followed by vanilla over cheese filling, top with remaining Cool Whip.
notes: Monica M.

title: Shortbread Tarts with Cheese and Fruit
instructions: Shortbread Tarts: Mix ingredients with mix master.
Do not roll but pat into muffin tins with your fingers to form shells.
Prick bottoms with a fork, bake for 20 minutes in a 350ºF oven.
During baking time, prick bottoms again if the shells puff up. Tip:* These may be made in large quantity and frozen.
In small bowl beat cream cheese until fluffy.
Gradually beat in milk; stir in lemon juice and vanilla.
Fill tarts at least 2 hours before serving to allow flavours to blend.
Top with fresh fruit (kiwi and strawberries) or put a dab of blueberry or cherry pie filling on each tart.
notes: 4 dozen (1 ½ inch diameter) Cheese and fruit filling: Cheese & Fruit Filling:

title: Crepes, French Toast & Pancakes Crêpes

ingredients.rawText: ¼ cup fructose or powdered sugar

instructions: Combine flour, sugar and salt.
In small bowl mix eggs, milk and melted butter.
Combine wet and dry ingredients. Beat until mixture is smooth.
Brush frying pan with melted butter. Pour in small amount of batter; turn pan so that batter runs over and covers bottom of pan completely.

Cook until undersurface is golden brown, about 1 minute. Turn and brown other side, about 1 minute. Fill with canned peach slices and whipped cream, or Ricotta Cheese Filling for Palacinke below. with crêpes. each one with a sheet of waxed paper. Wrap in aluminum foil and freeze. To use, allow crêpes to thaw completely without unwrapping.
notes: Blueberry Syrup : Simmer until berries are broken down some. Delicious Tip: Crêpes may be prepared ahead of time. Pile cooled crêpes, separating

title: Ricotta Cheese Filling for Palacinke
instructions: Mix ricotta, egg, 8 tbsp sugar and raisins together.
Put on top of crepes and roll.
Place seam side down on greased cookie sheet.
Mix sour cream with sugar and pour over rolled crepes.
Bake 20 minutes in 350°F. oven
Serve warm sprinkled with vanilla sugar. follow procedure above.
notes: Tip: *Alternative Rosehip jam filling. Just fill crepes with Rosehip jam and

title: Palacinke Crepes
instructions: Note: * very fine corn flour, **white rice flour can be found in Bulk Barn.
Mix all the ingredients well in a bowl.
Put 1 tsp oil in a frying pan and put on stove to heat up. When oil is heated, place desired amount of batter in pan and cook.
Flip it over and bake other side. Remove from pan and place on platter.*** Remember to put 1 tsp oil in pan every time before pouring in batter. This is the same as for regular crepes.
Fill the crepes with jam or desired filling and roll.
For a palacinke meal roll several of them with any filling and place them in a baking pan.
Spread sour cream on top and bake it until it has the desired color.
notes: Fig. 1 Palacinke batter in bowl & frying pan. Fig. 2 Palacinke on a platter.

title: French Toast

ingredients.rawText: 8 – 1 inch thick diagonally cut slices French or Italian bread

instructions: Beat eggs. Add vanilla, milk, cinnamon. Beat well and set aside.
Heat skillet and spray with non stick spray
Dip bread slices into the egg
Place bread slices in skillet
Cook until golden brown turning once.

title: French Toast Mary F.
instructions: Butter 9”X13” pan.
Arrange slices in pan.
In bowl combine eggs, milk, cream, vanilla, cinnamon and nutmeg.
Mix well and pour over bread slices.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Next day . Preheat oven to 350ºF
In a small bowl, combine butter, sugar and corn syrup.

Place muffin tray into oven and bake for 10 minutes (or until golden).
Once golden, take tray out from oven and let cool for 5 minutes then place each French toast cup/shell onto plate.
Add berry combination of your choice into each cup until full, pour syrup/chocolate sauce on top of berries, sprinkle on a pinch of icing sugar if desired.

title: Baking Powder Old Fashioned Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 450°F.
In large bowl, combine flour, baking powder and salt.
Using pastry blender or fork, cut in shortening until like coarse meal.
Add milk and stir with fork just until a soft dough forms. Turn dough onto floured surface and sprinkle lightly with flour.
Knead gently 10 to 12 times until no longer sticky.
Roll or press dough to ½-inch thickness; cut with 2-inch floured cutter. (or roll dough into a log and slice and roll each slice into a ball)
Place biscuits 2 inches apart for soft sides or 1 inch apart for crusty sides on ungreased cookie sheet.
Bake at 450ºF. for 8 to 12 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve immediately. Makes 12-15 biscuits.

title: Banbury Tea Tarts
instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºF.
In a large bowl, cream butter and sugar together thoroughly. Add eggs, current, lemon zest, and lemon juice, stirring to mix well; set aside.

Prepare pie pastry. Roll out the pastry dough 1/8-inch thick. Tarts may be made any size. For conventional muffin pans, cut out circles with a tuna can which has both ends cut off. For miniature muffin pans, use a tomato paste can to cut out the rounds. Place pastry in the muffin pans, smoothing the dough so it has no bumps.
Stir filling mixture. Using a teaspoon, fill the tarts 2/3 full. NOTE : Do not let the filling spill onto the pan as it will make the tarts hard to remove.

Bake miniature tarts approximately 15 to 20 mins. or until pastry is light brown. Remove from oven, remove from muffin pans, and cool on rack. make about 9 dozen tiny tarts. They freeze beautifully between plastic wrap. These Banbury Tea Tarts are best when served slightly warmed either in a microwave or regular oven. Serve with tea, of course!

instructions: Blend four, baking powder, baking soda, and salt in a bowl.
Cut in lard with a pastry blender or two knives until particles are the size of rice kernels. Add buttermilk and stir with a fork only until dough follows fork.
Gently form dough into a ball and put on lightly floured surface. Knead lightly with fingertips 10 to 15 times. Gently roll dough ½ inch thick.

Cut with a floured biscuit cutter or knife, using an even pressure to keep sides of biscuits straight. Place on ungreased baking sheet, close together for soft-sided biscuits or 1 inch apart for crusty ones. Brush tops lightly with buttermilk.
Bake at 450°F. for 10 to 15 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown. Makes 1 dozen biscuits enough milk to equal ¾ cups liquid and let stand for ½ hour before using

title: Popover Biscuits
instructions: Heat oven to 450°F.
Generously grease (not oil) popover pans or muffin cups. If not greased dough will stick to paper or pan.
In small bowl, beat eggs slightly. Add remaining ingredients and beat just until blended. (Do not overbeat)
Fill prepared cups half full (about 13 cup) of batter.
Bake at 450°F. for 15 minutes; reduce oven temperature to 325ºF and bake 25 to 30 minutes or until deep golden brown.
Serve immediately. If desired, serve from baking cups.
notes: Makes 6 or 7 large popovers.

title: Raisin Tea Biscuits
instructions: Preheat oven to 220ºc
Combine flour, baking powder, sugar, salt and raisins
Cut in shortening quite finely
Add milk all at once, stirring with a fork to make a soft slightly sticky dough
Turn out onto lightly floured surface and knead lightly 10 times
Roll out about 1 cm thick and cut with a 6 or 7 cm round cookie cutter
Bake 10 - 12 minutes Makes 16-18 biscuits

title: Best Blueberry Muffins

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 cup chilled butter or margarine, cut into 1/4-inch pieces

instructions: Preheat oven to 400ºF. Lightly grease a muffin pan.

In a large bowl, combine flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt. With a pastry blender or two knives, cut in butter or margarine until particles are the size of small peas; make a well in the centre. In a small bowl, combine eggs and milk and add it all at once to the well in flour mixture and stirring just until moistened. Fold in orange zest and blueberries.
Fill prepared muffin cups 2/3 full. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven and immediately remove from pan.

Serve warm or at room temperature. Yields 12 muffins. NOTE: If using fresh blueberries , dust them lightly with flour; this helps prevent the blueberries from "bleeding" into the muffins. If using frozen blueberries , add them frozen to the batter; this will help prevent them from "bleeding" out their juices.

title: Cranberry Mini Muffins
instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºF. Spray a mini-muffin pan.

In a large bowl, whisk together butter and sugar. Add eggs and almond extract; continue whisking until blended. Add flour and continue to whisk until well blended. Using a spoon, mix in cranberries and pecans.
Fill each cup of prepared mini-muffin pan 1/2 full of cranberry dough.
Bake 30 minutes. Makes 48 mini muffins

title: Muffins Delfina
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in bowl.
Beat eggs, add milk, oil and fruit. Mix together with flour mixture.
Evenly put mixture into muffin tins.
Bake in a 400ºF oven for 20 minutes.
notes: Delfina M.

title: Apple Biscuit Scones

ingredients.rawText: 2 apples, peeled, cored, sliced, and diced

instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºF. Grease a cookie sheet. In a large bowl, sift flour and baking powder together. With a pastry blender or two knives, cut butter into flour until particles resemble coarse crumbs.

Stir in diced apples, sugar, and golden raisins. Stir in beaten egg until dough is soft. NOTE: If the batter appears too soft, slowly add an additional 1/4 cup of flour until dough reaches desired consistency.
Place amount of dough on cookie sheet to fit desired scone size. Sprinkle brown sugar on the top of each scone.
Bake until risen and golden brown, about 8 to 15 minutes depending on size. Remove from oven, let cool. Serve with apple butter.

title: Butterscotch-Ginger Holiday Tea Scones

ingredients.rawText: 1/4 cup candied ginger bits (or diced candied ginger)

instructions: Preheat oven to 350ºF.
In a large bowl, mix flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt together.
In a mixing bowl, blend buttermilk, egg, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Fold in butterscotch morsels and candied ginger bits; add mixture to the flour mixture.

With floured hands, pat dough to a 3/4-inch thickness onto a floured board. With a floured cutter of your desired shape, cut out and place 1- inch apart on a parchment paper lined or a lightly greased and floured baking sheet. If a drop scone is preferred, use 1/4 cup and place as instructed above.

Lightly brush the top of the scones with the egg wash. Extra cinnamon- sugar may also be sprinkled on top to taste. Bake 12 to 18 minutes until lightly golden brown. Baking time will vary according to the size of your scone. Makes 12 full size scones or 24 small size scones flavoured extracts, chocolate chips, coconut flakes, fruits, herbs, raisins, savouries and spices to taste.

title: Cherry Scones

ingredients.rawText: 1/3 cup chilled unsalted butter, cut into 1/4-inch pieces
1/2 cup fresh or frozen pitted sour cherries, drained

instructions: Preheat oven to 375ºF. Lightly spray a large baking sheet with vegetable oil cooking spray.

In a large bowl, combine flour, 1/3 cup sugar, baking powder, and salt. With a pastry blender or two knives, cut butter into flour mixture until particles are the size of small peas now stir in dates.
Add 1 egg, beaten, vanilla extract, and whipping cream; stir just until mixed. NOTE: When making scones, work the dough quickly and do not over mix.
On a lightly floured surface, knead dough gently. Pat or roll out the dough into a circle 1/2-inch thick.
To make wedge-shaped scones, cut into 8 pieces. Use a 1 1/2-inch diameter cookie cutter to cut out centre of circle. Separate each section. Place wedges 1 1/2 inches apart onto prepared baking sheet.
Make a small indentation in centre of each scone. Place about 1 tbsp cherries in the indentation. Brush scones, except for the cherries, with the egg and sprinkle with 2 tbsp sugar.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven and serve warm. Yields 8 scones.

title: Date Drop Scones

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 cup chilled unsalted butter, cut into 1/4-inch pieces

instructions: Preheat oven to 425ºF. Lightly spray a large baking sheet with vegetable oil cooking spray.

In a large bowl, sift together flour, sugar, baking powder, salt, baking soda and nutmeg. With a pastry blender or two knives, cut butter into flour mixture until particles are the size of small peas; stir in dates.
Add egg and buttermilk; stir just until mixed. NOTE: When making scones, work the dough quickly and do not over mix.
Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls onto prepared baking sheet, 2 inches apart to allow for spreading, making 10 mounds.
Bake 15 to 18 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven and serve warm. Yields 10 scones.

title: Irish Scones
instructions: Mix flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda and salt in a bowl.
Cut in shortening with a pastry blender or two knives until particles are the size of rice kernels.

Turn dough onto a floured surface and knead lightly with fingertips about 8 times, Divide dough in half and shape each into a round about 12 inches thick. Cut each round into 6 or 8 wedge shaped pieces. Place on an ungreased baking sheet.
Bake at 450ºF for 8 to 10 minutes. Serve warm. Makes 1 dozen scones

title: Rich Scones

Split and butter. Yield: 12 scone

title: Scotch Scones

Add remaining ingredients, stirring until dough clings together.
On well-floured surface, toss dough lightly until no longer sticky.
Knead dough in half.
Pat each ball of dough to a 6 inch circle with top slightly rounded.
Brush surface with milk and sprinkle with sugar.
Cut each circle into 6 wedges. Place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet.
Bake at 425ºF. for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown. Serve hot with margarine or butter, honey, raspberry or strawberry jam. Makes 12 scones

title: Wonderful Scones

ingredients.rawText: 1/2 cup chilled unsalted butter, cut into 1/4-inch pieces

instructions: Preheat oven to 450ºF. Spray a large baking sheet with vegetable oil cooking spray. In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt. With a pastry blender or two knives, cut butter into flour mixture until particles are the size of small peas; stir in raisins. In a medium bowl, beat 2 eggs lightly with 1 cup milk. Add to flour mixture and stir just until mixed.

On a lightly floured surface, knead dough gently. Pat or roll out the dough into a circle 1/2-inch thick. Using a lightly greased and floured 3- inch biscuit cutter, cut into rounds, cutting close together to generate as few scraps as possible. Dip cutter into flour as often as necessary to keep dough from sticking. Push scraps of dough together so that edges join; firmly pinch edges with fingertips to make a partial seal. Pat this remaining dough to 1/2-inch thick; continue to cut 3-inch rounds. Space 1-inch apart onto prepared baking sheet. NOTE: When making scones, work the dough quickly and do not over mix.
In a small bowl, combine 1 egg and 1 tablespoon milk; brush onto scones. Bake 15 to 18 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from oven and serve warm. Yields 12 to 14 scones.

title: Low Carb Bagels

ingredients.rawText: 1 1/2 cups Wholesome Yum Blanched Almond Flour
2 1/2 cups Mozzarella cheese (shredded; must be either pre-shredded OR

ingredients.normalizedName: wholesome yum coconut flour baking powder

instructions: OPTIONAL: Preheat oven to 375ºF (190ºC). Line baking sheet with parchment paper.

In food processor, process the almond flour (or coconut flour) and baking powder, until uniform. (Alternatively, you can mix them together in a bowl if you want to make the bagels by hand, without a food processor. However, you’ll get taller, fluffier bagels using the food processor method.)
Add the eggs to the food processor. Process until uniform. Set aside.
In large bowl, combine the shredded mozzarella and cubed cream cheese.

Microwave for 2 minutes, stirring halfway through. Stir again at the end until well incorporated. (If you don't want to use the microwave, heat the cheeses in a double boiler on the stove over low heat, stirring frequently, until completely melted and easy to stir.)

Transfer the cheeses into the food processor, positioning them so that the blade is sticking into the cheese. Working quickly while the cheese is hot, pulse until a uniform dough forms. (Alternatively, you can knead with your hands if not using a food processor. The dough will be very sticky, but keep kneading and squeezing through your fingers for a few minutes. If the dough becomes hard before fully mixed, is too difficult to mix, or is still sticky after a couple minutes, you can microwave/reheat for 15-20 seconds to soften it. In that case, wash your hands and knead again.)
No matter what method you use, it's very important for the dough to be completely uniform before proceeding to the next step. You shouldn't have pieces of cheese separate from areas of flour.

Form the dough into a ball and divide it into 6 parts. Form or roll a long log with each part, then press the parts together to make a bagel shape and place onto the lined baking sheet. Repeat with the remaining dough.

If you want to add toppings, such as sesame seeds or everything seasoning, spray the bagels lightly with cooking spray first. Then, sprinkle the toppings over the bagels and gently press into the dough.
Bake Keto bagels for about 15 minutes, until firm and golden brown.
Let bagels cool15 minutes, or completely, to improve their inner texture.
